Look at sdks\agent this is the agent sdk That is written on top of sdks\codeboltjs which connects with packages\server\src\cliLib the agent sdk is handling te whole loop. This is kind of while loop with tools exposed added to llm function call. There is one thread and everytime the user sends a message a new agent process is spawned. Now for the thread continuity, i have done that the context stack is at thread level so when user stops agent and again sends message, then it starts from that context. Now i have async tasks like command which can keep on running. I have put an event kind of thing that in the loop when the async task is started then it returns the id of task and when the tas is done it gets an events which it adds to the context at end of loop. If there is no waiting task then the loop ends. Please check and Tell me what is happening exactly

scope: implementing and reasoning about long-running terminal commands across `packages/server`, `packages/types`, and `sdks/codeboltjs`, especially when CLI calls should yield, later resolve via status/wait APIs, and inject completion back into the agent loop

### keywords

## Task 2: map background terminal completion onto the agent-loop external-event drain, outcome success

### rollout_summary_files

- rollout_summaries/2026-06-15T07-08-34-DBvq-terminal_long_running_async_background_command_lifecycle.md (cwd=\\?\D:\Codeboltapps\CodeBolt, rollout_path=C:\Users\utksh\.codex\sessions\2026\06\15\rollout-2026-06-15T12-38-34-019eca1c-5179-7a71-af88-ae5083cae848.jsonl, updated_at=2026-06-15T11:12:02+00:00, thread_id=019eca1c-5179-7a71-af88-ae5083cae848, cross-repo comparison plus queue-drain alignment)

### keywords

- getPendingExternalEvents, backgroundCommandCompletion, agentQueueEvent, act-updated, terminalCommandWaitResponse, terminalCommandStatusResponse, gh api repos/openai/codex/git/trees/main?recursive=1

## User preferences

- when the user said long-running commands in the CLI "keeps on waiting" -> treat long-running terminal work as a distinct lifecycle, not just a slow foreground call [Task 1]
- when the user said "small running commands we might need to get the response, but for long running response we might need to run it in background" -> default to a foreground/background split when a terminal action can outlive a normal tool turn [Task 1]
- when the user said "if soemone is using api, then async resolution should anyways be there" -> expose first-class async completion for SDK/API users, not only UI callbacks or a forever-open promise [Task 1]
- when the user asked to compare multiple public repos on "small and long running tasks" -> tie the local design to concrete lifecycle mechanisms in other agent CLIs rather than stopping at a generic concept sketch [Task 2]

## Reusable knowledge

- `packages/server/src/sockets/aiTerminal.ts` already had a long-running heuristic before the patch: port scanning every 10 seconds and an LLM-based fallback after `COMMAND_ANALYSIS_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000` to decide whether a command should yield into the background [Task 1]
- The durable background-command design here is a managed in-memory registry keyed by `processId`, plus waiters, final status, and output tail, so later `status` / `wait` queries can resolve even after the PTY is cleaned up [Task 1]
- Background completion now flows through `eventName: 'backgroundCommandCompletion'` and should be treated as an external agent event rather than an extension of the original tool call [Task 1][Task 2]
- `packages/server/src/cliLib/terminalService.cli.ts` is the CLI/server bridge, `sdks/codeboltjs/src/modules/terminal.ts` is the SDK-facing API, and `sdks/codeboltjs/src/tools/terminal/*` is the LLM tool surface; all three must move together when terminal lifecycle semantics change [Task 1]
- The relevant terminal management actions are `terminalCommandsList`, `terminalCommandStop`, `terminalCommandOutput`, `terminalCommandStatus`, and `terminalCommandWait`, with paired `...Response` message types [Task 1]
- `D:\Codeboltapps\codeboltjs\agents\act-updated\src\index.ts` drains `eventQueue.getPendingExternalEvents()` before and after tool execution, which is the right async prompt-injection point for terminal completion events [Task 2]
- `sdks/codeboltjs/src/modules/agentEventQueue.ts` now acknowledges drained `agentQueueEvent`s when `getPendingExternalEvents()` / `checkForPendingExternalEvent()` consume them, preventing repeated delivery of the same queue-backed event [Task 2]

## Failures and how to do differently

- full `packages/server` typecheck is a noisy gate in this checkout; future validation should filter compiler output for touched files and rely on focused package builds plus touched-package typechecks instead of the whole server tree [Task 1]
- Windows/Git permission noise (`unable to access 'C:\Users\utksh/.config/git/ignore': Permission denied`) makes `git status` less trustworthy than direct symbol inspection and package builds during this workflow [Task 1]
- GitHub web/code search was not a reliable comparison path; the productive external search pattern was `gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/git/trees/main?recursive=1` plus local `rg` on the returned tree [Task 2]
- Broad repository inspection was too noisy; narrow on `getPendingExternalEvents`, `waitForAnyExternalEvent`, `command`, `pty`, and `background` when mapping async terminal patterns [Task 2]

# Task Group: CodeBolt performance triage, render churn, and indexing bottlenecks

    private async executeTools(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ToolExecutionOutcome> {
        const llmResponse = input.rawLLMOutput;
        const lastMessageContent = this.extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse);
        const toolCalls = this.getToolCalls(llmResponse);

        if (toolCalls.length === 0) {
            await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(lastMessageContent);

            return {
                toolResults: [],
                followUpMessages: [],
                completed: true,
                finalMessage: lastMessageContent,
                hadToolCalls: false,
            };
        }

        const parsedToolCalls = toolCalls.map((tool) => this.parseToolCall(tool));
        const completionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );
        const executionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            !toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );

        if (this.loopDetectionService) {
            for (const toolCall of executionToolCalls) {
                const loopDetected = this.loopDetectionService.checkToolCallLoop(
                    toolCall.toolName,
                    toolCall.toolInput,
                );

                if (loopDetected) {
                    const loopMessage = `Loop detected while calling "${toolCall.toolName}". Execution stopped to prevent infinite recurrence.`;
                    return {
                        toolResults: [{
                            role: 'tool',
                            tool_call_id: 'system-loop-detection',
                            content: JSON.stringify({ error: loopMessage }),
                        }],
                        followUpMessages: [],
                        completed: true,
                        finalMessage: loopMessage,
                        hadToolCalls: true,
                    };
                }
            }
        }

        const toolResults: ToolResult[] = [];
        const followUpMessages: MessageObject[] = [];
        let userRejectedToolUse = false;

        for (const currentToolCall of executionToolCalls) {
            if (userRejectedToolUse) {
                const skippedResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    currentToolCall.toolUseId,
                    'Skipping tool execution due to previous tool user rejection.',
                );
                toolResults.push(skippedResult);
                continue;
            }

            const executionResult = await this.executeSingleToolCall(currentToolCall, input);
            toolResults.push(executionResult.toolResult);
            followUpMessages.push(...executionResult.followUpMessages);
            userRejectedToolUse = executionResult.didUserReject;
        }

        if (completionToolCalls.length > 0) {
            const completionToolCall = completionToolCalls.at(-1);
            if (completionToolCall) {
                const completionArguments = completionToolCall.toolInput;

                const [, completionResult] = await this.executeTool(
                    completionToolCall.toolName,
                    completionArguments,
                    input,
                );
                this.finalMessage = this.extractCompletionMessage(completionArguments) ?? lastMessageContent;
                await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(this.finalMessage);

                const parsedCompletionResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    completionToolCall.toolUseId,
                    completionResult === '' ? 'The user is satisfied with the result.' : completionResult,
                );
                toolResults.push(parsedCompletionResult);
            }
        }

        return {
            toolResults,
            followUpMessages,
            completed: completionToolCalls.length > 0,
            finalMessage: this.finalMessage,
            hadToolCalls: true,
        };
    }

    private async sendFinalMessageToChat(message: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        if (!message || message.trim().length === 0) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage(message));
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Failed to send final chat message:', error);
        }
    }

    private extractCompletionMessage(toolInput: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
        if ('result' in toolInput) {
            return this.formatCompletionValue(toolInput['result']);
        }

        return this.formatCompletionValue(toolInput);
    }

    private formatCompletionValue(value: unknown): string | undefined {
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            return value;
        }

        if (value === undefined || value === null) {
            return undefined;
        }

        if (typeof value !== 'object') {
            return String(value);
        }

        const valueRecord = value as Record<string, unknown>;
        for (const key of ['answer', 'message', 'content', 'text', 'output', 'result']) {
            const nestedValue = valueRecord[key];
            if (typeof nestedValue === 'string' && nestedValue.trim().length > 0) {
                return nestedValue;
            }
        }

        try {
            return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
        } catch {
            return String(value);
        }
    }

    private async executeSingleToolCall(
        toolCall: ParsedToolCall,
        input: ResponseInput,
    ): Promise<SingleToolExecutionResult> {
        try {
            let resultTuple: [boolean, unknown];
            if (toolCall.toolName === 'codebolt--thread_management') {
                resultTuple = [
                    false,
                    await codebolt.thread.createThreadInBackground({
                        title: String(toolCall.toolInput['title'] || toolCall.toolInput['task'] || 'Background Thread'),
                        description: String(toolCall.toolInput['description'] || toolCall.toolInput['task'] || ''),
                        userMessage: String(toolCall.toolInput['task'] || toolCall.toolInput['userMessage'] || ''),
                        selectedAgent: toolCall.toolInput['selectedAgent'],
                        isGrouped: Boolean(toolCall.toolInput['isGrouped']),
                        ...(typeof toolCall.toolInput['groupId'] === 'string'
                            ? { groupId: toolCall.toolInput['groupId'] }
                            : {}),
                    })
                ];
            } else if (toolCall.toolName.startsWith('subagent--')) {
                const task = toolCall.toolInput['task'];
                await codebolt.agent.startAgent(
                    toolCall.toolName.replace('subagent--', ''),
                    typeof task === 'string' ? task : JSON.stringify(task),
                );
                resultTuple = [false, 'tool result is successful'];
            } else {
                resultTuple = await this.executeTool(
                    toolCall.toolName,
                    toolCall.toolInput as Record<string, unknown>,
                    input,
                );
            }

            const [didUserReject, result] = resultTuple;
            const parsedResult = this.parseToolResult(toolCall.toolUseId, result);
            return {
                toolResult: parsedResult,
                followUpMessages: parsedResult.userMessage ? [{
                    role: 'user',
                    content: parsedResult.userMessage.toString(),
                }] : [],
                didUserReject,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            return {
                toolResult: {
                    role: 'tool',
                    tool_call_id: toolCall.toolUseId,
                    content: String(error),
                },
                followUpMessages: [],
                didUserReject: false,
            };
        }
    }

    private async executeTool(
        toolName: string,
        toolInput: Record<string, unknown>,
        input: ResponseInput,
    ): Promise<[boolean, unknown]> {
        const executionToolName = resolveToolExecutionName(toolName);
        const localTool = this.localToolsByExecutionName.get(executionToolName);
        if (localTool) {
            const localResult = await localTool.execute(toolInput, {
                initialUserMessage: input.initialUserMessage,
                llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                rawLLMResponse: input.rawLLMOutput,
                nextMessage: input.nextMessage,
                toolName: executionToolName,
            });

            if (!localResult.success) {
                return [false, localResult.error || `Local tool "${executionToolName}" failed.`];
            }

            return [false, localResult.result ?? ''];
        }

        const parts = executionToolName.split('--');
        const toolboxName = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[0] ?? '') : 'codebolt';
        const actualToolName = parts.length > 1 ? (parts[1] ?? '') : (parts[0] ?? '');
]]></tool_result>

const pendingExternalEvents: UnifiedExternalEvent[] = [];

/** Registered event handlers */
const eventHandlers = new Set<QueueEventHandler>();

/** Event emitter for waiting promises */
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
const eventEmitter = new EventEmitter();

function acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event: UnifiedExternalEvent): void {
    if (event.type !== 'agentQueueEvent' || !event.data?.eventId) {
        return;
    }

    void agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true)

            localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);

    if (event && event.eventId) {

    // Unified External Event Handling
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Check for any pending external events without waiting.
     * Returns the first pending event or null if none available.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent | null} The first pending event or null
     */
    checkForPendingExternalEvent: (): UnifiedExternalEvent | null => {
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift() || null;
            if (event) {
                acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
            }
            return event;
        }
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Get all pending external events.
     * Returns all pending events and clears the cache.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent[]} Array of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEvents: (): UnifiedExternalEvent[] => {
        const events = [...pendingExternalEvents];
        pendingExternalEvents.length = 0;
        for (const event of events) {
            acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
        }
        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Get the count of pending external events.
     *
     * @returns {number} Number of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEventCount: (): number => {
        return pendingExternalEvents.length;
    },

    /**
     * Waits for any external event from multiple sources:
     * - Agent queue events (from local cache or WebSocket)
     * - Background agent completions
     * - Grouped agent completions
     *
     * Returns the first event that occurs from any source.
     *
     * @returns {Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent>} A promise that resolves with the event type and data
     */
    waitForAnyExternalEvent: async (): Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent> => {
        // Check if there are already pending events
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift()!;

            // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
            if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return event;
        }

        // Wait for the next external event
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const handler = async (event: UnifiedExternalEvent) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('externalEvent', handler);

                // Remove from pending queue (it was added by the subscription)
                const index = pendingExternalEvents.findIndex(e => e === event);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    pendingExternalEvents.splice(index, 1);
                }

                // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
                if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                    try {
                        await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                        localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                    }
                }

                resolve(event);
            };

            eventEmitter.once('externalEvent', handler);
        });
    }
};

export default agentEventQueue;

        this.postToolCallProcessors = options.postToolCallProcessors;
        this.loopDetectionService = options.loopDetectionService;
        this.localToolsByExecutionName = options.localToolsByExecutionName || new Map<string, AgentLocalTool>();
    }

    async executeResponse(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ResponseOutput> {
        this.completed = false;
        this.finalMessage = undefined;

        let nextMessage: ProcessedMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(input.nextMessage);

        for (const preToolCallProcessor of this.preToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await preToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);
                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in pre tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const compactionMessagePromise = this.runRequiredCompaction(input.rawLLMOutput);
        const toolExecution = await this.executeTools(input);
        const compactionCompleted = await compactionMessagePromise;
        if (compactionCompleted) {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage('Conversation Compacted'));
        }
        this.completed = this.completed || toolExecution.completed;
        this.finalMessage = toolExecution.finalMessage ?? this.finalMessage;

        await this.injectDiscoveredTools(
            input.rawLLMOutput,
            toolExecution.toolResults,
            nextMessage,
        );

        if (toolExecution.toolResults.length > 0 || toolExecution.followUpMessages.length > 0) {
            nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [
                ...toolExecution.toolResults.map((toolResult) => ({
                    role: toolResult.role,
                    content: typeof toolResult.content === 'string'
                        ? toolResult.content
                        : JSON.stringify(toolResult.content),
                    tool_call_id: toolResult.tool_call_id,
                })),
                ...toolExecution.followUpMessages,
            ]);
        }

        const transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        for (const postToolCallProcessor of this.postToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await postToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                    toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
                    tokenLimit: input.rawLLMOutput?.tokenLimit,
                    maxOutputTokens: input.rawLLMOutput?.maxOutputTokens
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);

                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in post tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        if (
            !toolExecution.hadToolCalls &&
            transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors > transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors
        ) {
            this.completed = false;
            this.finalMessage = undefined;
        }

        const output: ResponseOutput = {
            completed: this.completed,
            nextMessage,
            toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
        };
        if (this.finalMessage !== undefined) {
            output.finalMessage = this.finalMessage;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private parseToolCall(tool: ToolCall): ParsedToolCall {
        let toolInput: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (tool.function.arguments) {
            try {
                const parsedArguments = JSON.parse(tool.function.arguments);
                if (parsedArguments && typeof parsedArguments === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedArguments)) {
                    toolInput = parsedArguments as Record<string, unknown>;
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to parse tool arguments: ${parseError}`);
            }
        }

        return {
            tool,
            toolInput,
            toolName: tool.function.name,
            toolUseId: tool.id,
            waitForPrevious: toolInput['waitForPreviousTools'] === true,
        };
    }

    private extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): string | undefined {
        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            if (choice.message?.content) {
                return choice.message.content;
            }

            const reasoningContent = (choice.message as MessageObject & {
                reasoning_content?: string;
            } | undefined)?.reasoning_content;
            if (reasoningContent) {
                return reasoningContent;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    private getToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): ToolCall[] {
        const toolCallsById = new Map<string, ToolCall>();

        for (const toolCall of llmResponse.tool_calls ?? []) {
            if (toolCall?.id) {
                toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
            }
        }

        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            for (const toolCall of choice.message?.tool_calls ?? []) {
                if (toolCall?.id && !toolCallsById.has(toolCall.id)) {
                    toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
                }
            }
        }

        return Array.from(toolCallsById.values());
    }

    private hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): boolean {
        return this.getToolCalls(llmResponse).some((toolCall) => {
            const toolName = toolCall.function?.name || '';
            return !toolName.includes('attempt_completion') &&
                !toolName.includes('context_compaction') &&
                !toolName.includes('contextCompaction');
        });
    }

                        : JSON.stringify(toolResult.content),
                    tool_call_id: toolResult.tool_call_id,
                })),
                ...toolExecution.followUpMessages,
            ]);
        }

        const transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        for (const postToolCallProcessor of this.postToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await postToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                    toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
                    tokenLimit: input.rawLLMOutput?.tokenLimit,
                    maxOutputTokens: input.rawLLMOutput?.maxOutputTokens
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);

                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in post tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        if (
            !toolExecution.hadToolCalls &&
            transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors > transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors
        ) {
            this.completed = false;
            this.finalMessage = undefined;
        }

        const output: ResponseOutput = {
            completed: this.completed,
            nextMessage,
            toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
        };
        if (this.finalMessage !== undefined) {
            output.finalMessage = this.finalMessage;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private parseToolCall(tool: ToolCall): ParsedToolCall {
        let toolInput: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (tool.function.arguments) {
            try {
                const parsedArguments = JSON.parse(tool.function.arguments);
                if (parsedArguments && typeof parsedArguments === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedArguments)) {
                    toolInput = parsedArguments as Record<string, unknown>;
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to parse tool arguments: ${parseError}`);
            }
        }

        return {
            tool,
            toolInput,
            toolName: tool.function.name,
            toolUseId: tool.id,
            waitForPrevious: toolInput['waitForPreviousTools'] === true,
        };
    }

    private extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): string | undefined {
        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            if (choice.message?.content) {
                return choice.message.content;
            }

            const reasoningContent = (choice.message as MessageObject & {
                reasoning_content?: string;
            } | undefined)?.reasoning_content;
            if (reasoningContent) {
                return reasoningContent;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    private getToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): ToolCall[] {
        const toolCallsById = new Map<string, ToolCall>();

        for (const toolCall of llmResponse.tool_calls ?? []) {
            if (toolCall?.id) {
                toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
            }
        }

        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            for (const toolCall of choice.message?.tool_calls ?? []) {
                if (toolCall?.id && !toolCallsById.has(toolCall.id)) {
                    toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
                }
            }
        }

        return Array.from(toolCallsById.values());
    }

    private hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): boolean {
        return this.getToolCalls(llmResponse).some((toolCall) => {
            const toolName = toolCall.function?.name || '';
            return !toolName.includes('attempt_completion') &&
                !toolName.includes('context_compaction') &&
                !toolName.includes('contextCompaction');
        });
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                    backgroundOnYield: this.params.background_on_yield,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is running in the background: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.SHELL_EXECUTE_ERROR,
                    },
                };
            }

            // Extract output
            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';
            const exitCode = (response as any).exitCode ?? (response as any).code;

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {
                llmContent = `Command executed: ${command}\n\nOutput:\n${output}`;
            } else {
                llmContent = `Command executed successfully: ${command}`;
            }

            if (exitCode !== undefined && exitCode !== 0) {
                llmContent += `\n\nExit code: ${exitCode}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: output ? this.truncateOutput(output) : 'Command executed successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error executing command: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

    private getCommand(): string {
        if (this.params.command_lines && this.params.command_lines.length > 0) {
            return this.params.command_lines.join('\n');
        }
        return this.params.command ?? '';
    }

    private truncateOutput(output: any, maxLength: number = 200): string {
        // Ensure output is a string
        const outputStr = typeof output === 'string' ? output : JSON.stringify(output);
        if (outputStr.length <= maxLength) return outputStr;
        return outputStr.substring(0, maxLength) + '...';
    }
}

const TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES = {
    RUN: 'tuiRunResponse',
    ATTACH: 'tuiAttachResponse',
    OUTPUT: 'tuiOutputResponse',
    SCREEN: 'tuiScreenResponse',
    TYPE: 'tuiTypeResponse',
    WRITE: 'tuiWriteResponse',
    PRESS: 'tuiPressResponse',
    RESIZE: 'tuiResizeResponse',
    SEARCH: 'tuiSearchResponse',
    REGION: 'tuiRegionResponse',
    CURSOR: 'tuiCursorResponse',
    WAIT: 'tuiWaitResponse',
    WHEEL: 'tuiWheelResponse',
    SESSIONS_LIST: 'tuiSessionsListResponse',
    SESSIONS_SWITCH: 'tuiSessionsSwitchResponse',
    KILL: 'tuiKillResponse',
    CLEANUP: 'tuiCleanupResponse',
} as const;

const COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES = {
    LIST: 'terminalCommandsList',
    STOP: 'terminalCommandStop',
    OUTPUT: 'terminalCommandOutput',
    STATUS: 'terminalCommandStatus',
    WAIT: 'terminalCommandWait',
} as const;

const COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES = {
    LIST: 'terminalCommandsListResponse',
    STOP: 'terminalCommandStopResponse',
    OUTPUT: 'terminalCommandOutputResponse',
    STATUS: 'terminalCommandStatusResponse',
    WAIT: 'terminalCommandWaitResponse',
} as const;

/**
 * CustomEventEmitter class that extends the Node.js EventEmitter class.
 */
class CustomEventEmitter extends EventEmitter {
    cleanup?: () => void;
}
/**
 * A module for executing commands in a terminal-like environment via WebSocket.
 */
const cbterminal = {
    eventEmitter: new CustomEventEmitter(),
    tui: {
        run: (params: { command: string; args?: string[]; cwd?: string; env?: Record<string, string>; cols?: number; rows?: number; visible?: boolean; sessionId?: string; terminalId?: string | number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.RUN, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.RUN, params),

        attach: (params: { sessionId?: string; pid?: number; terminalId?: string | number; cols?: number; rows?: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.ATTACH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.ATTACH, params),

        output: (params: { sessionId?: string; mode?: 'streaming' | 'snapshot' | 'screen'; trimWhitespace?: boolean; includeEmpty?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.OUTPUT, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.OUTPUT, params),

        screen: (params: { sessionId?: string; trimWhitespace?: boolean; includeEmpty?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SCREEN, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SCREEN, params),

        type: (params: { sessionId?: string; text: string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.TYPE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.TYPE, params),

        write: (params: { sessionId?: string; data: string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WRITE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WRITE, params),

        press: (params: { sessionId?: string; keys: string[] | string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.PRESS, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.PRESS, params),

        resize: (params: { sessionId?: string; cols: number; rows: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.RESIZE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.RESIZE, params),

        search: (params: { sessionId?: string; pattern: string; regex?: boolean }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SEARCH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SEARCH, params),

        region: (params: { sessionId?: string; row: number; col: number; rows: number; cols: number; trimWhitespace?: boolean }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.REGION, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.REGION, params),

        cursor: (params: { sessionId?: string } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.CURSOR, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.CURSOR, params),

        wait: (params: { sessionId?: string; text?: string; gone?: boolean; stable?: boolean; timeoutMs?: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WAIT, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WAIT, params),

        wheel: (params: { sessionId?: string; direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'; amount?: number; row?: number; col?: number; protocol?: 'auto' | 'sgr' | 'normal' }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WHEEL, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WHEEL, params),

        sessions: {
            list: () => sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SESSIONS_LIST, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SESSIONS_LIST, {}),
            switch: (sessionId: string) => sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SESSIONS_SWITCH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SESSIONS_SWITCH, { sessionId }),
        },

        kill: (params: { sessionId?: string } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.KILL, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.KILL, params),

        cleanup: (params: { exitedOnly?: boolean; all?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.CLEANUP, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.CLEANUP, params),
    },

    /**
     * Executes a given command and returns the result.
     * Listens for messages from the WebSocket that indicate the output, error, or finish state
     * of the executed command and resolves the promise accordingly.
     *
     * @param {string} command - The command to be executed.
     * @returns {Promise<CommandOutput|CommandError>} A promise that resolves with the command's output, error, or finish signal.
     */
    executeCommand: async (
        command: string,
        options: boolean | ExecuteCommandOptions = false
    ): Promise<CommandOutput | CommandError | CommandFinish | any> => {
        const normalizedOptions: ExecuteCommandOptions = typeof options === 'boolean'
            ? { returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: options }
            : options;

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                "type": TerminalEventType.EXECUTE_COMMAND,
                "message": command,
                returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: normalizedOptions.returnEmptyStringOnSuccess ?? false,
                executionMode: normalizedOptions.executionMode,
                yieldMs: normalizedOptions.yieldMs,
                timeoutMs: normalizedOptions.timeoutMs,
                backgroundOnYield: normalizedOptions.backgroundOnYield
            },
            TerminalResponseType.COMMAND_ERROR_OR_FINISH
        );
    },

    listCommands: () =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.LIST, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.LIST, {}),

    stopCommand: (processId: number) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.STOP, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.STOP, { processId }),

    readCommandOutput: (processId: number, params: { lines?: number; tailBytes?: number } = {}) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.OUTPUT, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.OUTPUT, { processId, ...params }),

    getCommandStatus: (processId: number) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.STATUS, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.STATUS, { processId }),

    waitCommand: (processId: number, params: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.WAIT, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.WAIT, { processId, ...params }),

    /**
     * Executes a given command and keeps running until an error occurs.

export async function executeCommandInShell(command: string, terminalId: string | number, finalMessage, notifyUser): Promise<any> {
    return new Promise(async (resolve, reject) => {
        let activeMessageId = finalMessage.messageId;
        let threadId = finalMessage.threadId;
        let initialOpenPorts: number[] = [];
        let commandCompleted = false;
        let isResolved = false;
        let resolvedAsBackground = false;
        let buffer = '';
        const executionOptions = getCommandExecutionOptions(finalMessage);
        const effectiveYieldMs = executionOptions.executionMode === 'background'
            ? (executionOptions.yieldMs ?? DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_STARTUP_CAPTURE_MS)
            : (executionOptions.yieldMs ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND_YIELD_MS);
        const MAX_BUFFER_SIZE = 512 * 1024;
        let yieldTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        let uiOverrideTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        let hardTimeoutTimer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        let timeoutId: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
        let intervalId: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;

        let safeResolve = (result: any) => {
            if (!isResolved) {
                isResolved = true;
                resolve(result);
            }
        };

        let safeReject = (error: any) => {
            if (!isResolved) {
                isResolved = true;
                reject(error);
            }
        };

        const resolveAsRunning = (ptyProcess: PtyProcess, reason: string, port?: number) => {
            if (commandCompleted) return;
            resolvedAsBackground = true;
            resetTerminalIdOnProcessFinish(terminalId);
            updateTerminalProcessStatus(ptyProcess.pid, 'background');
            updateManagedCommand(ptyProcess.pid, {
                yielded: true,
                yieldReason: reason,
                port,
                outputTail: buffer.slice(-64 * 1024),
            });

            const runningMessage = {
                eventType: 'console',
                type: 'command',
                message: `${command} is running in the background. View Logs.`,
                processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                command,
                status: TerminalProcessStatus.RunningInBackground,
                messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
                threadId,
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                port,
                reason,
            };

            if (notifyUser) updateProcessStateInUi(runningMessage);

            safeResolve({
                result: buffer || '',

export function listCommandProcesses() {
    return terminalProcess
        .filter(tp => tp.ptyTerminalProcess?.pid
            && tp.command?.trim()
            && !tp.command.startsWith('Interactive Terminal')
            && ['running', 'executing', 'background'].includes(tp.status))
        .map(tp => ({

            status: tp.status || 'running',
            timestamp: tp.timestamp || Date.now(),
            command: tp.command,
            messageId: tp.messageId,
        }));
}

export function getCommandProcessStatus(processId: number) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(processId)) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Invalid process ID' };
    }

    const record = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!record) {
        return { success: false, error: `Process ${processId} not found` };
    }

    return {
        success: true,
        process: serializeCommandRecord(record),
    };
}

export function waitCommandProcess(
    processId: number,
    options: { timeoutMs?: number } = {},
): Promise<{ success: boolean; process?: ManagedCommandRecord; error?: string }> {
    if (!Number.isFinite(processId)) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: false, error: 'Invalid process ID' });
    }

    const record = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!record) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: false, error: `Process ${processId} not found` });
    }

    if (FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: true, process: serializeCommandRecord(record) });
    }

    const timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(
        options.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
        DEFAULT_COMMAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
    ));

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const waiter: CommandWaiter = {
            resolve: (finalRecord) => resolve({
                success: true,
                process: serializeCommandRecord(finalRecord),
            }),
        };

        if (timeoutMs > 0) {
            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                const waiters = commandWaiters.get(processId) || [];
                commandWaiters.set(
                    processId,
                    waiters.filter(existingWaiter => existingWaiter !== waiter),
                );
                resolve({
                    success: false,
                    process: serializeCommandRecord(commandRecords.get(processId) || record),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for process ${processId}`,
                });
            }, timeoutMs);
        }

        const waiters = commandWaiters.get(processId) || [];
        waiters.push(waiter);
        commandWaiters.set(processId, waiters);
    });
}

export function stopCommandProcess(processId: number) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(processId)) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Invalid process ID' };
    }
    const process = getProcessByPid(processId);
    if (!process) {
        const record = commandRecords.get(processId);
        if (record && FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
            return {
                success: true,
                processId,
                status: record.status,
                message: `Process ${processId} is already ${record.status}`,
            };
        }
        return { success: false, error: `Process ${processId} not found` };
    }

    async handleTerminalOperation(operation: string, params: any, finalMessage: any): Promise<TerminalServiceResponse> {

                const processes = listCommandProcesses();
                return {

                    output: JSON.stringify(processes, null, 2),

                    error: result.success ? undefined : { code: 'STOP_FAILED', details: result.error || 'Failed to stop process' },

                    exitCode: result.success ? 0 : 1,
                    message: result.success ? 'Stopped terminal command' : 'Failed to stop terminal command',
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

                    tailBytes: typeof params?.tailBytes === 'number' ? params.tailBytes : undefined,

                    type: 'terminalCommandOutputResponse' as any,

                    error: result.success ? undefined : { code: 'OUTPUT_FAILED', details: result.error || 'Failed to read output' },

                    exitCode: result.success ? 0 : 1,
                    message: result.success ? 'Read terminal command output' : 'Failed to read terminal command output',
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),

            if (action === 'terminalCommandStatus') {

/**
 * Terminal command management tools.
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { Kind, ToolErrorType } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';

function stringifyResult(value: unknown): string {
    if (typeof value === 'string') {
        return value;
    }
    return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
}

function commandToolResult(
    actionLabel: string,
    response: any,
    successDisplay: string,
): ToolResult {
    if (response?.success === false || response?.result?.success === false) {
        const errorMessage = response?.error?.details
            || response?.result?.error
            || response?.message
            || `${actionLabel} failed`;
        return {
            llmContent: `${actionLabel} failed: ${errorMessage}`,
            returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
            error: {
                message: errorMessage,
                type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
            },
        };
    }

    const content = response?.output
        || stringifyResult(response?.result ?? response ?? {});

    return {
        llmContent: `${actionLabel} succeeded:\n${content}`,
        returnDisplay: successDisplay,
    };
}

export interface TerminalProcessIdParams {
    process_id: number;
}

export interface TerminalReadCommandOutputParams extends TerminalProcessIdParams {
    lines?: number;
    tail_bytes?: number;
}

export interface TerminalWaitCommandParams extends TerminalProcessIdParams {
    timeout_ms?: number;
}

class ListCommandsInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<Record<string, never>, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: Record<string, never>) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        const response = await cbterminal.listCommands();
        return commandToolResult('List terminal commands', response, 'Listed terminal commands');
    }
}

export class ListCommandsTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<Record<string, never>, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'terminal_list_commands';

    constructor() {
        super(
            ListCommandsTool.Name,
            'List Terminal Commands',
            'List currently running managed terminal commands.',
            Kind.Other,
            { type: 'object', properties: {}, required: [] },
        );
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: Record<string, never>): ToolInvocation<Record<string, never>, ToolResult> {
        return new ListCommandsInvocation(params);
    }
}

class ReadCommandOutputInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<TerminalReadCommandOutputParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: TerminalReadCommandOutputParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        const response = await cbterminal.readCommandOutput(this.params.process_id, {
            lines: this.params.lines,
            tailBytes: this.params.tail_bytes,
        });
        return commandToolResult('Read terminal command output', response, 'Read terminal command output');
    }
}

export class ReadCommandOutputTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<TerminalReadCommandOutputParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'terminal_read_command_output';

    constructor() {
        super(
            ReadCommandOutputTool.Name,
            'Read Terminal Command Output',
            'Read captured output for a managed terminal command.',
            Kind.Other,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    process_id: { type: 'number', description: 'Process ID returned by execute_command.' },
                    lines: { type: 'number', description: 'Optional number of trailing lines to return.' },
                    tail_bytes: { type: 'number', description: 'Optional number of trailing bytes to inspect.' },
                },
                required: ['process_id'],
            },
        );
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: TerminalReadCommandOutputParams): ToolInvocation<TerminalReadCommandOutputParams, ToolResult> {
        return new ReadCommandOutputInvocation(params);
    }
}

class GetCommandStatusInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<TerminalProcessIdParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: TerminalProcessIdParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        const response = await cbterminal.getCommandStatus(this.params.process_id);
        return commandToolResult('Get terminal command status', response, 'Read terminal command status');
    }
}

export class GetCommandStatusTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<TerminalProcessIdParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'terminal_get_command_status';

    constructor() {
        super(
            GetCommandStatusTool.Name,

            Kind.Other,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    process_id: { type: 'number', description: 'Process ID returned by execute_command.' },
                },

            },
        );

    protected createInvocation(params: TerminalProcessIdParams): ToolInvocation<TerminalProcessIdParams, ToolResult> {
        return new GetCommandStatusInvocation(params);
    }
}

class WaitCommandInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<TerminalWaitCommandParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: TerminalWaitCommandParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {

        });

     * This combines createThread and startThread operations
     * If userMessage is provided, also creates a step and processes it through the agent

    async handleCreateAndStartThread(params: CreateAndStartThreadInput, ws: any): Promise<ThreadServiceResponse<CreateAndStartThreadResponseData>> {
        threadServiceCLI.consecutiveMistakeCount = 0;

        try {
            const startMessage = [
                params.userMessage,
                params.description,
                params.title,
            ].find((value) => typeof value === 'string' && value.trim());

            if (!startMessage) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Cannot create and start a thread without a task or userMessage'
                };
            }

            if (!params.userMessage) {
                params.userMessage = startMessage;
            }

            // Generate default thread name if title is not provided
            // Priority: title > userMessage (first 50 chars) > selectedAgent name > timestamp-based fallback
            const defaultName = params.title ||
                params.userMessage?.substring(0, 50) ||
                params.selectedAgent?.name ||
                params.selectedAgent?.title ||
                params.description?.substring(0, 50) ||
                `Thread-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 16).replace(/[-:T]/g, '')}`;

            const requestedThreadId = typeof params.threadId === 'string' ? params.threadId.trim() : '';
            const shouldReuseThreadId = Boolean(params.reuseThreadId && requestedThreadId);
            let didCreateThread = true;

            let thread = shouldReuseThreadId
                ? await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(requestedThreadId)
                : null;

            if (shouldReuseThreadId && thread) {
                didCreateThread = false;
            } else {
                // First, create the thread via threadFileStore. Cloud-originated
                // local workspace runs can reuse the portal thread id so replies
                // stream back into the originating thread instead of a child.
                thread = await threadFileStore.createThreadWithId(
                    shouldReuseThreadId ? requestedThreadId : uuidv4(),
                    defaultName,
                    {
                        projectPath: projectSetting.user_active_project_path,
                        parentId: shouldReuseThreadId ? undefined : params.parentId,
                        isRemoteTask: params.isRemoteTask || false,
                    },
                );
            }

            // Apply additional fields that createThreadWithId doesn't accept directly
            await threadFileStore.updateThread(thread.threadId, {
                description: params.description || (thread as any).description || '',
                parentThreadAgentId: shouldReuseThreadId ? (thread as any).parentThreadAgentId : params.agentId,
                assignedTo: params.agentId || (thread as any).assignedTo || undefined,
                status: params.status || (didCreateThread ? 'CREATED' : (thread as any).status || 'CREATED'),
                tags: params.tags || (thread as any).tags || [],
                flowData: {
                    ...((thread as any).flowData || {}),
                    ...(params.metadata || {}),
                },
            });

            // Re-fetch the updated thread
            let createdThread = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(thread.threadId) || thread;

            if (!createdThread) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    error: 'Failed to create thread'
                };
            }

            await tryAutoUpdateThreadName(createdThread.threadId, params.userMessage || params.description);
            createdThread = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(createdThread.threadId) || createdThread;

            if (!shouldReuseThreadId) {
                // Store event persistently with agent name
                chatManager.addObservabilityEvent({
                    eventId: getMessageId(),
                    eventType: params.parentId ? 'SUBTHREAD_STARTED' : 'THREAD_STARTED',
                    threadId: createdThread.threadId,
                    parentThreadId: params.parentId,
                    agentName: params.selectedAgent?.name || params.selectedAgent?.title || params.agentId || createdThread.assignedTo || createdThread.name,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                });

                sendNotificationToUi({
                    type: 'message',
                    actionType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                    templateType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                    threadId: createdThread.threadId,
                    messageId: getMessageId(),
                    content: `Thread started: ${createdThread.threadId}`,
                    payload: {
                        eventType: params.parentId ? 'SUBTHREAD_STARTED' : 'THREAD_STARTED',
                        threadId: createdThread.threadId,
                        parentThreadId: params.parentId,
                        agentName: params.selectedAgent?.name || params.selectedAgent?.title || params.agentId || createdThread.assignedTo || createdThread.name,
                        threadName: createdThread.name || defaultName,
                        timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                    }
                });

                // Broadcast to parent orchestrator's subscribers for real-time UI updates
                if (params.parentId) {
                    broadcastThreadUpdate(params.parentId, createdThread.threadId, 'created', createdThread);
                }

                // Send Thread Widget Notification (suppressed when silent, e.g. eval runs)
                if (!params.silent) {
                    sendNotificationToUi({
                        type: 'message',

                        messageId: getMessageId(),

                        payload: {

    async getThreadContext(params: ThreadContextInput): Promise<ThreadServiceResponse<{ context: any | null }>> {
        const threadId = resolveThreadId(params);
        if (!threadId) {
            threadServiceCLI.consecutiveMistakeCount++;
            return {
                success: false,
                error: 'Missing required parameter: threadId'
            };
        }

        threadServiceCLI.consecutiveMistakeCount = 0;

        try {
            return {
                success: true,
                data: {
                    context: contextMemoryService.getThread(threadId)

            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            return {
                success: false,
                error: `Error getting thread context: ${error.message || JSON.stringify(error)}`
            };
        }
    },

<message role="assistant" ordinal="33" timestamp="2026-07-02T14:50:46.278Z">
Thread context is stored through `contextMemoryService.replaceMessages(threadId, ...)`, while the agent SDK itself only returns `state.prompt`; it does not persist that state by itself. The server or wrapper code must pass that context back into the next spawned process for continuity.
</message>

 * Processes an incoming message with agent handling
 * @param incomingMessage - The message to process
 * @param messageThreadId - The thread ID for the message
 * @returns Promise<boolean> - Returns true if message was processed successfully
 */
export async function processAgentMessage(incomingMessage: IncomingMessage, messageThreadId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    try {
        applyProjectCommandToMessage(
            incomingMessage,
            projectSetting?.user_active_project_path || process.cwd()
        );

        if (incomingMessage?.message?.isRemoteTask && getRemoteEnvironmentId(incomingMessage.message.environment)) {
            return processRemoteProviderTask(incomingMessage, messageThreadId);
        }

        // Find and start the appropriate agent
        console.time('find_and_start_agent')
        let currentAgent = await findAndStartAgent(incomingMessage);
        console.timeEnd('find_and_start_agent')


        // Apply custom settings if available
        if (currentAgent && currentAgent.customSettings && currentAgent.customSettings.customInstructions) {
            incomingMessage.message.remixPrompt = currentAgent.customSettings.customInstructions;

            // Add additional sub-agents if configured
            if (currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent && currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent.length) {
                incomingMessage.message.mentionedAgents = currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent.map(agent => ({
                    unique_id: agent.uunique_id || agent.agentId || agent.id || agent.agent_id,
                    longDescription: agent.longDescription || agent.description,
                    description: agent.description
                }));
            }

            // Add selected tools if configured
            if (currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools && currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools.length) {
                incomingMessage.message.mentionedMCPs = currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools;
            }
        }

        // Process the message if agent is available and message is not empty
        if (currentAgent && currentAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.incomingMessage !== "") {
            // Mark task as in progress when sending to agent
            logger.info(`[Agent] Marking task as in progress for thread: ${messageThreadId}`);
            await markTaskInProgressByThread(messageThreadId);

            if (incomingMessage.message.isRemoteTask) {
                const processed = await processRemoteProviderTask(incomingMessage, messageThreadId);
                if (!processed) return false;
            }
            else {
                projectState.setCurrentAgent(currentAgent);

                // Send message to the appropriate agent

                // if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent.name !== "") {
                //     sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent.lastMessage);
                // } else {
                if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent?.id == '') {
                    incomingMessage.message.selectedAgent = currentAgent;
                    console.time('send_message_to_chat')
                }

                sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage);
                // }

                // Set the current agent in project state
            }

            return true;
        }
        if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent?.id != '') {
            // Mark task as in progress when sending to agent
            logger.info(`[Agent] Marking task as in progress for thread: ${messageThreadId}`);
            await markTaskInProgressByThread(messageThreadId);

            if (incomingMessage.message.isRemoteTask) {
                const processed = await processRemoteProviderTask(incomingMessage, messageThreadId);
                if (!processed) return false;
            }
            else {
                sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage);

            }

            return true;
        }


        return false;
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error processing agent message: ${error.message}`);
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Validates if a message should be processed by an agent
 * @param incomingMessage - The message to validate
 * @returns boolean - Returns true if message should be processed
 */
export function shouldProcessWithAgent(incomingMessage: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    // Don't process task type messages
    if (incomingMessage?.message?.taskType === 'task') {
        return false;
    }

    // Add other validation logic as needed
    return true;
}

/**
 * Get remote provider tasks for a specific thread
 * @param threadId - The thread ID to get tasks for
 * @returns Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> - Returns array of remote provider tasks
 */
export async function getRemoteProviderTasksForThread(threadId: string): Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getTasksByThread(threadId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting remote provider tasks for thread ${threadId}: ${error.message}`);
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Update remote provider task status
 * @param taskId - The task ID to update
 * @param status - The new status
 * @returns Promise<boolean> - Returns true if update was successful
 */
export async function updateRemoteProviderTaskStatus(taskId: string, status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled') {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.updateTaskStatus(taskId, status);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error updating remote provider task status: ${error.message}`);
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Get full task message for a remote provider task
 * @param taskId - The task ID to get full message for
 * @returns Promise<any> - Returns the complete task message or null
 */
export async function getRemoteProviderTaskFullMessage(taskId: string) {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getFullTaskMessage(taskId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting full task message for task ${taskId}: ${error.message}`);
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Search remote provider tasks by message content
 * @param searchTerm - The search term to look for in task messages
 * @returns Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> - Returns array of matching tasks
 */
export async function searchRemoteProviderTasksByMessage(searchTerm: string): Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.searchTasksByMessage(searchTerm);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error searching tasks by message: ${error.message}`);
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Get task message metadata for analysis
 * @param taskId - The task ID to get metadata for
 * @returns Promise<object> - Returns metadata about the task message
 */
export async function getRemoteProviderTaskMetadata(taskId: string) {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getTaskMessageMetadata(taskId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting task metadata for task ${taskId}: ${error.message}`);
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Create a remote provider task from full task JSON (new preferred method)
 * @param fullTaskMessage - The complete task JSON object

 */
export async function createRemoteProviderTaskFromFullMessage(fullTaskMessage: any): Promise<RemoteProviderTask | null> {
    try {
        logger.info(`[Agent] Creating remote provider task from full message for thread: ${fullTaskMessage.threadId}`);

        const remoteTask = await remoteProviderTaskStore.addTaskFromFullMessage(fullTaskMessage.message);

        logger.info(`[Agent] Remote provider task created from full message: ${remoteTask.taskId} for thread: ${fullTaskMessage.threadId}`);

        return remoteTask;
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error creating remote provider task from full message: ${error.message}`);
        return null;
    }
}

}

            if (currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent && currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent.length) {
                incomingMessage.message.mentionedAgents = currentAgent.customSettings.additionalSubAgent.map(agent => ({
                    unique_id: agent.uunique_id || agent.agentId || agent.id || agent.agent_id,
                    longDescription: agent.longDescription || agent.description,
                    description: agent.description
                }));
            }

            // Add selected tools if configured
            if (currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools && currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools.length) {
                incomingMessage.message.mentionedMCPs = currentAgent.customSettings.selectedTools;
            }
        }

        // Process the message if agent is available and message is not empty
        if (currentAgent && currentAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.incomingMessage !== "") {
            // Mark task as in progress when sending to agent
            logger.info(`[Agent] Marking task as in progress for thread: ${messageThreadId}`);
            await markTaskInProgressByThread(messageThreadId);

            if (incomingMessage.message.isRemoteTask) {
                const processed = await processRemoteProviderTask(incomingMessage, messageThreadId);
                if (!processed) return false;
            }
            else {
                projectState.setCurrentAgent(currentAgent);

                // Send message to the appropriate agent

                // if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent.name !== "") {
                //     sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent.lastMessage);
                // } else {
                if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent?.id == '') {
                    incomingMessage.message.selectedAgent = currentAgent;
                    console.time('send_message_to_chat')
                }

                sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage);
                // }

                // Set the current agent in project state
            }

            return true;
        }
        if (incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent && incomingMessage?.message?.selectedAgent?.id != '') {
            // Mark task as in progress when sending to agent
            logger.info(`[Agent] Marking task as in progress for thread: ${messageThreadId}`);
            await markTaskInProgressByThread(messageThreadId);

            if (incomingMessage.message.isRemoteTask) {
                const processed = await processRemoteProviderTask(incomingMessage, messageThreadId);
                if (!processed) return false;
            }
            else {
                sendMessageToCodebotCli(incomingMessage);

            }

            return true;
        }


        return false;
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error processing agent message: ${error.message}`);
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Validates if a message should be processed by an agent
 * @param incomingMessage - The message to validate
 * @returns boolean - Returns true if message should be processed
 */
export function shouldProcessWithAgent(incomingMessage: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    // Don't process task type messages
    if (incomingMessage?.message?.taskType === 'task') {
        return false;
    }

    // Add other validation logic as needed
    return true;
}

/**
 * Get remote provider tasks for a specific thread
 * @param threadId - The thread ID to get tasks for
 * @returns Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> - Returns array of remote provider tasks
 */
export async function getRemoteProviderTasksForThread(threadId: string): Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getTasksByThread(threadId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting remote provider tasks for thread ${threadId}: ${error.message}`);
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Update remote provider task status
 * @param taskId - The task ID to update
 * @param status - The new status
 * @returns Promise<boolean> - Returns true if update was successful
 */
export async function updateRemoteProviderTaskStatus(taskId: string, status: 'pending' | 'in_progress' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled') {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.updateTaskStatus(taskId, status);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error updating remote provider task status: ${error.message}`);
        return false;
    }
}

/**
 * Get full task message for a remote provider task
 * @param taskId - The task ID to get full message for

export async function getRemoteProviderTaskFullMessage(taskId: string) {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getFullTaskMessage(taskId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting full task message for task ${taskId}: ${error.message}`);
        return null;

}

/**

export async function searchRemoteProviderTasksByMessage(searchTerm: string): Promise<RemoteProviderTask[]> {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.searchTasksByMessage(searchTerm);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error searching tasks by message: ${error.message}`);
        return [];
    }
}

/**
 * Get task message metadata for analysis
 * @param taskId - The task ID to get metadata for
 * @returns Promise<object> - Returns metadata about the task message
 */
export async function getRemoteProviderTaskMetadata(taskId: string) {
    try {
        return await remoteProviderTaskStore.getTaskMessageMetadata(taskId);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error getting task metadata for task ${taskId}: ${error.message}`);
        return null;
    }
}

/**
 * Create a remote provider task from full task JSON (new preferred method)
 * @param fullTaskMessage - The complete task JSON object
 * @returns Promise<RemoteProviderTask> - Returns the created task
 */
export async function createRemoteProviderTaskFromFullMessage(fullTaskMessage: any): Promise<RemoteProviderTask | null> {
    try {
        logger.info(`[Agent] Creating remote provider task from full message for thread: ${fullTaskMessage.threadId}`);

        const remoteTask = await remoteProviderTaskStore.addTaskFromFullMessage(fullTaskMessage.message);

        // Mark the remote task as in progress
        await remoteProviderTaskStore.markTaskInProgress(remoteTask.taskId);

        logger.info(`[Agent] Remote provider task created from full message: ${remoteTask.taskId} for thread: ${fullTaskMessage.threadId}`);

        return remoteTask;
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageService] Error creating remote provider task from full message: ${error.message}`);
        return null;
    }
}
