    /**
     * Attempt immediate delivery via WebSocket
     */
    async attemptImmediateDelivery(event: AgentEventMessage): Promise<boolean> {
        try {
            // Try to find socket by agentInstanceId first, then by agentId, then by threadId
            let socket: any = null;

            if (event.targetAgentInstanceId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById?.(event.targetAgentInstanceId);
            }

            if (!socket) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByAgentId(event.targetAgentId);
            }

            if (!socket && event.targetThreadId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(event.targetThreadId);
            }

            if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) { // WebSocket.OPEN
                const message = {
                    type: 'agentEvent',
                    event
                };
                socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
                agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered event ${event.eventId} to agent ${event.targetAgentId}`);
                return true;
            }

            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] No active socket for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, event queued`);
            return false;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering event: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Deliver pending events to an agent (called when agent connects)
     */
    async deliverPendingEventsToAgent(agentId: string, socket: any): Promise<number> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const pendingEvents = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId);
            let deliveredCount = 0;

            for (const event of pendingEvents) {
                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    try {
                        socket.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'agentEvent',
                            event
                        }));
                        agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                        deliveredCount++;
                    } catch (error: any) {
                        logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Failed to deliver event ${event.eventId}: ${error.message}`);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deliveredCount > 0) {
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered ${deliveredCount} pending events to agent ${agentId}`);
            }

            return deliveredCount;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return 0;
        }
    },

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventQueue,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventPriority,
    PRIORITY_ORDER,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Store
 * In-memory store for managing agent event queues with EventEmitter for notifications.
 * Handles per-agent queues with pending and delivered states.
 */
class AgentEventQueueStore extends EventEmitter {
    private static instance: AgentEventQueueStore;

    /** Per-agent queues: Map<agentId, AgentEventQueue> */
    private agentQueues: Map<string, AgentEventQueue> = new Map();

    /** Quick lookup by eventId: Map<eventId, { agentId, eventId }> */
    private eventIndex: Map<string, { agentId: string; eventId: string }> = new Map();

    private constructor() {
        super();
        // Increase max listeners to handle multiple subscriptions
        this.setMaxListeners(50);
    }

    /**
     * Get singleton instance
     */
    static getInstance(): AgentEventQueueStore {
        if (!AgentEventQueueStore.instance) {
            AgentEventQueueStore.instance = new AgentEventQueueStore();
        }
        return AgentEventQueueStore.instance;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Queue Management
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Ensure a queue exists for an agent, create if not
     */
    ensureQueue(agentId: string, agentInstanceId?: string): AgentEventQueue {
        let queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            queue = {
                agentId,
                agentInstanceId,
                pendingEvents: new Map(),
                deliveredEvents: new Map()
            };
            this.agentQueues.set(agentId, queue);
            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Created queue for agent: ${agentId}`);
        }
        return queue;
    }

    /**
     * Get queue for an agent (returns undefined if not exists)
     */
    getQueue(agentId: string): AgentEventQueue | undefined {
        return this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
    }

    /**
     * Check if agent has a queue
     */
    hasQueue(agentId: string): boolean {
        return this.agentQueues.has(agentId);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Event Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event to agent's pending queue
     */
    addEvent(event: AgentEventMessage): void {
        const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

        // Check queue size limit
        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Queue full for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, removing oldest event`);
            // Remove oldest low-priority event
            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);
        }

        // Add to pending queue
        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);

        // Add to index for quick lookup
        this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            eventId: event.eventId
        });

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Added event ${event.eventId} for agent ${event.targetAgentId} (type: ${event.eventType}, priority: ${event.priority})`);
    }

    /**
     * Mark event as delivered (moved from pending to delivered queue)
     */
    markDelivered(eventId: string): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        const event = queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not in pending queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED;
        event.deliveredAt = new Date().toISOString();

        // Move from pending to delivered
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.set(eventId, event);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:delivered', {
            eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId
        });

        logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Marked event ${eventId} as delivered`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Handle acknowledgement from agent - removes from queue
     */
    handleAck(ack: AgentEventAck): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        // Find event in either pending or delivered queue
        let event = queue.deliveredEvents.get(ack.eventId) || queue.pendingEvents.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not in any queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED;
        event.acknowledgedAt = ack.acknowledgedAt;

        // Remove from both queues
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(ack.eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Remove from index
        this.eventIndex.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', {
            eventId: ack.eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Acknowledged event ${ack.eventId} for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (sorted by priority then creation time)
     * Includes both PENDING and DELIVERED events (delivered but not yet acknowledged)
     */
    getPendingEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return [];
        }

        // Get events from both pending and delivered queues
        // PENDING = not yet sent, DELIVERED = sent but not acknowledged
        const pendingEvents = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING);

        const deliveredEvents = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED);

        const allEvents = [...pendingEvents, ...deliveredEvents]
            .sort((a, b) => {
                // Sort by priority (lower PRIORITY_ORDER value = higher priority)
                const priorityDiff = PRIORITY_ORDER[a.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[b.priority];
                if (priorityDiff !== 0) {
                    return priorityDiff;
                }
                // Then by creation time (oldest first)
                return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
            });

        return limit ? allEvents.slice(0, limit) : allEvents;
    }

    /**
     * Pull events - get and remove from queue (no ACK needed)
     */
    pullEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const events = this.getPendingEvents(agentId, limit);
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);

        if (queue && events.length > 0) {
            for (const event of events) {
                event.status = AgentEventStatus.PULLED;
                queue.pendingEvents.delete(event.eventId);
                this.eventIndex.delete(event.eventId);
            }

            // Emit event
            this.emit('agentEventQueue:pulled', {
                agentId,
                count: events.length
            });

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Pulled ${events.length} events for agent ${agentId}`);
        }

        return events;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of pending events for an agent (includes PENDING and DELIVERED)
     */
    getPendingCount(agentId: string): number {

        return this.agentQueues.has(agentId);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Event Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event to agent's pending queue
     */
    addEvent(event: AgentEventMessage): void {
        const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

        // Check queue size limit
        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Queue full for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, removing oldest event`);
            // Remove oldest low-priority event
            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);
        }

        // Add to pending queue
        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);

        // Add to index for quick lookup
        this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            eventId: event.eventId
        });

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Added event ${event.eventId} for agent ${event.targetAgentId} (type: ${event.eventType}, priority: ${event.priority})`);
    }

    /**
     * Mark event as delivered (moved from pending to delivered queue)
     */
    markDelivered(eventId: string): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        const event = queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not in pending queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED;
        event.deliveredAt = new Date().toISOString();

        // Move from pending to delivered
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.set(eventId, event);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:delivered', {
            eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId
        });

        logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Marked event ${eventId} as delivered`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Handle acknowledgement from agent - removes from queue
     */
    handleAck(ack: AgentEventAck): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        // Find event in either pending or delivered queue
        let event = queue.deliveredEvents.get(ack.eventId) || queue.pendingEvents.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not in any queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED;
        event.acknowledgedAt = ack.acknowledgedAt;

        // Remove from both queues
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(ack.eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Remove from index
        this.eventIndex.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', {
            eventId: ack.eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Acknowledged event ${ack.eventId} for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (sorted by priority then creation time)
     * Includes both PENDING and DELIVERED events (delivered but not yet acknowledged)
     */
    getPendingEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return [];
        }

        // Get events from both pending and delivered queues
        // PENDING = not yet sent, DELIVERED = sent but not acknowledged
        const pendingEvents = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING);

        const deliveredEvents = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED);

        const allEvents = [...pendingEvents, ...deliveredEvents]
            .sort((a, b) => {
                // Sort by priority (lower PRIORITY_ORDER value = higher priority)
                const priorityDiff = PRIORITY_ORDER[a.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[b.priority];
                if (priorityDiff !== 0) {
                    return priorityDiff;
                }
                // Then by creation time (oldest first)
                return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
            });

        return limit ? allEvents.slice(0, limit) : allEvents;
    }

    /**
     * Pull events - get and remove from queue (no ACK needed)
     */
    pullEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const events = this.getPendingEvents(agentId, limit);
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);

        if (queue && events.length > 0) {
            for (const event of events) {
                event.status = AgentEventStatus.PULLED;
                queue.pendingEvents.delete(event.eventId);
                this.eventIndex.delete(event.eventId);
            }

            // Emit event
            this.emit('agentEventQueue:pulled', {
                agentId,
                count: events.length
            });

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Pulled ${events.length} events for agent ${agentId}`);
        }

        return events;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of pending events for an agent (includes PENDING and DELIVERED)
     */
    getPendingCount(agentId: string): number {
]]></tool_result>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="86" timestamp="2026-07-02T14:54:37.884Z">
I checked the actual `act-updated` agent. Your model is mostly right, but one important detail is different: the loop does not explicitly wait on “waiting tasks.” It only drains already-available external events.

**Actual Flow**
1. A user message reaches the server and goes through [agentMessageService.ts](/D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/services/agentMessageService.ts:126), which sends the message to the selected agent process via `sendMessageToCodebotCli(...)`.

2. In [act-updated/src/index.ts](&lt;/D:/Codeboltapps/codeboltjs/agents/act-updated/src/index.ts:416&gt;), every `codebolt.onMessage(...)` creates a new `CodeboltAgent`. So yes: each new user message creates a fresh runtime instance.

3. Continuity is rebuilt by `ChatHistoryMessageModifier`, not by reusing `AgentRunState`. In [chatHistoryMessageModifier.ts](/D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/sdks/agent/src/processor-pieces/messageModifiers/chatHistoryMessageModifier.ts:35), it calls `codebolt.chat.getChatHistory(threadId)` and prepends those messages into the new prompt.

4. The agent SDK loop is in [agent.ts](/D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/sdks/agent/src/unified/agent/agent.ts:287). It keeps running until `ResponseExecutor` says completed. Completion happens when the LLM returns no tool calls, or calls `attempt_completion`.

5. Async command flow:
   - `execute_command` calls `cbterminal.executeCommand(...)`.
   - Long-running commands return `commandRunning` with `processId`.
   - The tool result says “Command is running in the background... Process ID: X”.
   - The server stores the command record and later emits `backgroundCommandCompletion` through `agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent(...)` in [aiTerminal.ts](/D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/sockets/aiTerminal.ts:307).

6. `act-updated` drains external events in two places:
   - before inference via `externalEventProcessor` at [index.ts](&lt;/D:/Codeboltapps/codeboltjs/agents/act-updated/src/index.ts:387&gt;)
   - after tool execution via `externalEventPostToolProcessor` at [index.ts](&lt;/D:/Codeboltapps/codeboltjs/agents/act-updated/src/index.ts:399&gt;)

**Important Behavior**
`backgroundCommandCompletion` arrives as an `agentQueueEvent` with payload `{ type: &#34;custom&#34;, eventName: &#34;backgroundCommandCompletion&#34;, data: ... }`. Your `processExternalEvent(...)` does not special-case that event name; it injects it as a generic `&lt;agent_event&gt;` user message.

So:
- If the completion event is already pending while the loop is still running, it gets injected into the same run.
- If the loop finishes before the command completes, the process exits. The event stays queued server-side and is delivered when the agent reconnects on a later user message.
- The current code does **not** keep the loop alive just because a background command is still running.

The main gap: if your intended behavior is “do not end while async tasks exist,” that is not currently implemented in `act-updated`. Current behavior is “continue while LLM/tool loop continues; inject async events only if they are pending during one of the drain points.”

<message role="assistant" ordinal="88" timestamp="2026-07-02T15:05:46.233Z">
Yes, that makes sense. I’d make the runtime own async task lifecycle, not rely on the LLM remembering to clean up.

Recommended model:

**Default rule:** background tasks are owned by the current agent run and are killed when that run ends, unless the tool explicitly marks them as detached/keep-alive.

That handles `npm run dev`: it can run while the agent needs it, but when the agent calls `attempt_completion` or naturally finishes, the runtime stops it automatically. If the agent needs it to survive for user preview, the tool must mark it as `keepAlive: true` with a reason and preferably a TTL.

For completions, I would not auto-resume the agent by default. Queue the event and consume it on the next user message. Auto-resume should be opt-in per async task, e.g. `resumePolicy: &#34;on_completion&#34;`, and only for bounded jobs like tests/builds. Dev servers should use `resumePolicy: &#34;none&#34;` because they may never complete.

I’d split async tasks into three policies:

`ephemeral`
Default. Owned by current agent run. Stop on agent completion or user stop.

`awaited`
The agent wants completion. Queue completion event, optionally auto-resume if `resumePolicy` allows it. Has timeout.

`detached`
Allowed to survive agent completion. Requires explicit reason, TTL, and thread-visible record. Example: preview server for the user.

For forced stop/cancel: runtime should stop all `ephemeral` and `awaited` tasks for that agent run. For `detached`, either leave them running or ask/record policy. Then write a thread-visible event like: “Agent was stopped. Runtime stopped process 123 `npm test`; kept process 456 `npm run dev` as detached.” When the user says “continue,” the next agent can see exactly what happened.

Implementation-wise, I’d add a thread/run scoped task registry:

- `threadId`
- `agentInstanceId`
- `runId`
- `processId`
- `command`
- `status`
- `ownership`: `ephemeral | awaited | detached`
- `resumePolicy`: `none | on_completion | on_failure`
- `stopPolicy`: `on_agent_finish | on_user_stop | manual`
- `ttlMs`
- `startedAt`, `endedAt`
- `outputTail`

Then update the terminal tool schema to include lifecycle intent, while keeping safe defaults. The important guardrail is: if the LLM forgets to stop `npm run dev`, the runtime still cleans it up on run end unless it was explicitly detached.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="90" timestamp="2026-07-02T15:07:02.306Z">
Runtime should kill automatically by default. Do not ask the LLM to clean up as the primary mechanism.

The LLM can be informed or given a chance to decide, but cleanup must be deterministic. Otherwise `npm run dev`, watchers, tail commands, servers, and stuck installs can keep the agent alive forever.

Recommended behavior:

1. Foreground command
If the agent asks for foreground, wait only up to a bounded timeout/yield window. If it becomes long-running, convert it to a managed background task or fail with timeout. Never wait forever.

2. Background command, default ownership
Treat it as run-owned. When the agent finishes, the runtime stops it automatically.

3. Long-running dev server
Detect it as `background`/`server`. Let the agent use it during the run. On agent completion:
- if not explicitly marked `detached`, kill it.
- add a context/event note saying the runtime stopped it.
- include last output/port info.

4. Detached server
Only keep it alive if the tool call explicitly says something like `keep_alive: true`, ideally with TTL and reason. Example: “Keep preview server alive for user testing.” Then it should be visible in thread context so a later “continue” agent knows it exists.

So for your question: no, do not wait for `npm run dev` to end. The moment it is recognized as a server/long-running process, the command tool should return `processId`, `port`, and output-so-far. The agent loop continues. When the agent ends, runtime cleans it unless it was intentionally detached.

A good lifecycle is:

`running inline` -&gt; `yielded/background` -&gt; `used by agent` -&gt; `agent finishes` -&gt; `runtime cleanup` -&gt; `context note saved`

For user-forced stop, same principle: runtime immediately stops run-owned async tasks, records what it stopped, and leaves only explicitly detached tasks alive.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="92" timestamp="2026-07-02T15:18:10.368Z">
For background **agent threads**, I would not use one global rule. Use a completion policy per spawned thread.

Recommended default:

**Stop the parent agent and inject the child completion on the next user message.** Do not auto-resume by default.

Why: background threads may take minutes, may fail, may produce noisy partial results, and auto-resuming can surprise the user by spending tokens or making edits after the user thought the agent was done.

Use three policies:

`fire_and_forget`
Parent starts child thread, records thread id, then continues/finishes. Completion is stored in the parent thread context and surfaced next time the user says continue.

`await_blocking`
Parent waits for child completion only if the task is expected to be short and bounded. Must have timeout. If timeout hits, parent gets a “still running” event and decides what to do.

`auto_resume_on_completion`
Parent exits/suspends, and runtime starts a new parent agent turn when child completes. This should be opt-in and visible to the user, because it can cause autonomous follow-up work.

For your architecture, I’d implement default as:

1. Parent calls background thread tool.
2. Tool returns `childThreadId`, `status: running`, `completionPolicy: next_user_turn`.
3. Parent LLM can continue if it has other work, or call `attempt_completion` saying the subtask is running.
4. Runtime stores a parent-thread event: “Child thread X started.”
5. When child completes, server stores another parent-thread event: “Child thread X completed,” with summary/output.
6. If user later says “continue,” the new parent agent process gets those pending thread events injected before inference.

Auto-resume should exist, but only for explicit cases like “run this subagent and continue when it finishes.” Even then, add a maximum resume count / timeout so it cannot loop forever.

So the best default is: **parent stops, child completion is persisted, next user turn consumes it**. Use auto-resume as an explicit advanced policy, not the baseline.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="94" timestamp="2026-07-02T15:20:53.347Z">
Yes, that is the best shape, with one guardrail: make it a **single bounded cleanup turn**, not an infinite continuation loop.

When the agent wants to stop, runtime should run an “exit gate”:

1. Agent reaches completion.
2. Runtime checks active async tasks for this `agentInstanceId` / `threadId`.
3. If none: end normally.
4. If there are active tasks: inject a system/user message like:
<code_block language="text"><![CDATA[
You attempted to finish, but these async tasks are still active:
- process 123: npm run dev, running for 8m, port 5173
- child thread abc: status running

Choose one action for each:
- stop
- detach with reason and TTL
- wait if bounded
Then call attempt_completion again.
]]></code_block>
5. Let the LLM do one cleanup pass.
6. Runtime enforces the result. If the LLM ignores it or loops, runtime applies default policy.

The default policy should be:

- `npm run dev`, watchers, servers: stop unless explicitly detached.
- background child agents: detach by default and persist completion event for next user turn.
- short bounded commands/tests/builds: optionally wait up to timeout.
- unknown long-running processes: stop unless detached.
- on user forced stop: skip LLM cleanup and runtime stops run-owned tasks immediately.

This gives the LLM agency without trusting it as the final safety mechanism.

I’d implement task states like:

`running -&gt; exit_review_required -&gt; stopping | detached | waiting -&gt; resolved`

And policies:

`runOwned`: killed on finish unless detached.
`threadOwned`: survives parent process, but visible to next parent turn.
`detached`: survives with TTL/reason.
`awaited`: parent may wait, but only bounded.

So yes: on natural agent completion, check waiting tasks and give the LLM a cleanup chance. But after one or two cleanup turns max, runtime must decide. Otherwise `npm run dev` can trap the agent forever.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="96" timestamp="2026-07-02T15:25:44.404Z">
Yes. A unified “wait/stop/detach” tool is the cleanest version of this.

I would not make the agent manually read event queues. Give it a task-control surface:

- `async_task_list`
- `async_task_wait`
- `async_task_stop`
- `async_task_detach`

Or one tool:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
async_task_control({
  task_id,
  action: "wait" | "stop" | "detach",
  timeout_ms?,
  reason?,
  ttl_ms?
})
]]></code_block>
The runtime tracks commands, child threads, long-running jobs, etc. as the same abstraction: `AsyncTask`.

When the agent tries to finish, runtime checks active run-owned tasks. If any exist, it injects:
<code_block language="text"><![CDATA[
You attempted to finish, but these async tasks are still active.

- task cmd:123, type command, command "npm run dev", status running, port 5173
- task thread:abc, type background_thread, status running

Before completing, choose for each task:
- wait: wait for bounded completion
- stop: terminate it
- detach: leave it running with reason and TTL
]]></code_block>
Then the LLM calls the tool. This keeps the LLM in control of intent, while the runtime remains in control of safety.

Important constraint: `wait` must be bounded. Do not allow an unbounded `waitforprocesstoend`, because `npm run dev` will never end. For long-running servers, `async_task_wait` should either require `timeout_ms` or return something like:
<code_block language="json"><![CDATA[
{
  "status": "still_running",
  "classification": "long_running_service",
  "suggested_actions": ["detach", "stop"]
}
]]></code_block>
So the loop becomes:

1. Agent starts async task.
2. Runtime returns `task_id`.
3. Agent continues.
4. Agent attempts completion.
5. Runtime exit gate finds active tasks.
6. Agent must call `async_task_control` for each task.
7. Runtime permits completion only when all tasks are `done`, `stopped`, or `detached`.

For forced user stop, skip the LLM. Runtime should immediately stop run-owned tasks and preserve detached tasks. Then write a thread event so the next “continue” knows what was stopped and what is still running.

This design is simple and robust: the LLM decides wait/stop/detach, but cannot accidentally keep the run alive forever.
</message>

@@ -0,0 +1,356 @@
+// ── codebolt command mcp <action> ──
+
+import { Command } from 'commander';
+import { createClient } from './client-factory';
+import { printJson, printRecord, printSuccess, printTable } from './output';
+
+type CliFlags = Record<string, string | boolean>;
+
+type McpAvailableServer = {
+  id?: string | number;
+  mcpId?: string | number;
+  name?: string;
+  title?: string;
+  author?: string;
+  category?: string | { name?: string };
+  description?: string;
+  tags?: string[] | string;
+  githubUrl?: string;
+};
+
+export function buildMcpCommand(): Command {
+  const mcp = new Command('mcp')
+    .description('Manage MCP servers');
+
+  mcp.command('available')
+    .description('List registry MCP servers available for installation')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const servers = await getAvailableList(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(servers);
+      printTable(
+        normalizeList(servers).map((server) => ({
+          id: server.mcpId || server.id,
+          name: server.name || server.title,
+          category: getCategoryName(server.category),
+          author: server.author,
+          description: server.description,
+        })),
+        ['id', 'name', 'category', 'author', 'description'],
+      );
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('detail')
+    .description('Show registry MCP server details')
+    .requiredOption('--id <mcpId>', 'Registry MCP ID')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const detail = await getAvailableDetail(client, flags, opts.id);
+      if (json) return printJson(detail);
+      printRecord(flattenMcpDetail(detail));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('install')
+    .description('Install a registry MCP server')
+    .option('--id <mcpId>', 'Registry MCP ID')
+    .option('--name <name>', 'Registry MCP name, title, ID, or slug')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      if (!opts.id && !opts.name) {
+        console.error('Error: provide --id or --name');
+        process.exit(1);
+      }
+
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const mcpId = opts.id || await resolveMcpIdByName(client, flags, opts.name);
+      const result = await installMcp(client, flags, { mcpId });
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess(`MCP install started: ${mcpId}`);
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('local')
+    .description('List local project MCP servers')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const localMcps = await getLocalMcpList(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(localMcps);
+      printTable(
+        normalizeList(localMcps).map((server: any) => ({
+          id: server.uniqueName || server.mcpId || server.id,
+          name: server.name,
+          version: server.version,
+          description: server.description,
+        })),
+        ['id', 'name', 'version', 'description'],
+      );
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('install-local')
+    .description('Install a local project MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <uniqueName>', 'Local MCP unique name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const result = await installMcp(client, flags, { isLocal: true, uniqueName: opts.name });
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess(`Local MCP install started: ${opts.name}`);
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('list')
+    .description('List installed MCP servers')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const data = await getAllMcps(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(data);
+      printTable(formatInstalledServers(data), ['name', 'enabled', 'command', 'args']);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('tools')
+    .description('List cached configured MCP tools')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const data = await getConfiguredMcps(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(data);
+      printTable(formatConfiguredTools(data), ['server', 'tool', 'description']);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('refresh')
+    .description('Refresh MCP tools cache')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const result = await updateMcpTools(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess('MCP tools cache refresh requested.');
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('enable')
+    .description('Enable an installed MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <serverName>', 'Installed MCP server name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      await toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd, opts.name, true);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('disable')
+    .description('Disable an installed MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <serverName>', 'Installed MCP server name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      await toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd, opts.name, false);
+    });
+
+  return mcp;
+}
+
+async function toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd: Command, serverName: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
+  const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+  const json = isJson(cmd);
+  const client = await createClient(flags);
+  const result = await toggleMcp(client, flags, { serverName, enabled });
+  if (json) return printJson(result);
+  printSuccess(`MCP server ${enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}: ${serverName}`);
+  printRecord(asRecord(result));
+}
+
+async function getAvailableList(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getAvailableList', 'GET', '/mcp/available/list');
+}
+
+async function getAvailableDetail(client: any, flags: CliFlags, mcpId: string): Promise<any> {
+  if (client?.mcp?.getAvailableDetail) {
+    return client.mcp.getAvailableDetail(mcpId);
+  }
+  return request(flags, 'GET', `/mcp/available/list/detail/${encodeURIComponent(mcpId)}`);
+}
+
+async function getLocalMcpList(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getLocalMcpList', 'GET', '/mcp/localMcp/list');
+}
+
+async function getAllMcps(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getAll', 'GET', '/mcp');
+}
+
+async function getConfiguredMcps(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getConfiguredMcps', 'GET', '/mcp/configured/mcps');
+}
+
+async function installMcp(client: any, flags: CliFlags, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'install', 'POST', '/mcp/install', data);
+}
+
+async function updateMcpTools(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'updateTools', 'POST', '/mcp/tools/update', {});
+}
+
+async function toggleMcp(client: any, flags: CliFlags, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'toggle', 'POST', '/mcp/toggle', data);
+}
+
+async function callMcp(
+  client: any,
+  flags: CliFlags,
+  methodName: string,
+  httpMethod: string,
+  path: string,
+  body?: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Promise<any> {
+  if (client?.mcp?.[methodName]) {
+    return body === undefined ? client.mcp[methodName]() : client.mcp[methodName](body);
+  }
+  return request(flags, httpMethod, path, body);
+}
+
+async function request(flags: CliFlags, method: string, path: string, body?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  const host = typeof flags.host === 'string' ? flags.host : 'localhost';
+  const port = typeof flags.port === 'string' ? flags.port : '2719';
+  const response = await fetch(`http://${host}:${port}${path}`, {
+    method,
+    headers: body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
+    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
+  });
+
+  const text = await response.text();
+  const data = parseResponseBody(text);
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(data?.error || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
+  }
+
+  return data;
+}
+
+async function resolveMcpIdByName(client: any, flags: CliFlags, name: string): Promise<string> {
+  const servers = normalizeList(await getAvailableList(client, flags));
+  const normalizedName = normalizeLookupValue(name);
+  const match = servers.find((server) => getLookupValues(server).includes(normalizedName));
+
+  if (!match) {
+    console.error(`Error: MCP "${name}" was not found in the registry list.`);
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+
+  return String(match.mcpId || match.id || match.name);
+}
+
+function getLookupValues(server: McpAvailableServer): string[] {
+  return [server.name, server.title, server.mcpId, server.id]
+    .filter((value): value is string | number => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '')
+    .map((value) => normalizeLookupValue(String(value)));
+}
+
+function normalizeLookupValue(value: string): string {
+  return value
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
+}
+
+function normalizeList(data: any): any[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.data)) return data.data;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.mcps)) return data.mcps;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.mcpServers)) return data.mcpServers;
+  return [];
+}
+
+function getCategoryName(category: McpAvailableServer['category']): string {
+  if (!category) return '';
+  return typeof category === 'string' ? category : category.name || '';
+}
+
+function flattenMcpDetail(detail: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return {
+    id: detail?.mcpId || detail?.id,
+    name: detail?.name || detail?.title,
+    author: detail?.author,
+    category: getCategoryName(detail?.category),
+    description: detail?.description,
+    githubUrl: detail?.githubUrl,
+    requiresApiKey: detail?.requiresApiKey,
+    tags: Array.isArray(detail?.tags) ? detail.tags.join(', ') : detail?.tags,
+  };
+}
+
+function formatInstalledServers(data: any): Record<string, unknown>[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
+    return data.map((server: any) => ({
+      name: server.name || server.serverName || server.mcpId || server.id,
+      enabled: server.enabled ?? server.status,
+      command: server.command,
+      args: Array.isArray(server.args) ? server.args.join(' ') : server.args,
+    }));
+  }
+
+  const servers = data?.mcpServers || data || {};
+  return Object.keys(servers).map((name) => ({
+    name,
+    enabled: Array.isArray(data?.enabled) ? data.enabled.includes(name) : '',
+    command: servers[name]?.command,
+    args: Array.isArray(servers[name]?.args) ? servers[name].args.join(' ') : '',
+  }));
+}
+
+function formatConfiguredTools(data: any): Record<string, unknown>[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
+    return data.flatMap((server: any) => {
+      const serverName = server.name || server.serverName || server.mcpId || server.id;
+      const tools = Array.isArray(server.tools) ? server.tools : [];
+      return tools.map((tool: any) => formatToolRow(serverName, tool));
+    });
+  }
+
+  return Object.entries(data || {}).flatMap(([serverName, serverData]: [string, any]) => {
+    const tools = Array.isArray(serverData?.tools) ? serverData.tools : [];
+    return tools.map((tool: any) => formatToolRow(serverName, tool));
+  });
+}
+
+function formatToolRow(serverName: string, tool: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return {
+    server: serverName,
+    tool: tool?.function?.name || tool?.name,
+    description: tool?.function?.description || tool?.description,
+  };
+}
+
+function parseResponseBody(text: string): any {
+  if (!text) return {};
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(text);
+  } catch {
+    return { result: text };
+  }
+}
+
+function asRecord(data: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  if (data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)) return data;
+  return { result: data };
+}
+
+function parentFlags(cmd: Command): CliFlags {
+  const root = cmd.parent?.parent;
+  const opts = root?.opts() || {};
+  return { port: opts.port || '2719', host: opts.host || 'localhost', json: !!opts.json };
+}
+
+function isJson(cmd: Command): boolean {
+  const root = cmd.parent?.parent;
+  return !!(root?.opts()?.json);
+}

 // ── Command router for codebolt command <module> <action> ──
 
 import { Command } from 'commander';
 import { buildThreadsCommand } from './threads';
 import { buildTasksCommand } from './tasks';
 import { buildJobsCommand } from './jobs';
 import { buildAgentsCommand } from './agents';
 import { buildGitCommand } from './git';
 import { buildSystemCommand } from './system';
 import { buildProjectsCommand } from './projects';
 import { buildChatCommand } from './chat';
 import { buildTodosCommand } from './todos';
 import { buildLlmCommand } from './llm';
+import { buildMcpCommand } from './mcp';
 
 export function buildCommandCommand(): Command {
   const cmd = new Command('command')
     .description('Connect to a running server and execute commands')
     .option('--port <number>', 'Server port', '2719')
     .option('--host <string>', 'Server host', 'localhost')
     .option('--json', 'Output raw JSON')
     .addHelpText('after', `
 Available modules:
   threads      List, create, delete, and inspect chat threads
   tasks        List, create, delete, and manage tasks
   jobs         List and inspect background jobs
   agents       List and manage installed agents
   git          Git operations (status, branches, diff, log, commit, push, pull)
   system       Server health check, CLI status, open folder
   projects     Project info, config, threads, history
   chat         Chat threads, messages, steps, memory
   todos        List, create, update, delete todo items
   llm          LLM providers, models, pricing, keys, local models
+  mcp          MCP servers, registry install, local install, tools
 
 Examples:
   $ codebolt command llm providers                List LLM providers
+  $ codebolt command mcp available                List registry MCP servers
+  $ codebolt command mcp install --id github      Install a registry MCP server
   $ codebolt command threads list                 List all threads
   $ codebolt command threads list --json          Output as JSON
   $ codebolt command git status                   Show git status
   $ codebolt command agents list --port 3000      Use custom port
   $ codebolt command system health                Check server health
   $ codebolt command todos list                   List all todos`);
 
   const subcommands = [
     buildThreadsCommand(),
     buildTasksCommand(),
     buildJobsCommand(),
     buildAgentsCommand(),
     buildGitCommand(),
     buildSystemCommand(),
     buildProjectsCommand(),
     buildChatCommand(),
     buildTodosCommand(),
     buildLlmCommand(),
+    buildMcpCommand(),
   ];
 
   const inheritedHelp = `
 Global options (from parent "codebolt command"):
   --port <number>  Server port (default: 2719)
   --host <string>  Server host (default: localhost)
   --json           Output raw JSON instead of formatted tables`;
 
   for (const sub of subcommands) {
     sub.addHelpText('after', inheritedHelp);
     cmd.addCommand(sub);
   }
 
   return cmd;
 }

 /**
  * Thread Create Start Tool - Creates and immediately starts a new thread
  * Wraps the SDK's threadService.createAndStartThread() method
  */
 
 import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
 import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
 import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
 import threadService from '../../modules/thread';
 
 export interface ThreadCreateStartParams {
     /** Thread creation and start options */
     options?: Record<string, any>;
     /** Task prompt to start the new thread with. */
     task: string;
     /** Optional explicit user message. Defaults to task. */
     userMessage?: string;
     /** Optional title for the new thread. */
     title?: string;
     /** Optional description for the new thread. */
     description?: string;
     /** Optional selected agent id or selected agent object. */
     selectedAgent?: string | Record<string, any>;
     /** Optional agent id. */
     agentId?: string;
     /** Optional group ID for the thread. */
     groupId?: string;
     /** Whether the thread belongs to a group. */
     isGrouped?: boolean;
     /** Existing environment id or environment object to run the thread in. */
     environment?: string | Record<string, any>;
     /** Existing environment id to run the thread in. Alias for environment. */
     environmentId?: string;
     /** If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally. */
     remoteEnv?: boolean;
     /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. */
     environmentProvider?: {
         name: string;
         unique_id?: string;
         providerId?: string;
     };
     /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
     environmentName?: string;
+    /** If true, wait for completion before returning. Defaults to false. */
+    waitForCompletion?: boolean;
 }

     constructor(params: ThreadCreateStartParams) {
         super(params);
     }
 
     async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
         try {
             const baseOptions = this.params.options || {};
             const environment = this.params.environment !== undefined
                 ? this.params.environment
                 : this.params.environmentId
                     ? { id: this.params.environmentId }
                     : undefined;
             const selectedAgent = this.params.selectedAgent !== undefined
                 ? typeof this.params.selectedAgent === 'string'
                     ? { id: this.params.selectedAgent }
                     : this.params.selectedAgent
                 : undefined;
             const userMessage = this.params.userMessage || this.params.task;
             const options = {
                 ...baseOptions,
                 title: this.params.title || baseOptions.title || this.params.task,

                 userMessage,

                 ...(this.params.agentId && { agentId: this.params.agentId }),
                 ...(this.params.groupId && { groupId: this.params.groupId }),

                     : (response.error as any)?.message || 'Thread creation and start failed';
                 return {
                     llmContent: `Thread creation and start failed: ${errorMsg}`,
                     returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMsg}`,

-            let output = 'Created and started thread successfully';
+            let output = resp.async === false ? 'Thread completed successfully' : 'Thread started successfully';
             if (resp.threadId) {
                 output += `\n\nThread ID: ${resp.threadId}`;
             }
+            if (resp.targetAgentId) {
+                output += `\nTarget Agent ID: ${resp.targetAgentId}`;
+            }
+            output += `\nTarget Agent Instance ID: ${resp.targetAgentInstanceId || 'not available yet'}`;
+            if (resp.activityId) {
+                output += `\nActivity ID: ${resp.activityId}`;
+            }
+            if (resp.status) {
+                output += `\nStatus: ${resp.status}`;
+            }
+            output += `\nCompletion Event: ${resp.completionEvent || 'threadCompletion'}`;
+            if (resp.threadId && resp.targetAgentId) {
+                output += `\n\nTo send this agent a message, use tool \`eventqueue_send_message\` with targetAgentId="${resp.targetAgentId}", targetThreadId="${resp.threadId}", and content="<message>".`;
+            }
+            if (resp.threadId && resp.async !== false) {
+                output += `\nTo wait for this thread to complete, use tool \`thread_wait_for_completion\` with threadId="${resp.threadId}".`;
+            }
+            if (resp.output) {

             if (resp.thread) {

             return {

                     type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                 },
             };

                     },

                     },
                     environmentName: {

                         type: 'string',
                     },
+                    waitForCompletion: {
+                        description: 'If true, wait for the thread to complete before returning. Defaults to false.',
+                        type: 'boolean',
+                    },
                 },
                 required: ['task'],
                 type: 'object',
             },
         );
     }
 
     protected override validateToolParamValues(params: ThreadCreateStartParams): string | null {
         if (params.options !== undefined && (typeof params.options !== 'object' || params.options === null || Array.isArray(params.options))) {
             return "'options' must be an object when provided";
         }
         if (typeof params.task !== 'string' || !params.task.trim()) {
             return "'task' is required and must be a non-empty string";
         }
         if (params.userMessage !== undefined && (typeof params.userMessage !== 'string' || !params.userMessage.trim())) {
             return "'userMessage' must be a non-empty string when provided";
         }
         if (params.selectedAgent !== undefined && typeof params.selectedAgent !== 'string' && (typeof params.selectedAgent !== 'object' || params.selectedAgent === null || Array.isArray(params.selectedAgent))) {
             return "'selectedAgent' must be a string agent id or selected agent object when provided";
         }
         if (params.environmentId !== undefined && (typeof params.environmentId !== 'string' || !params.environmentId.trim())) {
             return "'environmentId' must be a non-empty string when provided";
         }
         if (
             params.environment !== undefined &&
             typeof params.environment !== 'string' &&
             (typeof params.environment !== 'object' || params.environment === null || Array.isArray(params.environment))
         ) {
             return "'environment' must be a string environment id or an environment object when provided";
         }
         return null;
     }
 
     protected createInvocation(params: ThreadCreateStartParams): ToolInvocation<ThreadCreateStartParams, ToolResult> {
         return new ThreadCreateStartInvocation(params);

 }

+/**
+ * Thread Wait For Completion Tool - waits for a thread to complete.
+ */
+
+import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
+import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
+import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
+import threadService from '../../modules/thread';
+
+export interface ThreadWaitForCompletionParams {
+    /** Thread ID to wait for. */
+    threadId: string;
+}
+
+class ThreadWaitForCompletionInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<ThreadWaitForCompletionParams, ToolResult> {
+    constructor(params: ThreadWaitForCompletionParams) {
+        super(params);
+    }
+
+    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
+        try {
+            const response = await threadService.waitForThreadCompletion({
+                threadId: this.params.threadId,
+            });
+
+            if (response && !response.success && response.success !== undefined) {
+                const errorMsg = typeof response.error === 'string'
+                    ? response.error
+                    : 'Thread wait failed';
+                return {
+                    llmContent: `Thread wait failed: ${errorMsg}`,
+                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMsg}`,
+                    error: {
+                        message: errorMsg,
+                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
+                    },
+                };
+            }
+
+            const resp = response as any;
+            let llmContent = 'Thread completed.';
+            llmContent += `\n\nThread ID: ${resp.threadId || this.params.threadId}`;
+            if (resp.status) {
+                llmContent += `\nStatus: ${resp.status}`;
+            }
+            if (resp.activityId) {
+                llmContent += `\nActivity ID: ${resp.activityId}`;
+            }
+            if (resp.output) {
+                llmContent += `\n\nOutput:\n${resp.output}`;
+            }
+
+            return {
+                llmContent,
+                returnDisplay: `Thread ${resp.threadId || this.params.threadId} completed`,
+            };
+        } catch (error) {
+            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
+            return {
+                llmContent: `Error waiting for thread completion: ${errorMessage}`,
+                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
+                error: {
+                    message: errorMessage,
+                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
+                },
+            };
+        }
+    }
+}
+
+export class ThreadWaitForCompletionTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<ThreadWaitForCompletionParams, ToolResult> {
+    static readonly Name: string = 'thread_wait_for_completion';
+
+    constructor() {
+        super(
+            ThreadWaitForCompletionTool.Name,
+            'ThreadWaitForCompletion',
+            'Waits for a previously started thread to complete. This blocks until completion and has no timeout.',
+            Kind.Execute,
+            {
+                properties: {
+                    threadId: {
+                        description: 'Thread ID returned by thread_create_start or thread_create_background.',
+                        type: 'string',
+                    },
+                },
+                required: ['threadId'],
+                type: 'object',
+            },
+        );
+    }
+
+    protected override validateToolParamValues(params: ThreadWaitForCompletionParams): string | null {
+        if (typeof params.threadId !== 'string' || !params.threadId.trim()) {
+            return "'threadId' is required and must be a non-empty string";
+        }
+        return null;
+    }
+
+    protected createInvocation(params: ThreadWaitForCompletionParams): ToolInvocation<ThreadWaitForCompletionParams, ToolResult> {
+        return new ThreadWaitForCompletionInvocation(params);
+    }
+}
]]></tool_result>

+// ── codebolt command mcp <action> ──
+
+import { Command } from 'commander';
+import { createClient } from './client-factory';
+import { printJson, printRecord, printSuccess, printTable } from './output';
+
+type CliFlags = Record<string, string | boolean>;
+
+type McpAvailableServer = {
+  id?: string | number;
+  mcpId?: string | number;
+  name?: string;
+  title?: string;
+  author?: string;
+  category?: string | { name?: string };
+  description?: string;
+  tags?: string[] | string;
+  githubUrl?: string;
+};
+
+export function buildMcpCommand(): Command {
+  const mcp = new Command('mcp')
+    .description('Manage MCP servers');
+
+  mcp.command('available')
+    .description('List registry MCP servers available for installation')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const servers = await getAvailableList(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(servers);
+      printTable(
+        normalizeList(servers).map((server) => ({
+          id: server.mcpId || server.id,
+          name: server.name || server.title,
+          category: getCategoryName(server.category),
+          author: server.author,
+          description: server.description,
+        })),
+        ['id', 'name', 'category', 'author', 'description'],
+      );
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('detail')
+    .description('Show registry MCP server details')
+    .requiredOption('--id <mcpId>', 'Registry MCP ID')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const detail = await getAvailableDetail(client, flags, opts.id);
+      if (json) return printJson(detail);
+      printRecord(flattenMcpDetail(detail));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('install')
+    .description('Install a registry MCP server')
+    .option('--id <mcpId>', 'Registry MCP ID')
+    .option('--name <name>', 'Registry MCP name, title, ID, or slug')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      if (!opts.id && !opts.name) {
+        console.error('Error: provide --id or --name');
+        process.exit(1);
+      }
+
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const mcpId = opts.id || await resolveMcpIdByName(client, flags, opts.name);
+      const result = await installMcp(client, flags, { mcpId });
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess(`MCP install started: ${mcpId}`);
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('local')
+    .description('List local project MCP servers')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const localMcps = await getLocalMcpList(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(localMcps);
+      printTable(
+        normalizeList(localMcps).map((server: any) => ({
+          id: server.uniqueName || server.mcpId || server.id,
+          name: server.name,
+          version: server.version,
+          description: server.description,
+        })),
+        ['id', 'name', 'version', 'description'],
+      );
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('install-local')
+    .description('Install a local project MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <uniqueName>', 'Local MCP unique name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const result = await installMcp(client, flags, { isLocal: true, uniqueName: opts.name });
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess(`Local MCP install started: ${opts.name}`);
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('list')
+    .description('List installed MCP servers')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const data = await getAllMcps(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(data);
+      printTable(formatInstalledServers(data), ['name', 'enabled', 'command', 'args']);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('tools')
+    .description('List cached configured MCP tools')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const data = await getConfiguredMcps(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(data);
+      printTable(formatConfiguredTools(data), ['server', 'tool', 'description']);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('refresh')
+    .description('Refresh MCP tools cache')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+      const json = isJson(cmd);
+      const client = await createClient(flags);
+      const result = await updateMcpTools(client, flags);
+      if (json) return printJson(result);
+      printSuccess('MCP tools cache refresh requested.');
+      printRecord(asRecord(result));
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('enable')
+    .description('Enable an installed MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <serverName>', 'Installed MCP server name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      await toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd, opts.name, true);
+    });
+
+  mcp.command('disable')
+    .description('Disable an installed MCP server')
+    .requiredOption('--name <serverName>', 'Installed MCP server name')
+    .action(async (opts, cmd) => {
+      await toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd, opts.name, false);
+    });
+
+  return mcp;
+}
+
+async function toggleMcpFromCommand(cmd: Command, serverName: string, enabled: boolean): Promise<void> {
+  const flags = parentFlags(cmd);
+  const json = isJson(cmd);
+  const client = await createClient(flags);
+  const result = await toggleMcp(client, flags, { serverName, enabled });
+  if (json) return printJson(result);
+  printSuccess(`MCP server ${enabled ? 'enabled' : 'disabled'}: ${serverName}`);
+  printRecord(asRecord(result));
+}
+
+async function getAvailableList(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getAvailableList', 'GET', '/mcp/available/list');
+}
+
+async function getAvailableDetail(client: any, flags: CliFlags, mcpId: string): Promise<any> {
+  if (client?.mcp?.getAvailableDetail) {
+    return client.mcp.getAvailableDetail(mcpId);
+  }
+  return request(flags, 'GET', `/mcp/available/list/detail/${encodeURIComponent(mcpId)}`);
+}
+
+async function getLocalMcpList(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getLocalMcpList', 'GET', '/mcp/localMcp/list');
+}
+
+async function getAllMcps(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getAll', 'GET', '/mcp');
+}
+
+async function getConfiguredMcps(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'getConfiguredMcps', 'GET', '/mcp/configured/mcps');
+}
+
+async function installMcp(client: any, flags: CliFlags, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'install', 'POST', '/mcp/install', data);
+}
+
+async function updateMcpTools(client: any, flags: CliFlags): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'updateTools', 'POST', '/mcp/tools/update', {});
+}
+
+async function toggleMcp(client: any, flags: CliFlags, data: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  return callMcp(client, flags, 'toggle', 'POST', '/mcp/toggle', data);
+}
+
+async function callMcp(
+  client: any,
+  flags: CliFlags,
+  methodName: string,
+  httpMethod: string,
+  path: string,
+  body?: Record<string, unknown>,
+): Promise<any> {
+  if (client?.mcp?.[methodName]) {
+    return body === undefined ? client.mcp[methodName]() : client.mcp[methodName](body);
+  }
+  return request(flags, httpMethod, path, body);
+}
+
+async function request(flags: CliFlags, method: string, path: string, body?: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<any> {
+  const host = typeof flags.host === 'string' ? flags.host : 'localhost';
+  const port = typeof flags.port === 'string' ? flags.port : '2719';
+  const response = await fetch(`http://${host}:${port}${path}`, {
+    method,
+    headers: body ? { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } : undefined,
+    body: body ? JSON.stringify(body) : undefined,
+  });
+
+  const text = await response.text();
+  const data = parseResponseBody(text);
+
+  if (!response.ok) {
+    throw new Error(data?.error || data?.message || `HTTP ${response.status}`);
+  }
+
+  return data;
+}
+
+async function resolveMcpIdByName(client: any, flags: CliFlags, name: string): Promise<string> {
+  const servers = normalizeList(await getAvailableList(client, flags));
+  const normalizedName = normalizeLookupValue(name);
+  const match = servers.find((server) => getLookupValues(server).includes(normalizedName));
+
+  if (!match) {
+    console.error(`Error: MCP "${name}" was not found in the registry list.`);
+    process.exit(1);
+  }
+
+  return String(match.mcpId || match.id || match.name);
+}
+
+function getLookupValues(server: McpAvailableServer): string[] {
+  return [server.name, server.title, server.mcpId, server.id]
+    .filter((value): value is string | number => value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '')
+    .map((value) => normalizeLookupValue(String(value)));
+}
+
+function normalizeLookupValue(value: string): string {
+  return value
+    .trim()
+    .toLowerCase()
+    .replace(/[^a-z0-9._-]+/g, '-')
+    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
+}
+
+function normalizeList(data: any): any[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) return data;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.data)) return data.data;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.mcps)) return data.mcps;
+  if (Array.isArray(data?.mcpServers)) return data.mcpServers;
+  return [];
+}
+
+function getCategoryName(category: McpAvailableServer['category']): string {
+  if (!category) return '';
+  return typeof category === 'string' ? category : category.name || '';
+}
+
+function flattenMcpDetail(detail: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return {
+    id: detail?.mcpId || detail?.id,
+    name: detail?.name || detail?.title,
+    author: detail?.author,
+    category: getCategoryName(detail?.category),
+    description: detail?.description,
+    githubUrl: detail?.githubUrl,
+    requiresApiKey: detail?.requiresApiKey,
+    tags: Array.isArray(detail?.tags) ? detail.tags.join(', ') : detail?.tags,
+  };
+}
+
+function formatInstalledServers(data: any): Record<string, unknown>[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
+    return data.map((server: any) => ({
+      name: server.name || server.serverName || server.mcpId || server.id,
+      enabled: server.enabled ?? server.status,
+      command: server.command,
+      args: Array.isArray(server.args) ? server.args.join(' ') : server.args,
+    }));
+  }
+
+  const servers = data?.mcpServers || data || {};
+  return Object.keys(servers).map((name) => ({
+    name,
+    enabled: Array.isArray(data?.enabled) ? data.enabled.includes(name) : '',
+    command: servers[name]?.command,
+    args: Array.isArray(servers[name]?.args) ? servers[name].args.join(' ') : '',
+  }));
+}
+
+function formatConfiguredTools(data: any): Record<string, unknown>[] {
+  if (Array.isArray(data)) {
+    return data.flatMap((server: any) => {
+      const serverName = server.name || server.serverName || server.mcpId || server.id;
+      const tools = Array.isArray(server.tools) ? server.tools : [];
+      return tools.map((tool: any) => formatToolRow(serverName, tool));
+    });
+  }
+
+  return Object.entries(data || {}).flatMap(([serverName, serverData]: [string, any]) => {
+    const tools = Array.isArray(serverData?.tools) ? serverData.tools : [];
+    return tools.map((tool: any) => formatToolRow(serverName, tool));
+  });
+}
+
+function formatToolRow(serverName: string, tool: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  return {
+    server: serverName,
+    tool: tool?.function?.name || tool?.name,
+    description: tool?.function?.description || tool?.description,
+  };
+}
+
+function parseResponseBody(text: string): any {
+  if (!text) return {};
+  try {
+    return JSON.parse(text);
+  } catch {
+    return { result: text };
+  }
+}
+
+function asRecord(data: any): Record<string, unknown> {
+  if (data && typeof data === 'object' && !Array.isArray(data)) return data;
+  return { result: data };
+}
+
+function parentFlags(cmd: Command): CliFlags {
+  const root = cmd.parent?.parent;
+  const opts = root?.opts() || {};
+  return { port: opts.port || '2719', host: opts.host || 'localhost', json: !!opts.json };
+}
+
+function isJson(cmd: Command): boolean {
+  const root = cmd.parent?.parent;
+  return !!(root?.opts()?.json);
+}

 export function buildCommandCommand(): Command {
   const cmd = new Command('command')
     .description('Connect to a running server and execute commands')
     .option('--port <number>', 'Server port', '2719')
     .option('--host <string>', 'Server host', 'localhost')
     .option('--json', 'Output raw JSON')
     .addHelpText('after', `
 Available modules:
   threads      List, create, delete, and inspect chat threads
   tasks        List, create, delete, and manage tasks
   jobs         List and inspect background jobs
   agents       List and manage installed agents
   git          Git operations (status, branches, diff, log, commit, push, pull)
   system       Server health check, CLI status, open folder
   projects     Project info, config, threads, history
   chat         Chat threads, messages, steps, memory
   todos        List, create, update, delete todo items
   llm          LLM providers, models, pricing, keys, local models
+  mcp          MCP servers, registry install, local install, tools
 
 Examples:
   $ codebolt command llm providers                List LLM providers
+  $ codebolt command mcp available                List registry MCP servers
+  $ codebolt command mcp install --id github      Install a registry MCP server
   $ codebolt command threads list                 List all threads
   $ codebolt command threads list --json          Output as JSON
   $ codebolt command git status                   Show git status
   $ codebolt command agents list --port 3000      Use custom port
   $ codebolt command system health                Check server health
   $ codebolt command todos list                   List all todos`);
 
   const subcommands = [
     buildThreadsCommand(),
     buildTasksCommand(),
     buildJobsCommand(),
     buildAgentsCommand(),
     buildGitCommand(),
     buildSystemCommand(),
     buildProjectsCommand(),
     buildChatCommand(),
     buildTodosCommand(),
     buildLlmCommand(),
+    buildMcpCommand(),
   ];
 
   const inheritedHelp = `
 Global options (from parent "codebolt command"):
   --port <number>  Server port (default: 2719)
   --host <string>  Server host (default: localhost)
   --json           Output raw JSON instead of formatted tables`;
 
   for (const sub of subcommands) {
     sub.addHelpText('after', inheritedHelp);
     cmd.addCommand(sub);
   }
 
   return cmd;
 }
