    sessionsswitch: 'tuiSessionsSwitch',
    switch_session: 'tuiSessionsSwitch',
    session_switch: 'tuiSessionsSwitch',
    kill: 'tuiKill',
    cleanup: 'tuiCleanup',
};

function normalizeTuiAction(action: string): string {
    if (!action || typeof action !== 'string') {
        throw new Error("'action' is required for terminal_tui");
    }

    if (action.startsWith('tui')) {
        return action;
    }

    const normalized = action.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.-]/g, '_');
    const tuiAction = TUI_ACTION_MAP[normalized];
    if (!tuiAction) {
        throw new Error(`Unknown TUI operation: ${action}`);
    }
    return tuiAction;
}

function summarizeTuiResult(action: string, result: any): string {
    const output = typeof result?.output === 'string'
        ? result.output
        : typeof result?.result?.output === 'string'
            ? result.result.output
            : '';

    if (output) {
        return output.length > 400 ? `${output.slice(0, 400)}...` : output;
    }

    return `Terminal TUI action completed: ${action.replace(/^tui/, '') || action}`;
}

function sendTuiToolStateToUi(finalMessage: any, params: any, result: any, stateEvent: MCPToolStateEnum, error?: string): void {
    const action = params?.action || finalMessage?.type || finalMessage?.action || 'tui';
    sendMessageToUi({
        type: "message",
        actionType: TemplateEnum.MCP_TOOL,
        sender: SenderEnum.Agent,
        messageId: finalMessage.messageId || getMessageId(),
        threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
        templateType: TemplateEnum.MCP_TOOL,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        content: error || summarizeTuiResult(action, result),
        payload: {
            type: "terminal",
            toolName: "terminal_tui",
            serverName: "codebolt-terminal",
            params,
            result: error || result,
            stateEvent
        },
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
        agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage.parentId
    });
}

async function updateTerminalServicePermissions() {
    try {
        const appStateData = await getAppState();
        const currentState = projectState.getCurrentState();
        logger.debug(`Current app state for permissions: ${JSON.stringify(appStateData).substring(0, 200)}...`);
        const agentUniqueId = currentState.state?.activeAgent?.unique_id;

        // Check global autoConfirm setting first from app-level config
        // Only auto-confirm if config explicitly enables it; default is false (ask for confirmation)
        if (appStateData?.autoConfirm?.length && appStateData.autoConfirm[0].autoConfirm === true) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = true;
        } else if (appStateData?.autoConfirm?.length && appStateData.autoConfirm[0].autoConfirm === false) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = false;
        }

        if (!agentUniqueId) return;

        // Check agent-specific autoConfirm array
        const autoConfirmEntry = appStateData?.autoConfirm?.find(entry => entry.agentId === agentUniqueId);
        if (autoConfirmEntry && autoConfirmEntry.autoConfirm) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = true;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Error updating terminal service permissions: ${error}`);
    }

}

export const terminalCliService = {
    consecutiveMistakeCount: 0,
    alwaysAllowReadOnly: false,
    didEditFile: false,
    autoConfirm: false,

    async formatToolDeniedFeedback(feedback) {
        return `The user denied this operation and provided the following feedback:\n<feedback>\n${feedback}\n</feedback>`
    },

    async formatToolDenied() {
        return `The user denied this operation.`
    },

    async sayAndCreateMissingParamError(toolName, paramName, relPath?) {
        return await terminalCliService.formatToolError(
            `Missing value for required parameter '${paramName}'. Please retry with complete response.`
        )
    },

    async formatToolResult(result) {
        return result // the successful result of the tool should never be manipulated, if we need to add details it should be as a separate user text block
    },

    async formatToolError(error) {
        return `The tool execution failed with the following error:\n<error>\n${error}\n</error>`
    },

    async executeCommand(finalMessage) {
        // Safely get the command from params if it exists, otherwise from finalMessage directly
        const command = finalMessage.params?.command || finalMessage.command;

        if (!command) {
            return [false, await this.formatToolError("Command is required"), 0, 'commandError'];
        }

        finalMessage = {
            ...finalMessage,
            type: "codebolttools",
            action: "executeTool",
            toolName: "execute_command",
            params: {
                ...(finalMessage.params || {}),
                command: command
            },
            command: command
        };

        let [success, result, status_code, type, processId] = await executeCommand(finalMessage, finalMessage.command, finalMessage.type, finalMessage.action)
        return [success, result, status_code, type, processId]
    },

    formatImagesIntoBlocks(images) {
        return images
            ? images.map((dataUrl) => {
                // data:image/png;base64,base64string
                const [rest, base64] = dataUrl.split(",")
                const mimeType = rest.split(":")[1].split(";")[0]
                return {
                    type: "image",
                    source: { type: "base64", media_type: mimeType, data: base64 },
                }
            })
            : []
    },

    formatToolResponseWithImages(text, images) {
        if (images && images.length > 0) {
            const textBlock = { type: "text", text }
            const imageBlocks = terminalCliService.formatImagesIntoBlocks(images)
            // Placing images after text leads to better results
            return [textBlock, ...imageBlocks]
        } else {
            return text
        }
    },

    /**
     * Execute Terminal tools with confirmation and UI updates
     * @param toolName The name of the tool to execute
     * @param params Parameters for the tool
     * @param finalMessage Message object for UI updates
     * @returns Tool execution result
     */
    async executeTool(toolName: string, params: any, finalMessage: any) {

};

function normalizeTuiAction(action: string): string {
    if (!action || typeof action !== 'string') {
        throw new Error("'action' is required for terminal_tui");
    }

    if (action.startsWith('tui')) {
        return action;
    }

    const normalized = action.trim().toLowerCase().replace(/[.-]/g, '_');
    const tuiAction = TUI_ACTION_MAP[normalized];
    if (!tuiAction) {
        throw new Error(`Unknown TUI operation: ${action}`);
    }
    return tuiAction;
}

function summarizeTuiResult(action: string, result: any): string {
    const output = typeof result?.output === 'string'
        ? result.output
        : typeof result?.result?.output === 'string'
            ? result.result.output
            : '';

    if (output) {
        return output.length > 400 ? `${output.slice(0, 400)}...` : output;
    }

    return `Terminal TUI action completed: ${action.replace(/^tui/, '') || action}`;
}

function sendTuiToolStateToUi(finalMessage: any, params: any, result: any, stateEvent: MCPToolStateEnum, error?: string): void {
    const action = params?.action || finalMessage?.type || finalMessage?.action || 'tui';
    sendMessageToUi({
        type: "message",
        actionType: TemplateEnum.MCP_TOOL,
        sender: SenderEnum.Agent,
        messageId: finalMessage.messageId || getMessageId(),
        threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
        templateType: TemplateEnum.MCP_TOOL,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        content: error || summarizeTuiResult(action, result),
        payload: {
            type: "terminal",
            toolName: "terminal_tui",
            serverName: "codebolt-terminal",
            params,
            result: error || result,
            stateEvent
        },
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
        agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage.parentId
    });
}

async function updateTerminalServicePermissions() {
    try {
        const appStateData = await getAppState();
        const currentState = projectState.getCurrentState();
        logger.debug(`Current app state for permissions: ${JSON.stringify(appStateData).substring(0, 200)}...`);
        const agentUniqueId = currentState.state?.activeAgent?.unique_id;

        // Check global autoConfirm setting first from app-level config
        // Only auto-confirm if config explicitly enables it; default is false (ask for confirmation)
        if (appStateData?.autoConfirm?.length && appStateData.autoConfirm[0].autoConfirm === true) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = true;
        } else if (appStateData?.autoConfirm?.length && appStateData.autoConfirm[0].autoConfirm === false) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = false;
        }

        if (!agentUniqueId) return;

        // Check agent-specific autoConfirm array
        const autoConfirmEntry = appStateData?.autoConfirm?.find(entry => entry.agentId === agentUniqueId);
        if (autoConfirmEntry && autoConfirmEntry.autoConfirm) {
            terminalCliService.autoConfirm = true;
        }
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Error updating terminal service permissions: ${error}`);
    }

}

/**
 * Thread Create Start Tool - Creates and immediately starts a new thread
 * Wraps the SDK's threadService.createAndStartThread() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import threadService from '../../modules/thread';

export interface ThreadCreateStartParams {
    /** Thread creation and start options */
    options?: Record<string, any>;
    /** Task prompt to start the new thread with. */
    task: string;
    /** Optional explicit user message. Defaults to task. */
    userMessage?: string;
    /** Optional title for the new thread. */
    title?: string;
    /** Optional description for the new thread. */
    description?: string;
    /** Optional selected agent id or selected agent object. */
    selectedAgent?: string | Record<string, any>;
    /** Optional agent id. */
    agentId?: string;
    /** Optional group ID for the thread. */
    groupId?: string;
    /** Whether the thread belongs to a group. */
    isGrouped?: boolean;
    /** Existing environment id or environment object to run the thread in. */
    environment?: string | Record<string, any>;
    /** Existing environment id to run the thread in. Alias for environment. */
    environmentId?: string;
    /** If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally. */
    remoteEnv?: boolean;
    /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. */
    environmentProvider?: {
        name: string;
        unique_id?: string;
        providerId?: string;
    };
    /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
    environmentName?: string;
    /** If true, wait for completion before returning. Defaults to false. */

/**

    createThread: async (options: CreateThreadOptions): Promise<CreateThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

            action: 'createThread',
            requestId,
            message: options

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(

    createAndStartThread: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {

            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<StartThreadResponse>(
            event,
            'startThreadResponse'
        );

        if (response.threadId && (response as any).async !== false && (response as any).status !== 'completed') {

        }

        return response;
    },

        const requestId = randomUUID();

            type: 'threadEvent',

            message: options

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(

     */
    createAndStartThread: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {

            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<StartThreadResponse>(
            event,
            'startThreadResponse'
        );

        if (response.threadId && (response as any).async !== false && (response as any).status !== 'completed') {
            backgroundChildThreads.addRunningAgent(response.threadId, response, options.groupId);
        }

        return response;

type OpenAIToolLike = {
    type: 'function';
    function: {
        name: string;
        description?: string;
        parameters?: Record<string, unknown>;
    };
};

type OpenAIObjectParameterSchema = OpenAIToolSchema['function']['parameters'];

function parseQualifiedToolName(qualifiedName: string): { toolboxName: string; toolName: string } {
    const separatorIndex = qualifiedName.indexOf('--');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return { toolboxName: 'codebolt', toolName: qualifiedName };
    }
    return {
        toolboxName: qualifiedName.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        toolName: qualifiedName.slice(separatorIndex + 2),
    };
}

function normalizeToolParameters(parameters: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): OpenAIObjectParameterSchema {
    if (!parameters || typeof parameters !== 'object') {
        return { type: 'object', properties: {} };
    }
    return {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {},
        ...parameters,
    } as OpenAIObjectParameterSchema;
}

function normalizeToolResultPayload(payload: unknown): string {
    return typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
}

};

type OpenAIObjectParameterSchema = OpenAIToolSchema['function']['parameters'];

function parseQualifiedToolName(qualifiedName: string): { toolboxName: string; toolName: string } {
    const separatorIndex = qualifiedName.indexOf('--');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return { toolboxName: 'codebolt', toolName: qualifiedName };
    }
    return {
        toolboxName: qualifiedName.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        toolName: qualifiedName.slice(separatorIndex + 2),
    };
}

function normalizeToolParameters(parameters: Record<string, unknown> | undefined): OpenAIObjectParameterSchema {
    if (!parameters || typeof parameters !== 'object') {
        return { type: 'object', properties: {} };
    }
    return {
        type: 'object',
        properties: {},
        ...parameters,
    } as OpenAIObjectParameterSchema;
}

function normalizeToolResultPayload(payload: unknown): string {
    return typeof payload === 'string' ? payload : JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2);
}

/**
 * @class Codebolt
 * @description This class provides a unified interface to interact with various modules.

class Codebolt {
    websocket: WebSocket | null = null;
    private isReady: boolean = false;
    private readyPromise: Promise<void>;
    private readyHandlers: Array<() => void | Promise<void>> = [];
    private messageQueue: FlatUserMessage[] = [];
    private messageResolvers: Array<(message: FlatUserMessage) => void> = [];

    /**
     * @constructor
     * @description Initializes the websocket connection.
     */
    constructor() {
        //console.log("Codebolt Agent initialized");
        this.readyPromise = this.initializeConnection();
        this.setupMessageListener()
        this.lastUserMessage = undefined
    }

    /**
     * @method initializeConnection
     * @description Initializes the WebSocket connection asynchronously.
     * @private
     */
    private async initializeConnection(): Promise<void> {
        try {
            await cbws.initializeWebSocket();
            this.websocket = cbws.getWebsocket;
            this.isReady = true;
            //console.log("Codebolt WebSocket connection established");

            // Execute all registered ready handlers
            for (const handler of this.readyHandlers) {
                try {
                    await handler();
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error executing ready handler:', error);
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Failed to initialize WebSocket connection:', error);
            throw error;
        }
    }

    /**

     * @description Waits for the Codebolt instance to be fully initialized.
     * @returns {Promise<void>} A promise that resolves when the instance is ready.

    async waitForReady(): Promise<void> {

    }

    get ready(): boolean {

import { WebSocketServer } from 'ws';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { IncomingMessage } from 'http';
import { CustomWebSocket } from '../types/socket';
import { codeboltMainSocketConnection, uiSocketConnection, wsconnectionManager } from './socketManager';
import handleCliMessages from '../cliLib';
import dbHelperInstance from '../database/db';
import terminalManager from '../services/terminalService';
import { setCodeboltCliSocket } from '../cliLib/wsconnections';
import { settingService, getThreadIdFromToken } from '../services/settingService';
import { cLogger } from '../utils/categorizedLogger';
import { FocusedLogCategory } from '../sharedTypes/focusedLogCategories';
import { eventEnums } from '../sharedTypes/eventEnums';

import { registerAgent } from '../cliLib/agentService.cli';
import { getMessageId, stopAgent } from '../utils/agentHelper';
import { SenderEnum, TemplateEnum } from '../sharedTypes/chatTypes';
import { sendNotificationToUi, sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi } from '../utils/messages';
import { shouldPreserveThreadStatusOnDisconnect, threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { remoteProviderTaskStore } from '../stores/remoteProviderTaskStore';
import { registerEnvironmentProviderConnection, unregisterEnvironmentProviderConnection } from '../services/environmentsServices';

// Import EventEmitter to emit events
import { agentProcessManager } from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import { sideExecutionManager } from '../managers/SideExecutionManager';
import agentExecutionManager, { AgentExecutionStatus } from '../stores/agentExecutionManager';
import { agentEventQueueSocketHandler } from './agentEventQueueSocket';

const codeboltSocket = new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true });

// Handle WebSocket connections
codeboltSocket.on('connection', async (ws: CustomWebSocket, req: IncomingMessage) => {
    cLogger.debug(`send_and_receive_time_connect: ${Date.now()}`);

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(req.url?.split('?')[1]);
    const idFromUrl = urlParams.get('id');
    const agentId = urlParams.get('agentId');

    // Resolve instanceId from the running process (server-side, no round-trip needed)
    // This ensures the WebSocket uses the same instanceId that was used for log files
    const runningProcess = agentId ? agentProcessManager.getProcess(agentId) : null;
    const instanceIdFromProcess = runningProcess?.instanceId;

    // Priority for instanceId:
    // 1. Process instanceId (server-side resolution - most reliable)
    // 2. 'instanceId' param from URL (passed explicitly from AgentProcessManager via env var)
    // 3. 'id' param (legacy/fallback)
    // 4. Generate new UUID (only for connections without proper tracking)
    const instanceIdFromUrl = urlParams.get('instanceId');

    // Use process instanceId first, then URL params, then generate new
    ws.uniqueConnectionId = instanceIdFromProcess ||
        instanceIdFromUrl ||
        (idFromUrl && idFromUrl !== 'undefined' ? idFromUrl : uuidv4());

    if (instanceIdFromProcess) {
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved instanceId from process: ${instanceIdFromProcess} for agentId: ${agentId}`);
    }

    cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.GENERAL, 'debug', { message: `Agent connect to app using instanceId ${ws.uniqueConnectionId} (from process: ${instanceIdFromProcess}, instanceId URL: ${instanceIdFromUrl}, id: ${idFromUrl})`, context: { event: 'AGENT_CONNECTED_TO_SOCKET', urlParams } });

    const isRemoteProvider = urlParams.get('IS_REMOTE_PROVIDER') || false;
    const isSideExecution = urlParams.get('IS_SIDE_EXECUTION') === 'true';

    // Handle Side Execution connections
    // Side Executions use the same threadId as the parent agent
    // Requirements: 1.4, 2.4, 8.1
    if (isSideExecution) {

        const sideExecutionId = urlParams.get('SIDE_EXECUTION_ID');
        const threadId = urlParams.get('THREAD_ID');
        const parentAgentId = urlParams.get('PARENT_AGENT_ID');
        const parentAgentInstanceId = urlParams.get('PARENT_AGENT_INSTANCE_ID');
        ws.uniqueConnectionId = parentAgentInstanceId;
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Side Execution connection: sideExecutionId=${sideExecutionId}, threadId=${threadId}, parentAgentId=${parentAgentId}`);

        // Set WebSocket properties for Side Execution
        // For side executions, use the parent's agentInstanceId so messages are associated with the parent
        ws.agentId = parentAgentId// sideExecutionId || ws.uniqueConnectionId;
        ws.threadId = threadId || '';
        // ws.parentId = parentAgentId;
        ws.agentInstanceId = parentAgentInstanceId;
        (ws as any).isSideExecution = true;
        (ws as any).sideExecutionId = sideExecutionId;
        // Store the effective agentInstanceId (parent's) for side execution context
        // (ws as any).agentInstanceId = parentAgentInstanceId || ws.uniqueConnectionId;

        // Add connection to the connection manager
        wsconnectionManager.addConnection('codeboltSocketConnection', ws);

        // Update the connection with thread information
        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {
            wsconnectionManager.updateSocketThreadId(ws.uniqueConnectionId, ws.threadId);
        }

        setCodeboltCliSocket(ws);

        // Emit event that Side Execution connected successfully
        if (sideExecutionId) {
            sideExecutionManager.emit('sideExecutionConnected', {
                sideExecutionId,
                threadId,
                connectionId: ws.uniqueConnectionId
            });

            // Get the side execution metadata to retrieve params and threadContext
            const sideExecutionMetadata = sideExecutionManager.getSideExecution(sideExecutionId);

            // Send actionBlockInvocation message to the side execution
            // This triggers the onActionBlockInvocation listener in the ActionBlock
            const invocationMessage = {
                type: 'actionBlockInvocation',
                sideExecutionId,
                threadId,
                parentAgentId,
                parentAgentInstanceId,
                params: sideExecutionMetadata?.params || {},
                threadContext: sideExecutionMetadata?.threadContext || {},
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };

            try {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify(invocationMessage));
                cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Sent actionBlockInvocation to side execution: ${sideExecutionId}`);
            } catch (error) {
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Failed to send actionBlockInvocation: ${error.message}`);
            }
        }

        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Side Execution connection setup completed: ${sideExecutionId}`);
    }
    else if (!isRemoteProvider) {

        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Incoming connection with URL params: agentId=${urlParams.get('agentId')}, parentId=${urlParams.get('parentId')}, parentAgentInstanceId=${urlParams.get('parentAgentInstanceId')}, agentTask=${urlParams.get('agentTask')}, threadToken=${urlParams.get('threadToken')}`);

        const agentId = urlParams.get('agentId') || "c4d3fdb9-cf9e-4f82-8a1d-0160bbfc9ae9";
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved agentId: ${agentId}`);

        const parentId = urlParams.get('parentId');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved parentId: ${parentId}`);

        const parentAgentInstanceId = urlParams.get('parentAgentInstanceId');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved parentAgentInstanceId: ${parentAgentInstanceId}`);

        const task = urlParams.get('agentTask');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved agentTask: ${task}`);

        const threadToken = urlParams.get('threadToken');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved threadToken: ${threadToken}`);

        const environmentId = urlParams.get('environmentId');
        const effectiveProjectPath =
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_EFFECTIVE_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('projectPath');
        const baseProjectPath =
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_BASE_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('baseProjectPath');

        if (environmentId) {
            ws.environmentId = environmentId;
        }
        if (effectiveProjectPath) {
            ws.effectiveProjectPath = effectiveProjectPath;
            ws.workspacePath = effectiveProjectPath;
        }
        if (baseProjectPath) {
            ws.baseProjectPath = baseProjectPath;
        }

        if (agentId) {
            ws.agentId = agentId;
            cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Set ws.agentId: ${ws.agentId}`);
        }
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Agent connected with agentId: ${agentId}, parentId: ${parentId}, parentAgentInstanceId: ${parentAgentInstanceId}, agentTask: ${task}, threadToken: ${threadToken}, uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);
        //  return;
        // Handle thread token and retrieve threadId
        if (threadToken) {

            const retrievedThreadId = getThreadIdFromToken(threadToken);
            if (retrievedThreadId) {
                cLogger.info(`Retrieved threadId ${retrievedThreadId} from token ${threadToken}`);

                ws.threadId = retrievedThreadId;

                // Emit event that thread ID was retrieved successfully
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: agentId,
                    threadId: retrievedThreadId,
                    threadToken: threadToken,
                    agentInstanceId: ws.uniqueConnectionId
                });

                // NOTE: Agent execution tracking is now handled in AgentProcessManager.startProcess()
                // to ensure consistent instanceId across all systems.
                // We only log the connection here for debugging.
                cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Agent connected with instanceId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}, agentId: ${agentId}`);

                // Update thread status to 'running' when agent connects
                const updateSuccess = await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(retrievedThreadId, 'running');
                if (updateSuccess) {
                    cLogger.info(`Thread ${retrievedThreadId} status updated to 'running' on agent connection`);

                    // Send notification to UI about thread status change
                    const statusUpdateMessage = {
                        type: "message",
                        actionType: TemplateEnum.INFOWITHLINK,
                        sender: SenderEnum.System,
                        messageId: getMessageId(),
                        threadId: retrievedThreadId,
                        templateType: TemplateEnum.INFOWITHLINK,
                        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                        content: `Thread ${retrievedThreadId} is now running`,
                        payload: {
                            type: "threadStatusUpdate",
                            threadId: retrievedThreadId,
                            status: 'running',
                            message: `Thread ${retrievedThreadId} is now running`
                        }
                    };
                    sendNotificationToUi(statusUpdateMessage);
                } else {
                    cLogger.warn(`Failed to update thread ${retrievedThreadId} status to 'running'`);
                }
            } else {
                cLogger.warn(`Invalid or expired thread token: ${threadToken}`);
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Disconnecting socket due to invalid thread token`);
                // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: agentId,
                    threadId: null,
                    error: `Invalid or expired thread token: ${threadToken}`
                });
                // ws.close(1008, 'Invalid or expired thread token');
                // return;
            }
        } else {
            cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] No thread token provided - disconnecting socket`);
            // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed
            agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                processId: agentId,
                threadId: null,
                error: 'No thread token provided'
            });
            // ws.close(1008, 'Thread token is required');
            // return;
        }

        if (parentId) {
            ws.parentId = parentId;
            ws.parentAgentInstanceId = parentAgentInstanceId;
            // Get parent socket instance and set parentAgentInstanceId from parent's uniqueConnectionId
            const parentSocket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById(parentAgentInstanceId);
            if (parentSocket && parentSocket.uniqueConnectionId) {
                ws.parentAgentInstanceId = parentSocket.uniqueConnectionId;
                cLogger.debug('Set parentAgentInstanceId:', { context: { parentAgentInstanceId: ws.parentAgentInstanceId } });
            }

            registerAgent(agentId, ws.uniqueConnectionId, parentId, ws);
            if (parentId) {
                const message = {
                    type: "message",
                    actionType: TemplateEnum.CHILDAGENTSTARTED,
                    sender: SenderEnum.Agent,
                    messageId: getMessageId(),
                    threadId: ws.threadId,
                    agentInstanceId: ws.uniqueConnectionId,
                    agentId: agentId,
                    parentAgentInstanceId: parentAgentInstanceId,
                    parentId: parentId,
                    templateType: TemplateEnum.CHILDAGENTSTARTED,
                    parentAgentId: parentId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    content: task,
                    payload: {
                        task: task
                    }
                }
                sendNotificationToUi(message)
            }


        }
        cLogger.debug('ws.agentId', { context: { agentId: ws.agentId } });
        cLogger.debug('ws.parentId', { context: { parentId: ws.parentId } });

        if (ws.parentAgentInstanceId) {
            cLogger.debug('ws.parentAgentInstanceId', { context: { parentAgentInstanceId: ws.parentAgentInstanceId } });
        }

        global.isDevMode = req.url?.includes('dev=true');
        if (global.isDevMode) {
            cLogger.info('Development mode enabled');
            codeboltMainSocketConnection.send(JSON.stringify({ devloperMode: true, agentId: ws.uniqueConnectionId }));
        }
        // Add connection to the connection manager
        wsconnectionManager.addConnection('codeboltSocketConnection', ws);

        // Update the connection with thread information if available
        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {
            wsconnectionManager.updateSocketThreadId(ws.uniqueConnectionId, ws.threadId);
        }

        // Set the Codebolt CLI socket
        if (codeboltMainSocketConnection) {
            wsconnectionManager.setCodeBoletSocketId(ws.uniqueConnectionId);
        }
        setCodeboltCliSocket(ws);

        // Initialize settings
        settingService.init();

        // Log successful connection setup
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Connection setup completed for uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);

        // Initialize Agent Event Queue socket handler if not already initialized
        agentEventQueueSocketHandler.initialize();

        // Deliver any pending events to this agent
        if (agentId) {
            agentEventQueueSocketHandler.onAgentConnected(agentId, ws).catch(err => {
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Error delivering pending events: ${err.message}`);
            });
        }
    }
    else {
        ws.providerId = urlParams.get('providerId');
        ws.storedTaskId = urlParams.get('storedTaskId');
        ws.environmentId = urlParams.get('environmentId');
        ws.environmentName = urlParams.get('environmentName');

        // Get thread ID from remote provider task store based on storedTaskId and environmentId
        if (ws.storedTaskId) {
            try {
                cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connection - retrieving thread ID for storedTaskId: ${ws.storedTaskId}, environmentId: ${ws.environmentId}`);

                const storedTask = await remoteProviderTaskStore.getTask(ws.storedTaskId);
                if (storedTask) {
                    ws.threadId = storedTask.threadId;
                    cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Retrieved thread ID ${ws.threadId} from stored task ${ws.storedTaskId}`);

                    // Emit event that thread ID was retrieved successfully for remote provider
                    if (ws.providerId) {
                        agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                            processId: ws.providerId,
                            threadId: ws.threadId
                        });
                    }

                    // Verify environment ID matches if provided
                    if (ws.environmentId && storedTask.environmentData) {
                        if (storedTask.environmentData.environmentId === ws.environmentId ||
                            storedTask.environmentData.id === ws.environmentId) {
                            cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Environment ID ${ws.environmentId} matches stored task environment`);
                        } else {
                            cLogger.warn(`[codeboltSocket] Environment ID mismatch - provided: ${ws.environmentId}, stored: ${storedTask.environmentData.environmentId || storedTask.environmentData.id}`);
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    cLogger.warn(`[codeboltSocket] No stored task found for storedTaskId: ${ws.storedTaskId}`);
                    // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed for remote provider
                    if (ws.providerId) {
                        agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                            processId: ws.providerId,
                            threadId: null,
                            error: `No stored task found for storedTaskId: ${ws.storedTaskId}`
                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Error retrieving thread ID from stored task: ${error}`);
                // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed for remote provider
                if (ws.providerId) {
                    agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                        processId: ws.providerId,
                        threadId: null,
                        error: `Error retrieving thread ID from stored task: ${error.message}`
                    });
                }
            }
        } else {
            cLogger.warn(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connection without storedTaskId`);
            // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed for remote provider
            if (ws.providerId) {
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: ws.providerId,
                    threadId: null,
                    error: 'Remote provider connection without storedTaskId'
                });
            }
        }

        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connected with providerId: ${ws.providerId}, storedTaskId: ${ws.storedTaskId}, environmentId: ${ws.environmentId}, threadId: ${ws.threadId}, uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);

        // Add remote provider connection to the connection manager
        wsconnectionManager.addConnection('codeboltSocketConnection', ws);

        // Update the connection with thread information if available
        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {
            wsconnectionManager.updateSocketThreadId(ws.uniqueConnectionId, ws.threadId);
        }

        // Register environment provider connection if we have both environmentId and providerId
        if (ws.environmentId && ws.providerId && ws.uniqueConnectionId) {
            await registerEnvironmentProviderConnection(
                ws.uniqueConnectionId,
                ws,
                ws.environmentId,

                ws.environmentName
            );
            cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Registered environment provider connection: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId} for environment ${ws.environmentId}, provider ${ws.providerId}`);
        }

        // Log successful remote provider connection setup
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connection setup completed for uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);
    }

const codeboltSocket = new WebSocketServer({ noServer: true });

// Handle WebSocket connections
codeboltSocket.on('connection', async (ws: CustomWebSocket, req: IncomingMessage) => {
    cLogger.debug(`send_and_receive_time_connect: ${Date.now()}`);

    const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(req.url?.split('?')[1]);
    const idFromUrl = urlParams.get('id');
    const agentId = urlParams.get('agentId');

    // Resolve instanceId from the running process (server-side, no round-trip needed)
    // This ensures the WebSocket uses the same instanceId that was used for log files
    const runningProcess = agentId ? agentProcessManager.getProcess(agentId) : null;
    const instanceIdFromProcess = runningProcess?.instanceId;

    // Priority for instanceId:
    // 1. Process instanceId (server-side resolution - most reliable)
    // 2. 'instanceId' param from URL (passed explicitly from AgentProcessManager via env var)
    // 3. 'id' param (legacy/fallback)
    // 4. Generate new UUID (only for connections without proper tracking)
    const instanceIdFromUrl = urlParams.get('instanceId');

    // Use process instanceId first, then URL params, then generate new
    ws.uniqueConnectionId = instanceIdFromProcess ||
        instanceIdFromUrl ||
        (idFromUrl && idFromUrl !== 'undefined' ? idFromUrl : uuidv4());

    if (instanceIdFromProcess) {
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved instanceId from process: ${instanceIdFromProcess} for agentId: ${agentId}`);
    }

    cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.GENERAL, 'debug', { message: `Agent connect to app using instanceId ${ws.uniqueConnectionId} (from process: ${instanceIdFromProcess}, instanceId URL: ${instanceIdFromUrl}, id: ${idFromUrl})`, context: { event: 'AGENT_CONNECTED_TO_SOCKET', urlParams } });

    const isRemoteProvider = urlParams.get('IS_REMOTE_PROVIDER') || false;
    const isSideExecution = urlParams.get('IS_SIDE_EXECUTION') === 'true';

    // Handle Side Execution connections
    // Side Executions use the same threadId as the parent agent
    // Requirements: 1.4, 2.4, 8.1
    if (isSideExecution) {

        const sideExecutionId = urlParams.get('SIDE_EXECUTION_ID');
        const threadId = urlParams.get('THREAD_ID');
        const parentAgentId = urlParams.get('PARENT_AGENT_ID');
        const parentAgentInstanceId = urlParams.get('PARENT_AGENT_INSTANCE_ID');
        ws.uniqueConnectionId = parentAgentInstanceId;
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Side Execution connection: sideExecutionId=${sideExecutionId}, threadId=${threadId}, parentAgentId=${parentAgentId}`);

        // Set WebSocket properties for Side Execution
        // For side executions, use the parent's agentInstanceId so messages are associated with the parent
        ws.agentId = parentAgentId// sideExecutionId || ws.uniqueConnectionId;
        ws.threadId = threadId || '';
        // ws.parentId = parentAgentId;
        ws.agentInstanceId = parentAgentInstanceId;
        (ws as any).isSideExecution = true;
        (ws as any).sideExecutionId = sideExecutionId;
        // Store the effective agentInstanceId (parent's) for side execution context
        // (ws as any).agentInstanceId = parentAgentInstanceId || ws.uniqueConnectionId;

        // Add connection to the connection manager
        wsconnectionManager.addConnection('codeboltSocketConnection', ws);

        // Update the connection with thread information
        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {
            wsconnectionManager.updateSocketThreadId(ws.uniqueConnectionId, ws.threadId);

        setCodeboltCliSocket(ws);

        // Emit event that Side Execution connected successfully

            // Get the side execution metadata to retrieve params and threadContext
            const sideExecutionMetadata = sideExecutionManager.getSideExecution(sideExecutionId);

            // Send actionBlockInvocation message to the side execution
            // This triggers the onActionBlockInvocation listener in the ActionBlock
            const invocationMessage = {
                type: 'actionBlockInvocation',
                sideExecutionId,
                threadId,
                parentAgentId,
                parentAgentInstanceId,
                params: sideExecutionMetadata?.params || {},
                threadContext: sideExecutionMetadata?.threadContext || {},
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };

            try {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify(invocationMessage));
                cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Sent actionBlockInvocation to side execution: ${sideExecutionId}`);
            } catch (error) {
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Failed to send actionBlockInvocation: ${error.message}`);
            }
        }

        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Side Execution connection setup completed: ${sideExecutionId}`);

    else if (!isRemoteProvider) {

        const agentId = urlParams.get('agentId') || "c4d3fdb9-cf9e-4f82-8a1d-0160bbfc9ae9";
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved agentId: ${agentId}`);

        const parentId = urlParams.get('parentId');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved parentId: ${parentId}`);

        const parentAgentInstanceId = urlParams.get('parentAgentInstanceId');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved parentAgentInstanceId: ${parentAgentInstanceId}`);

        const task = urlParams.get('agentTask');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved agentTask: ${task}`);

        const threadToken = urlParams.get('threadToken');
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Resolved threadToken: ${threadToken}`);

        const environmentId = urlParams.get('environmentId');
        const effectiveProjectPath =
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_EFFECTIVE_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('projectPath');
        const baseProjectPath =
            urlParams.get('CODEBOLT_BASE_PROJECT_PATH') ||
            urlParams.get('baseProjectPath');

        if (environmentId) {
            ws.environmentId = environmentId;
        }
        if (effectiveProjectPath) {
            ws.effectiveProjectPath = effectiveProjectPath;
            ws.workspacePath = effectiveProjectPath;
        }
        if (baseProjectPath) {
            ws.baseProjectPath = baseProjectPath;

        if (agentId) {
            ws.agentId = agentId;
            cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Set ws.agentId: ${ws.agentId}`);

        //  return;
        // Handle thread token and retrieve threadId

                cLogger.info(`Retrieved threadId ${retrievedThreadId} from token ${threadToken}`);

                ws.threadId = retrievedThreadId;

                // Emit event that thread ID was retrieved successfully
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: agentId,
                    threadId: retrievedThreadId,

                // NOTE: Agent execution tracking is now handled in AgentProcessManager.startProcess()

                cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Agent connected with instanceId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}, agentId: ${agentId}`);

                // Update thread status to 'running' when agent connects
                const updateSuccess = await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(retrievedThreadId, 'running');
                if (updateSuccess) {
                    cLogger.info(`Thread ${retrievedThreadId} status updated to 'running' on agent connection`);

                    // Send notification to UI about thread status change
                    const statusUpdateMessage = {
                        type: "message",
                        actionType: TemplateEnum.INFOWITHLINK,
                        sender: SenderEnum.System,
                        messageId: getMessageId(),
                        threadId: retrievedThreadId,
                        templateType: TemplateEnum.INFOWITHLINK,

                        content: `Thread ${retrievedThreadId} is now running`,
                        payload: {
                            type: "threadStatusUpdate",
                            threadId: retrievedThreadId,
                            status: 'running',
                            message: `Thread ${retrievedThreadId} is now running`
                        }
                    };
                    sendNotificationToUi(statusUpdateMessage);
                } else {
                    cLogger.warn(`Failed to update thread ${retrievedThreadId} status to 'running'`);
                }
            } else {
                cLogger.warn(`Invalid or expired thread token: ${threadToken}`);
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Disconnecting socket due to invalid thread token`);
                // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: agentId,

        } else {

        if (parentId) {

                cLogger.debug('Set parentAgentInstanceId:', { context: { parentAgentInstanceId: ws.parentAgentInstanceId } });
            }

            registerAgent(agentId, ws.uniqueConnectionId, parentId, ws);
            if (parentId) {
                const message = {
                    type: "message",
                    actionType: TemplateEnum.CHILDAGENTSTARTED,
                    sender: SenderEnum.Agent,
                    messageId: getMessageId(),
                    threadId: ws.threadId,
                    agentInstanceId: ws.uniqueConnectionId,
                    agentId: agentId,
                    parentAgentInstanceId: parentAgentInstanceId,
                    parentId: parentId,
                    templateType: TemplateEnum.CHILDAGENTSTARTED,
                    parentAgentId: parentId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    content: task,
                    payload: {
                        task: task
                    }
                }
                sendNotificationToUi(message)
            }


        }
        cLogger.debug('ws.agentId', { context: { agentId: ws.agentId } });

        if (ws.parentAgentInstanceId) {

        }

        global.isDevMode = req.url?.includes('dev=true');
        if (global.isDevMode) {

        }
        // Add connection to the connection manager

        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {

        // Set the Codebolt CLI socket
        if (codeboltMainSocketConnection) {

        // Initialize Agent Event Queue socket handler if not already initialized
        agentEventQueueSocketHandler.initialize();

        // Deliver any pending events to this agent
        if (agentId) {

                    if (ws.providerId) {

                            processId: ws.providerId,
                            threadId: ws.threadId

                            cLogger.warn(`[codeboltSocket] Environment ID mismatch - provided: ${ws.environmentId}, stored: ${storedTask.environmentData.environmentId || storedTask.environmentData.id}`);

                    if (ws.providerId) {

                            processId: ws.providerId,

                        });
                    }
                }
            } catch (error) {
                cLogger.error(`[codeboltSocket] Error retrieving thread ID from stored task: ${error}`);
                // Emit event that thread ID retrieval failed for remote provider
                if (ws.providerId) {
                    agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                        processId: ws.providerId,
                        threadId: null,
                        error: `Error retrieving thread ID from stored task: ${error.message}`
                    });

            if (ws.providerId) {
                agentProcessManager.emit('threadIdRetrieved', {
                    processId: ws.providerId,
                    threadId: null,
                    error: 'Remote provider connection without storedTaskId'
                });
            }
        }

        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connected with providerId: ${ws.providerId}, storedTaskId: ${ws.storedTaskId}, environmentId: ${ws.environmentId}, threadId: ${ws.threadId}, uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);

        // Add remote provider connection to the connection manager
        wsconnectionManager.addConnection('codeboltSocketConnection', ws);

        // Update the connection with thread information if available
        if (ws.uniqueConnectionId && ws.threadId) {
            wsconnectionManager.updateSocketThreadId(ws.uniqueConnectionId, ws.threadId);
        }

        // Register environment provider connection if we have both environmentId and providerId
        if (ws.environmentId && ws.providerId && ws.uniqueConnectionId) {
            await registerEnvironmentProviderConnection(
                ws.uniqueConnectionId,
                ws,
                ws.environmentId,
                ws.providerId,
                ws.environmentName
            );
            cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Registered environment provider connection: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId} for environment ${ws.environmentId}, provider ${ws.providerId}`);
        }

        // Log successful remote provider connection setup
        cLogger.info(`[codeboltSocket] Remote provider connection setup completed for uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);

/**
 * Send a response to the agent AND broadcast an ExecutionNotification
 * to all subscribed plugins via the ExecutionGateway.
 */
function sendResponseAndNotify(ws: any, response: any, originalMessage: any) {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify(response));
    broadcastNotification(originalMessage, response);
}

function expectsThreadContext(message: any, ws: any): boolean {
    if (ws?.threadId || ws?.agentId || message?.threadId || message?.agentId || message?.parentId) {
        return true;
    }

    const type = typeof message?.type === 'string' ? message.type : '';
    if (!type) return false;

    return !(
        type.startsWith('environment.') ||
        type.startsWith('plugin.') ||
        type.startsWith('dynamicPanel.') ||
        type.startsWith('narrative.') ||
        type.startsWith('lsp.') ||
        type === 'providerHeartbeat' ||
        type === 'providerLazyResponse' ||
        type === 'remoteProviderEvent' ||
        type === 'providerResponse' ||
        type === 'environmentHeartbeatResponse' ||
        type === 'environmentRestartResponse' ||
        type === 'setResourceId' ||
        type === 'register_gateway' ||
        type === 'executionNotification' ||
        type === 'chatBroadcast'
    );
}

/**
 * Map an original request message type/action to its corresponding
 * notification type and action so we can route through
 * notificationEventService.handleNotificationEvent.
 */
function mapToNotification(type: string, action?: string): { notifyType: string; notifyAction: string } | null {
    const act = action || '';

    // FS operations → fsnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.FSEvent || type === WebSocketMessageType.FileSystemEvent || type === 'fsEvent') {
        const fsActionMap: Record<string, string> = {
            readFile: 'readFileRequest',
            writeToFile: 'writeToFileRequest',
            createFile: 'createFileResult',
            updateFile: 'updateFileResult',
            deleteFile: 'deleteFileResult',
            listDirectory: 'listDirectoryResult',
            listFiles: 'listDirectoryResult',
            createFolder: 'createFolderResult',
        };
        return { notifyType: 'fsnotify', notifyAction: fsActionMap[act] || `${act}Result` };
    }

    // Terminal → terminalnotify
    if ([WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommand, WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUnitlInterrupt,
    WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUntilError, WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandWithStream,
        'executeCommand'].includes(type as any)) {
        return { notifyType: 'terminalnotify', notifyAction: 'executeCommandResult' };
    }

    // Git → gitnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.gitEvent || type === 'gitEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'gitnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'gitResult' };
    }

    // Browser → browsernotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.BrowserEvent || type === 'browserEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'browsernotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'webFetchResult' };
    }

    // Crawler → crawlernotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CrawlerEvent || type === 'crawlerEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'crawlernotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'crawlerResult' };
    }

    // Task → tasknotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.TaskEvent || type === 'taskEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'tasknotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'addTaskResult' };
    }

    // Search → searchnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CodebaseSearchEvent || type === 'codebaseSearchEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'searchnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'codebaseSearchResult' };
    }

    // Code / CodeUtils → codeutilsnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CodeEvent || type === WebSocketMessageType.CodeUtilsEvent || type === 'codeEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'codeutilsnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'codeUtilsResult' };
    }

    // SendMessage / chat → chatnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.SendMessage || type === 'sendMessage') {
        return { notifyType: 'chatnotify', notifyAction: 'agentTextResponse' };
    }

    // Memory → dbmemorynotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.MemoryEvent || type === 'memoryEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'dbmemorynotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'memoryResult' };
    }

    // Default fallback: use chatnotify with agentTextResponse so user always sees something
    return { notifyType: 'chatnotify', notifyAction: 'agentTextResponse' };
}

/**
 * Build a notification message from the proxy reply and route it through
 * notificationEventService so the UI gets the same treatment as local execution.
 */
function sendProxyNotificationToUi(ws: any, originalMessage: any, proxyReply: any): void {
    try {
        // console.log('[ProxyNotification] Sending notification to UI:', {
        //     originalMessage,
        //     proxyReply
        // });
        const mapping = mapToNotification(originalMessage.type, originalMessage.action);
        if (!mapping) {
            logger.warn(`[ProxyNotification] No notification mapping for ${originalMessage.type}/${originalMessage.action}`);
            return;
        }

        const params = originalMessage.message || originalMessage.params || originalMessage;
        const isError = proxyReply.success === false;

        // Build notification in the same shape the notification services expect.
        // The zod schemas (e.g. fsNotificationBaseSchema) require `toolUseId` and
        // `requestId` from AgentMessageBaseSchema, so we must include them.
        const notification: any = {
            type: mapping.notifyType,
            action: mapping.notifyAction,
            content: proxyReply.content || proxyReply.output || proxyReply.message || JSON.stringify(proxyReply),
            isError,
            data: buildNotificationData(originalMessage, proxyReply, params),
            // Required by AgentMessageBaseSchema
            requestId: originalMessage.requestId || originalMessage.messageId || '',
            // Required by notification base schemas (e.g. fsNotificationBaseSchema)
            toolUseId: originalMessage.messageId || originalMessage.requestId || `proxy-${Date.now()}`,
            threadId: originalMessage.threadId,
            agentInstanceId: originalMessage.agentInstanceId,
            agentId: originalMessage.agentId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: originalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
            parentId: originalMessage.parentId,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        // logger.info(`[ProxyNotification] Routing proxy reply as ${mapping.notifyType}/${mapping.notifyAction}`);
        notificationEventService.handleNotificationEvent(ws, notification);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[ProxyNotification] Error sending UI notification: ${error}`);
    }
}

/**
 * Build the `data` field for the notification based on the original request type.
 * Each notification service expects specific data shapes.
 */
function buildNotificationData(originalMessage: any, proxyReply: any, params: any): any {
    const type = originalMessage.type;
    const action = originalMessage.action || '';

    // FS operations — notification services expect data.filePath and data.content / data.text
    if (type === 'fsEvent' || type === 'FSEvent' || type === WebSocketMessageType.FSEvent) {
        const filePath = params.filePath || params.path || proxyReply.path || '';
        const content = proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '';
        const text = params.text || params.content || '';
        return { filePath, content, text };
    }

    // Terminal — notification services expect content (string)
    if (type === 'executeCommand' || type === WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommand) {
        return {
            command: params.command || params.cmd || '',
            output: proxyReply.output || proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '',
        };
    }

    // Chat / sendMessage — expects data.message
    if (type === 'sendMessage' || type === WebSocketMessageType.SendMessage) {
        return { message: proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '' };
    }

    // Fallback — pass through whatever the proxy returned
    return proxyReply;
}

/**
 * Send a response to the agent AND broadcast an ExecutionNotification
 * to all subscribed plugins via the ExecutionGateway.
 */
function sendResponseAndNotify(ws: any, response: any, originalMessage: any) {
    ws.send(JSON.stringify(response));
    broadcastNotification(originalMessage, response);
}

function expectsThreadContext(message: any, ws: any): boolean {
    if (ws?.threadId || ws?.agentId || message?.threadId || message?.agentId || message?.parentId) {
        return true;
    }

    const type = typeof message?.type === 'string' ? message.type : '';
    if (!type) return false;

    return !(
        type.startsWith('environment.') ||
        type.startsWith('plugin.') ||
        type.startsWith('dynamicPanel.') ||
        type.startsWith('narrative.') ||
        type.startsWith('lsp.') ||
        type === 'providerHeartbeat' ||
        type === 'providerLazyResponse' ||
        type === 'remoteProviderEvent' ||
        type === 'providerResponse' ||
        type === 'environmentHeartbeatResponse' ||
        type === 'environmentRestartResponse' ||
        type === 'setResourceId' ||
        type === 'register_gateway' ||
        type === 'executionNotification' ||
        type === 'chatBroadcast'
    );
}

/**
 * Map an original request message type/action to its corresponding
 * notification type and action so we can route through
 * notificationEventService.handleNotificationEvent.
 */
function mapToNotification(type: string, action?: string): { notifyType: string; notifyAction: string } | null {
    const act = action || '';

    // FS operations → fsnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.FSEvent || type === WebSocketMessageType.FileSystemEvent || type === 'fsEvent') {
        const fsActionMap: Record<string, string> = {
            readFile: 'readFileRequest',
            writeToFile: 'writeToFileRequest',
            createFile: 'createFileResult',
            updateFile: 'updateFileResult',
            deleteFile: 'deleteFileResult',
            listDirectory: 'listDirectoryResult',
            listFiles: 'listDirectoryResult',
            createFolder: 'createFolderResult',
        };
        return { notifyType: 'fsnotify', notifyAction: fsActionMap[act] || `${act}Result` };
    }

    // Terminal → terminalnotify
    if ([WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommand, WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUnitlInterrupt,
    WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUntilError, WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandWithStream,
        'executeCommand'].includes(type as any)) {
        return { notifyType: 'terminalnotify', notifyAction: 'executeCommandResult' };
    }

    // Git → gitnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.gitEvent || type === 'gitEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'gitnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'gitResult' };
    }

    // Browser → browsernotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.BrowserEvent || type === 'browserEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'browsernotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'webFetchResult' };
    }

    // Crawler → crawlernotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CrawlerEvent || type === 'crawlerEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'crawlernotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'crawlerResult' };
    }

    // Task → tasknotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.TaskEvent || type === 'taskEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'tasknotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'addTaskResult' };
    }

    // Search → searchnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CodebaseSearchEvent || type === 'codebaseSearchEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'searchnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'codebaseSearchResult' };
    }

    // Code / CodeUtils → codeutilsnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.CodeEvent || type === WebSocketMessageType.CodeUtilsEvent || type === 'codeEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'codeutilsnotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'codeUtilsResult' };
    }

    // SendMessage / chat → chatnotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.SendMessage || type === 'sendMessage') {
        return { notifyType: 'chatnotify', notifyAction: 'agentTextResponse' };
    }

    // Memory → dbmemorynotify
    if (type === WebSocketMessageType.MemoryEvent || type === 'memoryEvent') {
        return { notifyType: 'dbmemorynotify', notifyAction: act ? `${act}Result` : 'memoryResult' };
    }

    // Default fallback: use chatnotify with agentTextResponse so user always sees something
    return { notifyType: 'chatnotify', notifyAction: 'agentTextResponse' };
}

/**
 * Build a notification message from the proxy reply and route it through
 * notificationEventService so the UI gets the same treatment as local execution.
 */
function sendProxyNotificationToUi(ws: any, originalMessage: any, proxyReply: any): void {
    try {
        // console.log('[ProxyNotification] Sending notification to UI:', {
        //     originalMessage,
        //     proxyReply
        // });
        const mapping = mapToNotification(originalMessage.type, originalMessage.action);
        if (!mapping) {
            logger.warn(`[ProxyNotification] No notification mapping for ${originalMessage.type}/${originalMessage.action}`);
            return;
        }

        const params = originalMessage.message || originalMessage.params || originalMessage;
        const isError = proxyReply.success === false;

        // Build notification in the same shape the notification services expect.
        // The zod schemas (e.g. fsNotificationBaseSchema) require `toolUseId` and
        // `requestId` from AgentMessageBaseSchema, so we must include them.
        const notification: any = {
            type: mapping.notifyType,
            action: mapping.notifyAction,
            content: proxyReply.content || proxyReply.output || proxyReply.message || JSON.stringify(proxyReply),
            isError,
            data: buildNotificationData(originalMessage, proxyReply, params),
            // Required by AgentMessageBaseSchema
            requestId: originalMessage.requestId || originalMessage.messageId || '',
            // Required by notification base schemas (e.g. fsNotificationBaseSchema)
            toolUseId: originalMessage.messageId || originalMessage.requestId || `proxy-${Date.now()}`,
            threadId: originalMessage.threadId,
            agentInstanceId: originalMessage.agentInstanceId,
            agentId: originalMessage.agentId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: originalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
            parentId: originalMessage.parentId,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        };

        // logger.info(`[ProxyNotification] Routing proxy reply as ${mapping.notifyType}/${mapping.notifyAction}`);
        notificationEventService.handleNotificationEvent(ws, notification);
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[ProxyNotification] Error sending UI notification: ${error}`);
    }
}

/**
 * Build the `data` field for the notification based on the original request type.
 * Each notification service expects specific data shapes.
 */
function buildNotificationData(originalMessage: any, proxyReply: any, params: any): any {
    const type = originalMessage.type;
    const action = originalMessage.action || '';

    // FS operations — notification services expect data.filePath and data.content / data.text
    if (type === 'fsEvent' || type === 'FSEvent' || type === WebSocketMessageType.FSEvent) {
        const filePath = params.filePath || params.path || proxyReply.path || '';
        const content = proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '';
        const text = params.text || params.content || '';
        return { filePath, content, text };
    }

    // Terminal — notification services expect content (string)
    if (type === 'executeCommand' || type === WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommand) {
        return {
            command: params.command || params.cmd || '',
            output: proxyReply.output || proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '',
        };
    }

    // Chat / sendMessage — expects data.message
    if (type === 'sendMessage' || type === WebSocketMessageType.SendMessage) {
        return { message: proxyReply.content || proxyReply.message || '' };
    }

    // Fallback — pass through whatever the proxy returned
    return proxyReply;
}

const handleCliMessages = async (message, ws, connectionId) => {
    try {
        // logger.log("AGETNT_MESSAGE_RECEIVED", "Message received from CLI agent", LogLevel.DEBUG, {
        //     connectionId,
        //     wsUniqueConnectionId: ws.uniqueConnectionId,
        //     messageType: typeof message,

        // });
        // console.log(message)


        const fileName = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);
        let finalMessage: cliSocketMessage;

        if (typeof message === 'string') {
            finalMessage = JSON.parse(message);
        } else if (Buffer.isBuffer(message)) {
            finalMessage = JSON.parse(message.toString());
        } else {
            finalMessage = message;
        }
        // console.log("finalMessage", finalMessage)
        finalMessage.timestamp = new Date().toISOString()
        const pluginConnectionId = typeof connectionId === 'string' && connectionId.startsWith('plugin-')
            ? connectionId.substring('plugin-'.length)
            : undefined;
        const isPluginSocket = Boolean((ws as any).isPlugin || (ws as any).pluginId || pluginConnectionId);

        if (isPluginSocket) {
            finalMessage.pluginId = (ws as any).pluginId || finalMessage.pluginId || pluginConnectionId;
            finalMessage.isPlugin = true;
        }
        //log full message
        // logger.debug(`[handleCliMessages] Full message: ${JSON.stringify(finalMessage)}`);

        // logger.debug(`[handleCliMessages] Processing message for connectionId: ${connectionId}, ws.uniqueConnectionId: ${ws.uniqueConnectionId}`);

        // logger.log("AGETNT_MESSAGE_PARSED", "Successfully parsed CLI message", LogLevel.DEBUG, {
        //     messageType: finalMessage.type,
        //     messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
        //     threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
        //     agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
        //     connectionId
        // });

        if (finalMessage.agentId) {
            finalMessage["agentToStart"] = finalMessage.agentId;
            global.agentId = finalMessage.agentId;
        }
        if (ws.parentAgentInstanceId) {
            finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId = ws.parentAgentInstanceId;
            // global.parentAgentInstanceId = ws.parentAgentInstanceId;
        }
        if (connectionId) {
            // Always use the connection ID as the authoritative source for this agent's
            // instance ID. Agents may send stale/parent IDs in their payload; the server
            // knows which connection the message came from, so that's the source of truth.
            // Without this, child-agent messages get tagged with the parent's instanceId
            // and the UI's NewAgentBox (filtered by agentInstanceId) shows no messages.
            finalMessage.agentInstanceId = connectionId;
        }
        if (ws.parentId) {
            finalMessage.parentId = ws.parentId;
            finalMessage.agentId = ws.agentId;
            // global.parentId = ws.parentId;
            // global.agentId = ws.agentId;
        }
        if (ws.agentId) {
            finalMessage.agentId = ws.agentId;
            // global.agentId = ws.agentId;
        }
        if (ws.threadId) {
            // logger.debug(`[handleCliMessages] Setting threadId from WebSocket: ${ws.threadId} (was: ${finalMessage.threadId})`);
            finalMessage.threadId = ws.threadId;
        } else if (!isPluginSocket && finalMessage.threadId) {
            // logger.debug(`[handleCliMessages] WebSocket has no threadId, using message threadId: ${finalMessage.threadId}`);
        } else if (!isPluginSocket && shouldBroadcastAsChat(finalMessage) && expectsThreadContext(finalMessage, ws)) {
            logger.warn(`[handleCliMessages] WebSocket has no threadId, using message threadId: ${finalMessage.threadId}`);
        }
        finalMessage.requestId = finalMessage.requestId

        // Plugin message enrichment: add pluginId and isPlugin flag
        if (isPluginSocket) {
            finalMessage.pluginId = (ws as any).pluginId || finalMessage.pluginId || pluginConnectionId;
            finalMessage.isPlugin = true;
            // Plugins don't have threadId/agentId — only pluginId and connectionId
        }

        // console.log('cli message',  finalMessage);
        finalMessage.messageId = finalMessage.messageId || Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15) + Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 15);

        // finalMessage.agentInstanceId = ws.uniqueConnectionId;
        // finalMessage.agentId = ws.agentId;
        // global.agentInstanceId=ws.uniqueConnectionId;
        // global.agentId= ws.agentId;
        // global.parentAgentId = ws.parentId;

        // Handle remote provider messages first (only if message contains providerId)
        // console.log("message form remote", finalMessage)

        // logger.log("AGETNT_MESSAGE_TO_SERVICES", `Routing CLI message to ${finalMessage.type} service`, LogLevel.DEBUG, {
        //     messageType: finalMessage.type,
        //     messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
        //     threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
        //     agentId: finalMessage.agentId
        // });
        // finalMessage.threadId = global.theadId;
        if (!finalMessage.threadId && !isPluginSocket) {
            finalMessage.threadId = getThreadIdBySocket(ws)
        }

        const socketProjectPath =
            (ws as any).effectiveProjectPath ||
            (ws as any).workspacePath ||
            (ws as any).baseProjectPath;

        if (socketProjectPath && !(finalMessage as any).projectPath) {
            (finalMessage as any).projectPath = …1800 tokens truncated…nse, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('projectStructure.')) {
            const response = await handleProjectStructureOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('eval.')) {
            const response = await handleEvalOperation(finalMessage.type as any, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            ws.send(JSON.stringify(response));
            return;
        }




        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('updateRequest.')) {
            const action = finalMessage.type.replace('updateRequest.', '');
            const response = await projectStructureUpdateRequestCliService.handleUpdateRequestOperation(
                action,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('codemap.')) {
            const response = await handleCodemapOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('fileUpdateIntent.')) {
            const action = finalMessage.type.replace('fileUpdateIntent.', '');
            const response = await fileUpdateIntentServiceCLI.handleFileUpdateIntentOperation(
                action,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
