        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('kg.')) {
            const response = await handleKGOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('eventLog.')) {
            const response = await handleEventLogOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('kvStore.')) {
            const response = await handleKVStoreOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('persistentMemory.')) {
            const response = await handlePersistentMemoryOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('contextAssembly.')) {
            const response = await handleContextAssemblyOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('contextCompaction.')) {
            const response = await handleContextCompactionOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('contextRuleEngine.')) {
            const response = await handleContextRuleEngineOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('orchestrator.')) {
            const action = finalMessage.type.replace('orchestrator.', '');
            const response = await orchestratorService.handleOrchestratorOperation(
                action,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Dynamic Agent Events - handles agentEvents.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('agentEvents.')) {
            const response = await handleAgentEventsOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Agent Event Queue - handles agentEventQueue.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('agentEventQueue.')) {
            const action = finalMessage.type.replace('agentEventQueue.', '');
            const response = await agentEventQueueCliService.handleAgentEventQueueOperation(
                action,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Agent Execution Phase - handles agentExecutionPhase.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('agentExecutionPhase.')) {
            const response = await handleAgentExecutionPhaseOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Agent Instance - handles agentInstance.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('agentInstance.')) {
            const response = await handleAgentInstanceOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Guardrail - handles guardrail.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('guardrail.')) {
            const response = await handleGuardrailOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // DynamicPanel - handles dynamicPanel.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('dynamicPanel.')) {
            const response = await dynamicPanelServiceCLI.handleDynamicPanelOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Environment - handles environment.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('environment.')) {
            const action = finalMessage.type.replace('environment.', '');
            const response = await environmentServiceCli.handleEnvironmentOperation(
                action,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        // Plugin - handles plugin.* messages
        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && finalMessage.type.startsWith('plugin.')) {
            const response = await pluginServiceCLI.handlePluginOperation(
                finalMessage.type,
                (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage,
                finalMessage
            );
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, response, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        if (typeof finalMessage.type === 'string' && (finalMessage.type.startsWith('tui') || finalMessage.type.startsWith('terminalCommand'))) {
            const terminalResponse = await terminalCliService.handleTerminalOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
            await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, terminalResponse, finalMessage);
            return;
        }

        switch (finalMessage.type) {
            case WebSocketMessageType.SendMessage:
            case WebSocketMessageType.PorcessStarted:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ProcessStoped:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ConfirmationRequest:
            case WebSocketMessageType.WaitForReply:
                const messageResponse = await messageCliService.handleMessageOperation(finalMessage.type, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, messageResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.GetChatHistory:
                handleGetChatHistory(finalMessage, ws);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.Inference:
                if (['listRoles', 'setRole', 'deleteRole'].includes(finalMessage.action)) {
                    const llmRoleResponse = await llmService.handleRoleOperation(
                        finalMessage.action,
                        (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message || finalMessage,
                        finalMessage
                    );
                    await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, llmRoleResponse, finalMessage);
                } else {
                    llmService.handleAskLLMStream(finalMessage, ws);
                }
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommand:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUnitlInterrupt:
            case WebSocketMessageType.SendInterruptToTerminal:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandRunUntilError:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteCommandWithStream:
                const terminalResponse = await terminalCliService.handleTerminalOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, terminalResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.FSEvent:
            case WebSocketMessageType.FileSystemEvent:
                const fsInput = finalMessage.message || (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage;
                const fsResponse = finalMessage.action === 'readFile'
                    ? await serverCallableRegistry.execute('fs.readFile', fsInput, { finalMessage })
                    : await filesystemServiceCLI.handleFilesystemOperation(finalMessage.action, fsInput, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, fsResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.BrowserEvent:
                const browserResponse = await browserService.handleBrowserOperation(finalMessage.action, finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, browserResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.CrawlerEvent:
                const crawlerResponse = await crawlerCliService.handleCrawlerOperation(finalMessage.action, finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, crawlerResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.SettingEvent:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ProjectEvent:
                const projectResponse = await settingService.handleProjectOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage, ws);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, projectResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.FlagEvent:
            case 'flagEvent' as any:
                const flagResponse = await flagCliService.handleFlagOperation(finalMessage.action as any, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, flagResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.gitEvent:
                const gitResponse = await gitServiceCli.handleGitOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, gitResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.MemoryEvent:
                // Route to dbmemoryService for legacy actions (set, get)
                dbmemoryService.handleMemoryEvents(ws, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.GetAppState:
            case WebSocketMessageType.ProjectStateEvent:
                const appResponse = await appCliService.handleAppOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, appResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.CodebaseSearchEvent:
                const searchResponse = await codebaseSearchCliService.handleCodebaseSearchOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, searchResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.ExecuteToolEvent:
                const executeToolResponse = await executeToolService.handleExecuteToolOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, executeToolResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.VactorDbEvent:
                const vectorResponse = await vectorDbCliService.handleVectorOperation(finalMessage.action, finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, vectorResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.TaskEvent:
                const taskResponse = await taskServiceCLI.handleTaskOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, taskResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.JobEvent:
                const jobResponse = await jobServiceCLI.handleJobOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, jobResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.ThreadEvent:
                const threadResponse = await threadServiceCLI.handleThreadOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage.message, finalMessage, ws);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, threadResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.TodoEvent:
                if (['addTodo', 'updateTodo', 'getTodoList', 'getAllIncompleteTodos'].includes(finalMessage.action)) {
                    const todoResponse = await todoCliService.handleTodoOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                    await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, todoResponse, finalMessage);
                } else {
                    const todoResponse = await plannnerTodoService.handleTodoOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                    await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, todoResponse, finalMessage);
                }
                break;
            case 'SET' as any:
            case 'GET' as any:
                const dbMemoryResponse = await dbmemoryService.handleDbMemoryOperation(finalMessage.action, finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, dbMemoryResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case 'saveMemory' as any:
            case 'updateMemory' as any:
            case 'deleteMemory' as any:
            case 'listMemory' as any:
                // const memoryResponse = await codeboltMemory.handleMemoryOperation(finalMessage.action, finalMessage, finalMessage);
                // ws.send(JSON.stringify(memoryResponse));
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.CodeEvent:
            case WebSocketMessageType.CodeUtilsEvent:
                const codeUtilsResponse = await codeUtilsService.handleCodeUtilsOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, codeUtilsResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.TreeSitterEvent:
                const treeResponse = await jsTreeParserCliService.handleJsTreeParserOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, treeResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.AgentStateEvent:
                const stateResponse = await stateService.handleStateOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, stateResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.TokenizerEvent:
                const tokenResponse = await tokeizerCliService.handleTokenOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, tokenResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.DebugEvent:
                const debugResponse = await debugCliService.handleDebugOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);
                await sendResponseAndNotify(ws, debugResponse, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.NotificationEvent:
                notificationCliService.handleNotificationEvents(ws, finalMessage);
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.ProcessFinished:
                await handleProcessFinished();
                break;
            case WebSocketMessageType.ChatSummaryEvent:
                const chatResponse = await chatCliService.handleChatOperation(finalMessage.action, (finalMessage as any).params || finalMessage, finalMessage);

export function listCommandProcesses() {
    return terminalProcess
        .filter(tp => tp.ptyTerminalProcess?.pid
            && tp.command?.trim()
            && !tp.command.startsWith('Interactive Terminal')
            && ['running', 'executing', 'background'].includes(tp.status))
        .map(tp => ({
            processId: tp.ptyTerminalProcess.pid,
            terminalId: tp.terminalId,
            status: tp.status || 'running',
            timestamp: tp.timestamp || Date.now(),
            command: tp.command,
            messageId: tp.messageId,
        }));
}

export function getCommandProcessStatus(processId: number) {
    if (!Number.isFinite(processId)) {
        return { success: false, error: 'Invalid process ID' };
    }

    const record = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!record) {
        return { success: false, error: `Process ${processId} not found` };
    }

    return {
        success: true,
        process: serializeCommandRecord(record),
    };
}

export function waitCommandProcess(
    processId: number,
    options: { timeoutMs?: number } = {},
): Promise<{ success: boolean; process?: ManagedCommandRecord; error?: string }> {
    if (!Number.isFinite(processId)) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: false, error: 'Invalid process ID' });
    }

    const record = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!record) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: false, error: `Process ${processId} not found` });
    }

    if (FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
        return Promise.resolve({ success: true, process: serializeCommandRecord(record) });
    }

    const timeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(
        options.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
        DEFAULT_COMMAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS,
    ));

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const waiter: CommandWaiter = {
            resolve: (finalRecord) => resolve({

import { stopAgent } from '../utils/agentHelper';
// taskManager and chatManager removed - tasks and threads are separate, steps belong to threads
import { normalizeThreadStatus, ThreadStepStatus } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { cliSocketMessage, MessageData, WebSocketMessageType, } from "../types/cliWs";

// ThreadStepManager initialization is handled in the function where it's used
import { SenderEnum, TemplateEnum } from "../sharedTypes/chatTypes";
import { ComponentType } from '../types/componentType';
import { uiSocketConnection, wsconnectionManager } from '../sockets/socketManager';
import { forwardTaskCompletion } from './agentService.cli';
import { sendMessage, sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi, sendNotificationToUi } from '../utils/messages';
import { getMessageId } from '../utils/agentHelper';
import { sendMessageToCodebotCli } from './wsconnections';
import { processAgentMessage } from '../services/agentMessageService';
import { llmService } from '../services/llmService';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import taskActivityService, { TaskActivityStatus, TaskActivityType } from '../services/taskActivityService';
import taskManager from '../services/TaskManager';
import { notifyThreadCompletion } from './thread/thread-service.cli';
import { actionPlanService } from '../services/actionPlanService';
import { threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { applicationEventBus } from '../services/applicationEventBus';
import { broadcastThreadUpdate } from '../sockets/orchestratorSocket';
import { runGuardedMcpTool } from './toolRuntime/toolApprovalRuntime';
import { GuardedToolType } from '../types/guardrail';

import {
    SendMessageEvent,
    ProcessStartedEvent,
    ProcessStoppedEvent,
    ConfirmationRequestEvent,
    WaitForReplyEvent
} from '@codebolt/types/dist/wstypes/agent-to-app-ws/actions/messageEventSchemas';

import {
    MessageServiceResponse,
    MessageOperationSuccessResponse,
    MessageOperationErrorResponse
} from '@codebolt/types/dist/wstypes/app-to-agent-ws/messageServiceResponses';

// Import factory validators
import {
    createAgentMessageFactory,
    createInfoWithLinkMessageFactory,
    createConfirmationChatMessageFactory
} from "../factoryValidator/app-to-ui-factory/messageservice-factory-validator";
import agentExecutionManager, { AgentExecutionStatus } from '../stores/agentExecutionManager';
import chatManager from '../stores/chatManager';
import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';

function getMessageGuardedToolType(toolName: string): GuardedToolType {
    switch (toolName) {
        case 'message_send':
            return 'message.send';
        case 'message_process_start':
            return 'message.processStart';
        case 'message_process_stop':
            return 'message.processStop';
        case 'message_confirmation_request':
            return 'message.confirmationRequest';
        case 'message_wait_for_reply':
            return 'message.waitForReply';
        default:
            return 'mcp.callTool';
    }
}

const isSteeringThreadStep = (step: any): boolean => {
    return step?.type === 'steering' ||
        step?.metaData?.isSteeringMessage === true ||
        step?.metaData?.messageType === 'steering' ||
        step?.metaData?.sentAsSteering === true;
};

const handleSendMessage = (finalMessage: cliSocketMessage) => {
    if (!uiSocketConnection) return;
    const { message, type } = finalMessage;
    let templateType = TemplateEnum.AGENT;
    // Ensure text is always a string
    const messageText = typeof message === 'string' ? message : JSON.stringify(message);
    let data = { text: messageText };

    sendMessage({
        type: 'message',
        content: messageText,
        actionType: type,
        templateType,
        data,
        messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
        agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
        threadId: finalMessage.threadId
    });
};

const handleProcessStarted = (finalMessage: cliSocketMessage) => {
    if (!uiSocketConnection) return;

    const messageText = typeof finalMessage.message === 'string' ? finalMessage.message : JSON.stringify(finalMessage.message);
    sendMessage({
        type: "processStarted",
        content: messageText,
        actionType: finalMessage.type,
        messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
        templateType: TemplateEnum.INFOWITHLINK,
        data: { text: messageText, linkUrl: ComponentType.Memory },
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
        agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
        threadId: finalMessage.threadId
    });
};

/**
 * Update task status when a thread completes
 * @param threadId The completed thread ID
 */
const updateTaskStatusForCompletedThread = async (threadId: string, message: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
        // Find task activity associated with this thread
        const activityResult = await taskActivityService.getTaskActivities({ threadId });

        if (activityResult.success && activityResult.data) {
            const activities = Array.isArray(activityResult.data) ? activityResult.data : [activityResult.data];

            for (const activity of activities) {
                if (activity.taskId && activity.status === TaskActivityStatus.RUNNING) {
                    // Create a new task activity entry for the completed status
                    await taskActivityService.createTaskActivity({
                        taskId: activity.taskId,
                        threadId: threadId,
                        type: TaskActivityType.AGENT_SUMMARY,
                        status: TaskActivityStatus.COMPLETED,
                        message: message
                    });

                    // Update the main task status to completed
                    const taskUpdated = await taskManager.markTaskCompleted(
                        activity.taskId,
                        `Thread ${threadId} completed successfully`
                    );

                    if (taskUpdated) {
                        logger.info(`Task ${activity.taskId} marked as completed when thread ${threadId} finished`);

                        // Also update Action Plan status if applicable
                        try {
                            await actionPlanService.updateActionPlanTaskStatus(activity.taskId, 'completed');
                            logger.info(`Action Plan Task ${activity.taskId} marked as completed`);
                        } catch (apError) {
                            logger.warn(`Failed to update Action Plan status for task ${activity.taskId}: ${apError.message}`);
                        }
                    } else {
                        logger.warn(`Failed to update task status for task ${activity.taskId}`);
                    }

                    // Only update the first running activity we find
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else {
            logger.debug(`No task activity found for completed thread: ${threadId}`);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Error updating task status for completed thread ${threadId}: ${error.message}`);
        // Don't throw error - continue with normal thread completion flow
    }
};

const emittedAgentFinished = new Set<string>();

const updateThreadStatusAndNotify = async (threadId: string, status: string, message?: string): Promise<boolean> => {
    const normalizedStatus = normalizeThreadStatus(status);
    const updated = await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, normalizedStatus);

    if (updated) {
        sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi(threadId, normalizedStatus, message);
    }

    return updated;
};

/**
 * Recursively stop all child threads and their associated agents
 * @param parentThreadId The parent thread ID whose children should be stopped
 */
const stopChildThreads = async (parentThreadId: string): Promise<void> => {
    try {
        // Get all child threads for this parent
        const childThreads = await threadFileStore.getChildThreads(parentThreadId);

        if (childThreads.length === 0) {
            logger.debug(`No child threads found for parent: ${parentThreadId}`);
            return;
        }

        logger.info(`[StopChildThreads] Found ${childThreads.length} child thread(s) to stop for parent: ${parentThreadId}`);

        for (const childThread of childThreads) {
            const childThreadId = childThread.threadId;

            try {
                // First, recursively stop any grandchild threads
                await stopChildThreads(childThreadId);

                llmService.cancelActiveRequestsForThread(childThreadId, 'child_thread_stopped');

                // Stop all agent processes associated with this child thread
                const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(childThreadId, false);
                logger.info(`[StopChildThreads] Stopped ${stoppedCount} process(es) for child thread: ${childThreadId}`);

                // Update child thread status to stopped when it is interrupted by its parent
                await updateThreadStatusAndNotify(
                    childThreadId,
                    'stopped',
                    'Thread stopped because parent thread stopped'
                );

                // Store THREAD_FINISHED event for observability
                chatManager.addObservabilityEvent({
                    eventId: getMessageId(),
                    eventType: 'THREAD_FINISHED',
                    threadId: childThreadId,
                    parentThreadId: parentThreadId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    metadata: { reason: 'parent_thread_stopped' }
                });

                // Broadcast thread completion to subscribers
                broadcastThreadUpdate(parentThreadId, childThreadId, 'updated', {
                    ...childThread,
                    status: 'stopped',
                    completedAt: new Date().toISOString()
                });

                // Notify thread completion
                notifyThreadCompletion(childThreadId, {
                    thread: childThread,
                    activityId: 'activity-' + childThreadId,
                    status: 'stopped',
                    message: 'Thread stopped because parent thread stopped',
                    output: 'Parent thread stopped'
                });

                logger.info(`[StopChildThreads] Successfully stopped child thread: ${childThreadId}`);
            } catch (error) {
                logger.error(`[StopChildThreads] Error stopping child thread ${childThreadId}: ${error.message}`);
            }
        }
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[StopChildThreads] Error fetching child threads for ${parentThreadId}: ${error.message}`);
    }
};

const handleProcessStopped = async (finalMessage: cliSocketMessage) => {
    // if (!uiSocketConnection) return;
]]></tool_result>

                        activity.taskId,

                    );

                    if (taskUpdated) {
                        logger.info(`Task ${activity.taskId} marked as completed when thread ${threadId} finished`);

                        // Also update Action Plan status if applicable
                        try {
                            await actionPlanService.updateActionPlanTaskStatus(activity.taskId, 'completed');
                            logger.info(`Action Plan Task ${activity.taskId} marked as completed`);
                        } catch (apError) {

                    } else {

const handleProcessStopped = async (finalMessage: cliSocketMessage) => {
    // if (!uiSocketConnection) return;

    const threadId = finalMessage.threadId;

    // Get thread info from database FIRST to determine if this is a main or sub thread
    // This is important because finalMessage.parentId might not be set correctly
    // even though the thread has a parentId in the database
    const threadFromDb = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);

    // Use database parentId to determine thread type, not message parentId
    // This ensures child threads created via createAndStartThread are correctly identified
    const actualParentId = threadFromDb?.parentId || finalMessage?.parentId;
    const isSubThread = actualParentId != null;

    // Update agent execution status to COMPLETED
    if (finalMessage?.agentInstanceId) {
        try {
            agentProcessManager.markCompletionNotified(finalMessage.agentInstanceId);
            agentExecutionManager.updateAgentStatus(
                finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                AgentExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
            );
            logger.info(`Updated agent execution status to COMPLETED: ${finalMessage.agentInstanceId}`);
        } catch (statusError) {
            logger.error(`Failed to update agent execution status: ${statusError.message}`);
        }
    }

    // Stop all child threads when this thread stops
    // This ensures that when a parent thread is stopped, all its child threads are also stopped
    if (threadId) {
        try {
            await stopChildThreads(threadId);
        } catch (childThreadError) {
            logger.error(`[handleProcessStopped] Error stopping child threads for ${threadId}: ${childThreadError.message}`);
        }
    }

    try {
        if (finalMessage?.threadId) {
            const dedupeKey = `${finalMessage.threadId}:${finalMessage.agentId || ''}:${actualParentId || ''}`;
            // if (emittedAgentFinished.has(dedupeKey)) {
            //     logger.debug(`[ThreadObservability] Skipping duplicate AGENT_FINISHED for ${dedupeKey}`);
            // } else {
            emittedAgentFinished.add(dedupeKey);
            setTimeout(() => emittedAgentFinished.delete(dedupeKey), 5 * 60 * 1000); // auto-clear after 5 minutes

            // Store event persistently
            chatManager.addObservabilityEvent({
                eventId: getMessageId(),
                eventType: 'AGENT_FINISHED',
                threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                parentThreadId: actualParentId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });

            sendNotificationToUi({
                type: 'message',
                actionType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                templateType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                messageId: getMessageId(),
                content: `Agent finished for thread ${finalMessage.threadId}`,
                payload: {
                    eventType: 'AGENT_FINISHED',
                    threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                    parentId: actualParentId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                }

    // Get thread info from database FIRST to determine if this is a main or sub thread
    // This is important because finalMessage.parentId might not be set correctly
    // even though the thread has a parentId in the database
    const threadFromDb = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);

    // Use database parentId to determine thread type, not message parentId
    // This ensures child threads created via createAndStartThread are correctly identified
    const actualParentId = threadFromDb?.parentId || finalMessage?.parentId;
    const isSubThread = actualParentId != null;

    // Update agent execution status to COMPLETED
    if (finalMessage?.agentInstanceId) {
        try {
            agentProcessManager.markCompletionNotified(finalMessage.agentInstanceId);
            agentExecutionManager.updateAgentStatus(
                finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                AgentExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
            );
            logger.info(`Updated agent execution status to COMPLETED: ${finalMessage.agentInstanceId}`);
        } catch (statusError) {
            logger.error(`Failed to update agent execution status: ${statusError.message}`);
        }
    }

    // Stop all child threads when this thread stops
    // This ensures that when a parent thread is stopped, all its child threads are also stopped
    if (threadId) {
        try {
            await stopChildThreads(threadId);
        } catch (childThreadError) {
            logger.error(`[handleProcessStopped] Error stopping child threads for ${threadId}: ${childThreadError.message}`);
        }
    }

    try {
        if (finalMessage?.threadId) {
            const dedupeKey = `${finalMessage.threadId}:${finalMessage.agentId || ''}:${actualParentId || ''}`;
            // if (emittedAgentFinished.has(dedupeKey)) {
            //     logger.debug(`[ThreadObservability] Skipping duplicate AGENT_FINISHED for ${dedupeKey}`);
            // } else {
            emittedAgentFinished.add(dedupeKey);
            setTimeout(() => emittedAgentFinished.delete(dedupeKey), 5 * 60 * 1000); // auto-clear after 5 minutes

            // Store event persistently
            chatManager.addObservabilityEvent({
                eventId: getMessageId(),
                eventType: 'AGENT_FINISHED',
                threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                parentThreadId: actualParentId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            });

            sendNotificationToUi({
                type: 'message',
                actionType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                templateType: TemplateEnum.THREAD_OBSERVABILITY,
                threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                messageId: getMessageId(),
                content: `Agent finished for thread ${finalMessage.threadId}`,
                payload: {
                    eventType: 'AGENT_FINISHED',
                    threadId: finalMessage.threadId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                    parentId: actualParentId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                }
            });

+export type AsyncTaskType = 'thread' | 'command' | 'action_block' | 'remote_job';

+export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';

+export interface AsyncTaskRecord {

+
+type AsyncTaskWaiter = {
+    resolve: (record: AsyncTaskRecord) => void;
+    timeoutId?: NodeJS.Timeout;

+
+const FINAL_STATUSES = new Set<AsyncTaskStatus>(['completed', 'failed', 'stopped']);
+const MAX_TASKS = 500;

+function nowIso(): string {

+class AsyncTaskRegistry {

+    registerTask(input: AsyncTaskRegisterInput): AsyncTaskRecord {
+        const timestamp = nowIso();
+        const existing = this.tasks.get(input.taskId);
+        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
+            ...(existing || {}),
+            taskId: input.taskId,
+            type: input.type,
+            status: existing?.status === 'detached' ? 'detached' : 'running',
+            ownership: existing?.ownership || 'owned',
+            ownerThreadId: input.ownerThreadId || existing?.ownerThreadId,
+            ownerAgentId: input.ownerAgentId || existing?.ownerAgentId,
+            ownerAgentInstanceId: input.ownerAgentInstanceId || existing?.ownerAgentInstanceId,
+            startedAt: existing?.startedAt || timestamp,
+            updatedAt: timestamp,
+            title: input.title || existing?.title,
+            summary: input.summary || existing?.summary,
+            metadata: {
+                ...(existing?.metadata || {}),
+                ...(input.metadata || {}),
+            },
+        };
+
+        this.tasks.set(input.taskId, record);
+        this.prune();
+        return { ...record };
+    }
+
+    updateTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial<AsyncTaskRecord>): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
+        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
+        if (!existing) {
+            return undefined;
+        }
+
+        const timestamp = nowIso();
+        const status = updates.status || existing.status;
+        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
+            ...existing,
+            ...updates,
+            metadata: {
+                ...(existing.metadata || {}),
+                ...(updates.metadata || {}),
+            },
+            updatedAt: timestamp,
+            endedAt: FINAL_STATUSES.has(status) ? updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt || timestamp : updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt,
+        };

+        this.tasks.set(taskId, record);
+        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
+            this.resolveWaiters(record);

+        return { ...record };
+    }
+
+    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
+        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);

+    }
+
+    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
+        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';

+            .filter(task => {
+                if (scope === 'all') {

+                }
+                if (scope === 'current_run') {

+                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&

+    markAwaitingDecisionForRun(ownerThreadId?: string, ownerAgentId?: string, ownerAgentInstanceId?: string): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
+        const updatedTasks: AsyncTaskRecord[] = [];

+            }
+            if (ownerThreadId && task.ownerThreadId !== ownerThreadId) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            if (ownerAgentId && task.ownerAgentId !== ownerAgentId) {

+            }
+            if (ownerAgentInstanceId && task.ownerAgentInstanceId !== ownerAgentInstanceId) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            const updated = this.updateTask(task.taskId, {

+    }
+
+    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
+        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
+        if (!existing) {
+            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
+        }
+
+        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
+            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
+        }
+
+        return new Promise((resolve) => {
+            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
+                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),
+            };
+
+            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {

+            const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
+            waiters.push(waiter);
+            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
+        });
+    }
+
+    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
+        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
+        if (!waiters?.length) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        this.waiters.delete(record.taskId);
+        for (const waiter of waiters) {

+            }
+            waiter.resolve(record);
+        }
+    }
+
+    private prune(): void {
+        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        const completedTasks = Array.from(this.tasks.values())
+            .filter(task => FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))

+        for (const task of completedTasks) {

+            }
+            this.tasks.delete(task.taskId);

+        }
+    }

+import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';

+import { stopCommandProcess, waitCommandProcess, readCommandProcessOutput } from '../sockets/aiTerminal';
+import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskRecord, AsyncTaskScope } from './asyncTaskRegistry.cli';
+
+const DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 1000;
+const MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
+
+type AsyncTaskAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';
+
+function normalizeTimeoutMs(value: unknown): number {
+    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
+        return DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
+    }
+    return Math.min(Math.floor(value), MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
+}
+
+function inferTaskParts(taskId: string): { type?: string; resourceId?: string } {
+    const separatorIndex = taskId.indexOf(':');
+    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
+        return {};
+    }
+    return {
+        type: taskId.slice(0, separatorIndex),
+        resourceId: taskId.slice(separatorIndex + 1),
+    };
+}
+
+function formatResponse(type: string, success: boolean, data: Record<string, any>, error?: string) {
+    return {
+        type,
+        success,
+        ...data,
+        error,
+        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
+    };
+}
+
+async function stopThreadTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
+    const threadId = task.metadata?.threadId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId;
+    if (!threadId) {
+        return { success: false, error: `Cannot infer thread id for task ${task.taskId}` };
+    }
+
+    const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(threadId, false);
+    await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
+    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
+        status: 'stopped',
+        ownership: task.ownership === 'detached' ? 'detached' : task.ownership,
+        summary: `Stopped thread task ${threadId}`,
+        metadata: { stoppedCount },
+    });
+
+    return { success: true, stoppedCount };
+}
+
+async function stopCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
+    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
+    const result = stopCommandProcess(processId);
+    if (!result.success) {
+        return result;
+    }
+
+    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
+        status: 'stopped',
+        summary: `Stopped command process ${processId}`,
+    });
+    return result;
+}
+
+async function waitCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord, timeoutMs: number) {
+    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
+    const result = await waitCommandProcess(processId, { timeoutMs });
+
+    if (result.process) {
+        const status = result.process.status === 'done'
+            ? 'completed'
+            : result.process.status === 'failed'
+                ? 'failed'
+                : result.process.status === 'stopped'
+                    ? 'stopped'
+                    : task.status;
+        asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
+            status,
+            summary: result.error || task.summary,

+    const output = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, { lines: 80, tailBytes: 64 * 1024 });

+export const asyncTaskServiceCLI = {

+        }
+        if (!['wait', 'stop', 'detach'].includes(action)) {

export const notifyThreadCompletion = (threadId: string, completionData: any = {}) => {
    const record = pendingThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
    const endedAt = nowIso();
    const completion: ThreadCompletionResult = {
        ...completionData,
        thread: completionData.thread || record?.thread,
        activityId: completionData.activityId || record?.activityId || 'activity-' + threadId,
    };

    completedThreadCompletions.set(threadId, completion);
    pruneCompletedThreadCompletions();

    if (record) {
        logger.info(`[ThreadCompletion] Resolving ${record.waiters.length} waiter(s) for thread ${threadId}`);
        record.endedAt = endedAt;
        record.completion = completion;
        if (!record.targetAgentInstanceId) {
            record.targetAgentInstanceId = resolveThreadAgentInstanceId(threadId, record.targetAgentId);
        }

        for (const resolve of record.waiters) {
            resolve(completion);
        }
        record.waiters = [];
        void emitThreadCompletionEvent(record, completion);
        pendingThreadCompletions.delete(threadId);
    } else {
        logger.debug(`[ThreadCompletion] No pending promise found for thread ${threadId}`);
    }

/**
 * Execute Command Tool - Executes shell commands
 * Wraps the SDK's cbterminal.executeCommand() method
 */

import type {
    ToolInvocation,
    ToolResult,
    ToolCallConfirmationDetails,
    ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails,
} from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind, ToolConfirmationOutcome } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';
import cbchat from '../../modules/chat';
import { isCodeboltCommand, executeCodeboltCommand } from '../pseudo-cli';

/**
 * Parameters for the ExecuteCommand tool
 */
export interface ExecuteCommandToolParams {
    /**
     * One sentence explanation of why this tool is being used
     */
    explanation?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command to execute
     */
    command?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command split into physical shell lines.
     * Prefer this for heredocs and other multiline shell constructs.
     */
    command_lines?: string[];

    /**
     * Whether to return empty string on success (default: false)
     */
    return_empty_on_success?: boolean;

    /**
     * How the command should be managed.
     */
    execution_mode?: 'auto' | 'foreground' | 'background';

    /**
     * Milliseconds to wait in auto/background mode before returning a running process.
     */
    yield_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Optional hard timeout for foreground command execution.
     */
    timeout_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Whether auto mode should keep the process alive after yield.
     */
    background_on_yield?: boolean;
}

class ExecuteCommandToolInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    ExecuteCommandToolParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: ExecuteCommandToolParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    override async shouldConfirmExecute(
        _abortSignal: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<ToolCallConfirmationDetails | false> {
        const command = this.getCommand();

        // Codebolt pseudo-CLI commands don't need confirmation
        if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Extract root command for confirmation
        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {
                // Callback handled by the framework
            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                    backgroundOnYield: this.params.background_on_yield,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is running in the background: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.SHELL_EXECUTE_ERROR,
                    },
                };
            }

            // Extract output
            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';
            const exitCode = (response as any).exitCode ?? (response as any).code;

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {
                llmContent = `Command executed: ${command}\n\nOutput:\n${output}`;
            } else {
                llmContent = `Command executed successfully: ${command}`;
            }

            if (exitCode !== undefined && exitCode !== 0) {
                llmContent += `\n\nExit code: ${exitCode}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: output ? this.truncateOutput(output) : 'Command executed successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error executing command: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

    private getCommand(): string {
]]></tool_result>

import {
    AgentResponseExecutor,
    AgentLocalTool,
    PostToolCallProcessor,
    PreToolCallProcessor,
    ProcessedMessage,
    ResponseInput,
    ResponseOutput,
    ToolResult
} from '@codebolt/types/agent';
import { LLMCompletion, MessageObject, Tool, ToolCall } from '@codebolt/types/sdk';
import codebolt from '@codebolt/codeboltjs';

import { LoopDetectionService } from '../services/LoopDetectionService';
import {
    appendTranscriptMessages,
    getTranscriptMessages,
    reconcileRuntimePromptContext,
} from './promptContext';
import { appendUniqueTools, listProjectLocalTools, resolveToolExecutionName } from '../utils/agentToolLoader';

interface ParsedToolCall {
    tool: ToolCall;
    toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
    toolName: string;
    toolUseId: string;
    waitForPrevious: boolean;
}

interface ToolExecutionOutcome {
    toolResults: ToolResult[];
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    completed: boolean;
    finalMessage: string | undefined;
    hadToolCalls: boolean;
}

interface SingleToolExecutionResult {
    toolResult: ToolResult;
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    didUserReject: boolean;
}

interface ContextCompactionDecision {
    required?: boolean;
    hasToolCalls?: boolean;
    runRequest?: Record<string, unknown>;
    reason?: string;
    stats?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

type LLMCompletionWithCompaction = LLMCompletion & {
    contextCompaction?: ContextCompactionDecision;
};

export class ResponseExecutor implements AgentResponseExecutor {

    private preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private completed = false;
    private finalMessage: string | undefined = undefined;
    private loopDetectionService: LoopDetectionService | undefined;
    private localToolsByExecutionName: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;

    constructor(options: {
        preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[];
        postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[];
        loopDetectionService?: LoopDetectionService;
        localToolsByExecutionName?: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;
    }) {
        this.preToolCallProcessors = options.preToolCallProcessors;
        this.postToolCallProcessors = options.postToolCallProcessors;
        this.loopDetectionService = options.loopDetectionService;
        this.localToolsByExecutionName = options.localToolsByExecutionName || new Map<string, AgentLocalTool>();
    }

    async executeResponse(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ResponseOutput> {
        this.completed = false;
        this.finalMessage = undefined;

        let nextMessage: ProcessedMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(input.nextMessage);

        for (const preToolCallProcessor of this.preToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await preToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);
                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in pre tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const compactionMessagePromise = this.runRequiredCompaction(input.rawLLMOutput);
        const toolExecution = await this.executeTools(input);
        const compactionCompleted = await compactionMessagePromise;
        if (compactionCompleted) {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage('Conversation Compacted'));
        }
        this.completed = this.completed || toolExecution.completed;
        this.finalMessage = toolExecution.finalMessage ?? this.finalMessage;

        await this.injectDiscoveredTools(
            input.rawLLMOutput,
            toolExecution.toolResults,
            nextMessage,
        );

        if (toolExecution.toolResults.length > 0 || toolExecution.followUpMessages.length > 0) {
            nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [
                ...toolExecution.toolResults.map((toolResult) => ({
                    role: toolResult.role,
                    content: typeof toolResult.content === 'string'
                        ? toolResult.content
                        : JSON.stringify(toolResult.content),
                    tool_call_id: toolResult.tool_call_id,
                })),
                ...toolExecution.followUpMessages,
            ]);
        }

        const transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        for (const postToolCallProcessor of this.postToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await postToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                    toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
                    tokenLimit: input.rawLLMOutput?.tokenLimit,
                    maxOutputTokens: input.rawLLMOutput?.maxOutputTokens
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);

                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in post tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        if (
            !toolExecution.hadToolCalls &&
            transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors > transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors
        ) {
            this.completed = false;
            this.finalMessage = undefined;
        }

        const output: ResponseOutput = {
            completed: this.completed,
            nextMessage,
            toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
        };
        if (this.finalMessage !== undefined) {
            output.finalMessage = this.finalMessage;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private parseToolCall(tool: ToolCall): ParsedToolCall {
        let toolInput: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (tool.function.arguments) {
            try {
                const parsedArguments = JSON.parse(tool.function.arguments);
                if (parsedArguments && typeof parsedArguments === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedArguments)) {
                    toolInput = parsedArguments as Record<string, unknown>;
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to parse tool arguments: ${parseError}`);
            }
        }

        return {
            tool,
            toolInput,
            toolName: tool.function.name,
            toolUseId: tool.id,
            waitForPrevious: toolInput['waitForPreviousTools'] === true,
        };
    }

    private extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): string | undefined {
        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            if (choice.message?.content) {
                return choice.message.content;
            }

            const reasoningContent = (choice.message as MessageObject & {
                reasoning_content?: string;
            } | undefined)?.reasoning_content;
            if (reasoningContent) {
                return reasoningContent;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    private getToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): ToolCall[] {
        const toolCallsById = new Map<string, ToolCall>();

        for (const toolCall of llmResponse.tool_calls ?? []) {
            if (toolCall?.id) {
                toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
            }
        }

        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            for (const toolCall of choice.message?.tool_calls ?? []) {
                if (toolCall?.id && !toolCallsById.has(toolCall.id)) {
                    toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
                }
            }
        }

        return Array.from(toolCallsById.values());
    }

    private hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): boolean {
        return this.getToolCalls(llmResponse).some((toolCall) => {
            const toolName = toolCall.function?.name || '';
            return !toolName.includes('attempt_completion') &&
                !toolName.includes('context_compaction') &&
                !toolName.includes('contextCompaction');
        });
    }

    private async runRequiredCompaction(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): Promise<boolean> {
        const decision = (llmResponse as LLMCompletionWithCompaction).contextCompaction;
        if (!decision?.required || decision.hasToolCalls === false || !this.hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            await codebolt.contextCompaction.run({
                ...(decision.runRequest || {}),
                reason: String(decision.runRequest?.['reason'] || decision.reason || 'llm_response_tool_calls'),
            });
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Context compaction failed:', error);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private async executeTools(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ToolExecutionOutcome> {
        const llmResponse = input.rawLLMOutput;
        const lastMessageContent = this.extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse);
        const toolCalls = this.getToolCalls(llmResponse);

        if (toolCalls.length === 0) {
            await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(lastMessageContent);

            return {
                toolResults: [],
                followUpMessages: [],
                completed: true,
                finalMessage: lastMessageContent,
                hadToolCalls: false,
            };
        }

        const parsedToolCalls = toolCalls.map((tool) => this.parseToolCall(tool));
        const completionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );
        const executionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            !toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );

        if (this.loopDetectionService) {
            for (const toolCall of executionToolCalls) {
                const loopDetected = this.loopDetectionService.checkToolCallLoop(
                    toolCall.toolName,
                    toolCall.toolInput,
                );

                if (loopDetected) {
                    const loopMessage = `Loop detected while calling "${toolCall.toolName}". Execution stopped to prevent infinite recurrence.`;
                    return {
                        toolResults: [{
                            role: 'tool',
                            tool_call_id: 'system-loop-detection',
                            content: JSON.stringify({ error: loopMessage }),
                        }],
                        followUpMessages: [],
                        completed: true,
                        finalMessage: loopMessage,
                        hadToolCalls: true,
                    };
                }
            }
        }

        const toolResults: ToolResult[] = [];
        const followUpMessages: MessageObject[] = [];
        let userRejectedToolUse = false;

        for (const currentToolCall of executionToolCalls) {
            if (userRejectedToolUse) {
                const skippedResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    currentToolCall.toolUseId,
                    'Skipping tool execution due to previous tool user rejection.',
                );
                toolResults.push(skippedResult);
                continue;
            }

            const executionResult = await this.executeSingleToolCall(currentToolCall, input);
            toolResults.push(executionResult.toolResult);
            followUpMessages.push(...executionResult.followUpMessages);
            userRejectedToolUse = executionResult.didUserReject;
        }

        if (completionToolCalls.length > 0) {
            const completionToolCall = completionToolCalls.at(-1);
            if (completionToolCall) {
                const completionArguments = completionToolCall.toolInput;

                const [, completionResult] = await this.executeTool(
                    completionToolCall.toolName,
                    completionArguments,
                    input,

        return {

            followUpMessages,
            completed: completionToolCalls.length > 0,
            finalMessage: this.finalMessage,
            hadToolCalls: true,
        };
    }

    private async sendFinalMessageToChat(message: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        if (!message || message.trim().length === 0) {

import { BaseMessageModifier } from "../base";
import { FlatUserMessage, MessageObject } from "@codebolt/types/sdk";
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';

import { appendUserContextMessage } from "../../unified/base/promptContext";

    includePatterns?: string[];
    excludePatterns?: string[];
}

    private readonly defaultExcludePatterns = [
        'node_modules/**',

import {

    PreInferenceProcessor,

} from "@codebolt/types/agent";

import { InitialPromptGenerator } from "../base";
import { AgentStep } from "../base/agentStep";
