export interface AgentOptions extends AgentConfig {
    context?: ProcessedMessage;
    allowedTools?: string[];
    compaction?: CompactionOrchestratorOptions;
    loopDetectionService?: LoopDetectionService;
    maxTurns?: number;
    includeDefaultModifiers?: boolean;
    includeDefaultProcessors?: boolean;
    messageModifiers?: MessageModifier[];
    preInferenceProcessors?: PreInferenceProcessor[];
    postInferenceProcessors?: PostInferenceProcessor[];
    preToolCallProcessors?: PreToolCallProcessor[];
    postToolCallProcessors?: PostToolCallProcessor[];
}

export interface AgentRunResult {
    success: boolean;
    state: AgentRunState | null;
    toolResults: ToolResult[];
    finalMessage?: string;
    error?: string;
    /**
     * @deprecated Use `state.prompt` instead.
     */
    result: ProcessedMessage | null;
    /**
     * @deprecated Use `state` instead.
     */
    context: ProcessedMessage | null;
}

export interface AgentRunState {
    prompt: ProcessedMessage;
}

export interface AgentRunOptions {
    state?: AgentRunState;
    context?: ProcessedMessage;
}

export interface CreateAgentOptions extends AgentOptions {
    systemPrompt?: string;
}

type ProcessorWithIdentity = {
    id?: unknown;
    name?: unknown;
    constructor?: {
        name?: string;
    };
};

const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = 'Based on User Message send reply';

function getProcessorKey(processor: unknown): string {
    const candidate = processor as ProcessorWithIdentity;
    if (typeof candidate.id === 'string' && candidate.id.length > 0) {
        return candidate.id;
    }

    if (typeof candidate.name === 'string' && candidate.name.length > 0) {
        return candidate.name;
    }

    if (candidate.constructor?.name) {
        return candidate.constructor.name;
    }

    return String(processor);
}

function mergeProcessors<T>(defaults: T[], custom: T[]): T[] {
    const merged = new Map<string, T>();

    for (const processor of defaults) {
        merged.set(getProcessorKey(processor), processor);
    }

    for (const processor of custom) {
        merged.set(getProcessorKey(processor), processor);
    }

    return Array.from(merged.values());
}

function createDefaultMessageModifiers(systemPrompt: string, allowedTools?: string[]): MessageModifier[] {
    return [
        new ChatHistoryMessageModifier({
            enableChatHistory: true,
            includeSystemMessages: false,
        }),
        new EnvironmentContextModifier({ enableFullContext: true }),
        new DirectoryContextModifier(),
        new IdeContextModifier({
            includeActiveFile: true,
            includeOpenFiles: true,
            includeCursorPosition: true,
            includeSelectedText: true
        }),
        new CoreSystemPromptModifier({ customSystemPrompt: systemPrompt }),
        new ToolInjectionModifier({
            includeToolDescriptions: true,
            ...(allowedTools ? { allowedTools } : {})
        }),
        new AtFileProcessorModifier({ enableRecursiveSearch: true })
    ];
}

function createDefaultPreInferenceProcessors(): PreInferenceProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultPostInferenceProcessors(): PostInferenceProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultPreToolCallProcessors(): PreToolCallProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultPostToolCallProcessors(): PostToolCallProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultUserMessage(message: string): FlatUserMessage {
    const timestamp = Date.now();

    return {
        userMessage: message,
        selectedAgent: {
            id: 'codebolt-agent',
            name: 'Codebolt Agent'
        },
        mentionedFiles: [],
        mentionedFullPaths: [],
        mentionedFolders: [],
        mentionedMCPs: [],
        uploadedImages: [],
        mentionedAgents: [],
        mentionedEnvironments: [],
        messageId: `msg-${timestamp}`,
        threadId: `thread-${timestamp}`
    };
}

function collectProcessors<T>(
    fromNested: T[] | undefined,
    fromTopLevel: T[] | undefined,
): T[] {
    return [
        ...(fromNested ?? []),
        ...(fromTopLevel ?? []),
    ];
}

export class Agent implements AgentInterface {
    private readonly config: AgentOptions;
    private readonly messageModifiers: MessageModifier[];
    private readonly preInferenceProcessors: PreInferenceProcessor[];
    private readonly postInferenceProcessors: PostInferenceProcessor[];
    private readonly preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[];
    private readonly postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[];
    private readonly enableLogging: boolean;
    private readonly baseSystemPrompt: string;
    private readonly context: ProcessedMessage | undefined;
    private readonly allowedTools: string[] | undefined;
    private readonly compactionOrchestrator: CompactionOrchestrator;
    private readonly loopDetectionService: LoopDetectionService | undefined;
    private readonly maxTurns: number;
    private readonly localToolSchemas: SdkTool[];
    private readonly localToolsByExecutionName: ReturnType<typeof createAgentLocalToolRegistry>['byExecutionName'];

    constructor(config: AgentOptions) {
        const localToolRegistry = createAgentLocalToolRegistry(config.tools || []);
        const includeDefaultModifiers = config.includeDefaultModifiers
            ?? config.defaultProcessors
            ?? true;
        const includeDefaultProcessors = config.includeDefaultProcessors
            ?? config.defaultProcessors
            ?? true;
        const customMessageModifiers = collectProcessors(
            config.processors?.messageModifiers,
            config.messageModifiers,
        );
        const defaultMessageModifiers = includeDefaultModifiers
            ? createDefaultMessageModifiers(
                config.instructions || DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
                config.allowedTools,
            )
            : [];

        this.config = { ...config };
        this.enableLogging = config.enableLogging !== false;
        this.baseSystemPrompt = config.instructions || DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT;
        this.context = config.context;
        this.allowedTools = config.allowedTools;
        this.messageModifiers = mergeProcessors(defaultMessageModifiers, customMessageModifiers);
        this.preInferenceProcessors = mergeProcessors(
            includeDefaultProcessors ? createDefaultPreInferenceProcessors() : [],
            collectProcessors(config.processors?.preInferenceProcessors, config.preInferenceProcessors),
        );
        this.postInferenceProcessors = mergeProcessors(
            includeDefaultProcessors ? createDefaultPostInferenceProcessors() : [],
            collectProcessors(config.processors?.postInferenceProcessors, config.postInferenceProcessors),
        );
        this.preToolCallProcessors = mergeProcessors(
            includeDefaultProcessors ? createDefaultPreToolCallProcessors() : [],
            collectProcessors(config.processors?.preToolCallProcessors, config.preToolCallProcessors),
        );
        this.postToolCallProcessors = mergeProcessors(
            includeDefaultProcessors ? createDefaultPostToolCallProcessors() : [],
            collectProcessors(config.processors?.postToolCallProcessors, config.postToolCallProcessors),
        );
        this.compactionOrchestrator = new CompactionOrchestrator(config.compaction);
        this.loopDetectionService = config.loopDetectionService;
        this.maxTurns = config.maxTurns ?? config.maxIterations ?? 25;
        this.localToolSchemas = localToolRegistry.schemas;
        this.localToolsByExecutionName = localToolRegistry.byExecutionName;
    }

    public async run(
        message: string | FlatUserMessage,
        options?: ProcessedMessage | AgentRunOptions,
    ): Promise<AgentRunResult> {
        try {
            const reqMessage: FlatUserMessage = typeof message === 'string'
                ? createDefaultUserMessage(message)
                : message;

            let prompt: ProcessedMessage;
            const contextToUse = this.resolveRunContext(options);

            if (contextToUse) {
                prompt = contextToUse;
            } else {
                const promptGenerator = new InitialPromptGenerator({
                    processors: this.messageModifiers,
                    baseSystemPrompt: this.baseSystemPrompt,
                    enableLogging: this.enableLogging
                });
                prompt = await promptGenerator.processMessage(reqMessage);
            }

            let completed = false;
            let turnNumber = 0;
            let finalMessage: string | undefined;
            const toolResults: ToolResult[] = [];

            while (!completed) {
                turnNumber += 1;
                if (turnNumber > this.maxTurns) {
                    throw new Error(`Agent exceeded the maximum turn limit of ${this.maxTurns}.`);
                }

                this.compactionOrchestrator.resetForTurn();
                prompt = await this.applyCompaction(prompt);
                prompt = await this.refreshAvailableTools(reqMessage, prompt);

                const agentStep = new AgentStep({
                    preInferenceProcessors: this.preInferenceProcessors,
                    postInferenceProcessors: this.postInferenceProcessors
                });

                let stepResult: AgentStepOutput | undefined;
                while (!stepResult) {
                    try {
                        const nextStepResult = await agentStep.executeStep(reqMessage, prompt);
                        this.compactionOrchestrator.updateModelTokenLimit(
                            nextStepResult.rawLLMResponse?.tokenLimit,
                        );
                        const recoverableResponseError = this.getRecoverableResponseError(
                            nextStepResult.rawLLMResponse,
                        );

                        if (!recoverableResponseError) {
                            stepResult = nextStepResult;
                            break;
                        }

                        const recoveredPrompt = await this.tryRecoverPrompt(
                            prompt,
                            new Error(recoverableResponseError),
                        );
                        if (!recoveredPrompt) {
                            throw new Error(recoverableResponseError);
                        }

                        prompt = recoveredPrompt;
                    } catch (error) {
                        const recoveredPrompt = await this.tryRecoverPrompt(prompt, error);
                        if (!recoveredPrompt) {
                            throw error;
                        }

                        prompt = recoveredPrompt;
                    }
                }

                if (!stepResult) {
                    throw new Error('Agent step did not produce a response.');
                }

                const responseExecutor = new ResponseExecutor({
                    preToolCallProcessors: this.preToolCallProcessors,
                    postToolCallProcessors: this.postToolCallProcessors,
                    localToolsByExecutionName: this.localToolsByExecutionName,
                    ...(this.loopDetectionService
                        ? { loopDetectionService: this.loopDetectionService }
                        : {}),
                });

                const executionResult = await responseExecutor.executeResponse({
                    initialUserMessage: reqMessage,
                    actualMessageSentToLLM: stepResult.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMOutput: stepResult.rawLLMResponse,
                    nextMessage: stepResult.nextMessage
                });

                completed = executionResult.completed;
                prompt = executionResult.nextMessage;
                finalMessage = executionResult.finalMessage;
                toolResults.push(...(executionResult.toolResults ?? []));
            }

            const state: AgentRunState = { prompt };

            return {
                success: true,
                state,
                toolResults,
                ...(finalMessage !== undefined ? { finalMessage } : {}),
                result: prompt,
                context: prompt,
            };

        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';

            if (this.enableLogging) {
                console.error('[Agent] Execution failed:', error);

type ProcessorWithIdentity = {
    id?: unknown;
    name?: unknown;
    constructor?: {
        name?: string;
    };
};

const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = 'Based on User Message send reply';

function getProcessorKey(processor: unknown): string {
    const candidate = processor as ProcessorWithIdentity;
    if (typeof candidate.id === 'string' && candidate.id.length > 0) {
        return candidate.id;
    }

    if (typeof candidate.name === 'string' && candidate.name.length > 0) {
        return candidate.name;
    }

    if (candidate.constructor?.name) {
        return candidate.constructor.name;
    }

    return String(processor);
}

function mergeProcessors<T>(defaults: T[], custom: T[]): T[] {
    const merged = new Map<string, T>();

    for (const processor of defaults) {
        merged.set(getProcessorKey(processor), processor);
    }

    for (const processor of custom) {
        merged.set(getProcessorKey(processor), processor);
    }

    return Array.from(merged.values());
}

function createDefaultMessageModifiers(systemPrompt: string, allowedTools?: string[]): MessageModifier[] {
    return [
        new ChatHistoryMessageModifier({
            enableChatHistory: true,
            includeSystemMessages: false,
        }),
        new EnvironmentContextModifier({ enableFullContext: true }),
        new DirectoryContextModifier(),
        new IdeContextModifier({
            includeActiveFile: true,
            includeOpenFiles: true,
            includeCursorPosition: true,
            includeSelectedText: true
        }),
        new CoreSystemPromptModifier({ customSystemPrompt: systemPrompt }),
        new ToolInjectionModifier({
            includeToolDescriptions: true,
            ...(allowedTools ? { allowedTools } : {})
        }),
        new AtFileProcessorModifier({ enableRecursiveSearch: true })
    ];
}

function createDefaultPreInferenceProcessors(): PreInferenceProcessor[] {
    return [];

function createDefaultPostInferenceProcessors(): PostInferenceProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultPreToolCallProcessors(): PreToolCallProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultPostToolCallProcessors(): PostToolCallProcessor[] {
    return [];
}

function createDefaultUserMessage(message: string): FlatUserMessage {
    const timestamp = Date.now();

    return {

        mentionedAgents: [],
        mentionedEnvironments: [],

    };
}

function collectProcessors<T>(
    fromNested: T[] | undefined,
    fromTopLevel: T[] | undefined,
): T[] {
    return [

}

+                JSON.stringify(unresolvedTasks, null, 2),
+                '</pending_async_tasks>',
+            ].join('\n');
+        } catch (error) {

+let cleanupSweeperStarted = false;
+
+function startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper(): void {
+    if (cleanupSweeperStarted) {
+        return;
+    }
+    cleanupSweeperStarted = true;
+
+    setInterval(() => {
+        const now = Date.now();
+        const expiredTasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
+            scope: 'all',
+            includeCompleted: false,
+        }).filter(task =>
+            task.ownership === 'awaiting_decision' &&
+            typeof task.metadata?.defaultCleanupAt === 'string' &&
+            Date.parse(task.metadata.defaultCleanupAt) <= now,
+        );
+
+        for (const task of expiredTasks) {
+            if (task.type === 'command') {
+                void stopCommandTask(task);
+            } else if (task.type === 'thread') {
+                void stopThreadTask(task);
+            }
+        }
+    }, AWAITING_DECISION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS).unref?.();
+}
+
+startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper();

+const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletionWithTimeout = async (
+    threadId: string,
+    timeoutMs = 30 * 1000,
+): Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }> => {
+    const boundedTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(timeoutMs, 5 * 60 * 1000));
+    if (boundedTimeoutMs === 0) {
+        return {
+            completed: false,
+            completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
+            error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,
+        };

+            completed: true,

<message role="assistant" ordinal="254" timestamp="2026-07-06T13:11:35.985Z">
Implemented a generic async task lifecycle across server, SDK, and agent loop.

Main work done:
- Added server async task registry/service for `command:&lt;pid&gt;` and `thread:&lt;threadId&gt;`.
- Added SDK API:
  - `codebolt.asyncTask.listTasks(...)`
  - `codebolt.asyncTask.controlTask(...)`
- Added LLM tools:
  - `async_task_list`
  - `async_task_control`
- Commands now register as async tasks when they keep running.
- Child/background threads now register as async tasks and update on completion.
- `thread_wait_for_completion` is now bounded via async task control instead of waiting forever.
- Agent completion now checks unresolved async tasks and forces the model to `wait`, `stop`, or `detach`.
- On user stop, tasks are frozen as `awaiting_decision` instead of being killed immediately.
- Next agent run gets pending async task context injected.
- Added TTL cleanup for forgotten `awaiting_decision` tasks.
- Fixed duplicate `threadCompletion` event injection.
- Fixed child thread target-agent overwrite bug.

Validation:
- `npm run build --workspace=packages/server` passes.
- SDK/agent/server typechecks still fail because of existing unrelated repo type drift, not the async task changes.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="259" timestamp="2026-07-06T13:14:18.619Z">
The two bugs were separate but both affected background child threads.

**1. Duplicate `threadCompletion` injection**

In [agentEventQueue.ts](D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/sdks/codeboltjs/src/modules/agentEventQueue.ts:110), a queued `threadCompletion` event was being converted into a friendly `backgroundAgentCompletion` event.

But before the fix, the same raw queue event was also pushed as a generic `agentQueueEvent`.

So the agent could see the same child-thread completion twice:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
Background agent completed: {...}
]]></code_block>
and also:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
<agent_event>
  {"type":"custom","eventName":"threadCompletion",...}
</agent_event>
]]></code_block>
That could make the LLM think two events happened, duplicate summaries, or process the same child result twice.

The fix added `pushedTypedExternalEvent`; when a `threadCompletion` is converted to `backgroundAgentCompletion`, it no longer also gets pushed as a generic queue event.

**2. Child thread target-agent overwrite bug**

In [thread-service.cli.ts](D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/cliLib/thread/thread-service.cli.ts:839), when handling `createAndStartThread`, the server stores caller context:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
messageParams.callerAgentId = finalMessage.agentId;
messageParams.callerThreadId = finalMessage.threadId;
]]></code_block>
That is correct: it tells the child thread who started it.

But previously the code also did this:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
messageParams.agentId = finalMessage.agentId;
]]></code_block>
That was wrong because `agentId` is supposed to mean the **target child agent to start**, while `callerAgentId` means the **parent/current agent**.

So if parent agent A asked to start child agent B, the server could overwrite B with A. Result: the child thread might start with the wrong agent, often the same parent agent again.

The fix keeps these separate:

- `callerAgentId = finalMessage.agentId`
- `agentId = selectedAgent/explicit target agent only if not already provided`

So parent identity and child target identity no longer collide.
</message>

const handleProcessStopped = async (finalMessage: cliSocketMessage) => {
    // if (!uiSocketConnection) return;

    const threadId = finalMessage.threadId;

    // Get thread info from database FIRST to determine if this is a main or sub thread
    // This is important because finalMessage.parentId might not be set correctly
    // even though the thread has a parentId in the database
    const threadFromDb = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);

    // Use database parentId to determine thread type, not message parentId
    // This ensures child threads created via createAndStartThread are correctly identified
    const actualParentId = threadFromDb?.parentId || finalMessage?.parentId;
    const isSubThread = actualParentId != null;

    // Update agent execution status to COMPLETED
    if (finalMessage?.agentInstanceId) {
        try {
            agentProcessManager.markCompletionNotified(finalMessage.agentInstanceId);
            agentExecutionManager.updateAgentStatus(
                finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                AgentExecutionStatus.COMPLETED
            );
            logger.info(`Updated agent execution status to COMPLETED: ${finalMessage.agentInstanceId}`);
        } catch (statusError) {
            logger.error(`Failed to update agent execution status: ${statusError.message}`);
        }
    }

    // Freeze owned async tasks when this agent stops. The next agent run can inspect
    // these tasks and choose to wait, stop, or detach them explicitly.
    if (threadId) {
        try {
            const awaitingTasks = asyncTaskRegistry.markAwaitingDecisionForRun(
                threadId,
                finalMessage.agentId,
                finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
            );
            if (awaitingTasks.length > 0) {
                chatManager.addObservabilityEvent({
                    eventId: getMessageId(),
                    eventType: 'THREAD_FINISHED',
                    threadId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,

    const threadId = finalMessage.threadId;

    // Get thread info from database FIRST to determine if this is a main or sub thread
    // This is important because finalMessage.parentId might not be set correctly
    // even though the thread has a parentId in the database
    const threadFromDb = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);

    // Use database parentId to determine thread type, not message parentId
    // This ensures child threads created via createAndStartThread are correctly identified
    const actualParentId = threadFromDb?.parentId || finalMessage?.parentId;
    const isSubThread = actualParentId != null;

    // Update agent execution status to COMPLETED
    if (finalMessage?.agentInstanceId) {
        try {
            agentProcessManager.markCompletionNotified(finalMessage.agentInstanceId);
            agentExecutionManager.updateAgentStatus(
                finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                AgentExecutionStatus.COMPLETED

let cleanupSweeperStarted = false;

function startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper(): void {
    if (cleanupSweeperStarted) {
        return;
    }
    cleanupSweeperStarted = true;

    setInterval(() => {
        const now = Date.now();
        const expiredTasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
            scope: 'all',
            includeCompleted: false,
        }).filter(task =>
            task.ownership === 'awaiting_decision' &&
            typeof task.metadata?.defaultCleanupAt === 'string' &&
            Date.parse(task.metadata.defaultCleanupAt) <= now,
        );

        for (const task of expiredTasks) {
            if (task.type === 'command') {
                void stopCommandTask(task);
            } else if (task.type === 'thread') {
                void stopThreadTask(task);
            }
        }
    }, AWAITING_DECISION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS).unref?.();
}

startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper();

<message role="assistant" ordinal="268" timestamp="2026-07-06T13:41:21.046Z">
Yes. Your concern is correct.

Current behavior after my change is:

- `handleProcessStopped` calls `asyncTaskRegistry.markAwaitingDecisionForRun(...)`.
- That only changes task ownership to `awaiting_decision`.
- It does **not** call `stopCommandProcess(...)`.
- It does **not** call `agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(...)` for child threads anymore.
- The task keeps running until:
  - the next agent explicitly stops it with `async_task_control`, or
  - the TTL sweeper stops it later. Current default is 30 minutes.

So for your example:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
npm run rebuild
]]></code_block>
If it becomes `command:&lt;pid&gt;` and the user force-stops the agent, the rebuild process can continue running in the backend. That is risky and can absolutely cause random behavior.

The bug is in the policy choice, not just code. We treated “user stopped agent” like “pause/freeze agent and decide later.” But in product semantics, a force stop usually means:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
Stop what the agent is doing now.
]]></code_block>
So the safer default should be:

- **Natural agent completion**: exit gate forces wait/stop/detach.
- **User force stop / cancel**: immediately stop non-detached owned async tasks.
- **Explicit pause / freeze / continue-later**: keep tasks as `awaiting_decision`.
- **Detached tasks**: keep running.

So I would change the current implementation. The stop button should kill owned background commands/threads unless the task was already explicitly detached. The “frozen state” should be a separate pause/resume mode, not the default forced stop behavior.
</message>

/**
 * Execute Command Tool - Executes shell commands
 * Wraps the SDK's cbterminal.executeCommand() method
 */

import type {
    ToolInvocation,
    ToolResult,
    ToolCallConfirmationDetails,
    ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails,
} from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind, ToolConfirmationOutcome } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';
import cbchat from '../../modules/chat';
import { isCodeboltCommand, executeCodeboltCommand } from '../pseudo-cli';

/**
 * Parameters for the ExecuteCommand tool
 */
export interface ExecuteCommandToolParams {
    /**
     * One sentence explanation of why this tool is being used
     */
    explanation?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command to execute
     */
    command?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command split into physical shell lines.
     * Prefer this for heredocs and other multiline shell constructs.
     */
    command_lines?: string[];

    /**
     * Whether to return empty string on success (default: false)
     */
    return_empty_on_success?: boolean;

    /**
     * How the command should be managed.
     */
    execution_mode?: 'auto' | 'foreground' | 'background';

    /**
     * Milliseconds to wait in auto/background mode before returning a running process.
     */
    yield_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Optional hard timeout for foreground command execution.
     */
    timeout_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Whether auto mode should keep the process alive after yield.
     */
    background_on_yield?: boolean;
}

class ExecuteCommandToolInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    ExecuteCommandToolParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: ExecuteCommandToolParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    override async shouldConfirmExecute(
        _abortSignal: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<ToolCallConfirmationDetails | false> {
        const command = this.getCommand();

        // Codebolt pseudo-CLI commands don't need confirmation
        if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Extract root command for confirmation
        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {
                // Callback handled by the framework
            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                    backgroundOnYield: this.params.background_on_yield,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is running in the background: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${processId ? `\nAsync Task ID: command:${processId}` : ''}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}\n\nUse async_task_control with action "wait", "stop", or "detach" before completing if this command is still running.`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.SHELL_EXECUTE_ERROR,
                    },
                };
            }

            // Extract output
            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';
            const exitCode = (response as any).exitCode ?? (response as any).code;

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {
                llmContent = `Command executed: ${command}\n\nOutput:\n${output}`;
            } else {
                llmContent = `Command executed successfully: ${command}`;
            }

            if (exitCode !== undefined && exitCode !== 0) {
                llmContent += `\n\nExit code: ${exitCode}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: output ? this.truncateOutput(output) : 'Command executed successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error executing command: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

    private getCommand(): string {
]]></tool_result>

import logger from '../utils/appLogger';

export type AsyncTaskType = 'thread' | 'command' | 'action_block' | 'remote_job';
export type AsyncTaskStatus = 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped' | 'detached';
export type AsyncTaskOwnership = 'owned' | 'awaiting_decision' | 'detached';
export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';

export interface AsyncTaskRecord {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    status: AsyncTaskStatus;
    ownership: AsyncTaskOwnership;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    startedAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    endedAt?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface AsyncTaskListInput {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

export interface AsyncTaskRegisterInput {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

type AsyncTaskWaiter = {
    resolve: (record: AsyncTaskRecord) => void;
    timeoutId?: NodeJS.Timeout;
};

const FINAL_STATUSES = new Set<AsyncTaskStatus>(['completed', 'failed', 'stopped']);
const MAX_TASKS = 500;
const DEFAULT_AWAITING_DECISION_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

function nowIso(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
}

class AsyncTaskRegistry {
    private readonly tasks = new Map<string, AsyncTaskRecord>();
    private readonly waiters = new Map<string, AsyncTaskWaiter[]>();

    registerTask(input: AsyncTaskRegisterInput): AsyncTaskRecord {
        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const existing = this.tasks.get(input.taskId);
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...(existing || {}),
            taskId: input.taskId,
            type: input.type,
            status: existing?.status === 'detached' ? 'detached' : 'running',
            ownership: existing?.ownership || 'owned',
            ownerThreadId: input.ownerThreadId || existing?.ownerThreadId,
            ownerAgentId: input.ownerAgentId || existing?.ownerAgentId,
            ownerAgentInstanceId: input.ownerAgentInstanceId || existing?.ownerAgentInstanceId,
            startedAt: existing?.startedAt || timestamp,
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            title: input.title || existing?.title,
            summary: input.summary || existing?.summary,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing?.metadata || {}),
                ...(input.metadata || {}),
            },
        };

        this.tasks.set(input.taskId, record);
        this.prune();
        return { ...record };
    }

    updateTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial<AsyncTaskRecord>): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return undefined;
        }

        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const status = updates.status || existing.status;
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...existing,
            ...updates,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing.metadata || {}),
                ...(updates.metadata || {}),
            },
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            endedAt: FINAL_STATUSES.has(status) ? updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt || timestamp : updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt,
        };

        this.tasks.set(taskId, record);
        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
            this.resolveWaiters(record);
        }
        return { ...record };
    }

    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        return record ? { ...record } : undefined;
    }

    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';
        return Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => input.includeCompleted || !FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .filter(task => {
                if (scope === 'all') {
                    return true;
                }
                if (scope === 'current_run') {
                    return Boolean(
                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&
                        (!input.agentId || task.ownerAgentId === input.agentId) &&
                        (!input.agentInstanceId || task.ownerAgentInstanceId === input.agentInstanceId),
                    );
                }
                return !input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId;
            })
            .sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt.localeCompare(left.updatedAt))
            .map(task => ({ ...task }));
    }

    markAwaitingDecisionForRun(ownerThreadId?: string, ownerAgentId?: string, ownerAgentInstanceId?: string): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const updatedTasks: AsyncTaskRecord[] = [];
        for (const task of this.tasks.values()) {
            if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status) || task.ownership === 'detached') {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerThreadId && task.ownerThreadId !== ownerThreadId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentId && task.ownerAgentId !== ownerAgentId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentInstanceId && task.ownerAgentInstanceId !== ownerAgentInstanceId) {
                continue;
            }

            const updated = this.updateTask(task.taskId, {
                ownership: 'awaiting_decision',
                summary: task.summary || 'Task is still running after the owning agent stopped.',
                metadata: {
                    defaultCleanupAt: new Date(Date.now() + DEFAULT_AWAITING_DECISION_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
                },
            });
            if (updated) {
                updatedTasks.push(updated);
            }
        }
        return updatedTasks;
    }

    detachTask(taskId: string, reason?: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        return this.updateTask(taskId, {
            ownership: 'detached',
            status: 'detached',
            summary: reason || 'Task detached from the owning agent run.',
        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),
            };

            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
                this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters.filter(existingWaiter => existingWaiter !== waiter));
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    task: this.getTask(taskId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for task ${taskId}`,
                });
            }, timeoutMs);

            const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
            waiters.push(waiter);
            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
        });
    }

    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
        if (!waiters?.length) {
            return;
        }

        this.waiters.delete(record.taskId);
        for (const waiter of waiters) {
            if (waiter.timeoutId) {
                clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
            }
            waiter.resolve(record);
        }
    }

    private prune(): void {
        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
            return;
        }

        const completedTasks = Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .sort((left, right) => left.updatedAt.localeCompare(right.updatedAt));
]]></tool_result>

    registerTask(input: AsyncTaskRegisterInput): AsyncTaskRecord {
        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const existing = this.tasks.get(input.taskId);
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...(existing || {}),
            taskId: input.taskId,
            type: input.type,
            status: existing?.status === 'detached' ? 'detached' : 'running',
            ownership: existing?.ownership || 'owned',
            ownerThreadId: input.ownerThreadId || existing?.ownerThreadId,
            ownerAgentId: input.ownerAgentId || existing?.ownerAgentId,
            ownerAgentInstanceId: input.ownerAgentInstanceId || existing?.ownerAgentInstanceId,
            startedAt: existing?.startedAt || timestamp,
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            title: input.title || existing?.title,
            summary: input.summary || existing?.summary,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing?.metadata || {}),
                ...(input.metadata || {}),
            },
        };

        this.tasks.set(input.taskId, record);
        this.prune();
        return { ...record };
    }

    updateTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial<AsyncTaskRecord>): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return undefined;
        }

        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const status = updates.status || existing.status;
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...existing,
            ...updates,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing.metadata || {}),
                ...(updates.metadata || {}),
            },
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            endedAt: FINAL_STATUSES.has(status) ? updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt || timestamp : updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt,
        };

        this.tasks.set(taskId, record);
        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
            this.resolveWaiters(record);
        }
        return { ...record };
    }

    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        return record ? { ...record } : undefined;
    }

    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';
        return Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => input.includeCompleted || !FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .filter(task => {
                if (scope === 'all') {
                    return true;
                }
                if (scope === 'current_run') {
                    return Boolean(
                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&
                        (!input.agentId || task.ownerAgentId === input.agentId) &&
                        (!input.agentInstanceId || task.ownerAgentInstanceId === input.agentInstanceId),
                    );
                }
                return !input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId;
            })
            .sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt.localeCompare(left.updatedAt))
            .map(task => ({ ...task }));
    }

    markAwaitingDecisionForRun(ownerThreadId?: string, ownerAgentId?: string, ownerAgentInstanceId?: string): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const updatedTasks: AsyncTaskRecord[] = [];
        for (const task of this.tasks.values()) {
            if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status) || task.ownership === 'detached') {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerThreadId && task.ownerThreadId !== ownerThreadId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentId && task.ownerAgentId !== ownerAgentId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentInstanceId && task.ownerAgentInstanceId !== ownerAgentInstanceId) {
                continue;
            }

            const updated = this.updateTask(task.taskId, {
                ownership: 'awaiting_decision',
                summary: task.summary || 'Task is still running after the owning agent stopped.',
                metadata: {
                    defaultCleanupAt: new Date(Date.now() + DEFAULT_AWAITING_DECISION_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
                },
            });
            if (updated) {
                updatedTasks.push(updated);
            }
        }
        return updatedTasks;
    }

    detachTask(taskId: string, reason?: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        return this.updateTask(taskId, {
            ownership: 'detached',
            status: 'detached',
            summary: reason || 'Task detached from the owning agent run.',
        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),

                    task: this.getTask(taskId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for task ${taskId}`,

            waiters.push(waiter);
            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
        });
    }

    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
        if (!waiters?.length) {

            if (waiter.timeoutId) {
                clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
            }
            waiter.resolve(record);
        }
    }

        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {

<message role="assistant" ordinal="275" timestamp="2026-07-06T14:05:31.846Z">
Yes, your model makes sense, but I would slightly rename/split it.

The key fix: **do not mix “how the command is executed” with “who owns its lifetime.”**

Right now we partly mix them. `detached` is treated almost like a status, but it should be a **lifetime policy**. A detached process is still `running`; it is just allowed to survive agent stop/completion.

I would model it like this:

**1. Execution Mode**
How the tool call behaves immediately.
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
executionMode:
  | "foreground"   // block until done or timeout
  | "auto"         // wait briefly, then yield as async if still running
  | "background"   // return task id quickly
]]></code_block>
This maps to what you called:

- `sync` -&gt; `foreground`
- `syncunclear` -&gt; `auto`
- `async` -&gt; `background`

**2. Lifetime Policy**
What happens when the agent stops or completes.
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
lifetime:
  | "run_scoped"   // owned by current agent run; kill on user stop
  | "detached"     // intentionally survives user stop/completion
]]></code_block>
I would avoid a third lifetime called `background` because it overlaps with both `async` and `detached`. Instead:

- **async** means “not finished yet, task id returned.”
- **detached** means “allowed to survive agent lifecycle.”
- **background** can be UI wording: “detached background process.”

So the examples become:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
ls
executionMode: foreground
lifetime: run_scoped
]]></code_block>
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
cp large-folder
executionMode: auto
lifetime: run_scoped
]]></code_block>
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
npm run build
executionMode: auto
lifetime: run_scoped
]]></code_block>
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
npm run dev
executionMode: background
lifetime: detached
]]></code_block>
Or, if the LLM initially starts `npm run dev` as auto/background but not detached, the exit gate should force:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
This command is still running. Stop it or detach it before completing.
]]></code_block>
**Manual User Stop Policy**

This should be strict:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
On user force stop:
- kill all running run_scoped tasks
- keep only detached tasks
- record what was killed and what survived
]]></code_block>
So `npm run rebuild` will be stopped. `npm run dev` survives only if it was explicitly detached.

**Natural Agent Completion Policy**

When the agent finishes on its own:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
- run_scoped async tasks must be resolved
  - wait
  - stop
  - or promote to detached
- detached tasks do not block completion
  - but the agent should mention them or they should be injected next turn
]]></code_block>
**Child Threads**

Child threads can be both:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
thread lifetime:
  | "run_scoped"
  | "detached"
]]></code_block>
Default depends on intent:

- If parent starts child thread to do part of the current task: `run_scoped`
- If parent delegates independent long-running work: `detached`

So yes, child threads should support async/run-scoped too. Otherwise every child thread survives stop, which has the same panic-stop problem.

**What We Should Change From Current Implementation**

Current implementation:
- `awaiting_decision` on user stop
- task keeps running
- TTL kills later

I think we should replace that default with:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
user stop -> stop run_scoped tasks immediately
]]></code_block>
Keep `awaiting_decision` only for a true pause/freeze feature, not for force stop.

Also change the registry shape from current:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
status: "running" | "completed" | "failed" | "stopped" | "detached"
ownership: "owned" | "awaiting_decision" | "detached"
]]></code_block>
to cleaner:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[

import logger from '../utils/appLogger';

export type AsyncTaskType = 'thread' | 'command' | 'action_block' | 'remote_job';
export type AsyncTaskStatus = 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped' | 'detached';
export type AsyncTaskOwnership = 'owned' | 'awaiting_decision' | 'detached';
export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';

export interface AsyncTaskRecord {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    status: AsyncTaskStatus;
    ownership: AsyncTaskOwnership;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    startedAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    endedAt?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface AsyncTaskListInput {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

export interface AsyncTaskRegisterInput {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

type AsyncTaskWaiter = {
    resolve: (record: AsyncTaskRecord) => void;
    timeoutId?: NodeJS.Timeout;
};

const FINAL_STATUSES = new Set<AsyncTaskStatus>(['completed', 'failed', 'stopped']);
const MAX_TASKS = 500;
const DEFAULT_AWAITING_DECISION_TTL_MS = 30 * 60 * 1000;

function nowIso(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
}

class AsyncTaskRegistry {
    private readonly tasks = new Map<string, AsyncTaskRecord>();
    private readonly waiters = new Map<string, AsyncTaskWaiter[]>();

    registerTask(input: AsyncTaskRegisterInput): AsyncTaskRecord {
        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const existing = this.tasks.get(input.taskId);
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...(existing || {}),
            taskId: input.taskId,
            type: input.type,
            status: existing?.status === 'detached' ? 'detached' : 'running',
            ownership: existing?.ownership || 'owned',
            ownerThreadId: input.ownerThreadId || existing?.ownerThreadId,
            ownerAgentId: input.ownerAgentId || existing?.ownerAgentId,
            ownerAgentInstanceId: input.ownerAgentInstanceId || existing?.ownerAgentInstanceId,
            startedAt: existing?.startedAt || timestamp,
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            title: input.title || existing?.title,
            summary: input.summary || existing?.summary,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing?.metadata || {}),
                ...(input.metadata || {}),
            },
        };

        this.tasks.set(input.taskId, record);
        this.prune();
        return { ...record };
    }

    updateTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial<AsyncTaskRecord>): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return undefined;
        }

        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const status = updates.status || existing.status;
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...existing,
            ...updates,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing.metadata || {}),
                ...(updates.metadata || {}),
            },
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            endedAt: FINAL_STATUSES.has(status) ? updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt || timestamp : updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt,
        };

        this.tasks.set(taskId, record);
        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
            this.resolveWaiters(record);
        }
        return { ...record };
    }

    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        return record ? { ...record } : undefined;
    }

    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';
        return Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => input.includeCompleted || !FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .filter(task => {
                if (scope === 'all') {
                    return true;
                }
                if (scope === 'current_run') {
                    return Boolean(
                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&
                        (!input.agentId || task.ownerAgentId === input.agentId) &&
                        (!input.agentInstanceId || task.ownerAgentInstanceId === input.agentInstanceId),
                    );
                }
                return !input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId;
            })
            .sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt.localeCompare(left.updatedAt))
            .map(task => ({ ...task }));
    }

    markAwaitingDecisionForRun(ownerThreadId?: string, ownerAgentId?: string, ownerAgentInstanceId?: string): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const updatedTasks: AsyncTaskRecord[] = [];
        for (const task of this.tasks.values()) {
            if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status) || task.ownership === 'detached') {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerThreadId && task.ownerThreadId !== ownerThreadId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentId && task.ownerAgentId !== ownerAgentId) {
                continue;
            }
            if (ownerAgentInstanceId && task.ownerAgentInstanceId !== ownerAgentInstanceId) {
                continue;
            }

            const updated = this.updateTask(task.taskId, {
                ownership: 'awaiting_decision',
                summary: task.summary || 'Task is still running after the owning agent stopped.',
                metadata: {
                    defaultCleanupAt: new Date(Date.now() + DEFAULT_AWAITING_DECISION_TTL_MS).toISOString(),
                },
            });
            if (updated) {
                updatedTasks.push(updated);
            }
        }
        return updatedTasks;
    }

    detachTask(taskId: string, reason?: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        return this.updateTask(taskId, {
            ownership: 'detached',
            status: 'detached',
            summary: reason || 'Task detached from the owning agent run.',
        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),
            };

            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
                this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters.filter(existingWaiter => existingWaiter !== waiter));
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    task: this.getTask(taskId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for task ${taskId}`,
                });
            }, timeoutMs);

            const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
            waiters.push(waiter);
            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
        });
    }

    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
        if (!waiters?.length) {
            return;
        }

        this.waiters.delete(record.taskId);
        for (const waiter of waiters) {
            if (waiter.timeoutId) {
                clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
            }
            waiter.resolve(record);
        }
    }

    private prune(): void {
        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
            return;
        }

        const completedTasks = Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .sort((left, right) => left.updatedAt.localeCompare(right.updatedAt));

        for (const task of completedTasks) {
            if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
                return;
            }
            this.tasks.delete(task.taskId);
            logger.debug(`[AsyncTaskRegistry] Pruned task ${task.taskId}`);
        }
    }
}

export const asyncTaskRegistry = new AsyncTaskRegistry();
export { FINAL_STATUSES as FINAL_ASYNC_TASK_STATUSES };
]]></tool_result>

import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import { threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { stopCommandProcess, waitCommandProcess, readCommandProcessOutput } from '../sockets/aiTerminal';
import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskRecord, AsyncTaskScope } from './asyncTaskRegistry.cli';

const DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 1000;
const MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const AWAITING_DECISION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 60 * 1000;

type AsyncTaskAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

function normalizeTimeoutMs(value: unknown): number {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        return DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    }
    return Math.min(Math.floor(value), MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

function inferTaskParts(taskId: string): { type?: string; resourceId?: string } {
    const separatorIndex = taskId.indexOf(':');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return {};
    }
    return {
        type: taskId.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        resourceId: taskId.slice(separatorIndex + 1),
    };
}

function formatResponse(type: string, success: boolean, data: Record<string, any>, error?: string) {
    return {
        type,
        success,
        ...data,
        error,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
}

async function stopThreadTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const threadId = task.metadata?.threadId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId;
    if (!threadId) {
        return { success: false, error: `Cannot infer thread id for task ${task.taskId}` };
    }

    const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(threadId, false);
    await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        ownership: task.ownership === 'detached' ? 'detached' : task.ownership,
        summary: `Stopped thread task ${threadId}`,
        metadata: { stoppedCount },
    });

    return { success: true, stoppedCount };
}

async function stopCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = stopCommandProcess(processId);
    if (!result.success) {
        return result;
    }

    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped command process ${processId}`,
    });
    return result;
}

async function waitCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord, timeoutMs: number) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = await waitCommandProcess(processId, { timeoutMs });

    if (result.process) {
        const status = result.process.status === 'done'
            ? 'completed'
            : result.process.status === 'failed'
                ? 'failed'
                : result.process.status === 'stopped'
                    ? 'stopped'
                    : task.status;
        asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
            status,
            summary: result.error || task.summary,
            metadata: { commandRecord: result.process },
        });
    }

    const output = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, { lines: 80, tailBytes: 64 * 1024 });
    return {
        completed: result.success,
        task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(task.taskId),
        output: output.output,
        error: result.error,
    };
}

export const asyncTaskServiceCLI = {
    listTasks(params: any, finalMessage: any) {
        const scope = (params?.scope || 'thread') as AsyncTaskScope;
        const tasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
            scope,
            threadId: params?.threadId || params?.thread_id || finalMessage?.threadId,
            agentId: params?.agentId || params?.agent_id || finalMessage?.agentId,
            agentInstanceId: params?.agentInstanceId || params?.agent_instance_id || finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
            includeCompleted: params?.includeCompleted ?? params?.include_completed,
        });

        return formatResponse('asyncTask.listResponse', true, {
            tasks,
            output: JSON.stringify(tasks, null, 2),
        });
    },

    async controlTask(params: any, _finalMessage: any) {
        const taskId = params?.taskId || params?.task_id;
        const action = params?.action as AsyncTaskAction;
        if (!taskId || typeof taskId !== 'string') {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId: taskId || '' }, 'Missing required parameter: taskId');
        }
        if (!['wait', 'stop', 'detach'].includes(action)) {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId }, 'Invalid action. Expected wait, stop, or detach.');
        }

        const task = asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(taskId);
        if (!task) {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId }, `Task ${taskId} not found`);
        }

        if (action === 'detach') {
            const detached = asyncTaskRegistry.detachTask(taskId, params?.reason);
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', true, {
                taskId,
                action,
                task: detached,
                output: JSON.stringify(detached, null, 2),
            });
        }

        if (action === 'stop') {
            const result = task.type === 'command'
                ? await stopCommandTask(task)
                : task.type === 'thread'
                    ? await stopThreadTask(task)
                    : { success: false, error: `Stop is not implemented for task type ${task.type}` };

            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', Boolean(result.success), {
                taskId,
                action,
                task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(taskId),
                result,
                output: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2),
            }, result.success ? undefined : result.error);
        }

        const timeoutMs = normalizeTimeoutMs(params?.timeoutMs ?? params?.timeout_ms);
        const waitResult: any = task.type === 'command'
            ? await waitCommandTask(task, timeoutMs)
            : await asyncTaskRegistry.waitForTask(taskId, timeoutMs);

        return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', true, {
            taskId,
            action,
            completed: waitResult.completed,
            task: waitResult.task,
            output: waitResult.output || JSON.stringify(waitResult.task, null, 2),
            waitTimedOut: !waitResult.completed,
        }, waitResult.completed ? undefined : waitResult.error);
    },

    async handleAsyncTaskOperation(operation: string, params: any, finalMessage: any) {
        const action = operation.replace(/^asyncTask\./, '');
        if (action === 'list' || action === 'listTasks') {
            return this.listTasks(params, finalMessage);
        }
        if (action === 'control' || action === 'controlTask') {
            return this.controlTask(params, finalMessage);

import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import { threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { stopCommandProcess, waitCommandProcess, readCommandProcessOutput } from '../sockets/aiTerminal';
import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskRecord, AsyncTaskScope } from './asyncTaskRegistry.cli';

const DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 1000;
const MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const AWAITING_DECISION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 60 * 1000;

type AsyncTaskAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

function normalizeTimeoutMs(value: unknown): number {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        return DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    }
    return Math.min(Math.floor(value), MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

function inferTaskParts(taskId: string): { type?: string; resourceId?: string } {
    const separatorIndex = taskId.indexOf(':');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return {};
    }
    return {
        type: taskId.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        resourceId: taskId.slice(separatorIndex + 1),
    };
}

function formatResponse(type: string, success: boolean, data: Record<string, any>, error?: string) {
    return {
        type,
        success,
        ...data,
        error,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
}

async function stopThreadTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const threadId = task.metadata?.threadId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId;
    if (!threadId) {
        return { success: false, error: `Cannot infer thread id for task ${task.taskId}` };
    }

    const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(threadId, false);
    await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        ownership: task.ownership === 'detached' ? 'detached' : task.ownership,
        summary: `Stopped thread task ${threadId}`,
        metadata: { stoppedCount },
    });

    return { success: true, stoppedCount };
}

async function stopCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = stopCommandProcess(processId);
    if (!result.success) {
        return result;
    }

    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped command process ${processId}`,
    });
    return result;
}

async function waitCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord, timeoutMs: number) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = await waitCommandProcess(processId, { timeoutMs });

    if (result.process) {
        const status = result.process.status === 'done'
            ? 'completed'
            : result.process.status === 'failed'
                ? 'failed'
                : result.process.status === 'stopped'
                    ? 'stopped'
                    : task.status;
        asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
            status,
            summary: result.error || task.summary,
            metadata: { commandRecord: result.process },
        });
    }

    const output = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, { lines: 80, tailBytes: 64 * 1024 });
    return {
        completed: result.success,
        task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(task.taskId),
        output: output.output,
        error: result.error,
    };
}

export const asyncTaskServiceCLI = {
    listTasks(params: any, finalMessage: any) {
        const scope = (params?.scope || 'thread') as AsyncTaskScope;
        const tasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
            scope,
            threadId: params?.threadId || params?.thread_id || finalMessage?.threadId,
            agentId: params?.agentId || params?.agent_id || finalMessage?.agentId,
            agentInstanceId: params?.agentInstanceId || params?.agent_instance_id || finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
            includeCompleted: params?.includeCompleted ?? params?.include_completed,
        });

        return formatResponse('asyncTask.listResponse', true, {
            tasks,
            output: JSON.stringify(tasks, null, 2),
        });
    },

    async controlTask(params: any, _finalMessage: any) {
        const taskId = params?.taskId || params?.task_id;
        const action = params?.action as AsyncTaskAction;
        if (!taskId || typeof taskId !== 'string') {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId: taskId || '' }, 'Missing required parameter: taskId');
        }
        if (!['wait', 'stop', 'detach'].includes(action)) {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId }, 'Invalid action. Expected wait, stop, or detach.');
        }

        const task = asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(taskId);
        if (!task) {
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', false, { taskId }, `Task ${taskId} not found`);
        }

        if (action === 'detach') {
            const detached = asyncTaskRegistry.detachTask(taskId, params?.reason);
            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', true, {
                taskId,
                action,
                task: detached,
                output: JSON.stringify(detached, null, 2),
            });
        }

        if (action === 'stop') {
            const result = task.type === 'command'
                ? await stopCommandTask(task)
                : task.type === 'thread'
                    ? await stopThreadTask(task)
                    : { success: false, error: `Stop is not implemented for task type ${task.type}` };

            return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', Boolean(result.success), {
                taskId,
                action,
                task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(taskId),
                result,
                output: JSON.stringify(result, null, 2),
            }, result.success ? undefined : result.error);
        }

        const timeoutMs = normalizeTimeoutMs(params?.timeoutMs ?? params?.timeout_ms);
        const waitResult: any = task.type === 'command'
            ? await waitCommandTask(task, timeoutMs)
            : await asyncTaskRegistry.waitForTask(taskId, timeoutMs);

        return formatResponse('asyncTask.controlResponse', true, {
            taskId,
            action,
            completed: waitResult.completed,
            task: waitResult.task,
            output: waitResult.output || JSON.stringify(waitResult.task, null, 2),
            waitTimedOut: !waitResult.completed,
        }, waitResult.completed ? undefined : waitResult.error);
    },

    async handleAsyncTaskOperation(operation: string, params: any, finalMessage: any) {
        const action = operation.replace(/^asyncTask\./, '');
        if (action === 'list' || action === 'listTasks') {
            return this.listTasks(params, finalMessage);
        }
        if (action === 'control' || action === 'controlTask') {
            return this.controlTask(params, finalMessage);
        }
        return formatResponse('asyncTask.errorResponse', false, {}, `Unknown async task operation: ${operation}`);
    },
};

let cleanupSweeperStarted = false;

function startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper(): void {
    if (cleanupSweeperStarted) {
        return;
    }
    cleanupSweeperStarted = true;

    setInterval(() => {
        const now = Date.now();
        const expiredTasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
            scope: 'all',
            includeCompleted: false,
        }).filter(task =>
            task.ownership === 'awaiting_decision' &&
            typeof task.metadata?.defaultCleanupAt === 'string' &&
            Date.parse(task.metadata.defaultCleanupAt) <= now,
        );

        for (const task of expiredTasks) {
            if (task.type === 'command') {
                void stopCommandTask(task);
            } else if (task.type === 'thread') {
                void stopThreadTask(task);
            }
        }
    }, AWAITING_DECISION_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS).unref?.();
}

startAwaitingDecisionCleanupSweeper();

export async function executeCommandInShell(command: string, terminalId: string | number, finalMessage, notifyUser): Promise<any> {

                .replace(/\x1b\[\?[0-9;]*[a-zA-Z]/g, '')

            stateEvent: 'accepted',
