/**
 * Thread Create Background Tool - Creates a thread in the background
 * Wraps the SDK's threadService.createThreadInBackground() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import threadService from '../../modules/thread';

export interface ThreadCreateBackgroundParams {
    /** Optional group ID for the thread */
    groupId?: string;
    title?: string;
    task?: string;
    description?: string;
    userMessage?: string;
    selectedAgent?: any;
    isGrouped?: boolean;
    /** If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally. */
    remoteEnv?: boolean;
    /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. */
    environmentProvider?: {
        name: string;
        unique_id?: string;
        providerId?: string;
    };
    /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
    environmentName?: string;
}

class ThreadCreateBackgroundInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<ThreadCreateBackgroundParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: ThreadCreateBackgroundParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const optionsWithGroup = {
                title: this.params.title || this.params.task || 'Background Thread',
                description: this.params.description || this.params.task || '',
                userMessage: this.params.task || this.params.userMessage || '',
                selectedAgent: { id: this.params.selectedAgent },
                isGrouped: this.params.isGrouped,
                groupId: this.params.groupId,
                ...(this.params.remoteEnv !== undefined && { remoteEnv: this.params.remoteEnv }),
                ...(this.params.environmentProvider && { environmentProvider: this.params.environmentProvider }),
                ...(this.params.environmentName && { environmentName: this.params.environmentName }),
            };

            const response = await threadService.createThreadInBackground(optionsWithGroup);

            if (response && !response.success && response.success !== undefined) {
                const errorMsg = typeof response.error === 'string'
                    ? response.error
                    : (response.error as any)?.message || 'Thread creation in background failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Thread creation in background failed: ${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMsg}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const resp = response as any;
            let output = 'Created thread in background successfully';
            if (resp.threadId) {
                output += `\n\nThread ID: ${resp.threadId}`;
            }
            if (this.params.groupId) {
                output += `\nGroup ID: ${this.params.groupId}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent: output,
                returnDisplay: 'Thread created in background successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error creating thread in background: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

export class ThreadCreateBackgroundTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<ThreadCreateBackgroundParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name: string = 'thread_create_background';

    constructor() {
        super(
            ThreadCreateBackgroundTool.Name,
            'ThreadCreateBackground',
            'Creates a thread in the background and resolves when the agent starts or fails.',
            Kind.Execute,
            {
                properties: {
                    groupId: {
                        description: 'Optional group ID for organizing threads.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    title: {
                        description: 'Title of the background thread.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    task: {
                        description: 'Task description related to the thread.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    description: {
                        description: 'Description of the thread.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    userMessage: {
                        description: 'The user message to start the thread with.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    selectedAgent: {
                        description: 'The selected agent id get it from <workerAgent> tag ',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    isGrouped: {
                        description: 'Whether the thread belongs to a group',
                        type: 'boolean',
                    },
                    remoteEnv: {
                        description: 'If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally.',
                        type: 'boolean',
                    },
                    environmentProvider: {
                        description: 'The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. Object with name, optional unique_id and providerId.',
                        type: 'object',
                    },
                    environmentName: {
                        description: 'Optional custom name for the remote environment.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                },
                required: ['task', 'selectedAgent'],
                type: 'object',
            },
        );
    }
]]></tool_result>

/**
 * Thread Create Start Tool - Creates and immediately starts a new thread
 * Wraps the SDK's threadService.createAndStartThread() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import threadService from '../../modules/thread';

export interface ThreadCreateStartParams {
    /** Thread creation and start options */
    options?: Record<string, any>;
    /** Task prompt to start the new thread with. */
    task: string;
    /** Optional explicit user message. Defaults to task. */
    userMessage?: string;
    /** Optional title for the new thread. */
    title?: string;
    /** Optional description for the new thread. */
    description?: string;
    /** Optional selected agent id or selected agent object. */
    selectedAgent?: string | Record<string, any>;
    /** Optional agent id. */
    agentId?: string;
    /** Optional group ID for the thread. */
    groupId?: string;
    /** Whether the thread belongs to a group. */
    isGrouped?: boolean;
    /** Existing environment id or environment object to run the thread in. */
    environment?: string | Record<string, any>;
    /** Existing environment id to run the thread in. Alias for environment. */
    environmentId?: string;
    /** If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally. */
    remoteEnv?: boolean;
    /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. */
    environmentProvider?: {
        name: string;
        unique_id?: string;
        providerId?: string;
    };
    /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
    environmentName?: string;
    /** If true, wait for completion before returning. Defaults to false. */
    waitForCompletion?: boolean;
}

class ThreadCreateStartInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<ThreadCreateStartParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: ThreadCreateStartParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const baseOptions = this.params.options || {};
            const environment = this.params.environment !== undefined
                ? this.params.environment
                : this.params.environmentId
                    ? { id: this.params.environmentId }
                    : undefined;
            const selectedAgent = this.params.selectedAgent !== undefined
                ? typeof this.params.selectedAgent === 'string'
                    ? { id: this.params.selectedAgent }
                    : this.params.selectedAgent
                : undefined;
            const userMessage = this.params.userMessage || this.params.task;
            const options = {
                ...baseOptions,
                title: this.params.title || baseOptions.title || this.params.task,
                description: this.params.description || baseOptions.description || this.params.task,
                userMessage,
                ...(selectedAgent !== undefined && { selectedAgent }),
                ...(this.params.agentId && { agentId: this.params.agentId }),
                ...(this.params.groupId && { groupId: this.params.groupId }),
                ...(this.params.isGrouped !== undefined && { isGrouped: this.params.isGrouped }),
                ...(environment !== undefined && { environment }),
                ...(this.params.remoteEnv !== undefined && { remoteEnv: this.params.remoteEnv }),
                ...(this.params.environmentProvider && { environmentProvider: this.params.environmentProvider }),
                ...(this.params.environmentName && { environmentName: this.params.environmentName }),
                ...(this.params.waitForCompletion !== undefined && { waitForCompletion: this.params.waitForCompletion }),
            };
            const response = await threadService.createAndStartThread(options);

            if (response && !response.success && response.success !== undefined) {
                const errorMsg = typeof response.error === 'string'
                    ? response.error
                    : (response.error as any)?.message || 'Thread creation and start failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Thread creation and start failed: ${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMsg}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const resp = response as any;
            let output = resp.async === false ? 'Thread completed successfully' : 'Thread started successfully';
            if (resp.threadId) {
                output += `\n\nThread ID: ${resp.threadId}`;
                output += `\nAsync Task ID: thread:${resp.threadId}`;
            }
            if (resp.targetAgentId) {
                output += `\nTarget Agent ID: ${resp.targetAgentId}`;
            }
            output += `\nTarget Agent Instance ID: ${resp.targetAgentInstanceId || 'not available yet'}`;
            if (resp.activityId) {
                output += `\nActivity ID: ${resp.activityId}`;
            }
            if (resp.status) {
                output += `\nStatus: ${resp.status}`;
            }
            output += `\nCompletion Event: ${resp.completionEvent || 'threadCompletion'}`;
            if (resp.threadId && resp.targetAgentId) {
                output += `\n\nTo send this agent a message, use tool \`eventqueue_send_message\` with targetAgentId="${resp.targetAgentId}", targetThreadId="${resp.threadId}", and content="<message>".`;
            }
            if (resp.threadId && resp.async !== false) {
                output += `\nTo manage this running thread, use tool \`async_task_control\` with taskId="thread:${resp.threadId}" and action "wait", "stop", or "detach".`;
            }
            if (resp.output) {
                output += `\n\nOutput:\n${resp.output}`;
            }
            if (resp.thread) {
                output += `\n\nThread: ${JSON.stringify(resp.thread, null, 2)}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent: output,
                returnDisplay: 'Thread created and started successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error creating and starting thread: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

export class ThreadCreateStartTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<ThreadCreateStartParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name: string = 'thread_create_start';

    constructor() {
        super(
            ThreadCreateStartTool.Name,
            'ThreadCreateStart',
            'Creates and immediately starts a new thread with the specified options.',
            Kind.Execute,
            {
                properties: {
                    options: {
                        description: 'Advanced thread creation and start options. Prefer the top-level task, selectedAgent, environment, and environmentId fields for common use.',
                        type: 'object',
                    },
                    task: {
                        description: 'Task prompt to start the new thread with. This is sent as the thread userMessage.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    userMessage: {
                        description: 'Optional explicit user message to start the thread with. Defaults to task.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    title: {
                        description: 'Optional title of the new thread. Defaults to task.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    description: {
                        description: 'Optional description of the new thread. Defaults to task.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    selectedAgent: {
                        description: 'Optional selected agent id or selected agent object.',
                        anyOf: [
                            { type: 'string' },
                            { type: 'object' },
                        ],
                    },
                    agentId: {
                        description: 'Optional agent id.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    groupId: {
                        description: 'Optional group ID for organizing threads.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    isGrouped: {
                        description: 'Whether the thread belongs to a group.',
                        type: 'boolean',
                    },
                    environment: {
                        description: 'Existing environment id or environment object to run the new thread in. When provided, the thread starts in that environment instead of creating a new one.',
                        anyOf: [
                            { type: 'string' },
                            { type: 'object' },
                        ],
                    },
                    environmentId: {
                        description: 'Existing environment id to run the new thread in. Alias for environment.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    remoteEnv: {
                        description: 'If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally.',
                        type: 'boolean',
                    },
                    environmentProvider: {
                        description: 'The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. Object with name, optional unique_id and providerId.',
                        type: 'object',
                    },
                    environmentName: {
                        description: 'Optional custom name for the remote environment.',
                        type: 'string',
                    },
                    waitForCompletion: {
                        description: 'If true, wait for the thread to complete before returning. Defaults to false.',
                        type: 'boolean',
                    },
                },
                required: ['task'],
                type: 'object',
            },
        );
    }

    protected override validateToolParamValues(params: ThreadCreateStartParams): string | null {
        if (params.options !== undefined && (typeof params.options !== 'object' || params.options === null || Array.isArray(params.options))) {
            return "'options' must be an object when provided";
        }
        if (typeof params.task !== 'string' || !params.task.trim()) {
            return "'task' is required and must be a non-empty string";
        }
        if (params.userMessage !== undefined && (typeof params.userMessage !== 'string' || !params.userMessage.trim())) {
            return "'userMessage' must be a non-empty string when provided";
        }
        if (params.selectedAgent !== undefined && typeof params.selectedAgent !== 'string' && (typeof params.selectedAgent !== 'object' || params.selectedAgent === null || Array.isArray(params.selectedAgent))) {
            return "'selectedAgent' must be a string agent id or selected agent object when provided";
        }
        if (params.environmentId !== undefined && (typeof params.environmentId !== 'string' || !params.environmentId.trim())) {
            return "'environmentId' must be a non-empty string when provided";
        }
        if (
            params.environment !== undefined &&
            typeof params.environment !== 'string' &&
            (typeof params.environment !== 'object' || params.environment === null || Array.isArray(params.environment))
        ) {
            return "'environment' must be a string environment id or an environment object when provided";
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: ThreadCreateStartParams): ToolInvocation<ThreadCreateStartParams, ToolResult> {
        return new ThreadCreateStartInvocation(params);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

                ...(this.params.environmentName && { environmentName: this.params.environmentName }),

            const response = await threadService.createAndStartThread(options);

                    ? response.error
                    : (response.error as any)?.message || 'Thread creation and start failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Thread creation and start failed: ${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMsg}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const resp = response as any;
            let output = resp.async === false ? 'Thread completed successfully' : 'Thread started successfully';
            if (resp.threadId) {
                output += `\n\nThread ID: ${resp.threadId}`;
                output += `\nAsync Task ID: thread:${resp.threadId}`;
            }
            if (resp.targetAgentId) {
                output += `\nTarget Agent ID: ${resp.targetAgentId}`;
            }
            output += `\nTarget Agent Instance ID: ${resp.targetAgentInstanceId || 'not available yet'}`;
            if (resp.activityId) {
                output += `\nActivity ID: ${resp.activityId}`;
            }
            if (resp.status) {
                output += `\nStatus: ${resp.status}`;
            }
            output += `\nCompletion Event: ${resp.completionEvent || 'threadCompletion'}`;
            if (resp.threadId && resp.targetAgentId) {
                output += `\n\nTo send this agent a message, use tool \`eventqueue_send_message\` with targetAgentId="${resp.targetAgentId}", targetThreadId="${resp.threadId}", and content="<message>".`;
            }
            if (resp.threadId && resp.async !== false) {
                output += `\nTo manage this running thread, use tool \`async_task_control\` with taskId="thread:${resp.threadId}" and action "wait", "stop", or "detach".`;
            }
            if (resp.output) {
                output += `\n\nOutput:\n${resp.output}`;
            }
            if (resp.thread) {
                output += `\n\nThread: ${JSON.stringify(resp.thread, null, 2)}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent: output,
                returnDisplay: 'Thread created and started successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error creating and starting thread: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { Kind, ToolErrorType } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import asyncTask, { AsyncTaskControlAction } from '../../modules/asyncTask';

export interface AsyncTaskControlParams {
    taskId: string;
    action: AsyncTaskControlAction;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    reason?: string;
}

class AsyncTaskControlInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: AsyncTaskControlParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const response = await asyncTask.controlTask(this.params);
            if (response?.success === false) {
                const errorMessage = response.error || 'Failed to control async task';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Async task ${this.params.action} failed: ${errorMessage}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMessage,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const task = response?.task;
            const statusLine = task?.status
                ? `Task ${this.params.taskId} status: ${task.status}`
                : `Task ${this.params.taskId} ${this.params.action} completed`;
            const waitLine = response?.waitTimedOut
                ? '\nWait timed out; the task is still running. Choose wait again, stop, or detach.'
                : '';
            const output = response?.output ? `\n\nOutput:\n${response.output}` : '';
            return {
                llmContent: `${statusLine}${waitLine}${output}`,
                returnDisplay: statusLine,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error controlling async task: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

export class AsyncTaskControlTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'async_task_control';

    constructor() {
        super(
            AsyncTaskControlTool.Name,
            'AsyncTaskControl',
            'Controls an async task. Use wait with a timeout, stop to terminate, or detach to let it survive agent completion.',
            Kind.Execute,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    taskId: {
                        type: 'string',
                        description: 'Async task ID, for example command:1234 or thread:abc.',
                    },
                    action: {
                        type: 'string',
                        enum: ['wait', 'stop', 'detach'],
                        description: 'Control action to perform.',
                    },
                    timeoutMs: {
                        type: 'number',
                        description: 'Maximum wait time in milliseconds for action=wait. The runtime caps this value.',
                    },
                    reason: {
                        type: 'string',
                        description: 'Optional reason used when detaching a task.',
                    },
                },
                required: ['taskId', 'action'],
            },
        );
    }

    protected override validateToolParamValues(params: AsyncTaskControlParams): string | null {
        if (typeof params.taskId !== 'string' || !params.taskId.trim()) {
            return "'taskId' is required and must be a non-empty string";
        }
        if (!['wait', 'stop', 'detach'].includes(params.action)) {
            return "'action' must be one of: wait, stop, detach";
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: AsyncTaskControlParams): ToolInvocation<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
        return new AsyncTaskControlInvocation(params);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { Kind, ToolErrorType } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import asyncTask, { AsyncTaskScope } from '../../modules/asyncTask';

export interface AsyncTaskListParams {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

class AsyncTaskListInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<AsyncTaskListParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: AsyncTaskListParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const response = await asyncTask.listTasks(this.params);
            if (response?.success === false) {
                const errorMessage = response.error || 'Failed to list async tasks';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Async task list failed: ${errorMessage}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMessage,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const tasks = response?.tasks || [];
            return {
                llmContent: `Async tasks:\n${JSON.stringify(tasks, null, 2)}`,
                returnDisplay: `Listed ${tasks.length} async task(s)`,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error listing async tasks: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

export class AsyncTaskListTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<AsyncTaskListParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'async_task_list';

    constructor() {
        super(
            AsyncTaskListTool.Name,
            'AsyncTaskList',
            'Lists running and recent async tasks such as background commands and child threads.',
            Kind.Other,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    scope: {
                        type: 'string',
                        enum: ['current_run', 'thread', 'all'],
                        description: 'Task scope. Defaults to thread.',
                    },
                    threadId: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional thread ID filter.' },
                    agentId: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional agent ID filter.' },
                    agentInstanceId: { type: 'string', description: 'Optional agent instance ID filter.' },
                    includeCompleted: { type: 'boolean', description: 'Include completed, failed, and stopped tasks.' },
                },
                required: [],
            },
        );
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: AsyncTaskListParams): ToolInvocation<AsyncTaskListParams, ToolResult> {
        return new AsyncTaskListInvocation(params);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

import cbws from '../core/websocket';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import backgroundChildThreads from './backgroundChildThreads';
import type {
    ThreadFileChange,
    ThreadFileChangesResponse,
    ThreadFileChangesSummaryResponse
} from '@codebolt/types/sdk';

// Import options types from agent-to-app-ws-schema
import type {
    CreateThreadOptions,
    UpdateThreadOptions,
    GetThreadListOptions,
    GetThreadDetailOptions,
    GetThreadMessagesOptions,
    GetThreadRawConversationsOptions,
    GetThreadContextOptions,
    GetThreadContextCompactedOptions,
    GetThreadContextSummaryOptions,
    AddThreadContextOptions,
    CreateAndStartThreadOptions,
} from '@codebolt/types/agent-to-app-ws-schema';

// Import response types from app-to-agent-ws-schema
import type {
    CreateThreadResponse,
    ListThreadsResponse,
    GetThreadResponse,
    GetThreadMessagesResponse,
    UpdateThreadResponse,
    DeleteThreadResponse,
    StartThreadResponse,
    WaitForThreadCompletionResponse,
    UpdateThreadStatusResponse,
    ThreadAgentStartedResponse,
    ThreadAgentStartFailedResponse,
    GetThreadRawConversationsResponse,
    GetThreadContextResponse,
    GetThreadContextCompactedResponse,
    GetThreadContextSummaryResponse,
    AddThreadContextResponse,
} from '@codebolt/types/app-to-agent-ws-schema';

// Re-export types for consumers
export type {
    ThreadFileChange,
    ThreadFileChangesResponse,
    ThreadFileChangesSummaryResponse
};

/**
 * Thread service for managing conversation threads.
 * This module provides a comprehensive API for thread management using thread-specific types.
 */

const threadService = {

    /**
     * Creates a new thread with comprehensive options.
     * @param options - The thread creation parameters
     * @returns A promise that resolves with the thread creation response
     */
    createThread: async (options: CreateThreadOptions): Promise<CreateThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'createThread',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'createThreadResponse'
        );
    },
    /**
     * Creates and immediately starts a new thread.
     * @param {CreateAndStartThreadOptions} options - The thread creation and start parameters
     * @param {boolean} [options.remoteEnv] - If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally.
     * @param {Object} [options.environmentProvider] - The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. If not specified, the first available provider is used.
     * @param {string} [options.environmentName] - Optional custom name for the remote environment.
     * @returns {Promise<StartThreadResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread start response
     */
    createAndStartThread: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'createAndStartThread',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<StartThreadResponse>(
            event,
            'startThreadResponse'
        );

        if (response.threadId && (response as any).async !== false && (response as any).status !== 'completed') {
            backgroundChildThreads.addRunningAgent(response.threadId, response, options.groupId);
        }

        return response;
    },

    /**
     * Creates and starts a thread, then waits for completion.
     */
    createAndStartThreadAndWait: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {
        return threadService.createAndStartThread({
            ...options,
            waitForCompletion: true,
        });
    },

    /**
     * Waits for a previously started thread to complete. The server applies a bounded timeout.
     */
    waitForThreadCompletion: async (options: { threadId: string; timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<WaitForThreadCompletionResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'waitForThreadCompletion',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<WaitForThreadCompletionResponse>(
            event,
            'waitForThreadCompletionResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Creates a thread in the background and resolves when the agent starts or fails.
     * @param {CreateAndStartThreadOptions} options - The thread creation and start parameters
     * @param {boolean} [options.remoteEnv] - If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally.
     * @param {Object} [options.environmentProvider] - The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true.
     * @param {string} [options.environmentName] - Optional custom name for the remote environment.
     * @returns {Promise<ThreadAgentStartedResponse | ThreadAgentStartFailedResponse>} A promise that resolves with ThreadAgentStarted or ThreadAgentStartFailed response
     */
    createThreadInBackground: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<ThreadAgentStartedResponse | ThreadAgentStartFailedResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'createAndStartThread',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<ThreadAgentStartedResponse | ThreadAgentStartFailedResponse>(
            event,
            'ThreadAgentStarted'
        );

        // Add to appropriate map based on whether groupId is provided
        // Add to appropriate map based on whether groupId is provided
        if (response.threadId) {
            backgroundChildThreads.addRunningAgent(response.threadId, response, options.groupId);
        }

        return response;
    },


    /**
     * Retrieves a list of threads with optional filtering.
     * @param {GetThreadListOptions} options - Optional filters for threads
     * @returns {Promise<ListThreadsResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread list response
     */
    getThreadList: async (options: GetThreadListOptions = {}): Promise<ListThreadsResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadList',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'listThreadsResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves detailed information about a specific thread.
     * @param {GetThreadDetailOptions} options - The thread detail options
     * @returns {Promise<GetThreadResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread detail response
     */
    getThreadDetail: async (options: GetThreadDetailOptions): Promise<GetThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadDetail',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Starts a thread.
     * @param {string} threadId - The thread ID to start
     * @returns {Promise<StartThreadResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread start response
     */
    startThread: async (threadId: string): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'startThread',
            requestId,
            message: {
                threadId
            }
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'startThreadResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Updates an existing thread.
     * @param {string} threadId - The thread ID to update
     * @param {UpdateThreadOptions} updates - The thread update parameters
     * @returns {Promise<UpdateThreadResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread update response
     */
    updateThread: async (threadId: string, updates: UpdateThreadOptions): Promise<UpdateThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'updateThread',
            requestId,
            message: {
                threadId,
                ...updates
            }
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'updateThreadResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Deletes a thread.
     * @param {string} threadId - The thread ID to delete
     * @returns {Promise<DeleteThreadResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread deletion response
     */
    deleteThread: async (threadId: string): Promise<DeleteThreadResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'deleteThread',
            requestId,
            message: {
                threadId
            }
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'deleteThreadResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Updates the status of a thread.
     * @param {string} threadId - The thread ID
     * @param {string} status - The new status
     * @returns {Promise<UpdateThreadStatusResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread status update response
     */
    updateThreadStatus: async (threadId: string, status: string): Promise<UpdateThreadStatusResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'updateThreadStatus',
            requestId,
            message: {
                threadId,
                status
            }
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'updateThreadStatusResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves messages for a specific thread.
     * @param {GetThreadMessagesOptions} options - The thread messages options
     * @returns {Promise<GetThreadMessagesResponse>} A promise that resolves with the thread messages response
     */
    getThreadMessages: async (options: GetThreadMessagesOptions): Promise<GetThreadMessagesResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadMessages',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadMessagesResponse'
        );
    },

    getThreadRawConversations: async (options: GetThreadRawConversationsOptions): Promise<GetThreadRawConversationsResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadRawConversations',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadRawConversationsResponse'
        );
    },

    getThreadContext: async (options: GetThreadContextOptions): Promise<GetThreadContextResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadContext',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadContextResponse'
        );
    },

    getThreadContextCompacted: async (options: GetThreadContextCompactedOptions): Promise<GetThreadContextCompactedResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadContextCompacted',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadContextCompactedResponse'
        );
    },

    getThreadContextSummary: async (options: GetThreadContextSummaryOptions): Promise<GetThreadContextSummaryResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadContextSummary',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadContextSummaryResponse'
        );
    },

    addThreadContext: async (options: AddThreadContextOptions): Promise<AddThreadContextResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'addThreadContext',
            requestId,
            message: options
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'addThreadContextResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Retrieves file changes associated with a specific thread.
     * @param threadId - The thread ID
     * @returns A promise that resolves with the file changes
     */
    getThreadFileChanges: async (threadId: string): Promise<ThreadFileChangesResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'getThreadFileChanges',
            requestId,
            message: {

            }
        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            event,
            'getThreadFileChangesResponse'

    /**

};

export default threadService;

        const requestId = randomUUID();

        const event = {
            type: 'threadEvent',
            action: 'createThread',
            requestId,

        };

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(

    /**
     * Creates and immediately starts a new thread.
     * @param {CreateAndStartThreadOptions} options - The thread creation and start parameters
     * @param {boolean} [options.remoteEnv] - If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally.
     * @param {Object} [options.environmentProvider] - The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. If not specified, the first available provider is used.
     * @param {string} [options.environmentName] - Optional custom name for the remote environment.

    createAndStartThread: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {

import { ProcessedMessage } from "@codebolt/types/agent";
import { BaseMessageModifier } from "../base";
import { FlatUserMessage, MessageObject } from "@codebolt/types/sdk";
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import codebolt from "@codebolt/codeboltjs";
import { appendUserContextMessage } from "../../unified/base/promptContext";

export interface EnvironmentContextOptions {
    enableFullContext?: boolean;
    maxFiles?: number;
    maxFileSize?: number;
    includePatterns?: string[];
    excludePatterns?: string[];
}

export class EnvironmentContextModifier extends BaseMessageModifier {
    private readonly options: EnvironmentContextOptions;
    private readonly defaultExcludePatterns = [
        'node_modules/**',
        '.git/**',
        'dist/**',
        'build/**',
        '*.log',
        '*.tmp',
        '.DS_Store',
        'coverage/**',
        '.next/**',
        '.nuxt/**',
        '.codebolt',
        '.codebolt/**',
    ];

    constructor(options: EnvironmentContextOptions = {}){
        super()
        this.options = {
            enableFullContext: options.enableFullContext || false,
            maxFiles: options.maxFiles || 100,
            maxFileSize: options.maxFileSize || 100 * 1024, // 100KB per file
            includePatterns: options.includePatterns || ['**/*.ts', '**/*.js', '**/*.json', '**/*.md', '**/*.txt', '**/*.yml', '**/*.yaml'],
            excludePatterns: [...this.defaultExcludePatterns, ...(options.excludePatterns || [])]
        };
    }

    async modify(originalRequest: FlatUserMessage, createdMessage: ProcessedMessage): Promise<ProcessedMessage> {
        try {
            // Get current date formatted to user's locale
            const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                weekday: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                day: 'numeric',
            });
            
            const platform = process.platform;
            const { projectPath } = await codebolt.project.getProjectPath();
            
            if (!projectPath) {
                return createdMessage;
            }
            
            const currentDir = process.env['CODEBOLT_EFFECTIVE_PROJECT_PATH'] || process.env['CODEBOLT_PROJECT_PATH'] || projectPath;
            const baseProjectPath = process.env['CODEBOLT_BASE_PROJECT_PATH'];
            
            // Get basic directory listing
            let directoryListing = '';
            try {
                const files = await fs.promises.readdir(currentDir);
                const fileList = files.slice(0, 20).join(', '); // Limit to first 20 files
                const moreFiles = files.length > 20 ? ` ... and ${files.length - 20} more files` : '';
                directoryListing = `Files in current directory: ${fileList}${moreFiles}`;
            } catch (error) {
                directoryListing = 'Unable to read current directory';
            }

            const environmentContext = `
This is the CodeBolt AI Agent. Setting up context for our chat.
Today's date is ${today} (formatted according to the user's locale).
Operating system: ${platform}
Effective project directory for this task: ${currentDir}
${baseProjectPath ? `CodeBolt base project directory: ${baseProjectPath}
CodeBolt app-level configuration, providers, plugins, and .codebolt data are loaded from the base project directory. Code changes for the task should still target the effective project directory unless the user explicitly says otherwise.` : ''}
${directoryListing}
Async task policy: long-running commands and child threads are tracked as async tasks. Before completing, use async_task_list to inspect unresolved work and async_task_control to wait, stop, or detach each running task. Waits are bounded; if a task like a dev server should keep running, detach it explicitly.
            `.trim();

            // Prepare context parts (same as gemini-cli)
            const contextParts: string[] = [environmentContext];

            const agentMdContext = await this.readProjectAgentMd(currentDir);
            if (agentMdContext) {
                contextParts.push(agentMdContext);
            }

            if (baseProjectPath && path.resolve(baseProjectPath) !== path.resolve(currentDir)) {
                const baseAgentMdContext = await this.readProjectAgentMd(baseProjectPath, 'Base Project Agent Instructions');
                if (baseAgentMdContext) {
                    contextParts.push(baseAgentMdContext);
                }
            }

            const mentionedEnvironmentContext = this.formatMentionedEnvironments(originalRequest.mentionedEnvironments);
            if (mentionedEnvironmentContext) {
                contextParts.push(mentionedEnvironmentContext);
            }

            const asyncTaskContext = await this.formatPendingAsyncTasks();
            if (asyncTaskContext) {
                contextParts.push(asyncTaskContext);
            }

            // Add full file context if enabled (just like gemini-cli does)
            if (this.options.enableFullContext) {
                try {
                    const fullContextContent = await this.generateFullContext(currentDir);
                    if (fullContextContent) {
                        contextParts.push(`\n--- Full File Context ---\n${fullContextContent}`);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error reading full file context:', error);
                    contextParts.push('\n--- Error reading full file context ---');
                }
            }

            const finalContent = contextParts.join('\n\n');
            const contextMessage: MessageObject = {
                role: 'user',
                content: finalContent
            };

            return Promise.resolve({
                ...appendUserContextMessage(createdMessage, contextMessage),
                metadata: {
                    ...createdMessage.metadata,
                    environmentContextAdded: true,
                    projectAgentMdContextAdded: Boolean(agentMdContext),
                    fullContextAdded: this.options.enableFullContext,
                    contextFilesCount: this.options.enableFullContext ? await this.countContextFiles(currentDir) : 0,
                    environmentInfo: {
                        date: today,
                        platform,
                        currentDir,
                        baseProjectPath
                    }
                }
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error in EnvironmentContextModifier:', error);
            return createdMessage;
        }
    }

    private formatMentionedEnvironments(mentionedEnvironments?: any[]): string | null {
        if (!mentionedEnvironments?.length) {
            return null;
        }

        const environments = mentionedEnvironments
            .map((mention) => {
                const environment = mention?.environmentData || mention;
                const provider = environment?.provider || environment?.remoteProvider || {};
                const config = environment?.config || {};

                return {
                    id: mention?.id || environment?.id || environment?.environmentId || environment?.environment_id,
                    name: mention?.title || environment?.name || environment?.title,
                    description: mention?.description || environment?.description,
                    state: environment?.state || environment?.status,
                    provider: provider?.name || provider?.title || provider?.id || provider?.providerId,
                    executionMode: config?.executionMode || environment?.executionMode || environment?.type,
                    environment,
                };
            })
            .filter((environment) => environment.id || environment.name);

        if (!environments.length) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            '<mentioned-environments>',
            'The user explicitly mentioned these environments with #. Treat them as routing context, not as an automatic active-environment selection.',
            'If the user asks to run, start, delegate, create, or continue work in one of these environments, first inspect this mentioned environment list and choose the matching environment.',
            'Use the thread tool `thread_create_background` to create a background thread in the selected remote environment. Pass the selected environment object in `environment`, set `isRemoteTask: true`, and put the requested work in `userMessage` or `task`.',
            'If the next step depends on that child thread finishing, use `async_task_control` with taskId `thread:<threadId>` and action `wait` before continuing.',
            'To send a follow-up message to the child agent, use `eventqueue_send_message` with the returned targetAgentId and threadId as targetThreadId.',
            'If `thread_create_background` is not available in the current tool list, first use the tool search capability, such as `tool_search`, to find the thread/background-thread creation tool and then use the matching tool.',
            'If multiple mentioned environments could match and the user did not specify which one, ask a brief clarification before creating the background thread.',
            'Do not call environment management tools or change the active environment just because an environment was mentioned.',
            JSON.stringify(environments, null, 2),
            '</mentioned-environments>',
        ].join('\n');
    }

    private async formatPendingAsyncTasks(): Promise<string | null> {
        try {
            const response = await (codebolt as any).asyncTask.listTasks({
                scope: 'thread',
            });
            const tasks = Array.isArray((response as any)?.tasks) ? (response as any).tasks : [];
            const unresolvedTasks = tasks.filter((task: any) =>
                task &&
                task.lifetime !== 'detached' &&
                !['completed', 'failed', 'stopped'].includes(task.status),
            );
            if (unresolvedTasks.length === 0) {
                return null;
            }

            return [
                '<pending_async_tasks>',
                'These async tasks are still unresolved for this thread. Before completing, choose wait, stop, or detach for each task using async_task_control.',
                JSON.stringify(unresolvedTasks, null, 2),
                '</pending_async_tasks>',
            ].join('\n');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error reading pending async tasks:', error);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private async readProjectAgentMd(basePath: string, title = 'Project Agent Instructions'): Promise<string> {
        const instructionFiles = [
            path.join(basePath, '.codebolt', 'agent.md'),
            path.join(basePath, 'agent.md'),
            path.join(basePath, 'AGENTS.md'),
        ];

        const sections: string[] = [];

        for (const instructionFile of instructionFiles) {
            const section = await this.readAgentInstructionFile(basePath, instructionFile, title);
            if (section) {
                sections.push(section);
            }
        }

        return sections.join('\n\n');
    }

    private async readAgentInstructionFile(basePath: string, filePath: string, title: string): Promise<string> {
        const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);

        try {
            const stats = await fs.promises.stat(filePath);
            if (!stats.isFile()) {
                return '';
            }

            if (stats.size > this.options.maxFileSize!) {
                return `--- ${title} (${relativePath}) ---\n[File too large: ${stats.size} bytes]`;
            }

            const content = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
            if (!content.trim()) {
                return '';
            }

            return `--- ${title} (${relativePath}) ---\n${content}`;
        } catch (error) {
            const nodeError = error as NodeJS.ErrnoException;
            if (nodeError.code !== 'ENOENT') {
                console.error(`Error reading ${relativePath}:`, error);
            }

            return '';
        }
    }

    // Full context methods (integrated like gemini-cli)
    private async generateFullContext(basePath: string): Promise<string> {
        try {
            const files = await this.findRelevantFiles(basePath);
            const contextParts: string[] = [];

            let processedFiles = 0;
            for (const filePath of files) {
                if (processedFiles >= this.options.maxFiles!) {
                    contextParts.push(`\n... (${files.length - processedFiles} more files not shown due to limit)\n`);
                    break;
                }

                try {
                    const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);
                    const stats = await fs.promises.stat(filePath);
                    
                    // Skip files that are too large
                    if (stats.size > this.options.maxFileSize!) {
                        contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n[File too large: ${stats.size} bytes]\n`);
                        processedFiles++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const content = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
                    contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n${content}\n`);
                    processedFiles++;
                } catch (error) {
                    const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);
                    contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n[Error reading file: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}]\n`);
                    processedFiles++;
                }
            }

            return contextParts.join('\n');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error generating full context:', error);
            return '';
        }
    }

    private async findRelevantFiles(basePath: string): Promise<string[]> {
        const files: string[] = [];
        
        try {
            await this.walkDirectory(basePath, files, basePath);
            return files.sort();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error finding relevant files:', error);
            return [];
        }
    }

    private async walkDirectory(dir: string, files: string[], basePath: string): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const entries = await fs.promises.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
            
            for (const entry of entries) {
                const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
                const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, fullPath);
                
                // Check exclusion patterns
                if (this.isExcluded(relativePath)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                    await this.walkDirectory(fullPath, files, basePath);
                } else if (entry.isFile()) {
                    // Check inclusion patterns
                    if (this.isIncluded(relativePath)) {
                        files.push(fullPath);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            // Skip directories we can't read
        }
    }

    private isExcluded(relativePath: string): boolean {
        return this.options.excludePatterns!.some(pattern => {
            return this.matchesPattern(relativePath, pattern);
        });
    }

    private isIncluded(relativePath: string): boolean {
        return this.options.includePatterns!.some(pattern => {
            return this.matchesPattern(relativePath, pattern);
        });
    }

    private matchesPattern(filePath: string, pattern: string): boolean {
        // Simple glob pattern matching - in production, use a proper glob library
        const regexPattern = pattern
            .replace(/\*\*/g, '.*')
            .replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*')
            .replace(/\?/g, '.');
        
        const regex = new RegExp(`^${regexPattern}$`);
        return regex.test(filePath);
    }

    private async countContextFiles(basePath: string): Promise<number> {
        try {
            const files = await this.findRelevantFiles(basePath);
            return Math.min(files.length, this.options.maxFiles!);
        } catch (error) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // Public methods to control full context
    public enableFullContext(): void {
        this.options.enableFullContext = true;
    }

    public disableFullContext(): void {
        this.options.enableFullContext = false;
    }

    public isFullContextEnabled(): boolean {
        return this.options.enableFullContext || false;
    }
}
