import { BaseMessageModifier } from "../base";
import { FlatUserMessage, MessageObject } from "@codebolt/types/sdk";
import * as path from 'path';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import codebolt from "@codebolt/codeboltjs";
import { appendUserContextMessage } from "../../unified/base/promptContext";

export interface EnvironmentContextOptions {
    enableFullContext?: boolean;
    maxFiles?: number;
    maxFileSize?: number;
    includePatterns?: string[];
    excludePatterns?: string[];
}

export class EnvironmentContextModifier extends BaseMessageModifier {
    private readonly options: EnvironmentContextOptions;
    private readonly defaultExcludePatterns = [
        'node_modules/**',
        '.git/**',
        'dist/**',
        'build/**',
        '*.log',
        '*.tmp',
        '.DS_Store',
        'coverage/**',
        '.next/**',
        '.nuxt/**',
        '.codebolt',
        '.codebolt/**',
    ];

    constructor(options: EnvironmentContextOptions = {}){
        super()
        this.options = {
            enableFullContext: options.enableFullContext || false,
            maxFiles: options.maxFiles || 100,
            maxFileSize: options.maxFileSize || 100 * 1024, // 100KB per file
            includePatterns: options.includePatterns || ['**/*.ts', '**/*.js', '**/*.json', '**/*.md', '**/*.txt', '**/*.yml', '**/*.yaml'],
            excludePatterns: [...this.defaultExcludePatterns, ...(options.excludePatterns || [])]
        };
    }

    async modify(originalRequest: FlatUserMessage, createdMessage: ProcessedMessage): Promise<ProcessedMessage> {
        try {
            // Get current date formatted to user's locale
            const today = new Date().toLocaleDateString(undefined, {
                weekday: 'long',
                year: 'numeric',
                month: 'long',
                day: 'numeric',
            });
            
            const platform = process.platform;
            const { projectPath } = await codebolt.project.getProjectPath();
            
            if (!projectPath) {
                return createdMessage;
            }
            
            const currentDir = process.env['CODEBOLT_EFFECTIVE_PROJECT_PATH'] || process.env['CODEBOLT_PROJECT_PATH'] || projectPath;
            const baseProjectPath = process.env['CODEBOLT_BASE_PROJECT_PATH'];
            
            // Get basic directory listing
            let directoryListing = '';
            try {
                const files = await fs.promises.readdir(currentDir);
                const fileList = files.slice(0, 20).join(', '); // Limit to first 20 files
                const moreFiles = files.length > 20 ? ` ... and ${files.length - 20} more files` : '';
                directoryListing = `Files in current directory: ${fileList}${moreFiles}`;
            } catch (error) {
                directoryListing = 'Unable to read current directory';
            }

            const environmentContext = `
This is the CodeBolt AI Agent. Setting up context for our chat.
Today's date is ${today} (formatted according to the user's locale).
Operating system: ${platform}
Effective project directory for this task: ${currentDir}
${baseProjectPath ? `CodeBolt base project directory: ${baseProjectPath}
CodeBolt app-level configuration, providers, plugins, and .codebolt data are loaded from the base project directory. Code changes for the task should still target the effective project directory unless the user explicitly says otherwise.` : ''}
${directoryListing}
Async task policy: long-running commands and child threads are tracked as async tasks. Before completing, use async_task_list to inspect unresolved work and async_task_control to wait, stop, or detach each running task. Waits are bounded; if a task like a dev server should keep running, detach it explicitly.
            `.trim();

            // Prepare context parts (same as gemini-cli)
            const contextParts: string[] = [environmentContext];

            const agentMdContext = await this.readProjectAgentMd(currentDir);
            if (agentMdContext) {
                contextParts.push(agentMdContext);
            }

            if (baseProjectPath && path.resolve(baseProjectPath) !== path.resolve(currentDir)) {
                const baseAgentMdContext = await this.readProjectAgentMd(baseProjectPath, 'Base Project Agent Instructions');
                if (baseAgentMdContext) {
                    contextParts.push(baseAgentMdContext);
                }
            }

            const mentionedEnvironmentContext = this.formatMentionedEnvironments(originalRequest.mentionedEnvironments);
            if (mentionedEnvironmentContext) {
                contextParts.push(mentionedEnvironmentContext);
            }

            const asyncTaskContext = await this.formatPendingAsyncTasks();
            if (asyncTaskContext) {
                contextParts.push(asyncTaskContext);
            }

            // Add full file context if enabled (just like gemini-cli does)
            if (this.options.enableFullContext) {
                try {
                    const fullContextContent = await this.generateFullContext(currentDir);
                    if (fullContextContent) {
                        contextParts.push(`\n--- Full File Context ---\n${fullContextContent}`);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error('Error reading full file context:', error);
                    contextParts.push('\n--- Error reading full file context ---');
                }
            }

            const finalContent = contextParts.join('\n\n');
            const contextMessage: MessageObject = {
                role: 'user',
                content: finalContent
            };

            return Promise.resolve({
                ...appendUserContextMessage(createdMessage, contextMessage),
                metadata: {
                    ...createdMessage.metadata,
                    environmentContextAdded: true,
                    projectAgentMdContextAdded: Boolean(agentMdContext),
                    fullContextAdded: this.options.enableFullContext,
                    contextFilesCount: this.options.enableFullContext ? await this.countContextFiles(currentDir) : 0,
                    environmentInfo: {
                        date: today,
                        platform,
                        currentDir,
                        baseProjectPath
                    }
                }
            });
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error in EnvironmentContextModifier:', error);
            return createdMessage;
        }
    }

    private formatMentionedEnvironments(mentionedEnvironments?: any[]): string | null {
        if (!mentionedEnvironments?.length) {
            return null;
        }

        const environments = mentionedEnvironments
            .map((mention) => {
                const environment = mention?.environmentData || mention;
                const provider = environment?.provider || environment?.remoteProvider || {};
                const config = environment?.config || {};

                return {
                    id: mention?.id || environment?.id || environment?.environmentId || environment?.environment_id,
                    name: mention?.title || environment?.name || environment?.title,
                    description: mention?.description || environment?.description,
                    state: environment?.state || environment?.status,
                    provider: provider?.name || provider?.title || provider?.id || provider?.providerId,
                    executionMode: config?.executionMode || environment?.executionMode || environment?.type,
                    environment,
                };
            })
            .filter((environment) => environment.id || environment.name);

        if (!environments.length) {
            return null;
        }

        return [
            '<mentioned-environments>',
            'The user explicitly mentioned these environments with #. Treat them as routing context, not as an automatic active-environment selection.',
            'If the user asks to run, start, delegate, create, or continue work in one of these environments, first inspect this mentioned environment list and choose the matching environment.',
            'Use the thread tool `thread_create_background` to create a background thread in the selected remote environment. Pass the selected environment object in `environment`, set `isRemoteTask: true`, and put the requested work in `userMessage` or `task`.',
            'If the next step depends on that child thread finishing, use `async_task_control` with taskId `thread:<threadId>` and action `wait` before continuing.',
            'To send a follow-up message to the child agent, use `eventqueue_send_message` with the returned targetAgentId and threadId as targetThreadId.',
            'If `thread_create_background` is not available in the current tool list, first use the tool search capability, such as `tool_search`, to find the thread/background-thread creation tool and then use the matching tool.',
            'If multiple mentioned environments could match and the user did not specify which one, ask a brief clarification before creating the background thread.',
            'Do not call environment management tools or change the active environment just because an environment was mentioned.',
            JSON.stringify(environments, null, 2),
            '</mentioned-environments>',
        ].join('\n');
    }

    private async formatPendingAsyncTasks(): Promise<string | null> {
        try {
            const response = await (codebolt as any).asyncTask.listTasks({
                scope: 'thread',
            });
            const tasks = Array.isArray((response as any)?.tasks) ? (response as any).tasks : [];
            const unresolvedTasks = tasks.filter((task: any) =>
                task &&
                task.lifetime !== 'detached' &&
                !['completed', 'failed', 'stopped'].includes(task.status),
            );
            if (unresolvedTasks.length === 0) {
                return null;
            }

            return [
                '<pending_async_tasks>',
                'These async tasks are still unresolved for this thread. Before completing, choose wait, stop, or detach for each task using async_task_control.',
                JSON.stringify(unresolvedTasks, null, 2),
                '</pending_async_tasks>',
            ].join('\n');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error reading pending async tasks:', error);
            return null;
        }
    }

    private async readProjectAgentMd(basePath: string, title = 'Project Agent Instructions'): Promise<string> {
        const instructionFiles = [
            path.join(basePath, '.codebolt', 'agent.md'),
            path.join(basePath, 'agent.md'),
            path.join(basePath, 'AGENTS.md'),
        ];

        const sections: string[] = [];

        for (const instructionFile of instructionFiles) {
            const section = await this.readAgentInstructionFile(basePath, instructionFile, title);
            if (section) {
                sections.push(section);
            }
        }

        return sections.join('\n\n');
    }

    private async readAgentInstructionFile(basePath: string, filePath: string, title: string): Promise<string> {
        const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);

        try {
            const stats = await fs.promises.stat(filePath);
            if (!stats.isFile()) {
                return '';
            }

            if (stats.size > this.options.maxFileSize!) {
                return `--- ${title} (${relativePath}) ---\n[File too large: ${stats.size} bytes]`;
            }

            const content = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
            if (!content.trim()) {
                return '';
            }

            return `--- ${title} (${relativePath}) ---\n${content}`;
        } catch (error) {
            const nodeError = error as NodeJS.ErrnoException;
            if (nodeError.code !== 'ENOENT') {
                console.error(`Error reading ${relativePath}:`, error);
            }

            return '';
        }
    }

    // Full context methods (integrated like gemini-cli)
    private async generateFullContext(basePath: string): Promise<string> {
        try {
            const files = await this.findRelevantFiles(basePath);
            const contextParts: string[] = [];

            let processedFiles = 0;
            for (const filePath of files) {
                if (processedFiles >= this.options.maxFiles!) {
                    contextParts.push(`\n... (${files.length - processedFiles} more files not shown due to limit)\n`);
                    break;
                }

                try {
                    const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);
                    const stats = await fs.promises.stat(filePath);
                    
                    // Skip files that are too large
                    if (stats.size > this.options.maxFileSize!) {
                        contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n[File too large: ${stats.size} bytes]\n`);
                        processedFiles++;
                        continue;
                    }

                    const content = await fs.promises.readFile(filePath, 'utf-8');
                    contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n${content}\n`);
                    processedFiles++;
                } catch (error) {
                    const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, filePath);
                    contextParts.push(`--- ${relativePath} ---\n[Error reading file: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'}]\n`);
                    processedFiles++;
                }
            }

            return contextParts.join('\n');
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error generating full context:', error);
            return '';
        }
    }

    private async findRelevantFiles(basePath: string): Promise<string[]> {
        const files: string[] = [];
        
        try {
            await this.walkDirectory(basePath, files, basePath);
            return files.sort();
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('Error finding relevant files:', error);
            return [];
        }
    }

    private async walkDirectory(dir: string, files: string[], basePath: string): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const entries = await fs.promises.readdir(dir, { withFileTypes: true });
            
            for (const entry of entries) {
                const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);
                const relativePath = path.relative(basePath, fullPath);
                
                // Check exclusion patterns
                if (this.isExcluded(relativePath)) {
                    continue;
                }

                if (entry.isDirectory()) {
                    await this.walkDirectory(fullPath, files, basePath);
                } else if (entry.isFile()) {
                    // Check inclusion patterns
                    if (this.isIncluded(relativePath)) {
                        files.push(fullPath);
                    }
                }
            }
        } catch (error) {
            // Skip directories we can't read
        }
    }

    private isExcluded(relativePath: string): boolean {
        return this.options.excludePatterns!.some(pattern => {
            return this.matchesPattern(relativePath, pattern);
        });
    }

    private isIncluded(relativePath: string): boolean {
        return this.options.includePatterns!.some(pattern => {
            return this.matchesPattern(relativePath, pattern);
        });
    }

    private matchesPattern(filePath: string, pattern: string): boolean {
        // Simple glob pattern matching - in production, use a proper glob library
        const regexPattern = pattern
            .replace(/\*\*/g, '.*')
            .replace(/\*/g, '[^/]*')
            .replace(/\?/g, '.');
        
        const regex = new RegExp(`^${regexPattern}$`);
        return regex.test(filePath);
    }

    private async countContextFiles(basePath: string): Promise<number> {
        try {
            const files = await this.findRelevantFiles(basePath);
            return Math.min(files.length, this.options.maxFiles!);
        } catch (error) {
            return 0;
        }
    }

    // Public methods to control full context
    public enableFullContext(): void {
        this.options.enableFullContext = true;
    }

    public disableFullContext(): void {
        this.options.enableFullContext = false;
    }

    public isFullContextEnabled(): boolean {
        return this.options.enableFullContext || false;
    }
}

import {
    AgentResponseExecutor,
    AgentLocalTool,
    PostToolCallProcessor,
    PreToolCallProcessor,
    ProcessedMessage,
    ResponseInput,
    ResponseOutput,
    ToolResult
} from '@codebolt/types/agent';
import { LLMCompletion, MessageObject, Tool, ToolCall } from '@codebolt/types/sdk';
import codebolt from '@codebolt/codeboltjs';

import { LoopDetectionService } from '../services/LoopDetectionService';
import {
    appendTranscriptMessages,
    getTranscriptMessages,
    reconcileRuntimePromptContext,
} from './promptContext';
import { appendUniqueTools, listProjectLocalTools, resolveToolExecutionName } from '../utils/agentToolLoader';

interface ParsedToolCall {
    tool: ToolCall;
    toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
    toolName: string;
    toolUseId: string;
    waitForPrevious: boolean;
}

interface ToolExecutionOutcome {
    toolResults: ToolResult[];
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    completed: boolean;
    finalMessage: string | undefined;
    hadToolCalls: boolean;
}

interface SingleToolExecutionResult {
    toolResult: ToolResult;
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    didUserReject: boolean;
}

interface ContextCompactionDecision {
    required?: boolean;
    hasToolCalls?: boolean;
    runRequest?: Record<string, unknown>;
    reason?: string;
    stats?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

type LLMCompletionWithCompaction = LLMCompletion & {
    contextCompaction?: ContextCompactionDecision;
};

export class ResponseExecutor implements AgentResponseExecutor {

    private preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private completed = false;
    private finalMessage: string | undefined = undefined;
    private loopDetectionService: LoopDetectionService | undefined;
    private localToolsByExecutionName: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;

    constructor(options: {
        preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[];
        postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[];
        loopDetectionService?: LoopDetectionService;
        localToolsByExecutionName?: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;
    }) {
        this.preToolCallProcessors = options.preToolCallProcessors;
        this.postToolCallProcessors = options.postToolCallProcessors;
        this.loopDetectionService = options.loopDetectionService;
        this.localToolsByExecutionName = options.localToolsByExecutionName || new Map<string, AgentLocalTool>();
    }

    async executeResponse(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ResponseOutput> {
        this.completed = false;
        this.finalMessage = undefined;

        let nextMessage: ProcessedMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(input.nextMessage);

        for (const preToolCallProcessor of this.preToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await preToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);
                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in pre tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const compactionMessagePromise = this.runRequiredCompaction(input.rawLLMOutput);
        const toolExecution = await this.executeTools(input);
        const compactionCompleted = await compactionMessagePromise;
        if (compactionCompleted) {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage('Conversation Compacted'));
        }
        this.completed = this.completed || toolExecution.completed;
        this.finalMessage = toolExecution.finalMessage ?? this.finalMessage;

        await this.injectDiscoveredTools(
            input.rawLLMOutput,
            toolExecution.toolResults,
            nextMessage,
        );

        if (toolExecution.toolResults.length > 0 || toolExecution.followUpMessages.length > 0) {
            nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [
                ...toolExecution.toolResults.map((toolResult) => ({
                    role: toolResult.role,
                    content: typeof toolResult.content === 'string'
                        ? toolResult.content
                        : JSON.stringify(toolResult.content),
                    tool_call_id: toolResult.tool_call_id,
                })),
                ...toolExecution.followUpMessages,
            ]);
        }

        const transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        for (const postToolCallProcessor of this.postToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await postToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                    toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
                    tokenLimit: input.rawLLMOutput?.tokenLimit,
                    maxOutputTokens: input.rawLLMOutput?.maxOutputTokens
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);

                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in post tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        if (
            !toolExecution.hadToolCalls &&
            transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors > transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors
        ) {
            this.completed = false;
            this.finalMessage = undefined;
        }

        if (this.completed) {
            const pendingAsyncTasks = await this.getPendingAsyncTasks();
            if (pendingAsyncTasks.length > 0) {
                nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [{
                    role: 'user',
                    content: [
                        '<async_tasks_require_decision>',
                        'You attempted to complete while async tasks owned by this run or thread are still unresolved.',
                        'Before completing, use async_task_control on each task with action "wait", "stop", or "detach".',
                        'If a wait times out and the task is intentionally long-running, either stop it or detach it explicitly.',
                        JSON.stringify(pendingAsyncTasks, null, 2),
                        '</async_tasks_require_decision>',
                    ].join('\n'),
                }]);
                this.completed = false;
                this.finalMessage = undefined;
            }
        }

        const output: ResponseOutput = {
            completed: this.completed,
            nextMessage,
            toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
        };
        if (this.finalMessage !== undefined) {
            output.finalMessage = this.finalMessage;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private parseToolCall(tool: ToolCall): ParsedToolCall {
        let toolInput: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (tool.function.arguments) {
            try {
                const parsedArguments = JSON.parse(tool.function.arguments);
                if (parsedArguments && typeof parsedArguments === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedArguments)) {
                    toolInput = parsedArguments as Record<string, unknown>;
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to parse tool arguments: ${parseError}`);
            }
        }

        return {
            tool,
            toolInput,
            toolName: tool.function.name,
            toolUseId: tool.id,
            waitForPrevious: toolInput['waitForPreviousTools'] === true,
        };
    }

    private extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): string | undefined {
        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            if (choice.message?.content) {
                return choice.message.content;
            }

            const reasoningContent = (choice.message as MessageObject & {
                reasoning_content?: string;
            } | undefined)?.reasoning_content;
            if (reasoningContent) {
                return reasoningContent;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    private getToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): ToolCall[] {
        const toolCallsById = new Map<string, ToolCall>();

        for (const toolCall of llmResponse.tool_calls ?? []) {
            if (toolCall?.id) {
                toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
            }
        }

        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            for (const toolCall of choice.message?.tool_calls ?? []) {
                if (toolCall?.id && !toolCallsById.has(toolCall.id)) {
                    toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
                }
            }
        }

        return Array.from(toolCallsById.values());
    }

    private hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): boolean {
        return this.getToolCalls(llmResponse).some((toolCall) => {
            const toolName = toolCall.function?.name || '';
            return !toolName.includes('attempt_completion') &&
                !toolName.includes('context_compaction') &&
                !toolName.includes('contextCompaction');
        });
    }

    private async runRequiredCompaction(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): Promise<boolean> {
        const decision = (llmResponse as LLMCompletionWithCompaction).contextCompaction;
        if (!decision?.required || decision.hasToolCalls === false || !this.hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            await codebolt.contextCompaction.run({
                ...(decision.runRequest || {}),
                reason: String(decision.runRequest?.['reason'] || decision.reason || 'llm_response_tool_calls'),
            });
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Context compaction failed:', error);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private async executeTools(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ToolExecutionOutcome> {
        const llmResponse = input.rawLLMOutput;
        const lastMessageContent = this.extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse);
        const toolCalls = this.getToolCalls(llmResponse);

        if (toolCalls.length === 0) {
            await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(lastMessageContent);

            return {
                toolResults: [],
                followUpMessages: [],
                completed: true,
                finalMessage: lastMessageContent,
                hadToolCalls: false,
            };
        }

        const parsedToolCalls = toolCalls.map((tool) => this.parseToolCall(tool));
        const completionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );
        const executionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            !toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );

        if (this.loopDetectionService) {
            for (const toolCall of executionToolCalls) {
                const loopDetected = this.loopDetectionService.checkToolCallLoop(
                    toolCall.toolName,
                    toolCall.toolInput,
                );

                if (loopDetected) {
                    const loopMessage = `Loop detected while calling "${toolCall.toolName}". Execution stopped to prevent infinite recurrence.`;
                    return {
                        toolResults: [{
                            role: 'tool',
                            tool_call_id: 'system-loop-detection',
                            content: JSON.stringify({ error: loopMessage }),
                        }],
                        followUpMessages: [],
                        completed: true,
                        finalMessage: loopMessage,
                        hadToolCalls: true,
                    };
                }
            }
        }

        const toolResults: ToolResult[] = [];
        const followUpMessages: MessageObject[] = [];
        let userRejectedToolUse = false;

        for (const currentToolCall of executionToolCalls) {
            if (userRejectedToolUse) {
                const skippedResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    currentToolCall.toolUseId,
                    'Skipping tool execution due to previous tool user rejection.',
                );
                toolResults.push(skippedResult);
                continue;
            }

            const executionResult = await this.executeSingleToolCall(currentToolCall, input);
            toolResults.push(executionResult.toolResult);
            followUpMessages.push(...executionResult.followUpMessages);
            userRejectedToolUse = executionResult.didUserReject;
        }

        if (completionToolCalls.length > 0) {
            const completionToolCall = completionToolCalls.at(-1);
            if (completionToolCall) {
                const completionArguments = completionToolCall.toolInput;

                const [, completionResult] = await this.executeTool(
                    completionToolCall.toolName,
                    completionArguments,
                    input,
                );
                this.finalMessage = this.extractCompletionMessage(completionArguments) ?? lastMessageContent;
                await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(this.finalMessage);

                const parsedCompletionResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    completionToolCall.toolUseId,
                    completionResult === '' ? 'The user is satisfied with the result.' : completionResult,
                );
                toolResults.push(parsedCompletionResult);
            }
        }

        return {
            toolResults,
            followUpMessages,
            completed: completionToolCalls.length > 0,
            finalMessage: this.finalMessage,
            hadToolCalls: true,
        };
    }

    private async sendFinalMessageToChat(message: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        if (!message || message.trim().length === 0) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage(message));
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Failed to send final chat message:', error);
        }
    }

    private async getPendingAsyncTasks(): Promise<any[]> {
        try {
            const response = await Promise.resolve((codebolt as any).asyncTask.listTasks({
                scope: 'current_run',

import {
    AgentResponseExecutor,
    AgentLocalTool,
    PostToolCallProcessor,
    PreToolCallProcessor,
    ProcessedMessage,
    ResponseInput,
    ResponseOutput,
    ToolResult
} from '@codebolt/types/agent';
import { LLMCompletion, MessageObject, Tool, ToolCall } from '@codebolt/types/sdk';
import codebolt from '@codebolt/codeboltjs';

import { LoopDetectionService } from '../services/LoopDetectionService';
import {
    appendTranscriptMessages,
    getTranscriptMessages,
    reconcileRuntimePromptContext,
} from './promptContext';
import { appendUniqueTools, listProjectLocalTools, resolveToolExecutionName } from '../utils/agentToolLoader';

interface ParsedToolCall {
    tool: ToolCall;
    toolInput: Record<string, unknown>;
    toolName: string;
    toolUseId: string;
    waitForPrevious: boolean;
}

interface ToolExecutionOutcome {
    toolResults: ToolResult[];
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    completed: boolean;
    finalMessage: string | undefined;
    hadToolCalls: boolean;
}

interface SingleToolExecutionResult {
    toolResult: ToolResult;
    followUpMessages: MessageObject[];
    didUserReject: boolean;
}

interface ContextCompactionDecision {
    required?: boolean;
    hasToolCalls?: boolean;
    runRequest?: Record<string, unknown>;
    reason?: string;
    stats?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

type LLMCompletionWithCompaction = LLMCompletion & {
    contextCompaction?: ContextCompactionDecision;
};

export class ResponseExecutor implements AgentResponseExecutor {

    private preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[] = [];
    private completed = false;
    private finalMessage: string | undefined = undefined;
    private loopDetectionService: LoopDetectionService | undefined;
    private localToolsByExecutionName: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;

    constructor(options: {
        preToolCallProcessors: PreToolCallProcessor[];
        postToolCallProcessors: PostToolCallProcessor[];
        loopDetectionService?: LoopDetectionService;
        localToolsByExecutionName?: Map<string, AgentLocalTool>;
    }) {
        this.preToolCallProcessors = options.preToolCallProcessors;
        this.postToolCallProcessors = options.postToolCallProcessors;
        this.loopDetectionService = options.loopDetectionService;
        this.localToolsByExecutionName = options.localToolsByExecutionName || new Map<string, AgentLocalTool>();
    }

    async executeResponse(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ResponseOutput> {
        this.completed = false;
        this.finalMessage = undefined;

        let nextMessage: ProcessedMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(input.nextMessage);

        for (const preToolCallProcessor of this.preToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await preToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);
                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in pre tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const compactionMessagePromise = this.runRequiredCompaction(input.rawLLMOutput);
        const toolExecution = await this.executeTools(input);
        const compactionCompleted = await compactionMessagePromise;
        if (compactionCompleted) {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage('Conversation Compacted'));
        }
        this.completed = this.completed || toolExecution.completed;
        this.finalMessage = toolExecution.finalMessage ?? this.finalMessage;

        await this.injectDiscoveredTools(
            input.rawLLMOutput,
            toolExecution.toolResults,
            nextMessage,
        );

        if (toolExecution.toolResults.length > 0 || toolExecution.followUpMessages.length > 0) {
            nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [
                ...toolExecution.toolResults.map((toolResult) => ({
                    role: toolResult.role,
                    content: typeof toolResult.content === 'string'
                        ? toolResult.content
                        : JSON.stringify(toolResult.content),
                    tool_call_id: toolResult.tool_call_id,
                })),
                ...toolExecution.followUpMessages,
            ]);
        }

        const transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        for (const postToolCallProcessor of this.postToolCallProcessors) {
            try {
                const { nextPrompt, shouldExit } = await postToolCallProcessor.modify({
                    llmMessageSent: input.actualMessageSentToLLM,
                    rawLLMResponseMessage: input.rawLLMOutput,
                    nextPrompt: nextMessage,
                    toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
                    tokenLimit: input.rawLLMOutput?.tokenLimit,
                    maxOutputTokens: input.rawLLMOutput?.maxOutputTokens
                });

                nextMessage = reconcileRuntimePromptContext(nextPrompt);

                if (shouldExit) {
                    this.completed = true;
                    break;
                }
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[ResponseExecutor] Error in post tool call processor:`, error);
            }
        }

        const transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors = getTranscriptMessages(nextMessage).length;
        if (
            !toolExecution.hadToolCalls &&
            transcriptLengthAfterPostToolProcessors > transcriptLengthBeforePostToolProcessors
        ) {
            this.completed = false;
            this.finalMessage = undefined;
        }

        if (this.completed) {
            const pendingAsyncTasks = await this.getPendingAsyncTasks();
            if (pendingAsyncTasks.length > 0) {
                nextMessage = appendTranscriptMessages(nextMessage, [{
                    role: 'user',
                    content: [
                        '<async_tasks_require_decision>',
                        'You attempted to complete while async tasks owned by this run or thread are still unresolved.',
                        'Before completing, use async_task_control on each task with action "wait", "stop", or "detach".',
                        'If a wait times out and the task is intentionally long-running, either stop it or detach it explicitly.',
                        JSON.stringify(pendingAsyncTasks, null, 2),
                        '</async_tasks_require_decision>',
                    ].join('\n'),
                }]);
                this.completed = false;
                this.finalMessage = undefined;
            }
        }

        const output: ResponseOutput = {
            completed: this.completed,
            nextMessage,
            toolResults: toolExecution.toolResults,
        };
        if (this.finalMessage !== undefined) {
            output.finalMessage = this.finalMessage;
        }

        return output;
    }

    private parseToolCall(tool: ToolCall): ParsedToolCall {
        let toolInput: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        if (tool.function.arguments) {
            try {
                const parsedArguments = JSON.parse(tool.function.arguments);
                if (parsedArguments && typeof parsedArguments === 'object' && !Array.isArray(parsedArguments)) {
                    toolInput = parsedArguments as Record<string, unknown>;
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                throw new Error(`Failed to parse tool arguments: ${parseError}`);
            }
        }

        return {
            tool,
            toolInput,
            toolName: tool.function.name,
            toolUseId: tool.id,
            waitForPrevious: toolInput['waitForPreviousTools'] === true,
        };
    }

    private extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): string | undefined {
        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            if (choice.message?.content) {
                return choice.message.content;
            }

            const reasoningContent = (choice.message as MessageObject & {
                reasoning_content?: string;
            } | undefined)?.reasoning_content;
            if (reasoningContent) {
                return reasoningContent;
            }
        }

        return undefined;
    }

    private getToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): ToolCall[] {
        const toolCallsById = new Map<string, ToolCall>();

        for (const toolCall of llmResponse.tool_calls ?? []) {
            if (toolCall?.id) {
                toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
            }
        }

        for (const choice of llmResponse.choices ?? []) {
            for (const toolCall of choice.message?.tool_calls ?? []) {
                if (toolCall?.id && !toolCallsById.has(toolCall.id)) {
                    toolCallsById.set(toolCall.id, toolCall);
                }
            }
        }

        return Array.from(toolCallsById.values());
    }

    private hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): boolean {
        return this.getToolCalls(llmResponse).some((toolCall) => {
            const toolName = toolCall.function?.name || '';
            return !toolName.includes('attempt_completion') &&
                !toolName.includes('context_compaction') &&
                !toolName.includes('contextCompaction');
        });
    }

    private async runRequiredCompaction(llmResponse: LLMCompletion): Promise<boolean> {
        const decision = (llmResponse as LLMCompletionWithCompaction).contextCompaction;
        if (!decision?.required || decision.hasToolCalls === false || !this.hasExecutableToolCalls(llmResponse)) {
            return false;
        }

        try {
            await codebolt.contextCompaction.run({
                ...(decision.runRequest || {}),
                reason: String(decision.runRequest?.['reason'] || decision.reason || 'llm_response_tool_calls'),
            });
            return true;
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Context compaction failed:', error);
            return false;
        }
    }

    private async executeTools(input: ResponseInput): Promise<ToolExecutionOutcome> {
        const llmResponse = input.rawLLMOutput;
        const lastMessageContent = this.extractLastMessageContent(llmResponse);
        const toolCalls = this.getToolCalls(llmResponse);

        if (toolCalls.length === 0) {
            await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(lastMessageContent);

            return {
                toolResults: [],
                followUpMessages: [],
                completed: true,
                finalMessage: lastMessageContent,
                hadToolCalls: false,
            };
        }

        const parsedToolCalls = toolCalls.map((tool) => this.parseToolCall(tool));
        const completionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );
        const executionToolCalls = parsedToolCalls.filter((toolCall) =>
            !toolCall.toolName.includes('attempt_completion'),
        );

        if (this.loopDetectionService) {
            for (const toolCall of executionToolCalls) {
                const loopDetected = this.loopDetectionService.checkToolCallLoop(
                    toolCall.toolName,
                    toolCall.toolInput,
                );

                if (loopDetected) {
                    const loopMessage = `Loop detected while calling "${toolCall.toolName}". Execution stopped to prevent infinite recurrence.`;
                    return {
                        toolResults: [{
                            role: 'tool',
                            tool_call_id: 'system-loop-detection',
                            content: JSON.stringify({ error: loopMessage }),
                        }],
                        followUpMessages: [],
                        completed: true,
                        finalMessage: loopMessage,
                        hadToolCalls: true,
                    };
                }
            }
        }

        const toolResults: ToolResult[] = [];
        const followUpMessages: MessageObject[] = [];
        let userRejectedToolUse = false;

        for (const currentToolCall of executionToolCalls) {
            if (userRejectedToolUse) {
                const skippedResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    currentToolCall.toolUseId,
                    'Skipping tool execution due to previous tool user rejection.',
                );
                toolResults.push(skippedResult);
                continue;
            }

            const executionResult = await this.executeSingleToolCall(currentToolCall, input);
            toolResults.push(executionResult.toolResult);
            followUpMessages.push(...executionResult.followUpMessages);
            userRejectedToolUse = executionResult.didUserReject;
        }

        if (completionToolCalls.length > 0) {
            const completionToolCall = completionToolCalls.at(-1);
            if (completionToolCall) {
                const completionArguments = completionToolCall.toolInput;

                const [, completionResult] = await this.executeTool(
                    completionToolCall.toolName,
                    completionArguments,
                    input,
                );
                this.finalMessage = this.extractCompletionMessage(completionArguments) ?? lastMessageContent;
                await this.sendFinalMessageToChat(this.finalMessage);

                const parsedCompletionResult = this.parseToolResult(
                    completionToolCall.toolUseId,
                    completionResult === '' ? 'The user is satisfied with the result.' : completionResult,
                );
                toolResults.push(parsedCompletionResult);
            }
        }

        return {
            toolResults,
            followUpMessages,
            completed: completionToolCalls.length > 0,
            finalMessage: this.finalMessage,
            hadToolCalls: true,
        };
    }

    private async sendFinalMessageToChat(message: string | undefined): Promise<void> {
        if (!message || message.trim().length === 0) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            await Promise.resolve(codebolt.chat.sendMessage(message));
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Failed to send final chat message:', error);
        }
    }

    private async getPendingAsyncTasks(): Promise<any[]> {
        try {
            const response = await Promise.resolve((codebolt as any).asyncTask.listTasks({
                scope: 'current_run',
            }));
            const tasks = Array.isArray((response as any)?.tasks) ? (response as any).tasks : [];
            return tasks.filter((task: any) =>
                task &&
                task.lifetime !== 'detached' &&
                !['completed', 'failed', 'stopped'].includes(task.status),
            );
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[ResponseExecutor] Failed to check async tasks before completion:', error);
            return [];
        }
    }

    private extractCompletionMessage(toolInput: Record<string, unknown>): string | undefined {
        if ('result' in toolInput) {
            return this.formatCompletionValue(toolInput['result']);
        }

        return this.formatCompletionValue(toolInput);
    }

    private formatCompletionValue(value: unknown): string | undefined {
        if (typeof value === 'string') {
            return value;
        }

        if (value === undefined || value === null) {
            return undefined;
        }

        if (typeof value !== 'object') {
            return String(value);
        }

        const valueRecord = value as Record<string, unknown>;
        for (const key of ['answer', 'message', 'content', 'text', 'output', 'result']) {
            const nestedValue = valueRecord[key];
            if (typeof nestedValue === 'string' && nestedValue.trim().length > 0) {
                return nestedValue;
            }
        }

        try {
            return JSON.stringify(value, null, 2);
        } catch {
            return String(value);
        }
    }

    private async executeSingleToolCall(
        toolCall: ParsedToolCall,
        input: ResponseInput,
    ): Promise<SingleToolExecutionResult> {
        try {
            let resultTuple: [boolean, unknown];
            if (toolCall.toolName === 'codebolt--thread_management') {
                resultTuple = [
                    false,
                    await codebolt.thread.createThreadInBackground({
                        title: String(toolCall.toolInput['title'] || toolCall.toolInput['task'] || 'Background Thread'),
                        description: String(toolCall.toolInput['description'] || toolCall.toolInput['task'] || ''),
                        userMessage: String(toolCall.toolInput['task'] || toolCall.toolInput['userMessage'] || ''),

                        isGrouped: Boolean(toolCall.toolInput['isGrouped']),
                        ...(typeof toolCall.toolInput['groupId'] === 'string'

import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import { threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { stopCommandProcess, waitCommandProcess, readCommandProcessOutput } from '../sockets/aiTerminal';
import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskRecord, AsyncTaskScope } from './asyncTaskRegistry.cli';

const DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 1000;
const MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

type AsyncTaskAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

function normalizeTimeoutMs(value: unknown): number {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        return DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    }
    return Math.min(Math.floor(value), MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

function inferTaskParts(taskId: string): { type?: string; resourceId?: string } {
    const separatorIndex = taskId.indexOf(':');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return {};
    }
    return {
        type: taskId.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        resourceId: taskId.slice(separatorIndex + 1),
    };
}

function formatResponse(type: string, success: boolean, data: Record<string, any>, error?: string) {
    return {
        type,
        success,
        ...data,
        error,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
}

async function stopThreadTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const threadId = task.metadata?.threadId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId;
    if (!threadId) {
        return { success: false, error: `Cannot infer thread id for task ${task.taskId}` };
    }

    const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(threadId, false);
    await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped thread task ${threadId}`,
        metadata: { stoppedCount },
    });

    return { success: true, stoppedCount };
}

async function stopCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = stopCommandProcess(processId);
    if (!result.success) {
        return result;
    }

    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped command process ${processId}`,
    });
    return result;
}

async function waitCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord, timeoutMs: number) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = await waitCommandProcess(processId, { timeoutMs });

    if (result.process) {
        const status = result.process.status === 'done'
            ? 'completed'
            : result.process.status === 'failed'
                ? 'failed'
                : result.process.status === 'stopped'
                    ? 'stopped'
                    : task.status;
        asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
            status,
            summary: result.error || task.summary,
            metadata: { commandRecord: result.process },
        });
    }

    const output = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, { lines: 80, tailBytes: 64 * 1024 });
    return {
        completed: result.success,
        task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(task.taskId),
        output: output.output,
        error: result.error,
    };
}

import agentProcessManager from '../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import { threadFileStore } from '../stores/threadFileStore';
import { stopCommandProcess, waitCommandProcess, readCommandProcessOutput } from '../sockets/aiTerminal';
import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskRecord, AsyncTaskScope } from './asyncTaskRegistry.cli';

const DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30 * 1000;
const MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;

type AsyncTaskAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

function normalizeTimeoutMs(value: unknown): number {
    if (typeof value !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
        return DEFAULT_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS;
    }
    return Math.min(Math.floor(value), MAX_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS);
}

function inferTaskParts(taskId: string): { type?: string; resourceId?: string } {
    const separatorIndex = taskId.indexOf(':');
    if (separatorIndex === -1) {
        return {};
    }
    return {
        type: taskId.slice(0, separatorIndex),
        resourceId: taskId.slice(separatorIndex + 1),
    };
}

function formatResponse(type: string, success: boolean, data: Record<string, any>, error?: string) {
    return {
        type,
        success,
        ...data,
        error,
        timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
}

async function stopThreadTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const threadId = task.metadata?.threadId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId;
    if (!threadId) {
        return { success: false, error: `Cannot infer thread id for task ${task.taskId}` };
    }

    const stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessesByThreadId(threadId, false);
    await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped thread task ${threadId}`,
        metadata: { stoppedCount },
    });

    return { success: true, stoppedCount };
}

async function stopCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = stopCommandProcess(processId);
    if (!result.success) {
        return result;
    }

    asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
        status: 'stopped',
        summary: `Stopped command process ${processId}`,
    });
    return result;
}

async function waitCommandTask(task: AsyncTaskRecord, timeoutMs: number) {
    const processId = Number(task.metadata?.processId || inferTaskParts(task.taskId).resourceId);
    const result = await waitCommandProcess(processId, { timeoutMs });

    if (result.process) {
        const status = result.process.status === 'done'
            ? 'completed'
            : result.process.status === 'failed'
                ? 'failed'
                : result.process.status === 'stopped'
                    ? 'stopped'
                    : task.status;
        asyncTaskRegistry.updateTask(task.taskId, {
            status,
            summary: result.error || task.summary,
            metadata: { commandRecord: result.process },
        });
    }

    const output = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, { lines: 80, tailBytes: 64 * 1024 });
    return {
        completed: result.success,
        task: asyncTaskRegistry.getTask(task.taskId),
        output: output.output,
        error: result.error,
    };
}

import logger from '../utils/appLogger';

export type AsyncTaskType = 'thread' | 'command' | 'action_block' | 'remote_job';
export type AsyncTaskStatus = 'running' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'stopped';
export type AsyncTaskLifetime = 'run_scoped' | 'detached';
export type AsyncTaskExecutionMode = 'foreground' | 'auto' | 'background';
export type AsyncTaskKind = 'finite' | 'long_running' | 'unknown';
export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';

export interface AsyncTaskRecord {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    status: AsyncTaskStatus;
    lifetime: AsyncTaskLifetime;
    executionMode?: AsyncTaskExecutionMode;
    taskKind?: AsyncTaskKind;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    startedAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    endedAt?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface AsyncTaskListInput {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

export interface AsyncTaskRegisterInput {
    taskId: string;
    type: AsyncTaskType;
    ownerThreadId?: string;
    ownerAgentId?: string;
    ownerAgentInstanceId?: string;
    title?: string;
    summary?: string;
    lifetime?: AsyncTaskLifetime;
    executionMode?: AsyncTaskExecutionMode;
    taskKind?: AsyncTaskKind;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

type AsyncTaskWaiter = {
    resolve: (record: AsyncTaskRecord) => void;
    timeoutId?: NodeJS.Timeout;
};

const FINAL_STATUSES = new Set<AsyncTaskStatus>(['completed', 'failed', 'stopped']);
const MAX_TASKS = 500;

function nowIso(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
}

class AsyncTaskRegistry {
    private readonly tasks = new Map<string, AsyncTaskRecord>();
    private readonly waiters = new Map<string, AsyncTaskWaiter[]>();

    registerTask(input: AsyncTaskRegisterInput): AsyncTaskRecord {
        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const existing = this.tasks.get(input.taskId);
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...(existing || {}),
            taskId: input.taskId,
            type: input.type,
            status: existing?.status && !FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status) ? existing.status : 'running',
            lifetime: input.lifetime || existing?.lifetime || 'run_scoped',
            executionMode: input.executionMode || existing?.executionMode,
            taskKind: input.taskKind || existing?.taskKind || 'unknown',
            ownerThreadId: input.ownerThreadId || existing?.ownerThreadId,
            ownerAgentId: input.ownerAgentId || existing?.ownerAgentId,
            ownerAgentInstanceId: input.ownerAgentInstanceId || existing?.ownerAgentInstanceId,
            startedAt: existing?.startedAt || timestamp,
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            title: input.title || existing?.title,
            summary: input.summary || existing?.summary,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing?.metadata || {}),
                ...(input.metadata || {}),
            },
        };

        this.tasks.set(input.taskId, record);
        this.prune();
        return { ...record };
    }

    updateTask(taskId: string, updates: Partial<AsyncTaskRecord>): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return undefined;
        }

        const timestamp = nowIso();
        const status = updates.status || existing.status;
        const record: AsyncTaskRecord = {
            ...existing,
            ...updates,
            metadata: {
                ...(existing.metadata || {}),
                ...(updates.metadata || {}),
            },
            updatedAt: timestamp,
            endedAt: FINAL_STATUSES.has(status) ? updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt || timestamp : updates.endedAt || existing.endedAt,
        };

        this.tasks.set(taskId, record);
        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(record.status)) {
            this.resolveWaiters(record);
        }
        return { ...record };
    }

    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        return record ? { ...record } : undefined;
    }

    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';
        return Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => input.includeCompleted || !FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .filter(task => {
                if (scope === 'all') {
                    return true;
                }
                if (scope === 'current_run') {
                    return Boolean(
                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&
                        (!input.agentId || task.ownerAgentId === input.agentId) &&
                        (!input.agentInstanceId || task.ownerAgentInstanceId === input.agentInstanceId),
                    );
                }
                return !input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId;
            })
            .sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt.localeCompare(left.updatedAt))
            .map(task => ({ ...task }));
    }

    detachTask(taskId: string, reason?: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        return this.updateTask(taskId, {
            lifetime: 'detached',
            summary: reason || 'Task detached from the owning agent run.',
        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),
            };

            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
                this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters.filter(existingWaiter => existingWaiter !== waiter));
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    task: this.getTask(taskId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for task ${taskId}`,
                });
            }, timeoutMs);

            const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
            waiters.push(waiter);
            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
        });
    }

    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
        if (!waiters?.length) {
            return;
        }

        this.waiters.delete(record.taskId);
        for (const waiter of waiters) {
            if (waiter.timeoutId) {
                clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
            }
            waiter.resolve(record);
        }
    }

    private prune(): void {
        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
            return;
        }

        const completedTasks = Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .sort((left, right) => left.updatedAt.localeCompare(right.updatedAt));

        for (const task of completedTasks) {
            if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
                return;
            }
            this.tasks.delete(task.taskId);
            logger.debug(`[AsyncTaskRegistry] Pruned task ${task.taskId}`);
        }
    }
}

export const asyncTaskRegistry = new AsyncTaskRegistry();
export { FINAL_STATUSES as FINAL_ASYNC_TASK_STATUSES };
]]></tool_result>

        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const waiter: AsyncTaskWaiter = {
                resolve: (record) => resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...record } }),
            };

            waiter.timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
                const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
                this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters.filter(existingWaiter => existingWaiter !== waiter));
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    task: this.getTask(taskId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for task ${taskId}`,
                });
            }, timeoutMs);

            const waiters = this.waiters.get(taskId) || [];
            waiters.push(waiter);
            this.waiters.set(taskId, waiters);
        });
    }

    private resolveWaiters(record: AsyncTaskRecord): void {
        const waiters = this.waiters.get(record.taskId);
        if (!waiters?.length) {
            return;
        }

        this.waiters.delete(record.taskId);
        for (const waiter of waiters) {
            if (waiter.timeoutId) {
                clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
            }
            waiter.resolve(record);
        }
    }

    private prune(): void {
        if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
            return;
        }

        const completedTasks = Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .sort((left, right) => left.updatedAt.localeCompare(right.updatedAt));

        for (const task of completedTasks) {
            if (this.tasks.size <= MAX_TASKS) {
                return;
            }
            this.tasks.delete(task.taskId);
            logger.debug(`[AsyncTaskRegistry] Pruned task ${task.taskId}`);
        }
    }
}

export const asyncTaskRegistry = new AsyncTaskRegistry();
export { FINAL_STATUSES as FINAL_ASYNC_TASK_STATUSES };

/**
 * Thread SDK Function Types
 * Types for the threadService module functions
 */

// Base response interface for thread operations
export interface BaseThreadSDKResponse {
  success?: boolean;
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * File change entry in a thread
 */
export interface ThreadFileChange {
  filePath: string;
  changeType: 'created' | 'modified' | 'deleted' | 'renamed';
  oldPath?: string;
  additions?: number;
  deletions?: number;
  content?: string;
}

/**
 * Thread file changes response
 */
export interface ThreadFileChangesResponse extends BaseThreadSDKResponse {
  threadId?: string;
  changes?: ThreadFileChange[];
  totalChanges?: number;
}

/**
 * Thread file changes summary for ChangesSummaryPanel
 */
export interface ThreadFileChangesSummaryResponse extends BaseThreadSDKResponse {
  threadId?: string;
  title?: string;
  changes?: number;
  files?: string[];
  summary?: string;
}

/**
 * Thread creation options
 */
export interface CreateThreadOptions {
  title?: string;
  description?: string;
  agentId?: string;
  parentThreadId?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
}

export interface ThreadFlagContext {
  user?: string[];
  project?: string[];
  thread?: string[];
  effective?: string[];
}

/**
 * Options for creating and starting a thread in one operation
 */
export interface CreateAndStartThreadOptions extends CreateThreadOptions {
  autoStart?: boolean;
  userMessage?: string;
  selectedAgent?: unknown;
  mentionedAgents?: unknown[];
  mentionedMCPs?: unknown[];
  mentionedFlags?: string[];
  flags?: ThreadFlagContext;
  source?: string;
  isFromPortal?: boolean;
  /** If true, creates a remote environment and starts the agent there. If false/undefined, runs locally. */
  remoteEnv?: boolean;
  /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. If not specified, the first available provider is used. */
  environmentProvider?: {
    name: string;
    unique_id?: string;
    providerId?: string;
  };
  /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
  environmentName?: string;
  /** If true, wait for the started thread to complete before resolving. Defaults to false. */
  waitForCompletion?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Options for getting thread details
 */
export interface GetThreadDetailOptions {
  threadId: string;
  includeMessages?: boolean;
  includeMetadata?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Options for getting thread list
 */
export interface GetThreadListOptions {
  status?: string;
  agentId?: string;
  limit?: number;
  offset?: number;
  startDate?: string;
  endDate?: string;
  metadata?: Record<string, unknown>;
  search?: string;
  sortBy?: string;
  sortOrder?: 'asc' | 'desc';
}

/**
 * Options for getting thread messages
 */
export interface GetThreadMessagesOptions {
  threadId: string;
  limit?: number;
]]></tool_result>

    createAndStartThread: async (options: CreateAndStartThreadOptions): Promise<StartThreadResponse> => {

        };

/**
 * Execute Command Tool - Executes shell commands
 * Wraps the SDK's cbterminal.executeCommand() method
 */

import type {
    ToolInvocation,
    ToolResult,
    ToolCallConfirmationDetails,
    ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails,
} from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind, ToolConfirmationOutcome } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';
import cbchat from '../../modules/chat';
import { isCodeboltCommand, executeCodeboltCommand } from '../pseudo-cli';

/**
 * Parameters for the ExecuteCommand tool
 */
export interface ExecuteCommandToolParams {
    /**
     * One sentence explanation of why this tool is being used
     */
    explanation?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command to execute
     */
    command?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command split into physical shell lines.
     * Prefer this for heredocs and other multiline shell constructs.
     */
    command_lines?: string[];

    /**
     * Whether to return empty string on success (default: false)
     */
    return_empty_on_success?: boolean;

    /**
     * How the command should be managed.
     */
    execution_mode?: 'auto' | 'foreground' | 'background';

    /**
     * Milliseconds to wait in auto/background mode before returning a running process.
     */
    yield_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Optional hard timeout for foreground command execution.
     */
    timeout_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Whether auto mode should keep the process alive after yield.
     */
    background_on_yield?: boolean;

    /**
     * Runtime lifetime. run_scoped tasks are killed on user force-stop; detached tasks survive.
     */
    lifetime?: 'run_scoped' | 'detached';

    /**
     * Expected command kind.
     */
    task_kind?: 'finite' | 'long_running' | 'unknown';
}

class ExecuteCommandToolInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    ExecuteCommandToolParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: ExecuteCommandToolParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    override async shouldConfirmExecute(
        _abortSignal: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<ToolCallConfirmationDetails | false> {
        const command = this.getCommand();

        // Codebolt pseudo-CLI commands don't need confirmation
        if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Extract root command for confirmation
        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {
                // Callback handled by the framework
            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                    backgroundOnYield: this.params.background_on_yield,
                    lifetime: this.params.lifetime,
                    taskKind: this.params.task_kind,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is running in the background: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${processId ? `\nAsync Task ID: command:${processId}` : ''}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}\n\nThis command is run_scoped unless it was explicitly started with lifetime="detached". Use async_task_control with action "wait", "stop", or "detach" before completing if this command is still running.`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,

            }

            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {

            }

                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

        }
        return this.params.command ?? '';
    }

        // Ensure output is a string
        const outputStr = typeof output === 'string' ? output : JSON.stringify(output);
        if (outputStr.length <= maxLength) return outputStr;
        return outputStr.substring(0, maxLength) + '...';
    }

    timeout_ms?: number;

     */

     */
    lifetime?: 'run_scoped' | 'detached';

    task_kind?: 'finite' | 'long_running' | 'unknown';
}

        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {

            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {

                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,

import cbws from '../core/websocket';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';
export type AsyncTaskControlAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

export interface AsyncTaskListOptions {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

export interface AsyncTaskControlOptions {
    taskId: string;
    action: AsyncTaskControlAction;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    reason?: string;
}

function sendAsyncTaskRequest<T>(action: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {
    const requestId = randomUUID();
    return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<T>(
        {
            type: `asyncTask.${action}`,
            action,
            requestId,
            params,
        },
        `asyncTask.${action}Response`,
    );
}

const asyncTask = {
    listTasks: (options: AsyncTaskListOptions = {}) =>
        sendAsyncTaskRequest<any>('list', options as unknown as Record<string, unknown>),

    controlTask: (options: AsyncTaskControlOptions) =>
        sendAsyncTaskRequest<any>('control', options as unknown as Record<string, unknown>),
};

export default asyncTask;
]]></tool_result>

/**
