                statusCode,
                cleanedBuffer.slice(-64 * 1024),
            );
            if (notifyUser) updateProcessStateInUi(exitMessage);

            safeResolve({
                result: cleanedBuffer || '',
                formattedResult: formattedResult || '',
                type: resultType,
                status_code: statusCode,
                processId: ptyProcess.pid
            });

            // Clean up process entry and close terminal in UI
            closeLogBuffer(ptyProcess.pid);
            setTimeout(() => {
                const entry = getProcessByPid(ptyProcess.pid);
                if (entry) {
                    removeProcessFromIndexes(entry);
                    terminalProcess = terminalProcess.filter(tp => tp.ptyTerminalProcess.pid !== ptyProcess.pid);
                }
                closeTerminal(ptyProcess.pid);
            }, 1000);
        });

        let message = {
            eventType: 'console',
            type: 'command',
            message: `Executing command ${command} View Logs.`,
            processId: ptyProcess.pid,
            command,
            status: TerminalProcessStatus.Executing,
            stateEvent: 'accepted',
            messageId: activeMessageId,
            agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
            agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
            parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
            threadId,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        }

        if (notifyUser) {
            subscriberToProcessStopped(message).then(async (data: any) => {
                if (commandCompleted) return;

                buffer += `User stopped the process for command : ${command}\n`;
                let stoppedMessage = {
                    eventType: 'console',
                    message: `${command} Stopped  View Logs.`,
                    processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                    type: 'command',
                    command,
                    status: TerminalProcessStatus.Stopped,
                    messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
                    agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                    parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                    parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                    threadId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                }

                stoppedMessage.status = TerminalProcessStatus.Stopped;
                safeResolve({ result: buffer || '', type: 'commandError', status_code: 1, processId: ptyProcess.pid });

                if (notifyUser)
                    updateProcessStateInUi(stoppedMessage)
                terminatePtyProcessById(ptyProcess.pid)
            }).catch((error) => {
                cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.TOOL_EXECUTION, 'error', {
                    message: 'Error in process stop subscriber',
                    tool_name: 'terminal',
                    tool_type: 'terminal',
                    operation: 'execute',
                    parameters: {},
                    success: false,
                });
                safeReject(error);
            });
        }

        if (notifyUser)
            updateProcessStateInUi(message)

        updateTerminalProcessStatus(ptyProcess.pid, 'executing');
        updateTerminalProcessCommand(ptyProcess.pid, command);

        const sendYieldOverridePrompt = () => {
            if (!notifyUser || commandCompleted || isResolved || !isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
                return;
            }

            const overrideMessage = {
                eventType: 'console',

                processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                type: 'command',
                command,
                status: TerminalProcessStatus.LongRunningProcessStarted,
                messageId: activeMessageId,
                threadId,
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,

                formattedResult: formattedResult || '',
                type: resultType,
                status_code: statusCode,
                processId: ptyProcess.pid
            });

            // Clean up process entry and close terminal in UI
            closeLogBuffer(ptyProcess.pid);
            setTimeout(() => {
                const entry = getProcessByPid(ptyProcess.pid);
                if (entry) {
                    removeProcessFromIndexes(entry);
                    terminalProcess = terminalProcess.filter(tp => tp.ptyTerminalProcess.pid !== ptyProcess.pid);
                }
                closeTerminal(ptyProcess.pid);
            }, 1000);
        });

        let message = {
            eventType: 'console',
            type: 'command',
            message: `Executing command ${command} View Logs.`,
            processId: ptyProcess.pid,
            command,
            status: TerminalProcessStatus.Executing,
            stateEvent: 'accepted',
            messageId: activeMessageId,
            agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
            agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
            parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
            threadId,
            timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
        }

        if (notifyUser) {
            subscriberToProcessStopped(message).then(async (data: any) => {
                if (commandCompleted) return;

                buffer += `User stopped the process for command : ${command}\n`;
                let stoppedMessage = {
                    eventType: 'console',
                    message: `${command} Stopped  View Logs.`,
                    processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                    type: 'command',
                    command,
                    status: TerminalProcessStatus.Stopped,
                    messageId: finalMessage.messageId,
                    agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                    parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                    parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                    threadId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                }

                stoppedMessage.status = TerminalProcessStatus.Stopped;
                safeResolve({ result: buffer || '', type: 'commandError', status_code: 1, processId: ptyProcess.pid });

                if (notifyUser)
                    updateProcessStateInUi(stoppedMessage)
                terminatePtyProcessById(ptyProcess.pid)
            }).catch((error) => {
                cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.TOOL_EXECUTION, 'error', {
                    message: 'Error in process stop subscriber',
                    tool_name: 'terminal',
                    tool_type: 'terminal',
                    operation: 'execute',
                    parameters: {},
                    success: false,
                });
                safeReject(error);
            });
        }

        if (notifyUser)
            updateProcessStateInUi(message)

        updateTerminalProcessStatus(ptyProcess.pid, 'executing');
        updateTerminalProcessCommand(ptyProcess.pid, command);

        const sendYieldOverridePrompt = () => {
            if (!notifyUser || commandCompleted || isResolved || !isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
                return;
            }

            const overrideMessage = {
                eventType: 'console',
                message: `${command} is still running. You can run it in the background now, or it will continue automatically after the yield window.`,
                processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                type: 'command',
                command,
                status: TerminalProcessStatus.LongRunningProcessStarted,
                messageId: activeMessageId,
                threadId,
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                yieldPending: true,
            };
            overrideMessage["templateType"] = TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION;

            sendTerminalConfirmation(overrideMessage).then((response) => {
                if (commandCompleted) return;
                if (response === 'runinbackground') {
                    resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, 'user_override');
                    subscriberToProcessStopped(overrideMessage).then(async (data: any) => {
                        terminatePtyProcessById(data.processId);
                    });
                } else if (response === 'noclose' || response === 'commandfailed') {
                    terminatePtyProcessById(ptyProcess.pid);
                    safeResolve({
                        result: buffer || '',
                        type: 'commandError',
                        status_code: response === 'commandfailed' ? 1 : 124,
                        processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                    });
                }
            }).catch((error) => {
                logger.warn(`[executeCommandInShell] Yield override prompt failed: ${error}`);
            });
        };

        if (isForegroundScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
            foregroundWaitTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, 'foreground_timeout');
            }, effectiveForegroundWaitMs);
        }

        if (isBackgroundMode(executionOptions.executionMode) || isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
            if (isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
                uiOverrideTimer = setTimeout(sendYieldOverridePrompt, Math.min(DEFAULT_UI_YIELD_OVERRIDE_MS, effectiveYieldMs));
            }
            yieldTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, isBackgroundMode(executionOptions.executionMode) ? 'explicit_background' : 'yield_timeout');
            }, effectiveYieldMs);
        }

        // Port scanner for detecting long-running servers
        portScannerService.start();
        initialOpenPorts = await portScannerService.getInitialPorts();

        // Port scanning interval to detect long-running servers

                safeReject(error);
            });
        }

        if (notifyUser)
            updateProcessStateInUi(message)

        updateTerminalProcessStatus(ptyProcess.pid, 'executing');
        updateTerminalProcessCommand(ptyProcess.pid, command);

        const sendYieldOverridePrompt = () => {
            if (!notifyUser || commandCompleted || isResolved || !isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
                return;
            }

            const overrideMessage = {
                eventType: 'console',
                message: `${command} is still running. You can run it in the background now, or it will continue automatically after the yield window.`,
                processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                type: 'command',
                command,
                status: TerminalProcessStatus.LongRunningProcessStarted,
                messageId: activeMessageId,
                threadId,
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                yieldPending: true,
            };
            overrideMessage["templateType"] = TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION;

            sendTerminalConfirmation(overrideMessage).then((response) => {
                if (commandCompleted) return;
                if (response === 'runinbackground') {
                    resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, 'user_override');
                    subscriberToProcessStopped(overrideMessage).then(async (data: any) => {
                        terminatePtyProcessById(data.processId);
                    });
                } else if (response === 'noclose' || response === 'commandfailed') {
                    terminatePtyProcessById(ptyProcess.pid);
                    safeResolve({
                        result: buffer || '',
                        type: 'commandError',
                        status_code: response === 'commandfailed' ? 1 : 124,
                        processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                    });
                }
            }).catch((error) => {
                logger.warn(`[executeCommandInShell] Yield override prompt failed: ${error}`);
            });
        };

        if (isForegroundScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {
            foregroundWaitTimer = setTimeout(() => {

            if (isAutoScoped(executionOptions.executionMode)) {

            yieldTimer = setTimeout(() => {
                resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, isBackgroundMode(executionOptions.executionMode) ? 'explicit_background' : 'yield_timeout');
            }, effectiveYieldMs);
        }

        // Port scanner for detecting long-running servers
        portScannerService.start();
        initialOpenPorts = await portScannerService.getInitialPorts();

        // Port scanning interval to detect long-running servers
        intervalId = setInterval(async () => {
            if (isResolved) {
                clearInterval(intervalId);
                return;
            }

            const finalOpenPorts = portScannerService.getCurrentPorts();
            const portOpenedByCommand = finalOpenPorts.find(port => !initialOpenPorts.includes(port));

            if (portOpenedByCommand && portOpenedByCommand <= 9999) {
                clearInterval(intervalId);
                stopTaskLoop();
                stateService.addToAgentState('ports', portOpenedByCommand, 'array');

                let portMessage = {
                    eventType: 'console',
                    message: `${command} started a server on port ${portOpenedByCommand}. View Logs.`,
                    processId: ptyProcess.pid,
                    type: 'command',
                    command,
                    status: TerminalProcessStatus.LongRunningProcessStarted,
                    messageId: activeMessageId,
                    threadId,
                    agentInstanceId: finalMessage.agentInstanceId,
                    agentId: finalMessage.agentId,
                    parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage.parentAgentInstanceId,
                    parentId: finalMessage.parentId,
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
                    port: portOpenedByCommand,
                }
                portMessage.status = TerminalProcessStatus.LongRunningProcessStarted
                portMessage["templateType"] = TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION
                portMessage.messageId = activeMessageId;
                resolveAsRunning(ptyProcess, 'port_detected', portOpenedByCommand);
                subscriberToProcessStopped(portMessage).then(async (data: any) => {
                    terminatePtyProcessById(data.processId)
                })
                return;
            }
        }, COMMAND_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS);

        // Clean up timeout when promise resolves
        const originalSafeResolve = safeResolve;
        safeResolve = (result: any) => {
            if (yieldTimer) clearTimeout(yieldTimer);
            if (uiOverrideTimer) clearTimeout(uiOverrideTimer);
            if (foregroundWaitTimer) clearTimeout(foregroundWaitTimer);
            if (intervalId) clearInterval(intervalId);
            originalSafeResolve(result);
        };

        const originalSafeReject = safeReject;
        safeReject = (error: any) => {
            if (yieldTimer) clearTimeout(yieldTimer);
            if (uiOverrideTimer) clearTimeout(uiOverrideTimer);
            if (foregroundWaitTimer) clearTimeout(foregroundWaitTimer);
            if (intervalId) clearInterval(intervalId);
            originalSafeReject(error);
        };

// websocketManager.js

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';

export const messageEmitter = new EventEmitter();

export function subscriberToMessage(messageData) {
    const messageId = messageData.messageId;
    logger.debug(`Setting up subscriber for messageId: ${messageId}`);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        // Create a handler function that we can reference for removal
        const messageHandler = (response) => {
            logger.debug(`Received response for messageId: ${messageId}`);
            messageEmitter.removeListener(messageId, messageHandler);
            resolve(response);
        };

        // Register the event handler
        messageEmitter.on(messageId, messageHandler);

        logger.debug(`Subscriber setup completed for messageId: ${messageId}`);
    });
}

export function subscriberToProcessStopped(messageData) {
    const messageId = messageData.messageId;
    logger.debug(`Setting up process stopped subscriber for messageId: ${messageId}`);

    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
        // Create a handler function that we can reference for removal
        const messageHandler = (response) => {
            if (response.type == "stopTerminalProcess") {
                logger.debug(`Received process stopped for messageId: ${messageId}`);
                messageEmitter.removeListener(messageId, messageHandler);
                resolve(response.message);
            }
        };

        // Register the event handler
        messageEmitter.on(messageId, messageHandler);

        logger.debug(`Process stopped subscriber setup completed for messageId: ${messageId}`);
    });
}

export function handleIncomingMessage(data) {
    try {
        const parsedData = JSON.parse(data);
        const messageId = parsedData?.messageId || parsedData.message?.messageId;

        if (messageId) {
            const listenerCount = messageEmitter.listenerCount(messageId);
            logger.debug(`Emitting event for messageId: ${messageId}, type: ${parsedData.type || 'unknown type'}, listeners: ${listenerCount}`);
            if (parsedData.type === 'confirmationResponse') {
                console.log(`[handleIncomingMessage] confirmationResponse messageId=${messageId} userMessage=${parsedData.message?.userMessage} listeners=${listenerCount}`);
            }
            // Emit the message to resolve the promise
            messageEmitter.emit(messageId, parsedData);
        } else {
            logger.log("warn", `Received message without messageId: ${JSON.stringify(parsedData).substring(0, 100)}...`);
        }
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Error parsing incoming message: ${error}`);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

export async function sendTerminalConfirmation(message): Promise<string | undefined> {

    let messageData = {
        type: WebSocketMessageType.ConfirmationRequest,
        actionType: WebSocketMessageType.ConfirmationRequest,
        content: message,
        sender: SenderEnum.Agent,
        data: { text: message, buttons: [] },
        payload: message,
        messageId: message.messageId, // Ensure this is a unique ID
        threadId: message.threadId,
        templateType: TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION,
        agentInstanceId: message.agentInstanceId,
        agentId: message.agentId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: message.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: message.parentId
    }

        const response = await subscriberToMessage(messageData);
        const parsedData: any = response
        if (parsedData?.message?.userMessage) {
            cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.GENERAL, 'debug', {
                message: `Received response in sendTerminalConfirmation: ${parsedData.message.userMessage}`,
            });
            return parsedData.message.userMessage;
        }
        cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.GENERAL, 'warn', {
            message: `No userMessage in sendTerminalConfirmation response`,
            error_type: 'missing_user_message',
        });
        return undefined;
    } catch (error) {
        cLogger.log(FocusedLogCategory.GENERAL, 'error', {
            message: `Error waiting for response in sendTerminalConfirmation: ${error}`,
            error_type: 'terminal_confirmation_error',
        });
        return undefined;
    }
}



export async function updateProcessStateInUi(message) {

        actionType: WebSocketMessageType.CommandStatusUpdate,
        content: message,
        sender: SenderEnum.Agent,

        parentAgentInstanceId: message.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: message.parentId
    });

}

  // Event handlers for process updates
  const handleProcessUpdate = useCallback((eventData: any) => {
    // Refetch processes when we get terminal-related events
    if (eventData.processId || eventData.payload?.processId) {
      if (fetchTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fetchTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      fetchTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 100);
    }
  }, [fetchActiveProcesses]);

  const handleSocketMessage = useCallback((message: any) => {
    // Refetch for terminal-related messages
    if (message.type === 'terminal' ||
      message.type === 'confirmationResponse' ||
      message.type === 'stopTerminalProcess' ||
      message.eventType === 'console' ||
      message.processId ||
      message.payload?.processId ||
      message.message?.processId) {

      // Emit process-specific events for CommandConfirmation components
      const processId = message.processId || message.payload?.processId || message.message?.processId;
      if (processId) {
        console.log(`ActiveProcessesListComponent: Emitting process-specific update for processId ${processId}`);
        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${processId}`, message as any);
        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', message as any);
      }

      if (fetchTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fetchTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      fetchTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 100);
    }
  }, [fetchActiveProcesses]);

  // Setup event listeners and initial fetch
  useEffect(() => {
    fetchActiveProcesses(true); // Initial fetch

    // Set up listeners
    ChatEventEmitter.on('SOCKET_CHAT_RECEIVED', handleSocketMessage);
    ChatComponentEventEmitter.on('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', handleProcessUpdate);

    // Set up periodic refresh for active processes (every 3 seconds)
    const refreshInterval = setInterval(() => {
      if (localProcesses.length > 0 || isExpanded) {
        fetchActiveProcesses(true);
      }
    }, 3000);

    // Cleanup function
    return () => {
      ChatEventEmitter.off('SOCKET_CHAT_RECEIVED', handleSocketMessage);
      ChatComponentEventEmitter.off('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', handleProcessUpdate);
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);

      if (fetchTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fetchTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [handleSocketMessage, handleProcessUpdate, localProcesses.length, isExpanded]);

  // Function to open terminal for a specific process
  const handleOpenTerminal = useCallback((process: TerminalProcess) => {
    if (api) {
      const panel = api.getPanel(ComponentType.Console);
      if (panel) {
        panel.focus();
      } else {
        api.addPanel({
          id: ComponentType.Console,
          component: ComponentType.Console,
          title: ComponentType.Console,
        });
      }
    }

    // Set the terminal ID to show this specific process
    setTerminalID({
      id: process.processId.toString(),
      processName: process.command || `Process ${process.processId}`,
    });
  }, [api, setTerminalID]);

  // Function to stop a specific process
  const handleStopProcess = useCallback(async (process: TerminalProcess) => {

    try {
      // Use the same WebSocket approach as CommandConfirmation component
      const inputJson = useInputStore.getState().inputJson;
      const messagePayload = {
        type: 'stopTerminalProcess',
        message: {
          ...inputJson,
          messageId: process.messageId || `stop-${process.processId}-${Date.now()}`, // Use existing messageId if available
          threadId: inputJson.threadId || 'default',
          userMessage: '',
          templateType: TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION,
          processId: process.processId,
          // Note: We don't have agent properties in this context, so we omit them
          // agentInstanceId, agentId, parentAgentInstanceId, parentId would be undefined
        },
      };

      console.log('Sending stop command via WebSocket:', messagePayload);
      ChatEventEmitter.emit('SOCKET_CHAT_SEND', messagePayload);

      // Emit immediate status update to notify CommandConfirmation components
      const statusUpdateMessage = {
        processId: process.processId,
        payload: {
          processId: process.processId,
          status: 'done',
          command: process.command,
          externalStop: true
        },
        status: 'done',
        externalStop: true
      };

      console.log(`ActiveProcessesListComponent: Emitting immediate status update for processId ${process.processId}`);
      ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
      ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);

      // Immediately refetch to update the UI
      setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 100);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping process via WebSocket:', error);

      // Fallback to REST API if WebSocket fails
      try {
        console.log('Falling back to REST API for process stop');
        const response = await fetch(`${window.env.backendUrl}/api/terminal-processes/stop-process/${process.processId}`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          console.log('Process stopped successfully via REST API');

          // Emit status update for REST API success as well
          const statusUpdateMessage = {
            processId: process.processId,
            payload: {
              processId: process.processId,
              status: 'done',
              command: process.command,
              externalStop: true
            },
            status: 'done',
            externalStop: true
          };

          ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
          ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);

          fetchActiveProcesses(true);
        } else {
          console.error('REST API fallback also failed:', await response.text());
        }
      } catch (apiError) {
        console.error('Both WebSocket and REST API approaches failed:', apiError);
      }
    }
  }, [fetchActiveProcesses]);

  // Function to stop all processes
  const handleStopAllProcesses = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      // Stop each process individually using the same WebSocket approach
      const inputJson = useInputStore.getState().inputJson;

      for (const process of localProcesses) {
        const messagePayload = {
          type: 'stopTerminalProcess',
          message: {
            ...inputJson,
            messageId: process.messageId || `stop-all-${process.processId}-${Date.now()}`, // Use existing messageId if available
            threadId: inputJson.threadId || 'default',
            userMessage: '',
            templateType: TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION,
            processId: process.processId,
          },
        };

        console.log(`Sending stop command for process ${process.processId} via WebSocket`);
        ChatEventEmitter.emit('SOCKET_CHAT_SEND', messagePayload);

        // Emit immediate status update for each process
        const statusUpdateMessage = {
          processId: process.processId,
          payload: {
            processId: process.processId,
            status: 'done',
            command: process.command,
            externalStop: true
          },
          status: 'done',
          externalStop: true
        };

        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);
      }

      // Refetch after a short delay to allow all processes to be stopped
      setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 500);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping all processes via WebSocket:', error);

      // Fallback to REST API
      try {
        console.log('Falling back to REST API for stop all processes');
        const response = await fetch(`${window.env.backendUrl}/api/terminal-processes/stop-all-processes`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          console.log('All processes stopped successfully via REST API');

          // Emit status updates for all processes after REST API success
          localProcesses.forEach(process => {
            const statusUpdateMessage = {
              processId: process.processId,
              payload: {
                processId: process.processId,
                status: 'done',
                command: process.command,
                externalStop: true
              },
              status: 'done',
              externalStop: true
            };

            ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
            ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);
          });

          fetchActiveProcesses(true);
        } else {
          console.error('REST API fallback for stop all also failed:', await response.text());
        }
      } catch (apiError) {
        console.error('Both WebSocket and REST API approaches failed for stop all:', apiError);
      }
    }

      ChatComponentEventEmitter.off('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', handleProcessUpdate);
      clearInterval(refreshInterval);

      if (fetchTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(fetchTimeoutRef.current);
      }
    };
  }, [handleSocketMessage, handleProcessUpdate, localProcesses.length, isExpanded]);

  // Function to open terminal for a specific process
  const handleOpenTerminal = useCallback((process: TerminalProcess) => {
    if (api) {
      const panel = api.getPanel(ComponentType.Console);
      if (panel) {
        panel.focus();
      } else {
        api.addPanel({
          id: ComponentType.Console,
          component: ComponentType.Console,
          title: ComponentType.Console,
        });
      }
    }

    // Set the terminal ID to show this specific process
    setTerminalID({
      id: process.processId.toString(),
      processName: process.command || `Process ${process.processId}`,
    });
  }, [api, setTerminalID]);

  // Function to stop a specific process
  const handleStopProcess = useCallback(async (process: TerminalProcess) => {

    try {
      // Use the same WebSocket approach as CommandConfirmation component
      const inputJson = useInputStore.getState().inputJson;
      const messagePayload = {
        type: 'stopTerminalProcess',
        message: {
          ...inputJson,
          messageId: process.messageId || `stop-${process.processId}-${Date.now()}`, // Use existing messageId if available
          threadId: inputJson.threadId || 'default',
          userMessage: '',
          templateType: TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION,
          processId: process.processId,
          // Note: We don't have agent properties in this context, so we omit them
          // agentInstanceId, agentId, parentAgentInstanceId, parentId would be undefined
        },
      };

      console.log('Sending stop command via WebSocket:', messagePayload);
      ChatEventEmitter.emit('SOCKET_CHAT_SEND', messagePayload);

      // Emit immediate status update to notify CommandConfirmation components
      const statusUpdateMessage = {
        processId: process.processId,
        payload: {
          processId: process.processId,
          status: 'done',
          command: process.command,
          externalStop: true
        },
        status: 'done',
        externalStop: true
      };

      console.log(`ActiveProcessesListComponent: Emitting immediate status update for processId ${process.processId}`);
      ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
      ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);

      // Immediately refetch to update the UI
      setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 100);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping process via WebSocket:', error);

      // Fallback to REST API if WebSocket fails
      try {
        console.log('Falling back to REST API for process stop');
        const response = await fetch(`${window.env.backendUrl}/api/terminal-processes/stop-process/${process.processId}`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          console.log('Process stopped successfully via REST API');

          // Emit status update for REST API success as well
          const statusUpdateMessage = {
            processId: process.processId,
            payload: {
              processId: process.processId,
              status: 'done',
              command: process.command,
              externalStop: true
            },
            status: 'done',
            externalStop: true
          };

          ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
          ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);

          fetchActiveProcesses(true);
        } else {
          console.error('REST API fallback also failed:', await response.text());
        }
      } catch (apiError) {
        console.error('Both WebSocket and REST API approaches failed:', apiError);
      }
    }
  }, [fetchActiveProcesses]);

  // Function to stop all processes
  const handleStopAllProcesses = useCallback(async () => {
    try {
      // Stop each process individually using the same WebSocket approach
      const inputJson = useInputStore.getState().inputJson;

      for (const process of localProcesses) {
        const messagePayload = {
          type: 'stopTerminalProcess',
          message: {
            ...inputJson,
            messageId: process.messageId || `stop-all-${process.processId}-${Date.now()}`, // Use existing messageId if available
            threadId: inputJson.threadId || 'default',
            userMessage: '',
            templateType: TemplateEnum.COMMANDCONFIRMATION,
            processId: process.processId,
          },
        };

        console.log(`Sending stop command for process ${process.processId} via WebSocket`);
        ChatEventEmitter.emit('SOCKET_CHAT_SEND', messagePayload);

        // Emit immediate status update for each process
        const statusUpdateMessage = {
          processId: process.processId,
          payload: {
            processId: process.processId,
            status: 'done',
            command: process.command,
            externalStop: true
          },
          status: 'done',
          externalStop: true
        };

        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
        ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);
      }

      // Refetch after a short delay to allow all processes to be stopped
      setTimeout(() => fetchActiveProcesses(true), 500);

    } catch (error) {
      console.error('Error stopping all processes via WebSocket:', error);

      // Fallback to REST API
      try {
        console.log('Falling back to REST API for stop all processes');
        const response = await fetch(`${window.env.backendUrl}/api/terminal-processes/stop-all-processes`, {
          method: 'POST',
          headers: {
            'Content-Type': 'application/json',
          },
        });

        if (response.ok) {
          console.log('All processes stopped successfully via REST API');

          // Emit status updates for all processes after REST API success
          localProcesses.forEach(process => {
            const statusUpdateMessage = {
              processId: process.processId,
              payload: {
                processId: process.processId,
                status: 'done',
                command: process.command,
                externalStop: true
              },
              status: 'done',
              externalStop: true
            };

            ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit(`process-${process.processId}`, statusUpdateMessage as any);
            ChatComponentEventEmitter.emit('TERMINAL_PROCESS_UPDATE', statusUpdateMessage as any);
          });

          fetchActiveProcesses(true);
        } else {
          console.error('REST API fallback for stop all also failed:', await response.text());
        }
      } catch (apiError) {
        console.error('Both WebSocket and REST API approaches failed for stop all:', apiError);
      }
    }
]]></tool_result>

function registerManagedCommand(
    processId: number,
    terminalId: string | number,
    command: string,
    finalMessage: any,
    executionOptions: CommandExecutionOptions,
): ManagedCommandRecord {
    const timestamp = nowIso();
    const existingRecord = commandRecords.get(processId);
    const record: ManagedCommandRecord = {
        ...(existingRecord || {}),
        processId,
        terminalId,
        command,
        status: existingRecord?.status || 'running',
        startedAt: existingRecord?.startedAt || timestamp,

        agentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage?.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage?.parentId,
    };

    commandRecords.set(processId, record);
    asyncTaskRegistry.registerTask({
        taskId: `command:${processId}`,
        type: 'command',
        ownerThreadId: record.threadId,
        ownerAgentId: record.agentId,
        ownerAgentInstanceId: record.agentInstanceId,
        title: command,
        summary: 'Managed terminal command is running.',
        executionMode: executionOptions.executionMode,
        metadata: {
            processId,
            terminalId,
            command,
            messageId: record.messageId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: record.parentAgentInstanceId,

    });

}

function pruneCommandRecords(): void {
    if (commandRecords.size <= MAX_COMMAND_RECORDS) {
        return;

    const records = Array.from(commandRecords.values())
        .filter(record => FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES.has(record.status))

    for (const record of records) {
        if (commandRecords.size <= MAX_COMMAND_RECORDS) {
            return;
        }
        commandRecords.delete(record.processId);
    }
}

): ManagedCommandRecord | undefined {
    const existingRecord = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!existingRecord) {

    const record: ManagedCommandRecord = {
        ...existingRecord,
        ...updates,

    commandRecords.set(processId, record);

    const waiters = commandWaiters.get(record.processId);

    setTimeout(() => {

        const entry = getProcessByPid(processId);

            terminalProcess = terminalProcess.filter(tp => tp.ptyTerminalProcess.pid !== processId);
            logger.info(`Removed process ${processId} from terminalProcess array and indexes`);
        }
    }, 1000);

    // Send a message to notify that the process has been terminated
    if (processMessageId) {
        // Emit a message to notify the frontend that the process has been stopped
        const messageEmitter = require('./socketManage').messageEmitter;
        messageEmitter.emit(processMessageId, {
            type: 'stopTerminalProcess',
            message: {
                processId: processId,
                status: 'done',
                messageId: processMessageId
            }
        });
    }

    closeTerminal(processId)
    if (!isProcessTerminated) {
        logger.warn(`No pty process found with ID ${processId}.`);
    }
}

// Handle uncaught exceptions like EPIPE
process.on('uncaughtException', (err: any) => {
    if (err.code === 'EPIPE') {
        logger.error('EPIPE error: Broken pipe detected');
    } else {
        logger.error('Uncaught exception:' + err);
    }
});

<message role="assistant" ordinal="629" timestamp="2026-07-07T09:19:35.859Z">
Two separate issues were happening.

First, the duplicate bottom “Command stopped” was just duplicate UI. The template had both:
- the top status badge
- a footer block for `Stopping/Stopped`

I removed the footer block, so status is shown only once in the header.

Second, I found a more important server bug in `getCommandExecutionOptions`.

For `codebolt.terminal.executeCommand(...)`, the WebSocket event shape is roughly:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
{
  type: "executeCommand",
  message: "echo started && sleep 1m ...",
  executionMode: "foreground_scoped",
  yieldMs: 10000,
  timeoutMs: 30000
}
]]></code_block>
But the server code was doing:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
const params = finalMessage?.params || finalMessage?.message || finalMessage || {};
]]></code_block>
Since `finalMessage.message` is the command string, it picked the string as `params` and ignored `executionMode`, `yieldMs`, and `timeoutMs` on the root object.

I fixed it to merge root fields correctly when `message` is just a string.

Now your command should respect:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
executionMode: "foreground_scoped",
yieldMs: 10000,
timeoutMs: 30000
]]></code_block>
Expected behavior after rebuild:
- command starts
- after 30s, if still running, it should become `Running in Background`
- it should not show `Stopping`
- it should not show the bottom duplicate stopped block

Validation: `npm run build --workspace=packages/server` passed.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="631" timestamp="2026-07-07T09:23:15.513Z">
They mean different wait budgets for different modes, but for `foreground_scoped` your example made it confusing because `yieldMs` is irrelevant there.

Recommended meaning:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
foreground_scoped:
  uses timeoutMs
  ignores yieldMs

auto_scoped:
  uses yieldMs
  ignores timeoutMs unless we want a hard max later

background_scoped:
  may use yieldMs only as startup log capture window, or can ignore it

background_detached:
  may use yieldMs only as startup log capture window, or can ignore it
]]></code_block>
So:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
executeCommand(command, {
  executionMode: "foreground_scoped",
  timeoutMs: 30000
})
]]></code_block>
means: wait up to 30s inline, then convert to `background_scoped`.
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
executeCommand(command, {
  executionMode: "auto_scoped",
  yieldMs: 3000
})
]]></code_block>
means: wait 3s inline, then convert to `background_scoped`.

For your command, this is enough:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
await codebolt.terminal.executeCommand(
  "echo started && sleep 1m && echo foreground_scoped",
  {
    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: true,
    executionMode: "foreground_scoped",
    timeoutMs: 30000,
  }
)
]]></code_block>
I think the tool schemas should say this clearly:
- `yield_ms`: only for `auto_scoped`
- `timeout_ms`: only for `foreground_scoped`

If you want an even cleaner API, we can rename both to one field:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
wait_ms
]]></code_block>
Then interpretation is simple:
- `foreground_scoped`: foreground max wait
- `auto_scoped`: auto yield wait
- background modes: startup capture wait

That may be better than exposing both `yieldMs` and `timeoutMs`.
</message>

const LOG_BUFFER_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 500;
const LOG_BUFFER_MAX_ENTRIES = 50;
const COMMAND_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 10000;
const DEFAULT_FOREGROUND_WAIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const DEFAULT_AUTO_YIELD_MS = 3000;
const DEFAULT_BACKGROUND_STARTUP_CAPTURE_MS = 250;
const DEFAULT_UI_YIELD_OVERRIDE_MS = 1000;

type CommandExecutionMode = AsyncTaskExecutionMode;

interface CommandExecutionOptions {
    executionMode: CommandExecutionMode;
    yieldMs?: number;
    timeoutMs?: number;
}

type ManagedCommandStatus = 'running' | 'executing' | 'background' | 'done' | 'failed' | 'stopped';

interface ManagedCommandRecord {
    processId: number;
    terminalId: string | number;
    command: string;
    status: ManagedCommandStatus;
    startedAt: string;
    updatedAt: string;
    endedAt?: string;
    exitCode?: number;
    outputTail?: string;
    messageId?: string;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    parentAgentInstanceId?: string;
    parentId?: string;
    yielded?: boolean;
    yieldReason?: string;
    port?: number;
    completionEventSent?: boolean;
}

type CommandWaiter = {
    resolve: (record: ManagedCommandRecord) => void;
    timeoutId?: NodeJS.Timeout;
};

const commandRecords = new Map<number, ManagedCommandRecord>();
const commandWaiters = new Map<number, CommandWaiter[]>();
const FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES = new Set<ManagedCommandStatus>(['done', 'failed', 'stopped']);
const DEFAULT_COMMAND_WAIT_TIMEOUT_MS = 10 * 60 * 1000;
const MAX_COMMAND_RECORDS = 200;

function nowIso(): string {
    return new Date().toISOString();
}

function normalizeManagedStatus(status: string): ManagedCommandStatus {
    if (status === 'executing'
        || status === 'background'
        || status === 'done'
        || status === 'failed'
        || status === 'stopped'
        || status === 'running') {
        return status;
    }

    if (status === TerminalProcessStatus.Done) return 'done';
    if (status === TerminalProcessStatus.Failed) return 'failed';
    if (status === TerminalProcessStatus.Stopped) return 'stopped';
    if (status === TerminalProcessStatus.Executing) return 'executing';
    return 'running';
}

function serializeCommandRecord(record: ManagedCommandRecord) {
    return { ...record };
}

function readCommandOutputTail(processId: number, lines = 80): string {
    const outputResult = readCommandProcessOutput(processId, {
        lines,
        tailBytes: 64 * 1024,
    });
    return outputResult.output || '';
}

function registerManagedCommand(
    processId: number,
    terminalId: string | number,
    command: string,
    finalMessage: any,
    executionOptions: CommandExecutionOptions,
): ManagedCommandRecord {
    const timestamp = nowIso();
    const existingRecord = commandRecords.get(processId);
    const record: ManagedCommandRecord = {
        ...(existingRecord || {}),
        processId,
        terminalId,
        command,
        status: existingRecord?.status || 'running',
        startedAt: existingRecord?.startedAt || timestamp,
        updatedAt: timestamp,
        messageId: finalMessage?.messageId,
        threadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
        agentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
        agentInstanceId: finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
        parentAgentInstanceId: finalMessage?.parentAgentInstanceId,
        parentId: finalMessage?.parentId,
    };

    commandRecords.set(processId, record);
    asyncTaskRegistry.registerTask({
        taskId: `command:${processId}`,
        type: 'command',
        ownerThreadId: record.threadId,
        ownerAgentId: record.agentId,
        ownerAgentInstanceId: record.agentInstanceId,
        title: command,
        summary: 'Managed terminal command is running.',
        executionMode: executionOptions.executionMode,
        metadata: {
            processId,
            terminalId,
            command,
            messageId: record.messageId,
            parentAgentInstanceId: record.parentAgentInstanceId,
            parentId: record.parentId,
        },
    });
    pruneCommandRecords();
    return record;
}

function pruneCommandRecords(): void {
    if (commandRecords.size <= MAX_COMMAND_RECORDS) {
        return;
    }

    const records = Array.from(commandRecords.values())
        .filter(record => FINAL_COMMAND_STATUSES.has(record.status))
        .sort((left, right) => left.updatedAt.localeCompare(right.updatedAt));

    for (const record of records) {
        if (commandRecords.size <= MAX_COMMAND_RECORDS) {
            return;
        }
        commandRecords.delete(record.processId);
    }
}

function updateManagedCommand(
    processId: number,
    updates: Partial<ManagedCommandRecord>,
): ManagedCommandRecord | undefined {
    const existingRecord = commandRecords.get(processId);
    if (!existingRecord) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const record: ManagedCommandRecord = {
        ...existingRecord,
        ...updates,
        updatedAt: nowIso(),
    };
    commandRecords.set(processId, record);
    return record;
}

function resolveCommandWaiters(record: ManagedCommandRecord): void {
    const waiters = commandWaiters.get(record.processId);
    if (!waiters?.length) {
        return;
    }

    commandWaiters.delete(record.processId);
    for (const waiter of waiters) {
        if (waiter.timeoutId) {
            clearTimeout(waiter.timeoutId);
        }
        waiter.resolve(record);
    }
}

async function emitBackgroundCommandCompletion(record: ManagedCommandRecord): Promise<void> {
    if (record.completionEventSent || !record.yielded || !record.agentId) {
        return;
    }

    record.completionEventSent = true;
    commandRecords.set(record.processId, record);

    const payloadData = {
        processId: record.processId,
        command: record.command,
        status: record.status,
        exitCode: record.exitCode,
        startedAt: record.startedAt,
        endedAt: record.endedAt,
        outputTail: record.outputTail,
        yieldReason: record.yieldReason,
        port: record.port,
    };

    try {
        await agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
            targetAgentId: record.agentId,
            targetAgentInstanceId: record.agentInstanceId,
            targetThreadId: record.threadId,
            eventType: AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
            priority: record.status === 'failed' ? AgentEventPriority.HIGH : AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
            payload: {
                type: 'custom',
                eventName: 'backgroundCommandCompletion',
                data: payloadData,
            },
            metadata: {
                source: 'terminal',
                processId: record.processId,
                command: record.command,
            },
        }, {
            agentId: 'system',
            threadId: record.threadId || 'terminal',
        });
    } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`Failed to emit background command completion for ${record.processId}: ${error}`);
    }
}

function finalizeManagedCommand(
    processId: number,
    status: ManagedCommandStatus,
    exitCode?: number,
    outputTail?: string,
): ManagedCommandRecord | undefined {
    const record = updateManagedCommand(processId, {

    }

const normalizeThreadFlagNames = (values: unknown): string[] => {
    const rawValues = Array.isArray(values)
        ? values
        : typeof values === 'string' && values.trim()
            ? [values]
            : [];

    return Array.from(new Set(rawValues
        .map((value) => flagService.normalizeFlagName(String(value)))
        .filter(Boolean)))
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
};

const CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS = new Set([
    'e2b-remote',
    'sprites-remote',
    'runloop-remote',
    'modal-remote',
    'daytona-remote',
]);

const isCloudRuntimeProviderId = (providerId?: string): boolean => {
    const normalized = String(providerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS.has(normalized) || normalized.startsWith('runner-node:');
};

const mergeThreadFlagNames = (...flagLists: Array<string[] | undefined>): string[] => {
    return normalizeThreadFlagNames(flagLists.flatMap((flags) => flags || []));
};

const resolveExistingEnvironmentId = (environment: unknown): string | undefined => {
    if (typeof environment === 'string') {
        return environment.trim() || undefined;
    }

    if (!environment || typeof environment !== 'object' || Array.isArray(environment)) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const record = environment as Record<string, any>;
    const nestedEnvironment = record.environment && typeof record.environment === 'object'
        ? record.environment as Record<string, any>
        : undefined;

    const id = record.id
        || record.environmentId
        || record.envId
        || record.value
        || nestedEnvironment?.id
        || nestedEnvironment?.environmentId;

    return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() ? id.trim() : undefined;
};

const buildThreadEnvironmentPayload = (environment: Environment): Record<string, any> => {
    const config = environment.config || {};
    const executionMode = config.executionMode;
    const projectPath =
        config.workspacePath ||
        config.worktreePath ||
        (environment as any).workspacePath ||
        config.environmentPath ||
        config.projectPath ||
        config.resolvedPath ||
        projectSetting.user_active_project_path;

    return {
        id: environment.id,
        name: environment.name,
        type: executionMode === 'local_thread_pool' ? 'local_thread_pool' : 'remote',
        executionMode,
        projectPath,
        workspacePath: config.workspacePath || projectPath,
        worktreePath: config.worktreePath,
        environmentPath: config.environmentPath,
        baseProjectPath: projectSetting.user_active_project_path,
    };
};

const normalizeIncomingFlagContext = (flags: Partial<FlagContext> | undefined, mentionedFlags: string[]): FlagContext | undefined => {
    if (!flags && mentionedFlags.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const userFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.user);
    const projectFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.project);
    const threadFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.thread, mentionedFlags);
    const effectiveFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.effective, userFlags, projectFlags, threadFlags, mentionedFlags);

    return {
        user: userFlags,
        project: projectFlags,
        thread: threadFlags,
        effective: effectiveFlags,
    };
};

const pruneCompletedThreadCompletions = (): void => {

        ...record,
        waiters: existing?.waiters || [],

    asyncTaskRegistry.registerTask({

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion = (threadId: string): Promise<ThreadCompletionResult> => {
    const completed = completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
    if (completed) {
        return Promise.resolve(completed);
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const existing = pendingThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
        if (existing) {
            existing.waiters.push(resolve);
            return;
        }

        pendingThreadCompletions.set(threadId, {
            threadId,
            activityId: 'activity-' + threadId,
            created: false,
            startedAt: nowIso(),
            waiters: [resolve],
        });
    });
};

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletionWithTimeout = async (
    threadId: string,
    timeoutMs = 30 * 1000,
): Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }> => {
    const boundedTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(timeoutMs, 5 * 60 * 1000));
    if (boundedTimeoutMs === 0) {
        return {
            completed: false,
            completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
            error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,

    }

    return Promise.race([
        waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion(threadId).then(completion => ({
            completed: true,
            completion,

        new Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }>((resolve) => {

};

const DEFAULT_THREAD_AUTO_YIELD_MS = 30 * 1000;

name: codebolt-electron-app-tester
description: Use whenever an agent needs to test a feature in the CodeBolt Electron desktop application. After implementing a feature or fixing a bug that affects the Electron app, the agent must call the action block named codebolt-electron-app-tester before completing the task.
---

# Test CodeBolt Electron App Features

Use this skill when the task includes any code or configuration change that affects the CodeBolt Electron desktop application, including but not limited to:

- `packages/electron` (Electron main/renderer process)
- `packages/ui` (UI components used by the Electron app)
- `packages/server` (Backend server that the Electron app connects to)
- `packages/web` (Shared web components)
- `sdks/codeboltjs` (SDK used by the Electron app)

## Mandatory Action Block

After adding a feature or fixing a bug that affects the Electron app, the agent must call the action block named `codebolt-electron-app-tester` before reporting the implementation as complete.

This requirement applies even if normal build, lint, typecheck, or test commands have already passed.

## Required Workflow

1. Complete the requested feature or bug fix.
2. Call the ActionBlock list tool to discover available ActionBlocks.
3. Confirm the list contains `codebolt-electron-app-tester`.
4. Call `codebolt-electron-app-tester` with a behavioral `spec` input.
5. Confirm the chat shows `CodeBolt Electron App Tester ActionBlock started`.
6. Inspect the ActionBlock output.
7. Only report completion after the ActionBlock finishes and reports success.

## ActionBlock List Tool

Before starting the tester, call the ActionBlock list tool:

```json
{}
```

The list response should include an ActionBlock with:

```json
{
  "name": "codebolt-electron-app-tester",
  "entryPoint": "dist/index.js",
  "type": "filesystem"
}
```

If the ActionBlock is missing, do not continue as if testing passed. Report that `codebolt-electron-app-tester` was not discovered and include the list response if available.

## ActionBlock Start Tool

After confirming the ActionBlock exists, start it:

```json
{
  "actionBlockName": "codebolt-electron-app-tester",
  "params": {
    "spec": {
      "title": "Verify implemented Electron app change",
      "featureName": "Short feature name",
      "bugSummary": "Short description of the bug fixed, if applicable.",
      "expectedBehavior": "What visible Electron app behavior should now happen.",
      "userWorkflow": [
        "Step the tester should perform in the Electron app.",
        "Next visible interaction or assertion."
      ],
      "acceptanceCriteria": [
        "Electron app starts successfully.",
        "The tester can reproduce the relevant workflow.",
        "The visible behavior matches the requested feature or bug fix."
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`spec` is optional at the ActionBlock level, but agents using this skill should provide it. Keep the `spec` behavioral. Do not pass install, build, start, shell, or test commands as the source of truth. Command fields such as `command`, `commands`, `shellCommand`, and `terminalCommand` are sanitized by the ActionBlock.

## ActionBlock Runtime Behavior

On invocation the ActionBlock sends:

```text
CodeBolt Electron App Tester ActionBlock started
```

Then its wrapper performs deterministic work outside the LLM:

1. Dependency install at the project root
2. Server dependency builds (types, codeboltjs, websearch, server)
3. DLL build (shared nodes)
4. Electron main process build
5. Electron renderer build
6. Electron app launch in dev mode via terminal TUI
7. Temp project folder creation for the test workspace
8. Agentic verification loop using terminal_tui against the running app
9. TUI session cleanup
10. Temp project cleanup

The mini-agent receives only behavioral context and the running Electron app session. It uses `terminal_tui` to inspect and interact with the visible app. It does not use source/file/search/codebase tools.

## ActionBlock Output

The response has this high-level shape:

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "result": {
    "title": "Verify implemented Electron app change",
    "startupMessage": "CodeBolt Electron App Tester ActionBlock started",
    "startupMessageSent": true,
    "lifecycleSteps": [],
    "electronAppSession": {
      "sessionId": "actionblock-electron-app-...",
      "started": true,
      "projectPath": "/tmp/codebolt-electron-app-test-...",
      "sourceProjectPath": "/Users/.../CodeBolt",
      "cleanup": { "attempted": true, "success": true },
      "tempProjectCleanup": { "attempted": true, "success": true }
    },
    "miniAgentReport": {
      "verdict": "passed",
      "summary": "Visible behavior matched the expected fix.",
      "scope": ["packages/electron"],
      "commandsRun": [],
      "checks": [],
      "issues": [],
      "recommendations": []
    },
    "recommendations": []
  },
  "verification": {
    "passed": true,
    "checks": []
  },
  "filesCreated": []
}
```

Before reporting completion, verify all of these:

- `result.startupMessageSent === true`
- every item in `result.lifecycleSteps` has `success === true`
- `result.electronAppSession.started === true`
- `result.electronAppSession.projectPath` points to a temp folder named `codebolt-electron-app-test-*`, not the CodeBolt checkout
- `result.electronAppSession.tempProjectCleanup.success === true`
- `result.miniAgentReport.verdict === "passed"`
- `verification.passed === true`
- top-level `success === true`

If any check fails, do not claim the task is complete. Report the failure, especially `result.miniAgentReport.issues`, failed `lifecycleSteps`, `result.electronAppSession.warning`, and `result.recommendations`.

## Notes

- Do not skip the action block for small changes if the change implements a feature or fixes a bug in the Electron app.
- If the action block fails, report the failure and do not claim the task is fully complete.
- If the change only reads files or answers a question without editing Electron app related packages, this skill does not require the action block.
- The ActionBlock output may have `success: false` even when setup/build passed; app launch or testing behavior can still fail.
]]></tool_result>

---
name: codebolt-feature-testcase-task
description: Use after an agent finishes implementing a feature or fixing a bug in the CodeBolt app. The agent must create or update a CodeBolt auto-testing test suite and test case through the testcase API, then create a CodeBolt task that clearly mentions the test suite and what it validates.
---

# CodeBolt Feature Testcase And Task

Use this skill after completing any feature implementation or bug fix in the CodeBolt app.

This skill applies after code changes are done, before the final response to the user. It does not replace normal validation, Electron app testing, remote validation, or package-specific test skills; run those as required by the touched files and user request.

Do not use this skill for read-only analysis, code review without edits, documentation-only changes, formatting-only changes, dependency metadata churn, or tasks where the user explicitly asks not to create CodeBolt testcases or tasks.

## Required Outcome

Before reporting the feature or bug fix as complete, create:

- One auto-testing test suite for the implemented feature or fixed bug, unless a clearly matching suite already exists.
- At least one auto-testing test case in that suite covering the user-visible behavior or regression.
- One CodeBolt task whose title and description clearly mention the test suite name, suite ID if available, test case name, test case ID if available, and what behavior the suite validates.

## Testcase API

Prefer the CodeBolt SDK or exposed declarative tools:

- Suite API: `codebolt.autoTesting.createSuite({ name, description, testCaseIds })`
- Case API: `codebolt.autoTesting.createCase({ suiteId, key, name, description, steps, labels, priority, caseType })`
- If declarative tools are available, use `test_suite_create` and `test_case_create`.

Use these required case fields:

- `suiteId`: the target suite ID.
- `key`: a stable uppercase key derived from the feature or bug, such as `CB-FEATURE-SHORT-NAME-001` or `CB-BUG-SHORT-NAME-001`.
- `name`: concise behavior under test.
- `description`: include the original feature or bug, expected behavior, files or area changed, and regression risk.
- `steps`: ordered human-runnable verification steps. Include setup, action, and expected result.
- `labels`: include `feature` or `bugfix`, plus relevant package or area labels.
- `priority`: use `high` for regressions and user-blocking fixes, otherwise `medium`.
- `caseType`: use `functional` for new features and `regression` for bug fixes.

## Task API

After the suite and case exist, create a CodeBolt task. Prefer the exposed declarative tool:

```json
{
  "title": "Test suite: <suite name>",
  "description": "Created/updated auto-testing suite <suite name> (<suite id>) for <feature or bug>. Test case: <case name> (<case id>). Validates: <specific behavior>. Relevant files: <paths>. Run/execute this suite before release or when this area changes."
}
```

If using the SDK directly, call `codebolt.task.createTask({ name, description, threadId })` with the same content.

The task description must explicitly mention:

- The test suite name and ID when returned by the API.
- The test case name and ID when returned by the API.
- Whether the work was a feature or bug fix.
- The behavior being protected.
- Any manual setup needed to execute the test.

## Workflow

1. Finish the code change.
2. Summarize the completed behavior in one or two sentences.
3. Create or identify a matching auto-testing suite.
4. Create at least one targeted test case in that suite.
5. Create a CodeBolt task that points at the suite and case.
6. In the final response, include the suite name/ID, case name/ID, and task title/ID if the APIs returned them.

## Failure Handling

- If testcase API tools are unavailable, report that the required testcase/task creation could not be completed and name the missing tool/API.
- If suite creation succeeds but case creation fails, include the created suite ID in the report and do not claim the testcase workflow is complete.
- If testcase creation succeeds but task creation fails, include the suite and case IDs and clearly state the task was not created.
- Do not fabricate suite IDs, case IDs, task IDs, or API success.
]]></tool_result>

import { WebSocketServer, WebSocket } from 'ws';
import os from 'os';
import { PtyProcess } from '../hostBridge';
import { getHostBridge, getProjectPath } from '../serverPaths';
import logger from "../utils/appLogger";
import { aiTerminalSocketConnection, codeboltMainSocketConnection, codeboltSocketConnection, wsconnectionManager } from './socketManager';
// Dynamic getter to always read the latest projectSetting value.
// With CommonJS modules, a named import captures the value at require-time.
// If settingService.init() reassigns projectSetting later, the stale reference is returned.
// This getter re-requires the module each time, ensuring the current value is used.
function getProjectSetting() {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-var-requires
    const settingModule = require('./../services/settingService');
    return settingModule.projectSetting;
}
import { portScannerService } from '../services/portScannerService';

import { IncomingMessage } from 'http';
import * as fs from 'fs';
import * as path from 'path';
import querystring from 'querystring';

import { terminalCliService } from '../cliLib/terminalService.cli';
import { TerminalProcessStatus } from '../sharedTypes/commandTypes';
import { TemplateEnum } from '../types/chatTypes';
import { WebSocketMessageType } from '../types/cliWs';
import { subscriberToMessage, subscriberToProcessStopped, messageEmitter } from './socketManage';
import { CategorizedLogger } from '../utils/categorizedLogger';
import { FocusedLogCategory } from '../sharedTypes/focusedLogCategories';
import { normalizeSingleLineHeredocCommand } from '../utils/terminalCommandNormalization';
import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
import { AgentEventPriority, AgentEventType } from '../types/agentEventQueue';
import { asyncTaskRegistry, AsyncTaskExecutionMode } from '../cliLib/asyncTaskRegistry.cli';
const cLogger = CategorizedLogger.getInstance();

// Chunked PTY write to prevent node-pty buffer overflow on multiline paste.
// Writing large payloads in a single write() call can fill the PTY input buffer
// and deadlock the event loop. This breaks the payload into small chunks with
// micro-delays so the kernel can drain the buffer between writes.
//
// Platform notes:
// - Linux/macOS: kernel PTY buffer is typically 4KB; 256-byte chunks with 5ms delay works well.
// - Windows (conpty): has a smaller input buffer and cmd.exe/PowerShell process input slower,
//   so we use smaller chunks (128 bytes) with a longer delay (10ms) to stay safe.
const PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 128 : 256;
const PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_DELAY_MS = os.platform() === 'win32' ? 10 : 5;

function writeToPtyChunked(ptyProcess: PtyProcess, data: string): void {
    if (data.length <= PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE) {
        ptyProcess.write(data);
        return;
    }

    let offset = 0;
    const writeNextChunk = () => {
        if (offset >= data.length) return;
        const chunk = data.slice(offset, offset + PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE);
        offset += PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_SIZE;
        ptyProcess.write(chunk);
        if (offset < data.length) {
            setTimeout(writeNextChunk, PTY_WRITE_CHUNK_DELAY_MS);
        }
    };
    writeNextChunk();
}
// Type for terminal process entries
interface TerminalProcessEntry {
    terminalId: string | number;
    ptyTerminalProcess: PtyProcess;
    command: string;
    timestamp: number;
    status: string;
    messageId: string;
}

export let terminalProcess: Array<TerminalProcessEntry> = [];

// Performance: Map indexes for O(1) lookups instead of O(n) array searches
// Index by terminalId for quick lookups
const terminalIdIndex = new Map<string | number, TerminalProcessEntry>();
// Index by PID for quick lookups
const pidIndex = new Map<number, TerminalProcessEntry>();
// Reverse index for WebSocket connections by PID (for O(1) broadcasting)
const pidToWebSockets = new Map<number, Set<WebSocket>>();


async function loadFixPath() {
    try {
        const fixPath = await import('fix-path');
        fixPath.default();
    } catch {
        // fix-path is optional — only needed in Electron GUI environment
    }
}

if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
    loadFixPath();
}
const ApproveButtons = {
    RETRY: "Retry",
    PROCEED_ANYWAYS: "Proceed Anyways",
    SAVE: "Save",
    APPROVE: "Approve",
    RUN_COMMAND: "Run Command",
    RESUME_TASK: "Resume Task",
    START_NEW_TASK: "Start New Task",
    YES: "Yes",
    Accept: "accept"
};


// Performance: Buffered file I/O for terminal logs
// Buffers writes in memory and flushes every 500ms or when buffer reaches 50 entries
const LOG_BUFFER_FLUSH_INTERVAL_MS = 500;
const LOG_BUFFER_MAX_ENTRIES = 50;
const COMMAND_STATUS_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS = 10000;
