const normalizeThreadFlagNames = (values: unknown): string[] => {
    const rawValues = Array.isArray(values)
        ? values
        : typeof values === 'string' && values.trim()
            ? [values]
            : [];

    return Array.from(new Set(rawValues
        .map((value) => flagService.normalizeFlagName(String(value)))
        .filter(Boolean)))
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
};

const CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS = new Set([
    'e2b-remote',
    'sprites-remote',
    'runloop-remote',
    'modal-remote',
    'daytona-remote',
]);

const isCloudRuntimeProviderId = (providerId?: string): boolean => {
    const normalized = String(providerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS.has(normalized) || normalized.startsWith('runner-node:');
};

const mergeThreadFlagNames = (...flagLists: Array<string[] | undefined>): string[] => {
    return normalizeThreadFlagNames(flagLists.flatMap((flags) => flags || []));
};

const resolveExistingEnvironmentId = (environment: unknown): string | undefined => {
    if (typeof environment === 'string') {
        return environment.trim() || undefined;
    }

    if (!environment || typeof environment !== 'object' || Array.isArray(environment)) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const record = environment as Record<string, any>;
    const nestedEnvironment = record.environment && typeof record.environment === 'object'
        ? record.environment as Record<string, any>
        : undefined;

    const id = record.id
        || record.environmentId
        || record.envId
        || record.value
        || nestedEnvironment?.id
        || nestedEnvironment?.environmentId;

    return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() ? id.trim() : undefined;
};

const buildThreadEnvironmentPayload = (environment: Environment): Record<string, any> => {
    const config = environment.config || {};
    const executionMode = config.executionMode;
    const projectPath =
        config.workspacePath ||
        config.worktreePath ||
        (environment as any).workspacePath ||
        config.environmentPath ||
        config.projectPath ||
        config.resolvedPath ||
        projectSetting.user_active_project_path;

    return {
        id: environment.id,
        name: environment.name,
        type: executionMode === 'local_thread_pool' ? 'local_thread_pool' : 'remote',
        executionMode,
        projectPath,
        workspacePath: config.workspacePath || projectPath,
        worktreePath: config.worktreePath,
        environmentPath: config.environmentPath,
        baseProjectPath: projectSetting.user_active_project_path,
    };
};

const normalizeIncomingFlagContext = (flags: Partial<FlagContext> | undefined, mentionedFlags: string[]): FlagContext | undefined => {
    if (!flags && mentionedFlags.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const userFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.user);
    const projectFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.project);
    const threadFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.thread, mentionedFlags);
    const effectiveFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.effective, userFlags, projectFlags, threadFlags, mentionedFlags);

    return {
        user: userFlags,
        project: projectFlags,
        thread: threadFlags,
        effective: effectiveFlags,
    };
};

interface GetThreadMessagesInput {
    threadId: string;
    limit?: number;
    offset?: number;
}

interface GetThreadRawConversationsInput {
    threadId?: string;
    id?: string;
    taskId?: string;
    limit?: number;
    offset?: number;
}

interface ThreadContextInput {
    threadId?: string;
    id?: string;
    taskId?: string;
}

interface AddThreadContextInput extends ThreadContextInput {
    title?: string;
    messages?: any[];
    summary?: string;
    compactedContext?: any;
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

interface UpdateThreadStatusInput {
    id: string;
    status: string;
}

// Define response types
interface CreateThreadResponseData {
    thread: ThreadResponseDto;
}

interface UpdateThreadResponseData {
    thread: ThreadResponseDto;
}

interface DeleteThreadResponseData {
    success: boolean;
}

interface GetThreadResponseData {
    thread: ThreadResponseDto | null;
}

interface ListThreadsResponseData {
    threads: ThreadResponseDto[];
    totalCount: number;
}

interface StartThreadResponseData {
    thread: ThreadResponseDto;
    activityId?: string;
}

interface CreateAndStartThreadResponseData {
    thread: ThreadResponseDto;
    activityId?: string;
    created: boolean;
    output?: string;
    status?: string;
    async?: boolean;
    completionEvent?: string;
    targetAgentId?: string;
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    callerAgentId?: string;
    callerAgentInstanceId?: string;
}

interface GetThreadMessagesResponseData {
    messages: ThreadMessageResponseDto[];
    totalCount: number;
}

// Extended StartThreadResponse to include output from thread completion
interface CreateAndStartThreadResponse extends Omit<StartThreadResponse, 'type'> {
    type: 'startThreadResponse';
    output?: string;
    status?: string;
    async?: boolean;
    completionEvent?: string;
    targetAgentId?: string;
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    callerAgentId?: string;
    callerAgentInstanceId?: string;
}

interface WaitForThreadCompletionResponse {
    type: 'waitForThreadCompletionResponse';
    success: boolean;
    threadId: string;
    thread?: any;
    activityId?: string;
    output?: string;
    status?: string;
    error?: string;
}

// Helper functions for formatting responses
const formatToolError = (error: string): string => {
    return `The tool execution failed with the following error:\n<error>\n${error}\n</error>`;
};

const resolveThreadId = (params: any): string | undefined => {
    return params?.threadId || params?.id || params?.taskId;
};

const nowIso = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

const resolveSelectedAgentId = (params: any): string | undefined => {
    return params?.selectedAgent?.agentId
        || params?.selectedAgent?.value
        || params?.selectedAgent?.id
        || params?.agentId;
};

const resolveThreadAgentInstanceId = (threadId?: string, agentId?: string): string | undefined => {
    if (!threadId && !agentId) return undefined;
    try {
        const socket = threadId && agentId
            ? wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadAndAgent(threadId, agentId)
            : threadId
                ? wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(threadId)
                : undefined;
        return socket?.uniqueConnectionId || socket?.agentInstanceId;
    } catch (error: any) {
        logger.debug(`[ThreadCompletion] Failed to resolve agent instance for thread=${threadId || ''}: ${error?.message || error}`);
        return undefined;
    }
};

const pruneCompletedThreadCompletions = (): void => {
    if (completedThreadCompletions.size <= MAX_COMPLETED_THREAD_COMPLETIONS) return;
    const keysToDelete = Array.from(completedThreadCompletions.keys())
        .slice(0, completedThreadCompletions.size - MAX_COMPLETED_THREAD_COMPLETIONS);
    for (const key of keysToDelete) {
        completedThreadCompletions.delete(key);
    }
};

const registerPendingThreadCompletion = (record: Omit<PendingThreadCompletion, 'waiters'>): PendingThreadCompletion => {
    const existing = pendingThreadCompletions.get(record.threadId);
    const merged: PendingThreadCompletion = {
        ...existing,
        ...record,
        waiters: existing?.waiters || [],
    };
    pendingThreadCompletions.set(record.threadId, merged);
    asyncTaskRegistry.registerTask({
        taskId: `thread:${record.threadId}`,
        type: 'thread',
        ownerThreadId: record.callerThreadId,
        ownerAgentId: record.callerAgentId,
        ownerAgentInstanceId: record.callerAgentInstanceId,
        title: record.thread?.title || record.thread?.name || `Thread ${record.threadId}`,
        summary: 'Child thread is running.',
        executionMode: record.executionMode || 'background_scoped',
        metadata: {
            threadId: record.threadId,
            activityId: record.activityId,
            targetAgentId: record.targetAgentId,
            targetAgentInstanceId: record.targetAgentInstanceId,
            groupId: record.groupId,
        },
    });
    return merged;
};

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion = (threadId: string): Promise<ThreadCompletionResult> => {
    const completed = completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
    if (completed) {
        return Promise.resolve(completed);
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const existing = pendingThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
        if (existing) {
            existing.waiters.push(resolve);
            return;
        }

        pendingThreadCompletions.set(threadId, {
            threadId,
            activityId: 'activity-' + threadId,
            created: false,
            startedAt: nowIso(),
            waiters: [resolve],
        });
    });
};

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletionWithTimeout = async (
    threadId: string,
    timeoutMs = 30 * 1000,
): Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }> => {
    const boundedTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(timeoutMs, 5 * 60 * 1000));
    if (boundedTimeoutMs === 0) {
        return {
            completed: false,
            completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
            error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,
        };
    }

    return Promise.race([
        waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion(threadId).then(completion => ({
            completed: true,
            completion,
        })),
        new Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }>((resolve) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,
                });
            }, boundedTimeoutMs);
        }),
    ]);
};

const DEFAULT_THREAD_FOREGROUND_WAIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000;
const DEFAULT_THREAD_AUTO_YIELD_MS = 30 * 1000;

function normalizeThreadExecutionMode(params: Partial<CreateAndStartThreadInput>): AsyncTaskExecutionMode {
    const requestedMode = params.executionMode || params.execution_mode;
    if (
        requestedMode === 'foreground_scoped' ||
        requestedMode === 'auto_scoped' ||
        requestedMode === 'background_scoped' ||
        requestedMode === 'background_detached'
    ) {
        return requestedMode;
    }
    if (params.lifetime === 'detached') {
        return 'background_detached';
    }
    if (params.waitForCompletion) {
        return 'foreground_scoped';
    }
    return 'background_scoped';
}

function shouldWaitForThreadMode(executionMode?: AsyncTaskExecutionMode): boolean {
    return executionMode === 'foreground_scoped' || executionMode === 'auto_scoped';
}

const normalizeThreadFlagNames = (values: unknown): string[] => {
    const rawValues = Array.isArray(values)
        ? values
        : typeof values === 'string' && values.trim()
            ? [values]
            : [];

    return Array.from(new Set(rawValues
        .map((value) => flagService.normalizeFlagName(String(value)))
        .filter(Boolean)))
        .sort((left, right) => left.localeCompare(right));
};

const CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS = new Set([
    'e2b-remote',
    'sprites-remote',
    'runloop-remote',
    'modal-remote',
    'daytona-remote',
]);

const isCloudRuntimeProviderId = (providerId?: string): boolean => {
    const normalized = String(providerId || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    return CLOUD_RUNTIME_PROVIDER_IDS.has(normalized) || normalized.startsWith('runner-node:');
};

const mergeThreadFlagNames = (...flagLists: Array<string[] | undefined>): string[] => {
    return normalizeThreadFlagNames(flagLists.flatMap((flags) => flags || []));
};

const resolveExistingEnvironmentId = (environment: unknown): string | undefined => {
    if (typeof environment === 'string') {
        return environment.trim() || undefined;
    }

    if (!environment || typeof environment !== 'object' || Array.isArray(environment)) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const record = environment as Record<string, any>;
    const nestedEnvironment = record.environment && typeof record.environment === 'object'
        ? record.environment as Record<string, any>
        : undefined;

    const id = record.id
        || record.environmentId
        || record.envId
        || record.value
        || nestedEnvironment?.id
        || nestedEnvironment?.environmentId;

    return typeof id === 'string' && id.trim() ? id.trim() : undefined;
};

const buildThreadEnvironmentPayload = (environment: Environment): Record<string, any> => {
    const config = environment.config || {};
    const executionMode = config.executionMode;
    const projectPath =
        config.workspacePath ||
        config.worktreePath ||
        (environment as any).workspacePath ||
        config.environmentPath ||
        config.projectPath ||
        config.resolvedPath ||
        projectSetting.user_active_project_path;

    return {
        id: environment.id,
        name: environment.name,
        type: executionMode === 'local_thread_pool' ? 'local_thread_pool' : 'remote',
        executionMode,
        projectPath,
        workspacePath: config.workspacePath || projectPath,
        worktreePath: config.worktreePath,
        environmentPath: config.environmentPath,
        baseProjectPath: projectSetting.user_active_project_path,
    };
};

const normalizeIncomingFlagContext = (flags: Partial<FlagContext> | undefined, mentionedFlags: string[]): FlagContext | undefined => {
    if (!flags && mentionedFlags.length === 0) {
        return undefined;
    }

    const userFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.user);
    const projectFlags = normalizeThreadFlagNames(flags?.project);
    const threadFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.thread, mentionedFlags);
    const effectiveFlags = mergeThreadFlagNames(flags?.effective, userFlags, projectFlags, threadFlags, mentionedFlags);

    return {
        user: userFlags,
        project: projectFlags,
        thread: threadFlags,
        effective: effectiveFlags,
    };
};

const formatToolError = (error: string): string => {

};

const resolveThreadId = (params: any): string | undefined => {
    return params?.threadId || params?.id || params?.taskId;
};

const nowIso = (): string => new Date().toISOString();

const resolveSelectedAgentId = (params: any): string | undefined => {
    return params?.selectedAgent?.agentId
        || params?.selectedAgent?.value
        || params?.selectedAgent?.id
        || params?.agentId;
};

const resolveThreadAgentInstanceId = (threadId?: string, agentId?: string): string | undefined => {
    if (!threadId && !agentId) return undefined;
    try {
        const socket = threadId && agentId
            ? wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadAndAgent(threadId, agentId)
            : threadId
                ? wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(threadId)
                : undefined;
        return socket?.uniqueConnectionId || socket?.agentInstanceId;
    } catch (error: any) {
        logger.debug(`[ThreadCompletion] Failed to resolve agent instance for thread=${threadId || ''}: ${error?.message || error}`);
        return undefined;
    }
};

const pruneCompletedThreadCompletions = (): void => {
    if (completedThreadCompletions.size <= MAX_COMPLETED_THREAD_COMPLETIONS) return;
    const keysToDelete = Array.from(completedThreadCompletions.keys())
        .slice(0, completedThreadCompletions.size - MAX_COMPLETED_THREAD_COMPLETIONS);
    for (const key of keysToDelete) {
        completedThreadCompletions.delete(key);
    }
};

const registerPendingThreadCompletion = (record: Omit<PendingThreadCompletion, 'waiters'>): PendingThreadCompletion => {
    const existing = pendingThreadCompletions.get(record.threadId);
    const merged: PendingThreadCompletion = {
        ...existing,
        ...record,
        waiters: existing?.waiters || [],
    };
    pendingThreadCompletions.set(record.threadId, merged);
    asyncTaskRegistry.registerTask({
        taskId: `thread:${record.threadId}`,
        type: 'thread',
        ownerThreadId: record.callerThreadId,
        ownerAgentId: record.callerAgentId,
        ownerAgentInstanceId: record.callerAgentInstanceId,
        title: record.thread?.title || record.thread?.name || `Thread ${record.threadId}`,
        summary: 'Child thread is running.',
        executionMode: record.executionMode || 'background_scoped',
        metadata: {
            threadId: record.threadId,
            activityId: record.activityId,
            targetAgentId: record.targetAgentId,
            targetAgentInstanceId: record.targetAgentInstanceId,
            groupId: record.groupId,
        },
    });
    return merged;
};

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion = (threadId: string): Promise<ThreadCompletionResult> => {
    const completed = completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
    if (completed) {
        return Promise.resolve(completed);
    }

    return new Promise((resolve) => {
        const existing = pendingThreadCompletions.get(threadId);
        if (existing) {
            existing.waiters.push(resolve);
            return;
        }

        pendingThreadCompletions.set(threadId, {
            threadId,
            activityId: 'activity-' + threadId,
            created: false,
            startedAt: nowIso(),
            waiters: [resolve],
        });
    });
};

const waitForRegisteredThreadCompletionWithTimeout = async (
    threadId: string,
    timeoutMs = 30 * 1000,
): Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }> => {
    const boundedTimeoutMs = Math.max(0, Math.min(timeoutMs, 5 * 60 * 1000));
    if (boundedTimeoutMs === 0) {
        return {
            completed: false,
            completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
            error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,
        };
    }

    return Promise.race([
        waitForRegisteredThreadCompletion(threadId).then(completion => ({
            completed: true,
            completion,
        })),
        new Promise<{ completed: boolean; completion?: ThreadCompletionResult; error?: string }>((resolve) => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                resolve({
                    completed: false,
                    completion: completedThreadCompletions.get(threadId),
                    error: `Timed out waiting for thread ${threadId}`,
                });
            }, boundedTimeoutMs);

};

import { z } from 'zod';

/**
 * Terminal Event Schemas for Agent-to-App Communication
 * Based on codeboltjs/src/modules/terminal.ts module operations
 */

// Base terminal message schema
export const terminalEventBaseSchema = z.object({
  type: z.string(),
  requestId: z.string(),
});

const asyncTaskExecutionModeSchema = z.enum(['foreground_scoped', 'auto_scoped', 'background_scoped', 'background_detached']);

// Execute Command Event Schema
export const executeCommandEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('executeCommand'),
  message: z.string(),
  returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: z.boolean().optional(),
  executionMode: asyncTaskExecutionModeSchema.optional(),
  yieldMs: z.number().optional(),
  timeoutMs: z.number().optional(),
});

// Execute Command Run Until Error Event Schema
export const executeCommandRunUntilErrorEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('executeCommandRunUntilError'),
  message: z.string(),
  executeInMain: z.boolean().optional(),
});

// Execute Command With Stream Event Schema
export const executeCommandWithStreamEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('executeCommandWithStream'),
  message: z.string(),
  executeInMain: z.boolean().optional(),
});

// Send Interrupt To Terminal Event Schema
export const sendInterruptToTerminalEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.literal('sendInterruptToTerminal'),
});

const tuiEventTypes = [
  'tuiRun',
  'tuiAttach',
  'tuiOutput',
  'tuiScreen',
  'tuiType',
  'tuiWrite',
  'tuiPress',
  'tuiResize',
  'tuiSearch',
  'tuiRegion',
  'tuiCursor',
  'tuiWait',
  'tuiWheel',
  'tuiSessionsList',
  'tuiSessionsSwitch',
  'tuiKill',
  'tuiCleanup',
] as const;

export const tuiEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.enum(tuiEventTypes),
  params: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
});

export const terminalCommandManagementEventSchema = terminalEventBaseSchema.extend({
  type: z.enum([
    'terminalCommandsList',
    'terminalCommandStop',
    'terminalCommandOutput',
    'terminalCommandStatus',
    'terminalCommandWait'
  ]),
  params: z.record(z.any()).optional(),
});

// Union of all terminal event schemas
export const terminalEventSchema = z.union([
  executeCommandEventSchema,
  executeCommandRunUntilErrorEventSchema,
  executeCommandWithStreamEventSchema,
  sendInterruptToTerminalEventSchema,
  tuiEventSchema,
  terminalCommandManagementEventSchema,
]);

// Execute Command Options Schema (for CLI service usage)
export const ExecuteCommandOptionsSchema = z.object({
  command: z.string(),
  returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: z.boolean().optional(),
  executeInMain: z.boolean().optional(),
  executionMode: asyncTaskExecutionModeSchema.optional(),
  execution_mode: asyncTaskExecutionModeSchema.optional(),
  yieldMs: z.number().optional(),
  yield_ms: z.number().optional(),
  timeoutMs: z.number().optional(),
  timeout_ms: z.number().optional(),
});

// Inferred TypeScript types for events
export type TerminalEventBase = z.infer<typeof terminalEventBaseSchema>;
export type ExecuteCommandEvent = z.infer<typeof executeCommandEventSchema>;
export type ExecuteCommandRunUntilErrorEvent = z.infer<typeof executeCommandRunUntilErrorEventSchema>;
export type ExecuteCommandWithStreamEvent = z.infer<typeof executeCommandWithStreamEventSchema>;
export type SendInterruptToTerminalEvent = z.infer<typeof sendInterruptToTerminalEventSchema>;
export type TuiEvent = z.infer<typeof tuiEventSchema>;
export type TerminalEvent = z.infer<typeof terminalEventSchema>;
export type ExecuteCommandOptions = z.infer<typeof ExecuteCommandOptionsSchema>;
]]></tool_result>

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import { CommandError, CommandFinish, CommandOutput, TerminalInterruptResponse } from '@codebolt/types/sdk';

import { TerminalEventType, TerminalResponseType } from '@codebolt/types/enum';

/**
 * Terminal stream response with type discriminator
 */
interface TerminalStreamResponse {
    type: string;
    output?: string;
    error?: string;

    stdout?: string;

const COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES = {

} as const;

/**
 * CustomEventEmitter class that extends the Node.js EventEmitter class.
 */
class CustomEventEmitter extends EventEmitter {

/**
 * A module for executing commands in a terminal-like environment via WebSocket.
 */
const cbterminal = {
    eventEmitter: new CustomEventEmitter(),
    tui: {
        run: (params: { command: string; args?: string[]; cwd?: string; env?: Record<string, string>; cols?: number; rows?: number; visible?: boolean; sessionId?: string; terminalId?: string | number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.RUN, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.RUN, params),

        attach: (params: { sessionId?: string; pid?: number; terminalId?: string | number; cols?: number; rows?: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.ATTACH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.ATTACH, params),

        output: (params: { sessionId?: string; mode?: 'streaming' | 'snapshot' | 'screen'; trimWhitespace?: boolean; includeEmpty?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.OUTPUT, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.OUTPUT, params),

        screen: (params: { sessionId?: string; trimWhitespace?: boolean; includeEmpty?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SCREEN, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SCREEN, params),

        type: (params: { sessionId?: string; text: string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.TYPE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.TYPE, params),

        write: (params: { sessionId?: string; data: string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WRITE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WRITE, params),

        press: (params: { sessionId?: string; keys: string[] | string }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.PRESS, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.PRESS, params),

        resize: (params: { sessionId?: string; cols: number; rows: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.RESIZE, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.RESIZE, params),

        search: (params: { sessionId?: string; pattern: string; regex?: boolean }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SEARCH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SEARCH, params),

        region: (params: { sessionId?: string; row: number; col: number; rows: number; cols: number; trimWhitespace?: boolean }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.REGION, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.REGION, params),

        cursor: (params: { sessionId?: string } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.CURSOR, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.CURSOR, params),

        wait: (params: { sessionId?: string; text?: string; gone?: boolean; stable?: boolean; timeoutMs?: number }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WAIT, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WAIT, params),

        wheel: (params: { sessionId?: string; direction: 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right'; amount?: number; row?: number; col?: number; protocol?: 'auto' | 'sgr' | 'normal' }) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.WHEEL, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.WHEEL, params),

        sessions: {
            list: () => sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SESSIONS_LIST, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SESSIONS_LIST, {}),
            switch: (sessionId: string) => sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.SESSIONS_SWITCH, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.SESSIONS_SWITCH, { sessionId }),
        },

        kill: (params: { sessionId?: string } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.KILL, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.KILL, params),

        cleanup: (params: { exitedOnly?: boolean; all?: boolean } = {}) =>
            sendTuiRequest(TUI_EVENT_TYPES.CLEANUP, TUI_RESPONSE_TYPES.CLEANUP, params),
    },

    /**
     * Executes a given command and returns the result.
     * Listens for messages from the WebSocket that indicate the output, error, or finish state
     * of the executed command and resolves the promise accordingly.
     *
     * @param {string} command - The command to be executed.
     * @returns {Promise<CommandOutput|CommandError>} A promise that resolves with the command's output, error, or finish signal.
     */
    executeCommand: async (
        command: string,
        options: boolean | ExecuteCommandOptions = false
    ): Promise<CommandOutput | CommandError | CommandFinish | any> => {
        const normalizedOptions: ExecuteCommandOptions = typeof options === 'boolean'
            ? { returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: options }
            : options;

        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                "type": TerminalEventType.EXECUTE_COMMAND,
                "message": command,
                returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: normalizedOptions.returnEmptyStringOnSuccess ?? false,
                executionMode: normalizedOptions.executionMode,
                yieldMs: normalizedOptions.yieldMs,
                timeoutMs: normalizedOptions.timeoutMs,
            },
            TerminalResponseType.COMMAND_ERROR_OR_FINISH
        );
    },

    listCommands: () =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.LIST, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.LIST, {}),

    stopCommand: (processId: number) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.STOP, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.STOP, { processId }),

    readCommandOutput: (processId: number, params: { lines?: number; tailBytes?: number } = {}) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.OUTPUT, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.OUTPUT, { processId, ...params }),

    getCommandStatus: (processId: number) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.STATUS, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.STATUS, { processId }),

    waitCommand: (processId: number, params: { timeoutMs?: number } = {}) =>
        sendTuiRequest(COMMAND_EVENT_TYPES.WAIT, COMMAND_RESPONSE_TYPES.WAIT, { processId, ...params }),
]]></tool_result>

/**
 * Execute Command Tool - Executes shell commands
 * Wraps the SDK's cbterminal.executeCommand() method
 */

import type {
    ToolInvocation,
    ToolResult,
    ToolCallConfirmationDetails,
    ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails,
} from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind, ToolConfirmationOutcome } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';
import cbchat from '../../modules/chat';
import { isCodeboltCommand, executeCodeboltCommand } from '../pseudo-cli';

/**
 * Parameters for the ExecuteCommand tool
 */
export interface ExecuteCommandToolParams {
    /**
     * One sentence explanation of why this tool is being used
     */
    explanation?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command to execute
     */
    command?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command split into physical shell lines.
     * Prefer this for heredocs and other multiline shell constructs.
     */
    command_lines?: string[];

    /**
     * Whether to return empty string on success (default: false)
     */
    return_empty_on_success?: boolean;

    /**
     * How the command should be managed.
     */
    execution_mode?: 'foreground_scoped' | 'auto_scoped' | 'background_scoped' | 'background_detached';

    /**
     * Milliseconds to wait in auto/background mode before returning a running process.
     */
    yield_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Optional hard timeout for foreground command execution.
     */
    timeout_ms?: number;

}

class ExecuteCommandToolInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    ExecuteCommandToolParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: ExecuteCommandToolParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    override async shouldConfirmExecute(
        _abortSignal: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<ToolCallConfirmationDetails | false> {
        const command = this.getCommand();

        // Codebolt pseudo-CLI commands don't need confirmation
        if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Extract root command for confirmation
        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {
                // Callback handled by the framework
            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                const executionMode = (response as any).executionMode || this.params.execution_mode || 'background_scoped';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is still running: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${processId ? `\nAsync Task ID: command:${processId}` : ''}\nExecution Mode: ${executionMode}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}\n\nUse async_task_control with action "wait", "stop", or "detach" before completing if this command is still running. Scoped commands are stopped if the user force-stops this agent; background_detached commands survive.`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.SHELL_EXECUTE_ERROR,
                    },
                };
            }

            // Extract output
            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';
            const exitCode = (response as any).exitCode ?? (response as any).code;

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {
                llmContent = `Command executed: ${command}\n\nOutput:\n${output}`;
            } else {
                llmContent = `Command executed successfully: ${command}`;
            }

            if (exitCode !== undefined && exitCode !== 0) {

/**
 * Execute Command Tool - Executes shell commands
 * Wraps the SDK's cbterminal.executeCommand() method
 */

import type {
    ToolInvocation,
    ToolResult,
    ToolCallConfirmationDetails,
    ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails,
} from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind, ToolConfirmationOutcome } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import cbterminal from '../../modules/terminal';
import cbchat from '../../modules/chat';
import { isCodeboltCommand, executeCodeboltCommand } from '../pseudo-cli';

/**
 * Parameters for the ExecuteCommand tool
 */
export interface ExecuteCommandToolParams {
    /**
     * One sentence explanation of why this tool is being used
     */
    explanation?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command to execute
     */
    command?: string;

    /**
     * The shell command split into physical shell lines.
     * Prefer this for heredocs and other multiline shell constructs.
     */
    command_lines?: string[];

    /**
     * Whether to return empty string on success (default: false)
     */
    return_empty_on_success?: boolean;

    /**
     * How the command should be managed.
     */
    execution_mode?: 'foreground_scoped' | 'auto_scoped' | 'background_scoped' | 'background_detached';

    /**
     * Milliseconds to wait in auto/background mode before returning a running process.
     */
    yield_ms?: number;

    /**
     * Optional hard timeout for foreground command execution.
     */
    timeout_ms?: number;

}

class ExecuteCommandToolInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    ExecuteCommandToolParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: ExecuteCommandToolParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    override async shouldConfirmExecute(
        _abortSignal: AbortSignal,
    ): Promise<ToolCallConfirmationDetails | false> {
        const command = this.getCommand();

        // Codebolt pseudo-CLI commands don't need confirmation
        if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
            return false;
        }

        // Extract root command for confirmation
        const rootCommand = command.trim().split(/\s+/)[0];

        const confirmationDetails: ToolExecuteConfirmationDetails = {
            type: 'exec',
            title: `Execute Command: ${rootCommand}`,
            command,
            rootCommand: rootCommand,
            onConfirm: async (outcome: ToolConfirmationOutcome) => {
                // Callback handled by the framework
            },
        };

        return confirmationDetails;
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const command = this.getCommand();

            // Intercept codebolt pseudo-CLI commands
            if (isCodeboltCommand(command)) {
                if (this.params.explanation) {
                    cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
                }
                return await executeCodeboltCommand(command);
            }

            if (this.params.explanation) {
                cbchat.sendMessage(this.params.explanation);
            }
            // Call the SDK's terminal module
            const response = await cbterminal.executeCommand(
                command,
                {
                    returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: this.params.return_empty_on_success ?? false,
                    executionMode: this.params.execution_mode,
                    yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms,
                    timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms,
                }
            );
            console.log("[Response from cbterminal.executeCommand]", response);

            if (response.type === 'commandRunning') {
                const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).stdout || '';
                const processId = (response as any).processId;
                const executionMode = (response as any).executionMode || this.params.execution_mode || 'background_scoped';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command is still running: ${command}\nProcess ID: ${processId}${processId ? `\nAsync Task ID: command:${processId}` : ''}\nExecution Mode: ${executionMode}${output ? `\n\nOutput so far:\n${output}` : ''}\n\nUse async_task_control with action "wait", "stop", or "detach" before completing if this command is still running. Scoped commands are stopped if the user force-stops this agent; background_detached commands survive.`,
                    returnDisplay: `Running in background${processId ? ` (PID ${processId})` : ''}`,
                };
            }

            // Check for errors in response
            if (response.type === 'commandError' || (response as any).error) {
                const errorMsg = (response as any).error || (response as any).message || 'Command execution failed';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Command failed:\n${errorMsg}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${this.truncateOutput(errorMsg)}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMsg,
                        type: ToolErrorType.SHELL_EXECUTE_ERROR,
                    },
                };
            }

            // Extract output
            const output = (response as any).output || (response as any).result || (response as any).message || '';
            const exitCode = (response as any).exitCode ?? (response as any).code;

            let llmContent = '';
            if (output) {
                llmContent = `Command executed: ${command}\n\nOutput:\n${output}`;
            } else {
                llmContent = `Command executed successfully: ${command}`;
            }

            if (exitCode !== undefined && exitCode !== 0) {
                llmContent += `\n\nExit code: ${exitCode}`;
            }

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: output ? this.truncateOutput(output) : 'Command executed successfully',
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error executing command: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }

    private getCommand(): string {
        if (this.params.command_lines && this.params.command_lines.length > 0) {
            return this.params.command_lines.join('\n');
        }
        return this.params.command ?? '';
    }

    private truncateOutput(output: any, maxLength: number = 200): string {
        // Ensure output is a string
        const outputStr = typeof output === 'string' ? output : JSON.stringify(output);
        if (outputStr.length <= maxLength) return outputStr;
        return outputStr.substring(0, maxLength) + '...';
    }
}

    groupId?: string;

    /** Existing environment id to run the thread in. Alias for environment. */

    /** The environment provider to use when remoteEnv is true. */

    /** Optional custom name for the remote environment. */
    environmentName?: string;

    waitForCompletion?: boolean;
    /** Unified task execution mode. Scoped modes are stopped on user force-stop; background_detached survives. */
    execution_mode?: 'foreground_scoped' | 'auto_scoped' | 'background_scoped' | 'background_detached';

            const environment = this.params.environment !== undefined

                : this.params.environmentId
                    ? { id: this.params.environmentId }
                    : undefined;
            const selectedAgent = this.params.selectedAgent !== undefined
                ? typeof this.params.selectedAgent === 'string'
                    ? { id: this.params.selectedAgent }
                    : this.params.selectedAgent
                : undefined;
            const userMessage = this.params.userMessage || this.params.task;
            const options = {
                ...baseOptions,
                title: this.params.title || baseOptions.title || this.params.task,
                description: this.params.description || baseOptions.description || this.params.task,
                userMessage,
                ...(selectedAgent !== undefined && { selectedAgent }),
                ...(this.params.agentId && { agentId: this.params.agentId }),
                ...(this.params.groupId && { groupId: this.params.groupId }),
                ...(this.params.isGrouped !== undefined && { isGrouped: this.params.isGrouped }),
                ...(environment !== undefined && { environment }),
                ...(this.params.remoteEnv !== undefined && { remoteEnv: this.params.remoteEnv }),
                ...(this.params.environmentProvider && { environmentProvider: this.params.environmentProvider }),
                ...(this.params.environmentName && { environmentName: this.params.environmentName }),
                ...(this.params.waitForCompletion !== undefined && { waitForCompletion: this.params.waitForCompletion }),
                ...(this.params.execution_mode !== undefined && { executionMode: this.params.execution_mode }),
                ...(this.params.timeout_ms !== undefined && { timeoutMs: this.params.timeout_ms }),
                ...(this.params.yield_ms !== undefined && { yieldMs: this.params.yield_ms }),

                    error: {

                };
            }

            const resp = response as any;
            let output = resp.async === false ? 'Thread completed successfully' : 'Thread started successfully';
            if (resp.threadId) {

            }
            if (resp.targetAgentId) {

            }
            output += `\nTarget Agent Instance ID: ${resp.targetAgentInstanceId || 'not available yet'}`;
            if (resp.activityId) {

            }
            if (resp.status) {

            }
            const executionMode = resp.executionMode || this.params.execution_mode || (this.params.waitForCompletion ? 'foreground_scoped' : 'background_scoped');

export interface TerminalModule {

   * Executes a given command and returns the result

   * @param returnEmptyStringOnSuccess - Whether to return empty string on success

  executeCommand(command: string, options?: boolean | {

    yieldMs?: number;

   * Lists managed terminal command processes
   */

   * Stops a managed terminal command process

  stopCommand(processId: number): Promise<APIResponse>;

  /**
   * Reads captured output for a managed terminal command process
   */
  readCommandOutput(processId: number, params?: { lines?: number; tailBytes?: number }): Promise<APIResponse>;

  /**
   * Gets durable status for a managed terminal command process
   */
  getCommandStatus(processId: number): Promise<APIResponse>;

  /**

  waitCommand(processId: number, params?: { timeoutMs?: number }): Promise<APIResponse>;

<message role="assistant" ordinal="732" timestamp="2026-07-07T09:33:57.086Z">
Implemented the simplification.

What changed:
- Command/thread start now uses one wait concept:
  - Tool/schema field: `wait_ms`
  - JS SDK option: `waitMs`
- `foreground_scoped` and `auto_scoped` wait up to that value, then convert to `background_scoped` if still running.
- `background_scoped` / `background_detached` use it as the startup-output capture window.
- Server still accepts old `yieldMs/yield_ms/timeoutMs/timeout_ms` as compatibility fallback, but public command/thread start schemas and SDK tools now expose `wait_ms` only.

Main files updated:
- [aiTerminal.ts](D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/sockets/aiTerminal.ts)
- [terminalService.cli.ts](D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/cliLib/terminalService.cli.ts)
- [thread-service.cli.ts](D:/codeboltapps/Codebolt/packages/server/src/cliLib/thread/thread-service.cli.ts)

- `npm run build --workspace=packages/server` passed.
- `npx tsc --noEmit --project packages/types/tsconfig.json` passed.
- `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/codeboltjs` still fails on existing unrelated type drift around `LLMInferenceParams`, MCP registered-tools exports, and thread completion response exports.

Remaining `timeout_ms` hits are for web-fetch or explicit wait/control tools, not command/thread start lifecycle.

// ============================================================================
// Agent Event Queue Module
// ============================================================================

const agentEventQueue = {
    // ========================================================================
    // Backend Communication Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add an event to a target agent's queue
     * @param params - Event creation parameters
     * @returns Promise resolving to the created event
     */
    addEvent: (params: AddEventInput): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgent',
                requestId,
                params
            },
            'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Send an inter-agent message (convenience wrapper)
     * @param params - Message parameters
     * @returns Promise resolving to the created event
     */
    sendAgentMessage: (params: SendAgentMessageInput): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessage',
                requestId,
                params
            },
            'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessageResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Get queue statistics
     * @returns Promise resolving to queue statistics
     */
    getQueueStats: (): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<QueueStatsResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStats',
                requestId,
                params: {}
            },
            'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse',
        );
    },

    /**
     * Clear the queue for an agent
     * @param agentId - Optional agent ID (defaults to current agent)
     * @returns Promise resolving to success confirmation
     */
    clearQueue: (agentId?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.clearQueue',
                requestId,
                params: { agentId }
            },
            'agentEventQueue.clearQueueResponse',
        );
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Internal Acknowledgement Helper
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Acknowledge an event at the backend
     * @param eventId - ID of the event to acknowledge
     * @param success - Whether processing was successful
     * @param errorMessage - Optional error message
     */
    _acknowledgeEvent: async (eventId: string, success: boolean = true, errorMessage?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.ackEvent',
                requestId,
                params: {
                    eventId,
                    success,
                    errorMessage
                } as AckEventInput
            },
            'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
        );
    },

    /**
     * Fetch pending events from backend
     * @param params - Query parameters
     */
    _fetchPendingFromBackend: async (params: GetPendingEventsInput = {}): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        try {
            const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>>(
                {
                    type: 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents',
                    requestId,
                    params
                },
                'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse'
            );

            console.log('[AgentEventQueue] Backend response:', JSON.stringify(response, null, 2));

            if (response.success && response.data) {
                // Handle case where data itself is the array
                if (Array.isArray(response.data)) {
                    return response.data;
                }
                // Handle case where events are nested under data.events
                const events = response.data.events;
                if (Array.isArray(events)) {
                    return events;
                }
                console.warn('[AgentEventQueue] response.data.events is not an array:', typeof events, events);
                return [];
            }
            // Handle case where events are at response root level (not nested under data)
            const responseAny = response as any;
            if (response.success && Array.isArray(responseAny.events)) {
                return responseAny.events;
            }
            return [];
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[AgentEventQueue] Error fetching pending events from backend:', error);
            return [];
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Local Event Management Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get pending events from local cache.
     * Sends acknowledgement for each event and removes from local cache.
     * If no local events, fetches from backend.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: all)
     * @returns Promise resolving to array of events
     */
    getPendingQueueEvents: async (maxDepth?: number): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        const events: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
        const eventIds = Array.from(localEventCache.keys());

        console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - localEventCache size:', localEventCache.size);

        // Determine how many events to process
        const limit = maxDepth !== undefined ? Math.min(maxDepth, eventIds.length) : eventIds.length;

        // Get events from local cache
        for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            const eventId = eventIds[i];
            const event = localEventCache.get(eventId);
            if (event) {
                console.log('[AgentEventQueue] Local cache event:', eventId, 'has eventId field:', !!event.eventId);
                events.push(event);
            }
        }

        // If no local events, try fetching from backend
        if (events.length === 0) {
            const backendEvents = await agentEventQueue._fetchPendingFromBackend({ limit: maxDepth });

            console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - backendEvents:',
                Array.isArray(backendEvents) ? `array of ${backendEvents.length}` : typeof backendEvents,
                JSON.stringify(backendEvents, null, 2));

            // Ensure backendEvents is an array
            if (!Array.isArray(backendEvents)) {
                console.error('[AgentEventQueue] backendEvents is not an array, returning empty array');
                return [];
            }

            // Acknowledge backend events
            for (const event of backendEvents) {
                try {
                    const ackResponse = await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    console.log(`[AgentEventQueue] Ack response for ${event.eventId}:`, JSON.stringify(ackResponse));
                    if (!ackResponse.success) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Failed to acknowledge event ${event.eventId}:`, ackResponse.message);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return backendEvents;
        }

        // Acknowledge and remove local events
        for (const event of events) {
            try {
                await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
            }
        }

        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Wait for the next event(s) from the queue.
     * First checks local cache, then waits for WebSocket events.
     * Sends acknowledgement and removes from cache before resolving.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: 1)
     * @returns Promise resolving to event(s)
     */
    waitForNextQueueEvent: async (maxDepth: number = 1): Promise<AgentEventMessage | AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        // Check local cache first
        if (localEventCache.size > 0) {
            const events = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth);
            if (events.length > 0) {
                return maxDepth === 1 ? events[0] : events;
            }
        }

        // Wait for new event from WebSocket
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const onNewEvent = async (event: AgentEventMessage) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('newEvent', onNewEvent);

                // Acknowledge the event
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }

                // If maxDepth > 1, try to get more events from cache
                if (maxDepth > 1 && localEventCache.size > 0) {
                    const additionalEvents = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth - 1);
                    resolve([event, ...additionalEvents]);
                } else {
                    resolve(maxDepth === 1 ? event : [event]);
                }
            };

            eventEmitter.once('newEvent', onNewEvent);
        });
]]></tool_result>

/**
 * EventQueue Wait Next Tool
 * Wraps the SDK's agentEventQueue.waitForNextQueueEvent() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import agentEventQueue from '../../modules/agentEventQueue';
import type { AgentEventMessage } from '../../types/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Parameters for the EventQueue Wait Next tool
 */
export interface EventQueueWaitNextParams {
    /** Maximum number of events to return */
    maxDepth?: number;
}

class EventQueueWaitNextInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    EventQueueWaitNextParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: EventQueueWaitNextParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const result = await agentEventQueue.waitForNextQueueEvent(this.params.maxDepth || 1);

            // Normalize to array for consistent handling
            const events: AgentEventMessage[] = Array.isArray(result) ? result : [result];

            let llmContent = `Received ${events.length} event(s):\n\n`;

            for (const event of events) {
                llmContent += `---\n`;
                llmContent += `Event ID: ${event.eventId}\n`;
                llmContent += `Type: ${event.eventType}\n`;
                llmContent += `Priority: ${event.priority}\n`;
                llmContent += `From: ${event.sourceAgentId || 'Unknown'}\n`;
                llmContent += `Created: ${event.createdAt}\n`;
                llmContent += `Payload: ${JSON.stringify(event.payload, null, 2)}\n`;
            }

            llmContent += `\nNote: These events have been acknowledged and removed from the queue.`;

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: `Received ${events.length} event(s)`,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error waiting for events: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Tool for waiting for the next queue event
 */
export class EventQueueWaitNextTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<
    EventQueueWaitNextParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    static readonly Name: string = 'eventqueue_wait_next';

    constructor() {
        super(
            EventQueueWaitNextTool.Name,
            'Wait for Next Event',
            'Wait for the next event(s) to arrive in the queue. This is a blocking call that resolves when an event is received. Events are automatically acknowledged.',
            Kind.Other,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    maxDepth: {
                        type: 'number',
                        description: 'Maximum number of events to return (default: 1). If more than 1, will try to batch events from the cache after receiving the first.'
                    }
                },
                required: []
            }
        );
    }

    protected createInvocation(
        params: EventQueueWaitNextParams,
    ): ToolInvocation<EventQueueWaitNextParams, ToolResult> {
        return new EventQueueWaitNextInvocation(params);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

/**
 * EventQueue Get Pending Tool
 * Wraps the SDK's agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import agentEventQueue from '../../modules/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Parameters for the EventQueue Get Pending tool
 */
export interface EventQueueGetPendingParams {
    /** Maximum number of events to return */
    maxDepth?: number;
}

class EventQueueGetPendingInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    EventQueueGetPendingParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: EventQueueGetPendingParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const events = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(this.params.maxDepth);

            if (events.length === 0) {
                return {
                    llmContent: 'No pending events in the queue.',
                    returnDisplay: 'No pending events',
                };
            }

            let llmContent = `Retrieved ${events.length} pending event(s):\n\n`;

            for (const event of events) {
                llmContent += `---\n`;
                llmContent += `Event ID: ${event.eventId}\n`;
                llmContent += `Type: ${event.eventType}\n`;
                llmContent += `Priority: ${event.priority}\n`;
                llmContent += `From: ${event.sourceAgentId || 'Unknown'}\n`;
                llmContent += `Created: ${event.createdAt}\n`;
                llmContent += `Payload: ${JSON.stringify(event.payload, null, 2)}\n`;
            }

            llmContent += `\nNote: These events have been acknowledged and removed from the queue.`;

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: `Retrieved ${events.length} event(s)`,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error getting pending events: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Tool for getting pending events from the queue
 */
export class EventQueueGetPendingTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<
    EventQueueGetPendingParams,
    ToolResult
> {

}

<message role="assistant" ordinal="744" timestamp="2026-07-07T10:26:49.969Z">
The completion payload contains `processId`, `command`, `status`, `exitCode`, `outputTail`, timestamps, and `yieldReason`. I’m using that exact shape in the example.

<message role="assistant" ordinal="745" timestamp="2026-07-07T10:26:57.806Z">
Use:

- `codebolt.terminal.executeCommand(...)` to start it with `executionMode: &#34;background_scoped&#34;`
- `codebolt.agentEventQueue.waitForNextQueueEvent()` or `getPendingQueueEvents()` to consume the completion event
- Event name: `backgroundCommandCompletion`
- Output field: `event.payload.data.outputTail`

Sample:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
import codebolt from '@codebolt/codeboltjs';

async function runBackgroundCommand() {
  const response = await codebolt.terminal.executeCommand(
    'npm run build',
    {
      executionMode: 'background_scoped',
      waitMs: 1000, // startup capture window before returning as background
      returnEmptyStringOnSuccess: true,
    }
  );

  if (response.type !== 'commandRunning') {
    console.log('Command finished inline:', response);
    return response;
  }

  const processId = response.processId;
  const taskId = `command:${processId}`;

  console.log(`Command running in background: ${taskId}`);

  while (true) {
    const event = await codebolt.agentEventQueue.waitForNextQueueEvent(1);
    const events = Array.isArray(event) ? event : [event];

    for (const item of events) {
      if (
        item.payload?.eventName === 'backgroundCommandCompletion' &&
        item.payload?.data?.processId === processId
      ) {
        const data = item.payload.data;

        console.log('Command completed');
        console.log('Status:', data.status);
        console.log('Exit code:', data.exitCode);
        console.log('Output:', data.outputTail);

        return data;
      }
    }
  }
}

runBackgroundCommand().catch(console.error);
]]></code_block>
If the agent is restarted later, use:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
const events = await codebolt.agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents();
]]></code_block>
That fetches already-pending completion events. Both `waitForNextQueueEvent()` and `getPendingQueueEvents()` auto-acknowledge events after reading them.
</message>

import cbws from '../core/websocket';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export type AsyncTaskScope = 'current_run' | 'thread' | 'all';
export type AsyncTaskControlAction = 'wait' | 'stop' | 'detach';

export interface AsyncTaskListOptions {
    scope?: AsyncTaskScope;
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    includeCompleted?: boolean;
}

export interface AsyncTaskControlOptions {
    taskId: string;
    action: AsyncTaskControlAction;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    reason?: string;
}

function sendAsyncTaskRequest<T>(action: string, params: Record<string, unknown>): Promise<T> {
    const requestId = randomUUID();
    return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<T>(
        {
            type: `asyncTask.${action}`,
            action,
            requestId,
            params,
        },
        `asyncTask.${action}Response`,
    );
}

const asyncTask = {
    listTasks: (options: AsyncTaskListOptions = {}) =>
        sendAsyncTaskRequest<any>('list', options as unknown as Record<string, unknown>),

    controlTask: (options: AsyncTaskControlOptions) =>
        sendAsyncTaskRequest<any>('control', options as unknown as Record<string, unknown>),
};

export default asyncTask;
]]></tool_result>

            return {

                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

            },
        );

        return new AsyncTaskListInvocation(params);
    }
}

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { Kind, ToolErrorType } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import asyncTask, { AsyncTaskControlAction } from '../../modules/asyncTask';

export interface AsyncTaskControlParams {
    taskId: string;
    action: AsyncTaskControlAction;
    timeoutMs?: number;
    reason?: string;
}

class AsyncTaskControlInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
    constructor(params: AsyncTaskControlParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const response = await asyncTask.controlTask(this.params);
            if (response?.success === false) {
                const errorMessage = response.error || 'Failed to control async task';
                return {
                    llmContent: `Async task ${this.params.action} failed: ${errorMessage}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                    error: {
                        message: errorMessage,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const task = response?.task;
            const statusLine = task?.status
                ? `Task ${this.params.taskId} status: ${task.status}`
                : `Task ${this.params.taskId} ${this.params.action} completed`;
            const waitLine = response?.waitTimedOut
                ? '\nWait timed out; the task is still running. Choose wait again, stop it, or detach it only if it is an intentional background service.'
                : '';
            const output = response?.output ? `\n\nOutput:\n${response.output}` : '';
            return {
                llmContent: `${statusLine}${waitLine}${output}`,
                returnDisplay: statusLine,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error controlling async task: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

export class AsyncTaskControlTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
    static readonly Name = 'async_task_control';

    constructor() {
        super(
            AsyncTaskControlTool.Name,
            'AsyncTaskControl',
            'Controls an async task. Use wait with a timeout, stop to terminate, or detach to convert intentional background work to background_detached so it survives agent completion and user force-stop.',
            Kind.Execute,
            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {
                    taskId: {
                        type: 'string',
                        description: 'Async task ID, for example command:1234 or thread:abc.',
                    },
                    action: {
                        type: 'string',
                        enum: ['wait', 'stop', 'detach'],
                        description: 'Control action to perform.',
                    },
                    timeoutMs: {
                        type: 'number',
                        description: 'Maximum wait time in milliseconds for action=wait. The runtime caps this value.',
                    },
                    reason: {
                        type: 'string',
                        description: 'Optional reason used when detaching a task. Detach only intentional background services such as dev servers.',
                    },
                },
                required: ['taskId', 'action'],
            },
        );
    }

    protected override validateToolParamValues(params: AsyncTaskControlParams): string | null {
        if (typeof params.taskId !== 'string' || !params.taskId.trim()) {
            return "'taskId' is required and must be a non-empty string";
        }
        if (!['wait', 'stop', 'detach'].includes(params.action)) {
            return "'action' must be one of: wait, stop, detach";
        }
        return null;
    }

    protected createInvocation(params: AsyncTaskControlParams): ToolInvocation<AsyncTaskControlParams, ToolResult> {
        return new AsyncTaskControlInvocation(params);
    }
}
]]></tool_result>

    async stopRunScopedTasksForRun(params: {
        threadId?: string;
        agentId?: string;
        agentInstanceId?: string;
    }) {
        const tasks = asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
            scope: 'current_run',
            threadId: params.threadId,
            agentId: params.agentId,
            agentInstanceId: params.agentInstanceId,
            includeCompleted: false,
        }).filter(task =>
            !isDetachedExecutionMode(task.executionMode) &&
            !['completed', 'failed', 'stopped'].includes(task.status),
        );

        const stoppedTasks: any[] = [];
        const failedTasks: any[] = [];
        for (const task of tasks) {
            const result = task.type === 'command'
                ? await stopCommandTask(task)
                : task.type === 'thread'
                    ? await stopThreadTask(task)
                    : { success: false, error: `Stop is not implemented for task type ${task.type}` };

            if (result.success) {
                stoppedTasks.push({ taskId: task.taskId, type: task.type, title: task.title, result });
            } else {
                failedTasks.push({ taskId: task.taskId, type: task.type, title: task.title, result });
            }
        }

        return {
            stoppedTasks,
            failedTasks,
            detachedTasks: asyncTaskRegistry.listTasks({
                scope: 'current_run',
                threadId: params.threadId,
                agentId: params.agentId,
                agentInstanceId: params.agentInstanceId,
                includeCompleted: false,
            }).filter(task => isDetachedExecutionMode(task.executionMode)),
        };
    },
};
]]></tool_result>

    getTask(taskId: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        const record = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        return record ? { ...record } : undefined;
    }

    listTasks(input: AsyncTaskListInput = {}): AsyncTaskRecord[] {
        const scope = input.scope || 'thread';
        return Array.from(this.tasks.values())
            .filter(task => input.includeCompleted || !FINAL_STATUSES.has(task.status))
            .filter(task => {
                if (scope === 'all') {
                    return true;
                }
                if (scope === 'current_run') {
                    return Boolean(
                        (!input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId) &&
                        (!input.agentId || task.ownerAgentId === input.agentId) &&
                        (!input.agentInstanceId || task.ownerAgentInstanceId === input.agentInstanceId),
                    );
                }
                return !input.threadId || task.ownerThreadId === input.threadId;
            })
            .sort((left, right) => right.updatedAt.localeCompare(left.updatedAt))
            .map(task => ({ ...task }));
    }

    detachTask(taskId: string, reason?: string): AsyncTaskRecord | undefined {
        return this.updateTask(taskId, {
            executionMode: 'background_detached',
            summary: reason || 'Task detached from the owning agent run.',
        });
    }

    waitForTask(taskId: string, timeoutMs: number): Promise<{ completed: boolean; task?: AsyncTaskRecord; error?: string }> {
        const existing = this.tasks.get(taskId);
        if (!existing) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: false, error: `Task ${taskId} not found` });
        }

        if (FINAL_STATUSES.has(existing.status)) {
            return Promise.resolve({ completed: true, task: { ...existing } });
        }

<message role="assistant" ordinal="756" timestamp="2026-07-07T10:33:45.148Z">
Use the generic async task registry, not terminal-only list:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
const response = await codebolt.asyncTask.listTasks({
  scope: 'thread',
  includeCompleted: false,
});
]]></code_block>
Then filter command tasks:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
import codebolt from '@codebolt/codeboltjs';

async function listRunningBackgroundCommands() {
  const response = await codebolt.asyncTask.listTasks({
    scope: 'thread',
    includeCompleted: false,
  });

  const tasks = response.tasks || [];

  const backgroundCommands = tasks.filter((task: any) =>
    task.type === 'command' &&
    task.status === 'running' &&
    (
      task.executionMode === 'background_scoped' ||
      task.executionMode === 'background_detached'
    )
  );

  return backgroundCommands;
}
]]></code_block>
For stop handling, scoped tasks should be stopped, detached tasks should survive:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
async function stopScopedBackgroundCommands() {
  const tasks = await listRunningBackgroundCommands();

  const scoped = tasks.filter(
    (task: any) => task.executionMode !== 'background_detached'
  );

  const detached = tasks.filter(
    (task: any) => task.executionMode === 'background_detached'
  );

  for (const task of scoped) {
    await codebolt.asyncTask.controlTask({
      taskId: task.taskId, // e.g. "command:12345"
      action: 'stop',
    });
  }

  return {
    stopped: scoped.map((task: any) => task.taskId),
    leftRunningDetached: detached.map((task: any) => task.taskId),
  };
}
]]></code_block>
If you only want terminal processes, there is also:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
await codebolt.terminal.listCommands();
]]></code_block>
But for agent stop/completion logic, `codebolt.asyncTask.listTasks()` is the correct one because it includes commands, child threads, execution mode, ownership, and detached/scoped status.
</message>

import {
