import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventQueue,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventPriority,
    PRIORITY_ORDER,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Store
 * In-memory store for managing agent event queues with EventEmitter for notifications.
 * Handles per-agent queues with pending and delivered states.
 */
class AgentEventQueueStore extends EventEmitter {
    private static instance: AgentEventQueueStore;

    /** Per-agent queues: Map<agentId, AgentEventQueue> */
    private agentQueues: Map<string, AgentEventQueue> = new Map();

    /** Quick lookup by eventId: Map<eventId, { agentId, eventId }> */
    private eventIndex: Map<string, { agentId: string; eventId: string }> = new Map();

    private constructor() {
        super();
        // Increase max listeners to handle multiple subscriptions
        this.setMaxListeners(50);
    }

    /**
     * Get singleton instance
     */
    static getInstance(): AgentEventQueueStore {
        if (!AgentEventQueueStore.instance) {
            AgentEventQueueStore.instance = new AgentEventQueueStore();
        }
        return AgentEventQueueStore.instance;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Queue Management
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Ensure a queue exists for an agent, create if not
     */
    ensureQueue(agentId: string, agentInstanceId?: string): AgentEventQueue {
        let queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            queue = {
                agentId,
                agentInstanceId,
                pendingEvents: new Map(),
                deliveredEvents: new Map()
            };
            this.agentQueues.set(agentId, queue);
            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Created queue for agent: ${agentId}`);
        }
        return queue;
    }

    /**
     * Get queue for an agent (returns undefined if not exists)
     */
    getQueue(agentId: string): AgentEventQueue | undefined {
        return this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
    }

    /**
     * Check if agent has a queue
     */
    hasQueue(agentId: string): boolean {
        return this.agentQueues.has(agentId);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Event Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event to agent's pending queue
     */
    addEvent(event: AgentEventMessage): void {
        const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

        // Check queue size limit
        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Queue full for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, removing oldest event`);
            // Remove oldest low-priority event
            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);
        }

        // Add to pending queue
        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);

        // Add to index for quick lookup
        this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            eventId: event.eventId
        });

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Added event ${event.eventId} for agent ${event.targetAgentId} (type: ${event.eventType}, priority: ${event.priority})`);
    }

    /**
     * Mark event as delivered (moved from pending to delivered queue)
     */
    markDelivered(eventId: string): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        const event = queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not in pending queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED;
        event.deliveredAt = new Date().toISOString();

        // Move from pending to delivered
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.set(eventId, event);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:delivered', {
            eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId
        });

        logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Marked event ${eventId} as delivered`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Handle acknowledgement from agent - removes from queue
     */
    handleAck(ack: AgentEventAck): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        // Find event in either pending or delivered queue
        let event = queue.deliveredEvents.get(ack.eventId) || queue.pendingEvents.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not in any queue`);
            return false;
        }

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED;
        event.acknowledgedAt = ack.acknowledgedAt;

        // Remove from both queues
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(ack.eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Remove from index
        this.eventIndex.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', {
            eventId: ack.eventId,
            agentId: indexEntry.agentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Acknowledged event ${ack.eventId} for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
        return true;
    }

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (sorted by priority then creation time)
     * Includes both PENDING and DELIVERED events (delivered but not yet acknowledged)
     */
    getPendingEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return [];
        }

        // Get events from both pending and delivered queues
        // PENDING = not yet sent, DELIVERED = sent but not acknowledged
        const pendingEvents = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING);

        const deliveredEvents = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED);

        const allEvents = [...pendingEvents, ...deliveredEvents]
            .sort((a, b) => {
                // Sort by priority (lower PRIORITY_ORDER value = higher priority)
                const priorityDiff = PRIORITY_ORDER[a.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[b.priority];
                if (priorityDiff !== 0) {
                    return priorityDiff;
                }
                // Then by creation time (oldest first)
                return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
            });

        return limit ? allEvents.slice(0, limit) : allEvents;
    }

    /**
     * Pull events - get and remove from queue (no ACK needed)
     */
    pullEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const events = this.getPendingEvents(agentId, limit);
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);

        if (queue && events.length > 0) {
            for (const event of events) {
                event.status = AgentEventStatus.PULLED;
                queue.pendingEvents.delete(event.eventId);
                this.eventIndex.delete(event.eventId);
            }

            // Emit event
            this.emit('agentEventQueue:pulled', {
                agentId,
                count: events.length
            });

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Pulled ${events.length} events for agent ${agentId}`);
        }

        return events;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of pending events for an agent (includes PENDING and DELIVERED)
     */
    getPendingCount(agentId: string): number {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return 0;
        }
        const pendingCount = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING)
            .length;
        const deliveredCount = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED)
            .length;
        return pendingCount + deliveredCount;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of delivered (awaiting ACK) events for an agent
     */
    getDeliveredCount(agentId: string): number {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        return queue ? queue.deliveredEvents.size : 0;
    }

    /**
     * Get all pending events awaiting delivery (across all agents)
     */
    getAllPendingForDelivery(): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const allPending: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
        for (const queue of this.agentQueues.values()) {
            for (const event of queue.pendingEvents.values()) {
                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    allPending.push(event);
                }
            }
        }
        return allPending;
    }

    /**
     * Get event by ID
     */
    getEventById(eventId: string): AgentEventMessage | undefined {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            return undefined;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return undefined;
        }

        return queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId) || queue.deliveredEvents.get(eventId);
    }

    /**
     * Check if event exists
     */
    hasEvent(eventId: string): boolean {
        return this.eventIndex.has(eventId);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Queue Maintenance
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Clear queue for an agent
     */
    clearQueue(agentId: string): void {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (queue) {
            // Remove all events from index
            for (const eventId of queue.pendingEvents.keys()) {
                this.eventIndex.delete(eventId);
            }
            for (const eventId of queue.deliveredEvents.keys()) {
                this.eventIndex.delete(eventId);
            }

            // Clear queues
            queue.pendingEvents.clear();
            queue.deliveredEvents.clear();

            // Emit event
            this.emit('agentEventQueue:queueCleared', { agentId });

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cleared queue for agent ${agentId}`);
        }
    }

    /**
     * Remove expired events from all queues
     */
    removeExpiredEvents(): number {
        let removedCount = 0;
        const now = new Date();

        for (const queue of this.agentQueues.values()) {
            for (const [eventId, event] of queue.pendingEvents) {
                if (event.expiresAt && new Date(event.expiresAt) < now) {
                    event.status = AgentEventStatus.EXPIRED;
                    queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
                    this.eventIndex.delete(eventId);

                    this.emit('agentEventQueue:expired', {
                        eventId,
                        agentId: queue.agentId
                    });

                    removedCount++;
                }
            }

            // Also check delivered events
            for (const [eventId, event] of queue.deliveredEvents) {
                if (event.expiresAt && new Date(event.expiresAt) < now) {
                    event.status = AgentEventStatus.EXPIRED;
                    queue.deliveredEvents.delete(eventId);
                    this.eventIndex.delete(eventId);

                    this.emit('agentEventQueue:expired', {
                        eventId,
                        agentId: queue.agentId
                    });

                    removedCount++;
                }
            }
        }

        if (removedCount > 0) {
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Removed ${removedCount} expired events`);
        }

        return removedCount;
    }

    /**
     * Remove oldest low-priority event from queue (used when queue is full)
     */
    private removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue: AgentEventQueue): void {
        // Find oldest low-priority event
        let oldestEvent: AgentEventMessage | null = null;
        let oldestTime = Infinity;

        for (const event of queue.pendingEvents.values()) {
            // Prefer removing low priority events
            if (event.priority === AgentEventPriority.LOW) {
                const eventTime = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime();
                if (eventTime < oldestTime) {
                    oldestTime = eventTime;
                    oldestEvent = event;
                }
            }
        }

        // If no low-priority events, remove oldest normal priority
        if (!oldestEvent) {
            for (const event of queue.pendingEvents.values()) {
                if (event.priority === AgentEventPriority.NORMAL) {
                    const eventTime = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime();
                    if (eventTime < oldestTime) {
                        oldestTime = eventTime;
                        oldestEvent = event;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        // If still no event, remove absolute oldest (except urgent)
        if (!oldestEvent) {
            for (const event of queue.pendingEvents.values()) {
                if (event.priority !== AgentEventPriority.URGENT) {
                    const eventTime = new Date(event.createdAt).getTime();
                    if (eventTime < oldestTime) {
                        oldestTime = eventTime;
                        oldestEvent = event;
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        if (oldestEvent) {
            queue.pendingEvents.delete(oldestEvent.eventId);
            this.eventIndex.delete(oldestEvent.eventId);
            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Removed oldest event ${oldestEvent.eventId} to make room`);
        }
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Statistics
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get statistics for all queues
     */
    getStats(): {
        totalQueues: number;
        totalPendingEvents: number;
        totalDeliveredEvents: number;
        queueStats: Array<{
            agentId: string;
            pendingCount: number;
            deliveredCount: number;
        }>;
    } {
        let totalPending = 0;
        let totalDelivered = 0;
        const queueStats: Array<{
            agentId: string;
            pendingCount: number;
            deliveredCount: number;
        }> = [];

        for (const [agentId, queue] of this.agentQueues) {
            const pendingCount = queue.pendingEvents.size;
            const deliveredCount = queue.deliveredEvents.size;
            totalPending += pendingCount;
            totalDelivered += deliveredCount;
            queueStats.push({ agentId, pendingCount, deliveredCount });
        }

        return {
            totalQueues: this.agentQueues.size,
            totalPendingEvents: totalPending,
            totalDeliveredEvents: totalDelivered,
            queueStats
        };
    }

    /**
     * Get all agent IDs that have queues
     */
    getAgentIds(): string[] {
        return Array.from(this.agentQueues.keys());
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Lifecycle
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Clear all queues (used for testing or shutdown)
     */
    clearAll(): void {
        for (const agentId of this.agentQueues.keys()) {
            this.clearQueue(agentId);
        }
        this.agentQueues.clear();
        this.eventIndex.clear();
        logger.info('[AgentEventQueueStore] Cleared all queues');
    }

    /**
     * Initialize store with events loaded from persistence
     */
    loadEvents(events: AgentEventMessage[]): void {
        for (const event of events) {
            // Only load pending or delivered events
            if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING ||
                event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED) {
                const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
                } else {
                    queue.deliveredEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
                }

                this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
                    agentId: event.targetAgentId,
                    eventId: event.eventId
                });
            }
        }

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Loaded ${events.length} events from persistence`);
    }
}

export const agentEventQueueStore = AgentEventQueueStore.getInstance();
export default agentEventQueueStore;

/**
 * Agent Event Queue CLI Service
 * CLI service for managing agent event queues - supports inter-agent messaging,
 * application notifications, and event queue operations.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { wsconnectionManager } from '../sockets/socketManager';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueDataService } from '../services/agentEventQueueDataService';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventPayload,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventInput,
    GetPendingEventsInput,
    PullEventsInput,
    AckEventInput,
    SendAgentMessageInput,
    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
    PullEventsResponseData,
    AddEventResponseData,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// CLI Service
// ============================================================================

export const agentEventQueueCliService = {
    initialized: false,

    /**
     * Initialize the service
     */
    async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        if (this.initialized) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Initialize data service
            await agentEventQueueDataService.initialize();

            // Load pending events from storage into memory
            await this.loadPendingEventsToMemory();

            // Set up event listeners for persistence
            this.setupEventListeners();

            this.initialized = true;
            logger.info('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialized successfully');
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialization error: ${error.message}`);
            throw error;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Load pending events from storage into memory store
     */
    async loadPendingEventsToMemory(): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const events = await agentEventQueueDataService.getAllPendingEventsFromStorage();
            if (events.length > 0) {
                agentEventQueueStore.loadEvents(events);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Loaded ${events.length} pending events from storage`);
            }
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error loading events: ${error.message}`);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Set up event listeners for persistence
     */
    setupEventListeners(): void {
        // Persist new events
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:added', async ({ event }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.appendEvent(event);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error persisting event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when event is acknowledged
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', async ({ eventId }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.updateIndexStatus(eventId, AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error updating acknowledged event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when events are pulled
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:pulled', async ({ agentId }) => {
            // Events are already removed from memory, just need to clean up index
            // This is handled by the pull operation itself
        });

        logger.debug('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Event listeners configured');
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // CLI API Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event for an agent (CLI API for external agents)
     */
    async addEventForAgent(
        params: AddEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            // Validate required fields
            if (!params.targetAgentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'targetAgentId is required'
                };
            }

            if (!params.payload) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'payload is required'
                };
            }

            // Create event
            const event: AgentEventMessage = {
                eventId: uuidv4(),
                targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
                targetAgentInstanceId: params.targetAgentInstanceId,
                targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
                sourceAgentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
                sourceThreadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                eventType: params.eventType || AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
                priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload: params.payload,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
                status: AgentEventStatus.PENDING,
                retryCount: 0,
                metadata: params.metadata
            };

            // Add to store (triggers persistence via event)
            agentEventQueueStore.addEvent(event);

            // Attempt immediate delivery
            await this.attemptImmediateDelivery(event);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'CREATED',
                message: 'Event added successfully',
                data: { event },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()

            await this.loadPendingEventsToMemory();

            // Set up event listeners for persistence
            this.setupEventListeners();

            this.initialized = true;
            logger.info('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialized successfully');
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialization error: ${error.message}`);
            throw error;
        }

    /**

        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error loading events: ${error.message}`);

    /**

    setupEventListeners(): void {

        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:added', async ({ event }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.appendEvent(event);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error persisting event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when event is acknowledged
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', async ({ eventId }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.updateIndexStatus(eventId, AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error updating acknowledged event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when events are pulled
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:pulled', async ({ agentId }) => {
            // Events are already removed from memory, just need to clean up index
            // This is handled by the pull operation itself
        });

        logger.debug('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Event listeners configured');
    },

            const event: AgentEventMessage = {

                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
                status: AgentEventStatus.PENDING,

    /**
     * Attempt immediate delivery via WebSocket
     */
    async attemptImmediateDelivery(event: AgentEventMessage): Promise<boolean> {
        try {
            // Try to find socket by agentInstanceId first, then by agentId, then by threadId
            let socket: any = null;

            if (event.targetAgentInstanceId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById?.(event.targetAgentInstanceId);
            }

            if (!socket) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByAgentId(event.targetAgentId);
            }

            if (!socket && event.targetThreadId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(event.targetThreadId);
            }

            if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) { // WebSocket.OPEN
                const message = {
                    type: 'agentEvent',
                    event
                };
                socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
                agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered event ${event.eventId} to agent ${event.targetAgentId}`);
                return true;
            }

            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] No active socket for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, event queued`);
            return false;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering event: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Deliver pending events to an agent (called when agent connects)
     */
    async deliverPendingEventsToAgent(agentId: string, socket: any): Promise<number> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const pendingEvents = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId);
            let deliveredCount = 0;

            for (const event of pendingEvents) {
                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    try {
                        socket.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'agentEvent',
                            event
                        }));
                        agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                        deliveredCount++;
                    } catch (error: any) {
                        logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Failed to deliver event ${event.eventId}: ${error.message}`);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deliveredCount > 0) {
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered ${deliveredCount} pending events to agent ${agentId}`);
            }

            return deliveredCount;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return 0;
        }
    },

// Subscribe to agentEvent messages from WebSocket
const agentEventSubscription = cbws.messageManager.subscribe('agentEvent');
agentEventSubscription.on('message', (message: any) => {
    const event = message.event as AgentEventMessage;
    if (event && event.eventId) {
        // Store in local cache
        localEventCache.set(event.eventId, event);

        const payload = (event as any).payload;
        let pushedTypedExternalEvent = false;
        if (payload?.type === 'custom' && payload?.eventName === 'threadCompletion') {
            const data = payload.data || {};
            const threadId = data.threadId || data.targetThreadId;
            if (threadId) {
                const externalEvent: UnifiedExternalEvent = {
                    type: 'backgroundAgentCompletion',
                    data: {
                        ...data,
                        eventId: event.eventId,
                        threadId,
                        success: data.error ? false : data.success,
                    }
                };
                pendingExternalEvents.push(externalEvent);
                eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', externalEvent);
                pushedTypedExternalEvent = true;
            }
        }

        // Also push to unified external events cache
        if (!pushedTypedExternalEvent) {
            pendingExternalEvents.push({ type: 'agentQueueEvent', data: event });
        }

        // Notify waiting promises
        eventEmitter.emit('newEvent', event);
        if (!pushedTypedExternalEvent) {
            eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', { type: 'agentQueueEvent', data: event });
        }

        // Call registered handlers
        for (const handler of eventHandlers) {
            try {
                handler(event);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('[AgentEventQueue] Error in event handler:', error);
            }
        }
    }
});

// Subscribe to ThreadCompleted as an alternative message type

        const externalEvent: UnifiedExternalEvent = { type: 'backgroundAgentCompletion', data: message };
        pendingExternalEvents.push(externalEvent);
        eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', externalEvent);
    }
});

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Types
 * Type definitions for the Agent Event Queue system in codeboltjs SDK
 */

// ============================================================================
// Event Type Enums
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Types of events that can be sent to agents
 */
export enum AgentEventType {
    /** Inter-agent communication */
    AGENT_MESSAGE = 'agentMessage',
    /** Calendar event notifications (reminders, updates) */
    CALENDAR_UPDATE = 'calendarUpdate',
    /** System-level notifications */
    SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION = 'systemNotification',
    /** Task status change notifications */
    TASK_UPDATE = 'taskUpdate',
    /** User-defined custom events */
    CUSTOM = 'custom'
}

/**
 * Status of an event in the queue
 */
export enum AgentEventStatus {
    /** In queue, awaiting delivery */
    PENDING = 'pending',
    /** Sent via WebSocket, awaiting acknowledgement */
    DELIVERED = 'delivered',
    /** Acknowledgement received, can be archived */
    ACKNOWLEDGED = 'acked',
    /** Retrieved via pull mode (auto-removed) */
    PULLED = 'pulled',
    /** Delivery failed */
    FAILED = 'failed',
    /** Event expired before delivery */
    EXPIRED = 'expired'
}

/**
 * Priority levels for events
 */
export enum AgentEventPriority {
    LOW = 'low',
    NORMAL = 'normal',
    HIGH = 'high',
    URGENT = 'urgent'
}

// ============================================================================
// Payload Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Payload for inter-agent messages
 */
export interface AgentMessagePayload {
    type: 'agentMessage';
    /** Message content */
    content: string;
    /** Type of message content */
    messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command';
    /** Reference to a previous eventId for replies */
    replyTo?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for calendar update notifications
 */
export interface CalendarUpdatePayload {
    type: 'calendarUpdate';
    /** ID of the calendar event */
    calendarEventId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder';
    /** Title of the calendar event */
    eventTitle?: string;
    /** Event start time (ISO string) */
    startTime?: string;
    /** Event end time (ISO string) */
    endTime?: string;
    /** Additional event details */
    description?: string;
    /** Location of the event */
    location?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for system notifications
 */
export interface SystemNotificationPayload {
    type: 'systemNotification';
    /** Type of notification */
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success';
    /** Notification title */
    title: string;
    /** Notification message */
    message: string;
    /** Whether the agent needs to take action */
    actionRequired?: boolean;
    /** Action to take if actionRequired is true */
    actionType?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for task update notifications
 */
export interface TaskUpdatePayload {
    type: 'taskUpdate';
    /** ID of the task */
    taskId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
    /** Title of the task */
    taskTitle?: string;
    /** Current status of the task */
    status?: string;
    /** Progress percentage (0-100) */
    progress?: number;
    /** Error message if failed */
    errorMessage?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for custom events
 */
export interface CustomEventPayload {
    type: 'custom';
    /** Name/identifier for the custom event */
    eventName: string;
    /** Arbitrary data for the custom event */
    data: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Union type for all event payloads
 */
export type AgentEventPayload =
    | AgentMessagePayload
    | CalendarUpdatePayload
    | SystemNotificationPayload
    | TaskUpdatePayload
    | CustomEventPayload;

// ============================================================================
// Core Event Message Interface
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Core event message structure
 */
export interface AgentEventMessage {
    /** Unique event identifier (UUID) */
    eventId: string;
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID (optional) */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID (optional) */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Source agent ID (for inter-agent messages) */
    sourceAgentId?: string;
    /** Source thread ID */
    sourceThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */
    priority: AgentEventPriority;
    /** Event payload (discriminated by type) */
    payload: AgentEventPayload;
    /** Event creation timestamp (ISO string) */
    createdAt: string;
    /** When the event was delivered via WebSocket */
    deliveredAt?: string;
    /** When acknowledgement was received */
    acknowledgedAt?: string;
    /** Optional expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Current status of the event */
    status: AgentEventStatus;
    /** Number of delivery retry attempts */
    retryCount: number;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

// ============================================================================
// Request/Input Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Input for adding an event to an agent's queue
 */
export interface AddEventInput {
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType?: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */

    /** Event payload */
    payload: AgentEventPayload;
    /** Optional expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

export interface GetPendingEventsInput {

<message role="assistant" ordinal="853" timestamp="2026-07-07T13:37:08.863Z">
&lt;proposed_plan&gt;
## Backend-First Normalized Agent Events

### Summary
Move agent events to one durable source of truth: the backend queue. The SDK will expose only normalized, consume-on-read events to agents. Remove the current split between raw queue events, SDK in-memory external events, and ack-driven local cache behavior for agent-facing flows.

### Key Changes
- **Backend event shape**
  - Store and return normalized events directly:
    
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
    {
      eventId: string,
      type: 'backgroundCommandCompletion' | 'threadCompletion' | 'steering' | 'agentMessage' | 'systemNotification' | 'taskUpdate' | 'custom',
      data: Record<string, any>,
      metadata: {
        sourceAgentId?: string,
        sourceThreadId?: string,
        targetAgentId: string,
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string,
        targetThreadId?: string,
        priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent',
        createdAt: string
      }
    }
    
]]></code_block>
  - Convert current `eventType + payload.type + payload.eventName` producers to create this normalized shape at source.
  - Keep a compatibility adapter only for old stored events that still have `payload.eventName`.

- **Backend queue behavior**
  - Make agent-facing `getPendingEvents` consume events using existing pull semantics.
  - `waitForNextEvent` should first consume pending events; if none exist, wait for a lightweight websocket notification, then consume from backend.
  - Remove ack from the normal agent-facing path. Reading means consuming.
  - Replace full websocket event delivery with `agentEventAvailable` notification. The SDK should not store full events locally as source of truth.

- **`sdks/codeboltjs` API**
  - Add:
    
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
    codebolt.agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents(options?)
    codebolt.agentEventQueue.waitForNextEvent(options?)
    
]]></code_block>
  - Both return normalized events, not raw `AgentEventMessage`.
  - Soft-deprecate existing:
    
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
    getPendingQueueEvents()
    waitForNextQueueEvent()
    getPendingExternalEvents()
    waitForAnyExternalEvent()
    acknowledgeEvent()
    peekLocalCache()
    clearLocalCache()
    
]]></code_block>
  - For compatibility, old queue APIs can call the new backend consume path internally, but should no longer rely on local event cache or ack.

- **`sdks/agent` and `act-updated`**
  - Replace `getPendingExternalEvents()` in `act-updated` with `getPendingEvents()`.
  - Inject normalized event types into the prompt:
    - `backgroundCommandCompletion`: command status, exit code, output tail.
    - `threadCompletion`: child thread status/output.
    - `steering`: user instruction.
    - `agentMessage`: inter-agent message.
  - Keep async-task completion gating unchanged: `async_task_list` / `async_task_control` still governs unresolved commands and child threads.
  - Fix `act-updated/package.json` local dependencies so it resolves this repo’s `sdks/agent`, `sdks/codeboltjs`, and `packages/types` on Windows.

### Test Plan
- **Backend queue**
  - Add event, call `getPendingEvents`, verify event is returned normalized and removed from pending queue.
  - Add event, call `waitForNextEvent`, verify it returns immediately if already pending.
  - Call `waitForNextEvent` before event exists, add event, verify websocket notification wakes the waiter and backend pull returns the event.
  - Verify no ack is required and no event is lost while the agent process is stopped.

- **Event producers**
  - Background command completion produces `type: &#39;backgroundCommandCompletion&#39;`.
  - Child thread completion produces `type: &#39;threadCompletion&#39;`.
  - Steering messages produce `type: &#39;steering&#39;`.
  - Inter-agent messages produce `type: &#39;agentMessage&#39;`.

- **Agent behavior**
  - Start `background_scoped` command, let agent stop, restart agent, verify completion event is injected from backend queue.
  - Start long-running scoped task and attempt completion, verify `sdks/agent` still blocks completion until wait/stop/detach.
  - Force-stop agent with scoped and detached tasks, verify scoped tasks stop and detached tasks remain visible on next run.

- **Build checks**
  - `npm run build --workspace=packages/server`
  - `npx tsc --noEmit --project packages/types/tsconfig.json`
  - `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/codeboltjs`
  - `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/agent`
  - `npx tsc --noEmit --project D:\Codeboltapps\codeboltjs\agents\act-updated\tsconfig.json`

### Assumptions
- We accept consume-on-read risk: if an agent pulls an event and crashes before injecting it into context, that event is consumed.
- No public raw-event API is needed for agents in this version.
- Existing old stored events may exist, so backend should include a short compatibility adapter during read/pull.
- `getPendingEvents` means “consume pending events,” not “peek.” If non-consuming debug is needed later, add `peekPendingEvents`.
&lt;/proposed_plan&gt;
</message>

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (sorted by priority then creation time)
     * Includes both PENDING and DELIVERED events (delivered but not yet acknowledged)
     */
    getPendingEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            return [];
        }

        // Get events from both pending and delivered queues
        // PENDING = not yet sent, DELIVERED = sent but not acknowledged
        const pendingEvents = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING);

        const deliveredEvents = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED);

        const allEvents = [...pendingEvents, ...deliveredEvents]
            .sort((a, b) => {
                // Sort by priority (lower PRIORITY_ORDER value = higher priority)
                const priorityDiff = PRIORITY_ORDER[a.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[b.priority];
                if (priorityDiff !== 0) {
                    return priorityDiff;
                }
                // Then by creation time (oldest first)
                return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();
            });

        return limit ? allEvents.slice(0, limit) : allEvents;
    }

    /**
     * Pull events - get and remove from queue (no ACK needed)
     */
    pullEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const events = this.getPendingEvents(agentId, limit);
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);

        if (queue && events.length > 0) {
            for (const event of events) {
                event.status = AgentEventStatus.PULLED;
                queue.pendingEvents.delete(event.eventId);
                this.eventIndex.delete(event.eventId);
            }

            // Emit event
            this.emit('agentEventQueue:pulled', {
                agentId,
                count: events.length
            });

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Pulled ${events.length} events for agent ${agentId}`);
        }

        return events;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of pending events for an agent (includes PENDING and DELIVERED)

    async addEventForAgent(
        params: AddEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            // Validate required fields
            if (!params.targetAgentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'targetAgentId is required'
                };
            }

            if (!params.payload) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'payload is required'
                };
            }

            // Create event
            const event: AgentEventMessage = {
                eventId: uuidv4(),
                targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
                targetAgentInstanceId: params.targetAgentInstanceId,
                targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
                sourceAgentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
                sourceThreadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                eventType: params.eventType || AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
                priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload: params.payload,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
                status: AgentEventStatus.PENDING,
                retryCount: 0,
                metadata: params.metadata
            };

            // Add to store (triggers persistence via event)
            agentEventQueueStore.addEvent(event);

            // Attempt immediate delivery
            await this.attemptImmediateDelivery(event);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'CREATED',
                message: 'Event added successfully',
                data: { event },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error adding event: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to add event',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (read-only)
     */
    async getPendingEvents(
        params: GetPendingEventsInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents called for agentId: ${agentId}`);

            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            let events = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId, params.limit);
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents found ${events.length} events for agentId: ${agentId}, eventIds: ${events.map(e => e.eventId).join(', ')}`);

            // Filter by event types if specified
            if (params.eventTypes && params.eventTypes.length > 0) {
                events = events.filter(e => params.eventTypes!.includes(e.eventType));
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: 'Pending events retrieved',
                data: {
                    events,
                    count: events.length,
                    pendingCount: agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCount(agentId)
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to get pending events',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

                data: {

                    count: events.length

                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error pulling events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to pull events',

<message role="assistant" ordinal="860" timestamp="2026-07-07T13:46:13.994Z">
Yes, I think we should add an explicit **event scope**. The current `targetAgentId`, `targetAgentInstanceId`, `targetThreadId` fields are not enough because they do not clearly define lifecycle.

Recommended model:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
{
  eventId: string,
  type: 'backgroundCommandCompletion' | 'threadCompletion' | 'steering' | 'agentMessage' | 'systemNotification' | 'taskUpdate' | 'custom',
  scope: 'agent_instance' | 'thread' | 'agent',
  target: {
    agentId?: string,
    agentInstanceId?: string,
    threadId?: string
  },
  data: Record<string, any>,
  metadata: {
    priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent',
    createdAt: string,
    sourceAgentId?: string,
    sourceThreadId?: string
  }
}
]]></code_block>
Meaning:
<code_block language="txt"><![CDATA[
agent_instance
= only for this running agent process
= drop if that agent instance is gone
= example: live steering to currently running agent

thread
= belongs to the thread, not a specific process
= next agent process for that thread should receive it
= example: backgroundCommandCompletion, force-stop cleanup summary

agent
= belongs to agent identity across threads/runs
= less common, maybe global agent notifications
]]></code_block>
For your use case:

- `backgroundCommandCompletion` should be `scope: &#39;thread&#39;`
  - because command was started in a thread
  - if current agent process ended, next agent for same thread should still see it

- user steering while agent is actively running can be `scope: &#39;agent_instance&#39;`
  - because it is meant to interrupt current execution
  - if user stops that agent, stale steering should not hit the next run accidentally

- force-stop cleanup event should be `scope: &#39;thread&#39;`
  - next run should know scoped tasks were stopped and detached tasks survived

- child thread completion should usually be `scope: &#39;thread&#39;` for the parent thread
  - parent thread’s next agent run should see child completion

So yes, update the plan: backend queue should not only normalize event type, it should also own **event scope and lifecycle**. This solves the “drop after agent closes vs deliver on next thread run” question cleanly.
</message>

&lt;proposed_plan&gt;
## Backend-First Scoped Agent Events

### Summary
Use the backend queue as the only source of truth. Replace SDK in-memory external event caching with consume-on-read normalized events. Add explicit event scope so events either belong to the current agent process or to the thread and can survive agent restarts.

### Event Model
Use only two scopes:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
type AgentEventScope = 'agent_instance' | 'thread';

type AgentEvent = {
  eventId: string;
  type:
    | 'backgroundCommandCompletion'
    | 'threadCompletion'
    | 'steering'
    | 'agentMessage'
    | 'systemNotification'
    | 'taskUpdate'
    | 'forceStopCleanup'
    | 'custom';
  scope: AgentEventScope;
  target: {
    threadId?: string;
    agentId?: string;
    agentInstanceId?: string;
  };
  data: Record<string, any>;
  metadata: {
    priority: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent';
    createdAt: string;
    sourceAgentId?: string;
    sourceThreadId?: string;
  };
};
]]></code_block>
Scope behavior:

- `agent_instance`: deliver only to the specific running agent instance. If that instance exits before consuming it, drop it.
- `thread`: deliver to the next/current agent process for that thread. It survives agent restarts until consumed.

Default event scopes:

- `backgroundCommandCompletion`: `thread`
- `threadCompletion`: `thread`
- `forceStopCleanup`: `thread`
- `steering`: `agent_instance`
- `agentMessage`: `thread` when `threadId` is present, otherwise reject for now
- `systemNotification` / `taskUpdate` / `custom`: require caller to pass scope explicitly

### Backend Changes
- Update the server queue model to store normalized `AgentEvent` records directly instead of `eventType + payload.eventName`.
- Add thread-indexed queue lookup in addition to current agent-id lookup:
  - `agent_instance` events are matched by `target.agentInstanceId`.
  - `thread` events are matched by `target.threadId`.
- Change public consume path:
  - `pullEvents` becomes the implementation behind agent-facing `getPendingEvents`.
  - consuming removes events from memory and persistence.
  - no ack required for the agent-facing path.
- Keep read-only debug API separately as `peekPendingEvents` if needed.
- Change websocket delivery to lightweight notification:
  
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
  { type: 'agentEventAvailable', scope, threadId?, agentInstanceId? }
  
]]></code_block>
  Do not push full events as the main delivery mechanism.
- Add cleanup on agent instance close/force-stop:
  - remove unconsumed `agent_instance` events for that `agentInstanceId`.
  - keep `thread` events.

### SDK Changes
- In `sdks/codeboltjs`, expose:
  
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
  codebolt.agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents(options?)
  codebolt.agentEventQueue.waitForNextEvent(options?)
  
]]></code_block>
- `getPendingEvents` consumes currently pending normalized events and returns an array.
- `waitForNextEvent` first calls `getPendingEvents({ limit: 1 })`; if none exist, waits for `agentEventAvailable`, then pulls again.
- Remove SDK local event cache from the normal flow.
- Soft-deprecate:
  
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
  getPendingQueueEvents()
  waitForNextQueueEvent()
  getPendingExternalEvents()
  waitForAnyExternalEvent()
  acknowledgeEvent()
  peekLocalCache()
  clearLocalCache()
  
]]></code_block>
- Keep compatibility wrappers temporarily, but internally route them to the new consume-on-read backend flow.

### Agent SDK And `act-updated`
- Replace `getPendingExternalEvents()` in `act-updated` with:
  
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
  const events = await codebolt.agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents();
  
]]></code_block>
- Inject normalized events into the prompt by `event.type`.
- Keep `ResponseExecutor` async-task completion gate unchanged.
- Keep `EnvironmentContextModifier` async-task listing unchanged.
- Fix `act-updated/package.json` local dependencies so it resolves this repo’s `sdks/agent`, `sdks/codeboltjs`, and `packages/types`.

### Test Plan
- `agent_instance` steering:
  - send steering to live agent instance
  - verify `waitForNextEvent` receives it
  - stop agent before consuming another steering event
  - verify next run does not receive stale steering
- `thread` command completion:
  - start `background_scoped` command
  - let agent stop/restart
  - verify next run receives `backgroundCommandCompletion`
- `thread` child completion:
  - start child thread
  - parent agent exits
  - verify next parent run receives `threadCompletion`
- `forceStopCleanup`:
  - force-stop agent with scoped and detached tasks
  - verify next run receives cleanup event
- Build/type checks:
  - server build
  - types no-emit check
  - `sdks/codeboltjs` build
  - `sdks/agent` build
  - `act-updated` no-emit check

### Assumptions
- We accept consume-on-read risk: if an agent pulls an event and crashes before injecting it into context, the event is lost.
- No `agent` scope is needed.
- Thread-scoped events are intended for any future agent process running that thread.
- Agent-instance-scoped events are live-process only and should not survive process exit.
&lt;/proposed_plan&gt;
</message>

Use only two scopes:
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[
type AgentEventScope = 'agent_instance' | 'thread';

- `steering`: `agent_instance`

- `systemNotification` / `taskUpdate` / `custom`: require caller to pass scope explicitly

- Replace `eventType + payload + ack/delivered` queue records with normalized `AgentEvent` records.
- Remove ack/delivered state from the agent-facing queue path.
- Add lookup by scope:
  - `agent_instance` events match `target.agentInstanceId`.
  - `thread` events match `target.threadId`.

  - returns matching normalized events
  - removes them from memory and persistence
  - does not require ack
- Remove old backend actions:
  - `pullEvents`

  - `acknowledgeEvent`
- Add optional debug-only `peekPendingEvents` only if needed during implementation/testing.

]]></code_block>

  codebolt.agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessage(options?)
  
]]></code_block>
- `getPendingEvents` consumes currently pending normalized events and returns an array.
- `waitForNextEvent` first calls `getPendingEvents({ limit: 1 })`; if none exist, waits for `agentEventAvailable`, then pulls again.

<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[

  waitForNextQueueEvent()

  waitForAnyExternalEvent()
  acknowledgeEvent()

  clearLocalCache()
  _acknowledgeEvent()
  _fetchPendingFromBackend()

]]></code_block>
- Update agent-event tools and pseudo-CLI to use only the new normalized event APIs.

### Agent SDK And `act-updated`
- Replace `getPendingExternalEvents()` in `act-updated` with:
  
<code_block language="ts"><![CDATA[

]]></code_block>
- Inject normalized events into the prompt by `event.type`.
- Keep `ResponseExecutor` async-task completion gate unchanged.
- Keep `EnvironmentContextModifier` async-task listing unchanged.
- Fix `act-updated/package.json` local dependencies so it resolves this repo’s `sdks/agent`, `sdks/codeboltjs`, and `packages/types`.
- Remove references in prompts/docs/tools that tell agents to use old queue APIs.

### Test Plan
- `agent_instance` steering:
  - send steering to live agent instance
  - verify `waitForNextEvent` receives it
  - stop agent before consuming another steering event
  - verify next run does not receive stale steering
- `thread` command completion:

- `thread` child completion:

- Build/type checks:

  - types no-emit check

### Assumptions
- We accept consume-on-read risk: if an agent pulls an event and crashes before injecting it into context, the event is lost.

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';

 */
export interface EventQueueSendMessageParams {
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Target thread ID (optional) */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Message content */
    content: string;
    /** Message type */
    messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command';
    /** Message priority */
    priority?: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent';
    /** Reference to a previous event ID for replies */
    replyTo?: string;
}

class EventQueueSendMessageInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    EventQueueSendMessageParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: EventQueueSendMessageParams) {
        super(params);
    }

        try {

                    },

            let llmContent = `Message sent successfully.\n\n`;
            llmContent += `Event ID: ${response.data?.event?.eventId}\n`;

                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Internal Functions
 * Convenience functions for internal application components to send events to agents.
 * Use these functions from calendar service, task service, notification systems, etc.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventStatus,
    CalendarUpdatePayload,
    SystemNotificationPayload,
    TaskUpdatePayload,
    SteeringPayload,
    CustomEventPayload,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventResponseData
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// Internal Functions for Application Components
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Send a calendar update notification to an agent
 * Use this when calendar events are created, updated, or have reminders
 */
export async function sendCalendarUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    calendarEventId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder' | 'rescheduled',
    details?: {
        eventTitle?: string;
        startTime?: string;
        endTime?: string;
        location?: string;
        description?: string;
        reminderMinutes?: number;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'calendarUpdate',
        calendarEventId,
        action: action as any,
        eventTitle: details?.eventTitle,
        startTime: details?.startTime,
        endTime: details?.endTime,
        location: details?.location,
        description: details?.description,
        reminderMinutes: details?.reminderMinutes
    } as CalendarUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'reminder') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CALENDAR_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a system notification to an agent
 * Use for alerts, warnings, important system messages
 */
export async function sendSystemNotification(
    targetAgentId: string,
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'alert',
    title: string,
    message: string,
    options?: {
        actionRequired?: boolean;
        actionUrl?: string;
        actionLabel?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'systemNotification',
        notificationType: notificationType as any,
        title,
        message,
        actionRequired: options?.actionRequired,
        actionUrl: options?.actionUrl,
        actionLabel: options?.actionLabel
    } as SystemNotificationPayload;

    // Determine priority based on notification type
    let priority = options?.priority;
    if (!priority) {
        switch (notificationType) {
            case 'error':
            case 'alert':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
                break;
            case 'warning':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
                break;
            default:
                priority = AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
        }
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION,
        priority,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a task update notification to an agent
 * Use when tasks are created, updated, completed, or have status changes
 */
export async function sendTaskUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    taskId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'statusChanged' | 'dueSoon' | 'overdue',
    details?: {
        taskTitle?: string;
        status?: string;
        previousStatus?: string;
        assignee?: string;
        dueDate?: string;
        description?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'taskUpdate',
        taskId,
        action: action as any,
        taskTitle: details?.taskTitle,
        status: details?.status,
        previousStatus: details?.previousStatus,
        assignee: details?.assignee,
        dueDate: details?.dueDate,
        description: details?.description
    } as TaskUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'overdue') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
    } else if (action === 'dueSoon' || action === 'assigned') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.TASK_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a custom event to an agent
 * Use for application-specific events that don't fit other categories
 */
export async function sendCustomEvent(
    targetAgentId: string,
    eventName: string,
    data: Record<string, any>,
    options?: {
        targetThreadId?: string;
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload: CustomEventPayload = {
        type: 'custom',
        eventName,
        data
    };

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        targetAgentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a steering message to a running agent via the event queue
 * Use when the user sends a steering/instruction message to a running agent
 */
export async function sendSteeringMessage(
    targetAgentId: string,
    instruction: string,
    threadId: string,
    options?: {
        steeringStepId?: string;
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        context?: Record<string, any>;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload: SteeringPayload = {
        type: 'steering',
        instruction,
        steeringStepId: options?.steeringStepId,
        threadId,
        context: options?.context
    };

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetAgentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
        targetThreadId: threadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.STEERING,
        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.HIGH,
        payload,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'user', threadId });
}

/**
 * Broadcast an event to multiple agents
 * Use when the same notification needs to go to multiple agents
 */
export async function broadcastToAgents(
    targetAgentIds: string[],
    eventType: AgentEventType,
    payload: any,
    options?: {
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;
    }>;
}> {
    const results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;
    }> = [];

    for (const targetAgentId of targetAgentIds) {
        try {
            const response = await agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
                targetAgentId,
                eventType,
                priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload,
                expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
                metadata: options?.metadata
            }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });

            results.push({
                agentId: targetAgentId,
                success: response.success,
                eventId: response.data?.event?.eventId,
                error: response.error?.message
            });
        } catch (error: any) {
            results.push({
                agentId: targetAgentId,
                success: false,
                error: error.message
            });
        }
    }

    const allSuccess = results.every(r => r.success);
    return {
        success: allSuccess,
        results
    };
}

/**

 */
export async function sendAgentToAgentMessage(
    sourceAgentId: string,
    sourceThreadId: string,

    content: string,
    options?: {
        messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command' | 'response';
        targetThreadId?: string;
        replyTo?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {

        content,
        messageType: (options?.messageType || 'text') as any,
        replyTo: options?.replyTo,
        priority: options?.priority
    }, { agentId: sourceAgentId, threadId: sourceThreadId });
}

/**

 */
