/**
 * Agent Event Queue Internal Functions
 * Convenience functions for internal application components to send events to agents.
 * Use these functions from calendar service, task service, notification systems, etc.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventStatus,
    CalendarUpdatePayload,
    SystemNotificationPayload,
    TaskUpdatePayload,
    SteeringPayload,
    CustomEventPayload,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventResponseData
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// Internal Functions for Application Components
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Send a calendar update notification to an agent
 * Use this when calendar events are created, updated, or have reminders
 */
export async function sendCalendarUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    calendarEventId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder' | 'rescheduled',
    details?: {
        eventTitle?: string;
        startTime?: string;
        endTime?: string;
        location?: string;
        description?: string;
        reminderMinutes?: number;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'calendarUpdate',
        calendarEventId,
        action: action as any,
        eventTitle: details?.eventTitle,
        startTime: details?.startTime,
        endTime: details?.endTime,
        location: details?.location,
        description: details?.description,
        reminderMinutes: details?.reminderMinutes
    } as CalendarUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'reminder') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CALENDAR_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a system notification to an agent
 * Use for alerts, warnings, important system messages
 */
export async function sendSystemNotification(
    targetAgentId: string,
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'alert',
    title: string,
    message: string,
    options?: {
        actionRequired?: boolean;
        actionUrl?: string;
        actionLabel?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'systemNotification',
        notificationType: notificationType as any,
        title,
        message,
        actionRequired: options?.actionRequired,
        actionUrl: options?.actionUrl,
        actionLabel: options?.actionLabel
    } as SystemNotificationPayload;

    // Determine priority based on notification type
    let priority = options?.priority;
    if (!priority) {
        switch (notificationType) {
            case 'error':
            case 'alert':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
                break;
            case 'warning':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
                break;
            default:
                priority = AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
        }
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION,
        priority,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a task update notification to an agent
 * Use when tasks are created, updated, completed, or have status changes
 */
export async function sendTaskUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    taskId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'statusChanged' | 'dueSoon' | 'overdue',
    details?: {
        taskTitle?: string;
        status?: string;
        previousStatus?: string;
        assignee?: string;
        dueDate?: string;
        description?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'taskUpdate',
        taskId,
        action: action as any,
        taskTitle: details?.taskTitle,
        status: details?.status,
        previousStatus: details?.previousStatus,
        assignee: details?.assignee,
        dueDate: details?.dueDate,
        description: details?.description
    } as TaskUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'overdue') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
    } else if (action === 'dueSoon' || action === 'assigned') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.TASK_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a custom event to an agent
 * Use for application-specific events that don't fit other categories
 */
export async function sendCustomEvent(
    targetAgentId: string,
    eventName: string,
    data: Record<string, any>,
    options?: {
        targetThreadId?: string;
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload: CustomEventPayload = {
        type: 'custom',
        eventName,
        data
    };

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        targetAgentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a steering message to a running agent via the event queue
 * Use when the user sends a steering/instruction message to a running agent
 */
export async function sendSteeringMessage(
    targetAgentId: string,
    instruction: string,
    threadId: string,
    options?: {
        steeringStepId?: string;
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        context?: Record<string, any>;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload: SteeringPayload = {
        type: 'steering',
        instruction,
        steeringStepId: options?.steeringStepId,
        threadId,
        context: options?.context
    };

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetAgentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
        targetThreadId: threadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.STEERING,
        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.HIGH,
        payload,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'user', threadId });
}

/**
 * Broadcast an event to multiple agents
 * Use when the same notification needs to go to multiple agents
 */
export async function broadcastToAgents(
    targetAgentIds: string[],
    eventType: AgentEventType,
    payload: any,
    options?: {
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;
    }>;
}> {
    const results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;
    }> = [];

    for (const targetAgentId of targetAgentIds) {
        try {
            const response = await agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
                targetAgentId,
                eventType,
                priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload,
                expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
                metadata: options?.metadata
            }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });

            results.push({
                agentId: targetAgentId,
                success: response.success,
                eventId: response.data?.event?.eventId,
                error: response.error?.message
            });
        } catch (error: any) {
            results.push({
                agentId: targetAgentId,
                success: false,
                error: error.message
            });
        }
    }

    const allSuccess = results.every(r => r.success);
    return {
        success: allSuccess,
        results
    };
}

/**
 * Send an inter-agent message (convenience wrapper)
 * Use when one agent needs to communicate with another
 */
export async function sendAgentToAgentMessage(
    sourceAgentId: string,
    sourceThreadId: string,
    targetAgentId: string,
    content: string,
    options?: {
        messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command' | 'response';
        targetThreadId?: string;
        replyTo?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    return agentEventQueueCliService.sendAgentMessage({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        content,
        messageType: (options?.messageType || 'text') as any,
        replyTo: options?.replyTo,
        priority: options?.priority
    }, { agentId: sourceAgentId, threadId: sourceThreadId });
}

/**
 * Get pending event count for an agent
 * Useful for UI badges and indicators
 */
export function getPendingEventCount(agentId: string): number {
    return agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCount(agentId);
}

/**
 * Get queue statistics
 * Useful for monitoring and debugging
 */
export function getQueueStats(): {
    totalQueues: number;
    totalPendingEvents: number;
    totalDeliveredEvents: number;
} {
    return agentEventQueueStore.getStats();
}

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Module
 * Provides functionality for managing agent event queues with local caching,
 * WebSocket event subscription, and acknowledgement handling.
 */

import cbws from '../core/websocket';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import type {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AddEventInput,
    SendAgentMessageInput,
    AckEventInput,
    GetPendingEventsInput,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventResponseData,
    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
    QueueStatsResponseData,
    QueueEventHandler
} from '@codebolt/types/lib';

// Re-export types for convenience
export type {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AddEventInput,
    SendAgentMessageInput,
    AckEventInput,
    GetPendingEventsInput,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventResponseData,
    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
    QueueStatsResponseData,
    QueueEventHandler
} from '@codebolt/types/lib';

export {
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventPriority
} from '@codebolt/types/lib';

// ============================================================================
// Unified External Event Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Types of external events that can be received
 */
export type ExternalEventType =
    | 'agentQueueEvent'
    | 'backgroundAgentCompletion'
    | 'backgroundGroupedAgentCompletion';

/**
 * Unified external event structure
 */
export interface UnifiedExternalEvent {
    type: ExternalEventType;
    data: any;
}

// ============================================================================
// Local Event Cache
// ============================================================================

/** Local cache for agent events received via WebSocket */
const localEventCache = new Map<string, AgentEventMessage>();

/** Unified cache for all external events (queue events, background completions, grouped completions) */
const pendingExternalEvents: UnifiedExternalEvent[] = [];

/** Registered event handlers */
const eventHandlers = new Set<QueueEventHandler>();

/** Event emitter for waiting promises */
import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
const eventEmitter = new EventEmitter();

function acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event: UnifiedExternalEvent): void {
    const eventId = event.type === 'agentQueueEvent'
        ? event.data?.eventId
        : event.data?.eventId;
    if (!eventId) {
        return;
    }

    void agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(eventId, true)
        .then(() => {
            localEventCache.delete(eventId);
        })
        .catch((error) => {
            console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${eventId}:`, error);
        });
}

// ============================================================================
// WebSocket Subscriptions
// ============================================================================

// Subscribe to agentEvent messages from WebSocket
const agentEventSubscription = cbws.messageManager.subscribe('agentEvent');
agentEventSubscription.on('message', (message: any) => {
    const event = message.event as AgentEventMessage;
    if (event && event.eventId) {
        // Store in local cache
        localEventCache.set(event.eventId, event);

        const payload = (event as any).payload;
        let pushedTypedExternalEvent = false;
        if (payload?.type === 'custom' && payload?.eventName === 'threadCompletion') {
            const data = payload.data || {};
            const threadId = data.threadId || data.targetThreadId;
            if (threadId) {
                const externalEvent: UnifiedExternalEvent = {
                    type: 'backgroundAgentCompletion',
                    data: {
                        ...data,
                        eventId: event.eventId,
                        threadId,
                        success: data.error ? false : data.success,
                    }
                };
                pendingExternalEvents.push(externalEvent);
                eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', externalEvent);
                pushedTypedExternalEvent = true;
            }
        }

        // Also push to unified external events cache
        if (!pushedTypedExternalEvent) {
            pendingExternalEvents.push({ type: 'agentQueueEvent', data: event });
        }

        // Notify waiting promises
        eventEmitter.emit('newEvent', event);
        if (!pushedTypedExternalEvent) {
            eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', { type: 'agentQueueEvent', data: event });
        }

        // Call registered handlers
        for (const handler of eventHandlers) {
            try {
                handler(event);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error('[AgentEventQueue] Error in event handler:', error);
            }
        }
    }
});

// Subscribe to ThreadCompleted as an alternative message type
const threadCompletedSubscription = cbws.messageManager.subscribe('ThreadCompleted');
threadCompletedSubscription.on('message', (message: any) => {
    if (message.threadId) {
        const externalEvent: UnifiedExternalEvent = { type: 'backgroundAgentCompletion', data: message };
        pendingExternalEvents.push(externalEvent);
        eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', externalEvent);
    }
});

// Subscribe to grouped agent completion messages
const groupedAgentSubscription = cbws.messageManager.subscribe('backgroundGroupedAgentCompletion');
groupedAgentSubscription.on('message', (message: any) => {
    if (message.threadId) {
        const externalEvent: UnifiedExternalEvent = { type: 'backgroundGroupedAgentCompletion', data: message };
        pendingExternalEvents.push(externalEvent);
        eventEmitter.emit('externalEvent', externalEvent);
    }
});

// ============================================================================
// Agent Event Queue Module
// ============================================================================

const agentEventQueue = {
    // ========================================================================
    // Backend Communication Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add an event to a target agent's queue
     * @param params - Event creation parameters
     * @returns Promise resolving to the created event
     */
    addEvent: (params: AddEventInput): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgent',
                requestId,
                params
            },
            'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Send an inter-agent message (convenience wrapper)
     * @param params - Message parameters
     * @returns Promise resolving to the created event
     */
    sendAgentMessage: (params: SendAgentMessageInput): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessage',
                requestId,
                params
            },
            'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessageResponse'
        );
    },

    /**
     * Get queue statistics
     * @returns Promise resolving to queue statistics
     */
    getQueueStats: (): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<QueueStatsResponseData>> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStats',
                requestId,
                params: {}
            },
            'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse',
        );
    },

    /**
     * Clear the queue for an agent
     * @param agentId - Optional agent ID (defaults to current agent)
     * @returns Promise resolving to success confirmation
     */
    clearQueue: (agentId?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.clearQueue',
                requestId,
                params: { agentId }
            },
            'agentEventQueue.clearQueueResponse',
        );
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Internal Acknowledgement Helper
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Acknowledge an event at the backend
     * @param eventId - ID of the event to acknowledge
     * @param success - Whether processing was successful
     * @param errorMessage - Optional error message
     */
    _acknowledgeEvent: async (eventId: string, success: boolean = true, errorMessage?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
            {
                type: 'agentEventQueue.ackEvent',
                requestId,
                params: {
                    eventId,
                    success,
                    errorMessage
                } as AckEventInput
            },
            'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
        );
    },

    /**
     * Fetch pending events from backend
     * @param params - Query parameters
     */
    _fetchPendingFromBackend: async (params: GetPendingEventsInput = {}): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        const requestId = randomUUID();
        try {
            const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>>(
                {
                    type: 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents',
                    requestId,
                    params
                },
                'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse'
            );

            console.log('[AgentEventQueue] Backend response:', JSON.stringify(response, null, 2));

            if (response.success && response.data) {
                // Handle case where data itself is the array
                if (Array.isArray(response.data)) {
                    return response.data;
                }
                // Handle case where events are nested under data.events
                const events = response.data.events;
                if (Array.isArray(events)) {
                    return events;
                }
                console.warn('[AgentEventQueue] response.data.events is not an array:', typeof events, events);
                return [];
            }
            // Handle case where events are at response root level (not nested under data)
            const responseAny = response as any;
            if (response.success && Array.isArray(responseAny.events)) {
                return responseAny.events;
            }
            return [];
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[AgentEventQueue] Error fetching pending events from backend:', error);
            return [];
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Local Event Management Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get pending events from local cache.
     * Sends acknowledgement for each event and removes from local cache.
     * If no local events, fetches from backend.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: all)
     * @returns Promise resolving to array of events
     */
    getPendingQueueEvents: async (maxDepth?: number): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        const events: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
        const eventIds = Array.from(localEventCache.keys());

        console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - localEventCache size:', localEventCache.size);

        // Determine how many events to process
        const limit = maxDepth !== undefined ? Math.min(maxDepth, eventIds.length) : eventIds.length;

        // Get events from local cache
        for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            const eventId = eventIds[i];
            const event = localEventCache.get(eventId);
            if (event) {
                console.log('[AgentEventQueue] Local cache event:', eventId, 'has eventId field:', !!event.eventId);
                events.push(event);
            }
        }

        // If no local events, try fetching from backend
        if (events.length === 0) {
            const backendEvents = await agentEventQueue._fetchPendingFromBackend({ limit: maxDepth });

            console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - backendEvents:',
                Array.isArray(backendEvents) ? `array of ${backendEvents.length}` : typeof backendEvents,
                JSON.stringify(backendEvents, null, 2));

            // Ensure backendEvents is an array
            if (!Array.isArray(backendEvents)) {
                console.error('[AgentEventQueue] backendEvents is not an array, returning empty array');
                return [];
            }

            // Acknowledge backend events
            for (const event of backendEvents) {
                try {
                    const ackResponse = await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    console.log(`[AgentEventQueue] Ack response for ${event.eventId}:`, JSON.stringify(ackResponse));
                    if (!ackResponse.success) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Failed to acknowledge event ${event.eventId}:`, ackResponse.message);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return backendEvents;
        }

        // Acknowledge and remove local events
        for (const event of events) {
            try {
                await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
            }
        }

        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Wait for the next event(s) from the queue.
     * First checks local cache, then waits for WebSocket events.
     * Sends acknowledgement and removes from cache before resolving.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: 1)
     * @returns Promise resolving to event(s)
     */
    waitForNextQueueEvent: async (maxDepth: number = 1): Promise<AgentEventMessage | AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        // Check local cache first
        if (localEventCache.size > 0) {
            const events = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth);
            if (events.length > 0) {
                return maxDepth === 1 ? events[0] : events;
            }
        }

        // Wait for new event from WebSocket
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const onNewEvent = async (event: AgentEventMessage) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('newEvent', onNewEvent);

                // Acknowledge the event
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }

                // If maxDepth > 1, try to get more events from cache
                if (maxDepth > 1 && localEventCache.size > 0) {
                    const additionalEvents = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth - 1);
                    resolve([event, ...additionalEvents]);
                } else {
                    resolve(maxDepth === 1 ? event : [event]);
                }
            };

            eventEmitter.once('newEvent', onNewEvent);
        });
    },

    /**
     * Register an event handler that will be called when events are received.
     * The handler receives events as they arrive via WebSocket.
     * Note: This does NOT automatically acknowledge events.
     * 
     * @param handler - Function to call when an event is received
     * @returns Unsubscribe function
     */
    onQueueEvent: (handler: QueueEventHandler): (() => void) => {
        eventHandlers.add(handler);

        return () => {
            eventHandlers.delete(handler);
        };
    },

    /**
     * Manually acknowledge an event.
     * Use this when handling events via onQueueEvent.
     * 
     * @param eventId - ID of the event to acknowledge
     * @param success - Whether processing was successful
     * @param errorMessage - Optional error message if failed
     */
    acknowledgeEvent: async (eventId: string, success: boolean = true, errorMessage?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const response = await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(eventId, success, errorMessage);

        // Remove from local cache
        localEventCache.delete(eventId);

        return response;
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Utility Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get the number of events in the local cache
     * @returns Number of cached events
     */
    getLocalCacheSize: (): number => {
        return localEventCache.size;
    },

    /**
     * Get all events currently in the local cache without removing them
     * @returns Array of cached events
     */
    peekLocalCache: (): AgentEventMessage[] => {
        return Array.from(localEventCache.values());
    },

    /**
     * Clear the local event cache (does not affect backend)
     */
    clearLocalCache: (): void => {
        localEventCache.clear();
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Unified External Event Handling
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Check for any pending external events without waiting.
     * Returns the first pending event or null if none available.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent | null} The first pending event or null
     */
    checkForPendingExternalEvent: (): UnifiedExternalEvent | null => {
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift() || null;
            if (event) {
                acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
            }
            return event;
        }
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Get all pending external events.
     * Returns all pending events and clears the cache.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent[]} Array of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEvents: (): UnifiedExternalEvent[] => {
        const events = [...pendingExternalEvents];
        pendingExternalEvents.length = 0;
        for (const event of events) {
            acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
        }
        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Get the count of pending external events.
     *
     * @returns {number} Number of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEventCount: (): number => {
        return pendingExternalEvents.length;
    },

    /**
     * Waits for any external event from multiple sources:
     * - Agent queue events (from local cache or WebSocket)
     * - Background agent completions
     * - Grouped agent completions
     *
     * Returns the first event that occurs from any source.
     *
     * @returns {Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent>} A promise that resolves with the event type and data
     */
    waitForAnyExternalEvent: async (): Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent> => {
        // Check if there are already pending events
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift()!;

            // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
            if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return event;
        }

        // Wait for the next external event
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const handler = async (event: UnifiedExternalEvent) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('externalEvent', handler);

                // Remove from pending queue (it was added by the subscription)
                const index = pendingExternalEvents.findIndex(e => e === event);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    pendingExternalEvents.splice(index, 1);
                }

                // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
                if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                    try {
                        await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                        localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                    }
                }

                resolve(event);
            };

            eventEmitter.once('externalEvent', handler);
        });
    }
};

export default agentEventQueue;

            if (response.success && Array.isArray(responseAny.events)) {
                return responseAny.events;
            }
            return [];
        } catch (error) {
            console.error('[AgentEventQueue] Error fetching pending events from backend:', error);
            return [];
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Local Event Management Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get pending events from local cache.
     * Sends acknowledgement for each event and removes from local cache.
     * If no local events, fetches from backend.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: all)
     * @returns Promise resolving to array of events
     */
    getPendingQueueEvents: async (maxDepth?: number): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        const events: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
        const eventIds = Array.from(localEventCache.keys());

        console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - localEventCache size:', localEventCache.size);

        // Determine how many events to process
        const limit = maxDepth !== undefined ? Math.min(maxDepth, eventIds.length) : eventIds.length;

        // Get events from local cache
        for (let i = 0; i < limit; i++) {
            const eventId = eventIds[i];
            const event = localEventCache.get(eventId);
            if (event) {
                console.log('[AgentEventQueue] Local cache event:', eventId, 'has eventId field:', !!event.eventId);
                events.push(event);
            }
        }

        // If no local events, try fetching from backend
        if (events.length === 0) {
            const backendEvents = await agentEventQueue._fetchPendingFromBackend({ limit: maxDepth });

            console.log('[AgentEventQueue] getPendingQueueEvents - backendEvents:',
                Array.isArray(backendEvents) ? `array of ${backendEvents.length}` : typeof backendEvents,
                JSON.stringify(backendEvents, null, 2));

            // Ensure backendEvents is an array
            if (!Array.isArray(backendEvents)) {
                console.error('[AgentEventQueue] backendEvents is not an array, returning empty array');
                return [];
            }

            // Acknowledge backend events
            for (const event of backendEvents) {
                try {
                    const ackResponse = await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    console.log(`[AgentEventQueue] Ack response for ${event.eventId}:`, JSON.stringify(ackResponse));
                    if (!ackResponse.success) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Failed to acknowledge event ${event.eventId}:`, ackResponse.message);
                    }
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return backendEvents;
        }

        // Acknowledge and remove local events
        for (const event of events) {
            try {
                await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
            } catch (error) {
                console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
            }
        }

        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Wait for the next event(s) from the queue.
     * First checks local cache, then waits for WebSocket events.
     * Sends acknowledgement and removes from cache before resolving.
     * 
     * @param maxDepth - Maximum number of events to return (default: 1)
     * @returns Promise resolving to event(s)
     */
    waitForNextQueueEvent: async (maxDepth: number = 1): Promise<AgentEventMessage | AgentEventMessage[]> => {
        // Check local cache first
        if (localEventCache.size > 0) {
            const events = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth);
            if (events.length > 0) {
                return maxDepth === 1 ? events[0] : events;
            }
        }

        // Wait for new event from WebSocket
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const onNewEvent = async (event: AgentEventMessage) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('newEvent', onNewEvent);

                // Acknowledge the event
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.eventId}:`, error);
                }

                // If maxDepth > 1, try to get more events from cache
                if (maxDepth > 1 && localEventCache.size > 0) {
                    const additionalEvents = await agentEventQueue.getPendingQueueEvents(maxDepth - 1);
                    resolve([event, ...additionalEvents]);
                } else {
                    resolve(maxDepth === 1 ? event : [event]);
                }
            };

            eventEmitter.once('newEvent', onNewEvent);
        });
    },

    /**
     * Register an event handler that will be called when events are received.
     * The handler receives events as they arrive via WebSocket.
     * Note: This does NOT automatically acknowledge events.
     * 
     * @param handler - Function to call when an event is received
     * @returns Unsubscribe function
     */
    onQueueEvent: (handler: QueueEventHandler): (() => void) => {
        eventHandlers.add(handler);

        return () => {
            eventHandlers.delete(handler);
        };
    },

    /**
     * Manually acknowledge an event.
     * Use this when handling events via onQueueEvent.
     * 
     * @param eventId - ID of the event to acknowledge
     * @param success - Whether processing was successful
     * @param errorMessage - Optional error message if failed
     */
    acknowledgeEvent: async (eventId: string, success: boolean = true, errorMessage?: string): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> => {
        const response = await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(eventId, success, errorMessage);

        // Remove from local cache
        localEventCache.delete(eventId);

        return response;
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Utility Functions
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Get the number of events in the local cache
     * @returns Number of cached events
     */
    getLocalCacheSize: (): number => {
        return localEventCache.size;
    },

    /**
     * Get all events currently in the local cache without removing them
     * @returns Array of cached events
     */
    peekLocalCache: (): AgentEventMessage[] => {
        return Array.from(localEventCache.values());
    },

    /**
     * Clear the local event cache (does not affect backend)
     */
    clearLocalCache: (): void => {
        localEventCache.clear();
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Unified External Event Handling
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Check for any pending external events without waiting.
     * Returns the first pending event or null if none available.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent | null} The first pending event or null
     */
    checkForPendingExternalEvent: (): UnifiedExternalEvent | null => {
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift() || null;
            if (event) {
                acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
            }
            return event;
        }
        return null;
    },

    /**
     * Get all pending external events.
     * Returns all pending events and clears the cache.
     *
     * @returns {UnifiedExternalEvent[]} Array of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEvents: (): UnifiedExternalEvent[] => {
        const events = [...pendingExternalEvents];
        pendingExternalEvents.length = 0;
        for (const event of events) {
            acknowledgeExternalAgentEvent(event);
        }
        return events;
    },

    /**
     * Get the count of pending external events.
     *
     * @returns {number} Number of pending events
     */
    getPendingExternalEventCount: (): number => {
        return pendingExternalEvents.length;
    },

    /**
     * Waits for any external event from multiple sources:
     * - Agent queue events (from local cache or WebSocket)
     * - Background agent completions
     * - Grouped agent completions
     *
     * Returns the first event that occurs from any source.
     *
     * @returns {Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent>} A promise that resolves with the event type and data
     */
    waitForAnyExternalEvent: async (): Promise<UnifiedExternalEvent> => {
        // Check if there are already pending events
        if (pendingExternalEvents.length > 0) {
            const event = pendingExternalEvents.shift()!;

            // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
            if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                try {
                    await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                    localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                } catch (error) {
                    console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                }
            }

            return event;
        }

        // Wait for the next external event
        return new Promise((resolve) => {
            const handler = async (event: UnifiedExternalEvent) => {
                eventEmitter.removeListener('externalEvent', handler);

                // Remove from pending queue (it was added by the subscription)
                const index = pendingExternalEvents.findIndex(e => e === event);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    pendingExternalEvents.splice(index, 1);
                }

                // If it's an agent queue event, acknowledge it
                if (event.type === 'agentQueueEvent' && event.data?.eventId) {
                    try {
                        await agentEventQueue._acknowledgeEvent(event.data.eventId, true);
                        localEventCache.delete(event.data.eventId);
                    } catch (error) {
                        console.error(`[AgentEventQueue] Error acknowledging event ${event.data.eventId}:`, error);
                    }
                }

                resolve(event);
            };

            eventEmitter.once('externalEvent', handler);
        });
    }
};

export default agentEventQueue;

/**
 * Agent Event Queue CLI Service
 * CLI service for managing agent event queues - supports inter-agent messaging,
 * application notifications, and event queue operations.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { wsconnectionManager } from '../sockets/socketManager';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueDataService } from '../services/agentEventQueueDataService';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventPayload,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventInput,
    GetPendingEventsInput,
    PullEventsInput,
    AckEventInput,
    SendAgentMessageInput,
    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
    PullEventsResponseData,
    AddEventResponseData,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// CLI Service
// ============================================================================

export const agentEventQueueCliService = {
    initialized: false,

    /**
     * Initialize the service
     */
    async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        if (this.initialized) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Initialize data service
            await agentEventQueueDataService.initialize();

            // Load pending events from storage into memory
            await this.loadPendingEventsToMemory();

            // Set up event listeners for persistence
            this.setupEventListeners();

            this.initialized = true;
            logger.info('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialized successfully');
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialization error: ${error.message}`);
            throw error;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Load pending events from storage into memory store
     */
    async loadPendingEventsToMemory(): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const events = await agentEventQueueDataService.getAllPendingEventsFromStorage();
            if (events.length > 0) {
                agentEventQueueStore.loadEvents(events);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Loaded ${events.length} pending events from storage`);
            }
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error loading events: ${error.message}`);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Set up event listeners for persistence
     */
    setupEventListeners(): void {
        // Persist new events
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:added', async ({ event }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.appendEvent(event);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error persisting event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when event is acknowledged
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', async ({ eventId }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.updateIndexStatus(eventId, AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error updating acknowledged event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when events are pulled
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:pulled', async ({ agentId }) => {
            // Events are already removed from memory, just need to clean up index
            // This is handled by the pull operation itself
        });

        logger.debug('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Event listeners configured');
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // CLI API Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event for an agent (CLI API for external agents)
     */
    async addEventForAgent(
        params: AddEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            // Validate required fields
            if (!params.targetAgentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'targetAgentId is required'
                };
            }

            if (!params.payload) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'payload is required'
                };
            }

            // Create event
            const event: AgentEventMessage = {
                eventId: uuidv4(),
                targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
                targetAgentInstanceId: params.targetAgentInstanceId,
                targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
                sourceAgentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
                sourceThreadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                eventType: params.eventType || AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
                priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload: params.payload,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
                status: AgentEventStatus.PENDING,
                retryCount: 0,
                metadata: params.metadata
            };

            // Add to store (triggers persistence via event)
            agentEventQueueStore.addEvent(event);

            // Attempt immediate delivery
            await this.attemptImmediateDelivery(event);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'CREATED',
                message: 'Event added successfully',
                data: { event },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error adding event: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to add event',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (read-only)
     */
    async getPendingEvents(
        params: GetPendingEventsInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents called for agentId: ${agentId}`);

            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            let events = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId, params.limit);
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents found ${events.length} events for agentId: ${agentId}, eventIds: ${events.map(e => e.eventId).join(', ')}`);

            // Filter by event types if specified
            if (params.eventTypes && params.eventTypes.length > 0) {
                events = events.filter(e => params.eventTypes!.includes(e.eventType));
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: 'Pending events retrieved',
                data: {
                    events,
                    count: events.length,
                    pendingCount: agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCount(agentId)
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to get pending events',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Pull events (get and remove from queue, no ACK needed)
     */
    async pullEvents(
        params: PullEventsInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<PullEventsResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            const limit = params.limit === 'all' ? undefined : params.limit;
            const events = agentEventQueueStore.pullEvents(agentId, limit);

            // Remove from persistence index
            for (const event of events) {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.removeFromIndex(event.eventId);
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: `Pulled ${events.length} events`,
                data: {
                    events,
                    count: events.length
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error pulling events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to pull events',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Acknowledge event receipt
     */
    async acknowledgeEvent(
        params: AckEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] acknowledgeEvent called with eventId: ${params.eventId}, agentId: ${finalMessage?.agentId}`);

            if (!params.eventId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'eventId is required'
                };
            }

            const ack: AgentEventAck = {
                eventId: params.eventId,
                agentId: finalMessage?.agentId || '',
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
                threadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                acknowledgedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                success: params.success,
                errorMessage: params.errorMessage
            };

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Calling handleAck for event: ${params.eventId}`);
            const success = agentEventQueueStore.handleAck(ack);
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] handleAck result for ${params.eventId}: ${success}`);

            if (success) {
                // Remove from persistence
                await agentEventQueueDataService.removeFromIndex(params.eventId);

                return {
                    success: true,
                    code: 'OK',
                    message: 'Event acknowledged',
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };
            } else {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'NOT_FOUND',
                    message: 'Event not found or already acknowledged',
                    error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Event not found' }
                };
            }
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error acknowledging event: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to acknowledge event',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Send inter-agent message (convenience wrapper)
     */
    async sendAgentMessage(
        params: SendAgentMessageInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        return this.addEventForAgent({
            targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
            targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
            eventType: AgentEventType.AGENT_MESSAGE,
            priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
            payload: {
                type: 'agentMessage',
                content: params.content,
                messageType: params.messageType || 'text',
                replyTo: params.replyTo
            }
        }, finalMessage);
    },

    /**
     * Get queue statistics
     */
    async getQueueStats(
        params: any,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const stats = agentEventQueueStore.getStats();
            const storageStats = await agentEventQueueDataService.getStorageStats();

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: 'Queue statistics retrieved',
                data: {
                    ...stats,
                    storage: storageStats
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting stats: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to get statistics',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Clear queue for an agent
     */
    async clearQueue(
        params: { agentId?: string },
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            agentEventQueueStore.clearQueue(agentId);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: `Queue cleared for agent ${agentId}`,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error clearing queue: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to clear queue',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Delivery Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Attempt immediate delivery via WebSocket
     */
    async attemptImmediateDelivery(event: AgentEventMessage): Promise<boolean> {
        try {
            // Try to find socket by agentInstanceId first, then by agentId, then by threadId
            let socket: any = null;

            if (event.targetAgentInstanceId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById?.(event.targetAgentInstanceId);
            }

            if (!socket) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByAgentId(event.targetAgentId);
            }

            if (!socket && event.targetThreadId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(event.targetThreadId);
            }

            if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) { // WebSocket.OPEN
                const message = {
                    type: 'agentEvent',
                    event
                };
                socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
                agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered event ${event.eventId} to agent ${event.targetAgentId}`);
                return true;
            }

            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] No active socket for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, event queued`);
            return false;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering event: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Deliver pending events to an agent (called when agent connects)
     */
    async deliverPendingEventsToAgent(agentId: string, socket: any): Promise<number> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const pendingEvents = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId);
            let deliveredCount = 0;

            for (const event of pendingEvents) {
                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    try {
                        socket.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'agentEvent',
                            event
                        }));
                        agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                        deliveredCount++;
                    } catch (error: any) {
                        logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Failed to deliver event ${event.eventId}: ${error.message}`);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deliveredCount > 0) {
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered ${deliveredCount} pending events to agent ${agentId}`);
            }

            return deliveredCount;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return 0;
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Main Handler
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Main handler for CLI operations
     */
    async handleAgentEventQueueOperation(
        action: string,
        params: any,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        const requestId = finalMessage?.requestId;

        // Map actions to their specific response types (must match client expectations)
        const responseTypeMap: Record<string, string> = {
            'addEvent': 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse',
            'addEventForAgent': 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse',
            'getPendingEvents': 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse',
            'pullEvents': 'agentEventQueue.pullEventsResponse',
            'ackEvent': 'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
            'acknowledgeEvent': 'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
            'sendAgentMessage': 'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessageResponse',
            'getQueueStats': 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse',
            'clearQueue': 'agentEventQueue.clearQueueResponse'
        };

        try {
            await this.initialize();

            let response: AgentEventQueueResponse;

            switch (action) {
                case 'addEvent':
                case 'addEventForAgent':
                    response = await this.addEventForAgent(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'getPendingEvents':
                    response = await this.getPendingEvents(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'pullEvents':
                    response = await this.pullEvents(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'ackEvent':
                case 'acknowledgeEvent':
                    response = await this.acknowledgeEvent(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'sendAgentMessage':
                    response = await this.sendAgentMessage(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'getQueueStats':

                    break;

                        code: 'UNKNOWN_ACTION',

            }

            // Add requestId and operation-specific type for client matching
            const responseType = responseTypeMap[action] || 'agentEventQueueResponse';
            return { ...response, requestId, type: responseType };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error handling operation ${action}: ${error.message}`);
            const responseType = responseTypeMap[action] || 'agentEventQueueResponse';

                type: responseType,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
