/**
 * Agent Event Queue CLI Service
 * CLI service for managing agent event queues - supports inter-agent messaging,
 * application notifications, and event queue operations.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { wsconnectionManager } from '../sockets/socketManager';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueDataService } from '../services/agentEventQueueDataService';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventPayload,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventInput,
    GetPendingEventsInput,
    PullEventsInput,
    AckEventInput,
    SendAgentMessageInput,
    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
    PullEventsResponseData,
    AddEventResponseData,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// CLI Service
// ============================================================================

export const agentEventQueueCliService = {
    initialized: false,

    /**
     * Initialize the service
     */
    async initialize(): Promise<void> {
        if (this.initialized) {
            return;
        }

        try {
            // Initialize data service
            await agentEventQueueDataService.initialize();

            // Load pending events from storage into memory
            await this.loadPendingEventsToMemory();

            // Set up event listeners for persistence
            this.setupEventListeners();

            this.initialized = true;
            logger.info('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialized successfully');
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Initialization error: ${error.message}`);
            throw error;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Load pending events from storage into memory store
     */
    async loadPendingEventsToMemory(): Promise<void> {
        try {
            const events = await agentEventQueueDataService.getAllPendingEventsFromStorage();
            if (events.length > 0) {
                agentEventQueueStore.loadEvents(events);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Loaded ${events.length} pending events from storage`);
            }
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error loading events: ${error.message}`);
        }
    },

    /**
     * Set up event listeners for persistence
     */
    setupEventListeners(): void {
        // Persist new events
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:added', async ({ event }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.appendEvent(event);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error persisting event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when event is acknowledged
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', async ({ eventId }) => {
            try {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.updateIndexStatus(eventId, AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED);
            } catch (error: any) {
                logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error updating acknowledged event: ${error.message}`);
            }
        });

        // Update storage when events are pulled
        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:pulled', async ({ agentId }) => {
            // Events are already removed from memory, just need to clean up index
            // This is handled by the pull operation itself
        });

        logger.debug('[AgentEventQueueCliService] Event listeners configured');
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // CLI API Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event for an agent (CLI API for external agents)
     */
    async addEventForAgent(
        params: AddEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            // Validate required fields
            if (!params.targetAgentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'targetAgentId is required'
                };
            }

            if (!params.payload) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'payload is required'
                };
            }

            // Create event
            const event: AgentEventMessage = {
                eventId: uuidv4(),
                targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
                targetAgentInstanceId: params.targetAgentInstanceId,
                targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
                sourceAgentId: finalMessage?.agentId,
                sourceThreadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                eventType: params.eventType || AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
                priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload: params.payload,
                createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                expiresAt: params.expiresAt,
                status: AgentEventStatus.PENDING,
                retryCount: 0,
                metadata: params.metadata
            };

            // Add to store (triggers persistence via event)
            agentEventQueueStore.addEvent(event);

            // Attempt immediate delivery
            await this.attemptImmediateDelivery(event);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'CREATED',
                message: 'Event added successfully',
                data: { event },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error adding event: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to add event',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Get pending events for an agent (read-only)
     */
    async getPendingEvents(
        params: GetPendingEventsInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents called for agentId: ${agentId}`);

            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            let events = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId, params.limit);
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] getPendingEvents found ${events.length} events for agentId: ${agentId}, eventIds: ${events.map(e => e.eventId).join(', ')}`);

            // Filter by event types if specified
            if (params.eventTypes && params.eventTypes.length > 0) {
                events = events.filter(e => params.eventTypes!.includes(e.eventType));
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: 'Pending events retrieved',
                data: {
                    events,
                    count: events.length,
                    pendingCount: agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCount(agentId)
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to get pending events',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Pull events (get and remove from queue, no ACK needed)
     */
    async pullEvents(
        params: PullEventsInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<PullEventsResponseData>> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            const limit = params.limit === 'all' ? undefined : params.limit;
            const events = agentEventQueueStore.pullEvents(agentId, limit);

            // Remove from persistence index
            for (const event of events) {
                await agentEventQueueDataService.removeFromIndex(event.eventId);
            }

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: `Pulled ${events.length} events`,
                data: {
                    events,
                    count: events.length
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error pulling events: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to pull events',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Acknowledge event receipt
     */
    async acknowledgeEvent(
        params: AckEventInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] acknowledgeEvent called with eventId: ${params.eventId}, agentId: ${finalMessage?.agentId}`);

            if (!params.eventId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'eventId is required'
                };
            }

            const ack: AgentEventAck = {
                eventId: params.eventId,
                agentId: finalMessage?.agentId || '',
                agentInstanceId: finalMessage?.agentInstanceId,
                threadId: finalMessage?.threadId,
                acknowledgedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
                success: params.success,
                errorMessage: params.errorMessage
            };

            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Calling handleAck for event: ${params.eventId}`);
            const success = agentEventQueueStore.handleAck(ack);
            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] handleAck result for ${params.eventId}: ${success}`);

            if (success) {
                // Remove from persistence
                await agentEventQueueDataService.removeFromIndex(params.eventId);

                return {
                    success: true,
                    code: 'OK',
                    message: 'Event acknowledged',
                    timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
                };
            } else {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'NOT_FOUND',
                    message: 'Event not found or already acknowledged',
                    error: { code: 'NOT_FOUND', message: 'Event not found' }
                };
            }
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error acknowledging event: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to acknowledge event',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Send inter-agent message (convenience wrapper)
     */
    async sendAgentMessage(
        params: SendAgentMessageInput,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
        return this.addEventForAgent({
            targetAgentId: params.targetAgentId,
            targetThreadId: params.targetThreadId,
            eventType: AgentEventType.AGENT_MESSAGE,
            priority: params.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
            payload: {
                type: 'agentMessage',
                content: params.content,
                messageType: params.messageType || 'text',
                replyTo: params.replyTo
            }
        }, finalMessage);
    },

    /**
     * Get queue statistics
     */
    async getQueueStats(
        params: any,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const stats = agentEventQueueStore.getStats();
            const storageStats = await agentEventQueueDataService.getStorageStats();

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: 'Queue statistics retrieved',
                data: {
                    ...stats,
                    storage: storageStats
                },
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting stats: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to get statistics',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    /**
     * Clear queue for an agent
     */
    async clearQueue(
        params: { agentId?: string },
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const agentId = params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId;
            if (!agentId) {
                return {
                    success: false,
                    code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
                    message: 'agentId is required'
                };
            }

            agentEventQueueStore.clearQueue(agentId);

            return {
                success: true,
                code: 'OK',
                message: `Queue cleared for agent ${agentId}`,
                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
            };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error clearing queue: ${error.message}`);
            return {
                success: false,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Failed to clear queue',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Delivery Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Attempt immediate delivery via WebSocket
     */
    async attemptImmediateDelivery(event: AgentEventMessage): Promise<boolean> {
        try {
            // Try to find socket by agentInstanceId first, then by agentId, then by threadId
            let socket: any = null;

            if (event.targetAgentInstanceId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById?.(event.targetAgentInstanceId);
            }

            if (!socket) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByAgentId(event.targetAgentId);
            }

            if (!socket && event.targetThreadId) {
                socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(event.targetThreadId);
            }

            if (socket && socket.readyState === 1) { // WebSocket.OPEN
                const message = {
                    type: 'agentEvent',
                    event
                };
                socket.send(JSON.stringify(message));
                agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered event ${event.eventId} to agent ${event.targetAgentId}`);
                return true;
            }

            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] No active socket for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, event queued`);
            return false;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering event: ${error.message}`);
            return false;
        }
    },

    /**
     * Deliver pending events to an agent (called when agent connects)
     */
    async deliverPendingEventsToAgent(agentId: string, socket: any): Promise<number> {
        try {
            await this.initialize();

            const pendingEvents = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingEvents(agentId);
            let deliveredCount = 0;

            for (const event of pendingEvents) {
                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    try {
                        socket.send(JSON.stringify({
                            type: 'agentEvent',
                            event
                        }));
                        agentEventQueueStore.markDelivered(event.eventId);
                        deliveredCount++;
                    } catch (error: any) {
                        logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Failed to deliver event ${event.eventId}: ${error.message}`);
                    }
                }
            }

            if (deliveredCount > 0) {
                logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Delivered ${deliveredCount} pending events to agent ${agentId}`);
            }

            return deliveredCount;
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error delivering pending events: ${error.message}`);
            return 0;
        }
    },

    // ========================================================================
    // Main Handler
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Main handler for CLI operations
     */
    async handleAgentEventQueueOperation(
        action: string,
        params: any,
        finalMessage: any
    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
        const requestId = finalMessage?.requestId;

        // Map actions to their specific response types (must match client expectations)
        const responseTypeMap: Record<string, string> = {
            'addEvent': 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse',
            'addEventForAgent': 'agentEventQueue.addEventForAgentResponse',
            'getPendingEvents': 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse',
            'pullEvents': 'agentEventQueue.pullEventsResponse',
            'ackEvent': 'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
            'acknowledgeEvent': 'agentEventQueue.ackEventResponse',
            'sendAgentMessage': 'agentEventQueue.sendAgentMessageResponse',
            'getQueueStats': 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse',
            'clearQueue': 'agentEventQueue.clearQueueResponse'
        };

        try {
            await this.initialize();

            let response: AgentEventQueueResponse;

            switch (action) {
                case 'addEvent':
                case 'addEventForAgent':
                    response = await this.addEventForAgent(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'getPendingEvents':
                    response = await this.getPendingEvents(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'pullEvents':
                    response = await this.pullEvents(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'ackEvent':
                case 'acknowledgeEvent':
                    response = await this.acknowledgeEvent(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'sendAgentMessage':
                    response = await this.sendAgentMessage(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'getQueueStats':
                    response = await this.getQueueStats(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                case 'clearQueue':
                    response = await this.clearQueue(params, finalMessage);
                    break;

                default:
                    response = {
                        success: false,
                        code: 'UNKNOWN_ACTION',
                        message: `Unknown agent event queue action: ${action}`,
                        error: { code: 'UNKNOWN_ACTION', message: `Unknown action: ${action}` }
                    };
            }

            // Add requestId and operation-specific type for client matching
            const responseType = responseTypeMap[action] || 'agentEventQueueResponse';
            return { ...response, requestId, type: responseType };
        } catch (error: any) {
            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error handling operation ${action}: ${error.message}`);
            const responseType = responseTypeMap[action] || 'agentEventQueueResponse';
            return {
                success: false,
                requestId,
                type: responseType,
                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
                message: 'Internal error',
                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
            };
        }
    }
};

export default agentEventQueueCliService;

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Types
 * Type definitions for the Agent Event Queue system - a dedicated queue for
 * delivering real-time notifications and messages to running agents.
 */

// ============================================================================
// Event Type Enums
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Types of events that can be sent to agents
 */
export enum AgentEventType {
    /** Inter-agent communication */
    AGENT_MESSAGE = 'agentMessage',
    /** Calendar event notifications (reminders, updates) */
    CALENDAR_UPDATE = 'calendarUpdate',
    /** System-level notifications */
    SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION = 'systemNotification',
    /** Task status change notifications */
    TASK_UPDATE = 'taskUpdate',
    /** User steering messages sent to a running agent */
    STEERING = 'steering',
    /** User-defined custom events */
    CUSTOM = 'custom'
}

/**
 * Status of an event in the queue
 */
export enum AgentEventStatus {
    /** In queue, awaiting delivery */
    PENDING = 'pending',
    /** Sent via WebSocket, awaiting acknowledgement */
    DELIVERED = 'delivered',
    /** Acknowledgement received, can be archived */
    ACKNOWLEDGED = 'acked',
    /** Retrieved via pull mode (auto-removed) */
    PULLED = 'pulled',
    /** Delivery failed */
    FAILED = 'failed',
    /** Event expired before delivery */
    EXPIRED = 'expired'
}

/**
 * Priority levels for events
 */
export enum AgentEventPriority {
    LOW = 'low',
    NORMAL = 'normal',
    HIGH = 'high',
    URGENT = 'urgent'
}

// ============================================================================
// Payload Types (Discriminated Union)
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Payload for inter-agent messages
 */
export interface AgentMessagePayload {
    type: 'agentMessage';
    /** Message content */
    content: string;
    /** Type of message content */
    messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command';
    /** Reference to a previous eventId for replies */
    replyTo?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for calendar update notifications
 */
export interface CalendarUpdatePayload {
    type: 'calendarUpdate';
    /** ID of the calendar event */
    calendarEventId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder';
    /** Title of the calendar event */
    eventTitle?: string;
    /** Event start time (ISO string) */
    startTime?: string;
    /** Event end time (ISO string) */
    endTime?: string;
    /** Additional event details */
    description?: string;
    /** Location of the event */
    location?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for system notifications
 */
export interface SystemNotificationPayload {
    type: 'systemNotification';
    /** Type of notification */
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success';
    /** Notification title */
    title: string;
    /** Notification message */
    message: string;
    /** Whether the agent needs to take action */
    actionRequired?: boolean;
    /** Action to take if actionRequired is true */
    actionType?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for task update notifications
 */
export interface TaskUpdatePayload {
    type: 'taskUpdate';
    /** ID of the task */
    taskId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
    /** Title of the task */
    taskTitle?: string;
    /** Current status of the task */
    status?: string;
    /** Progress percentage (0-100) */
    progress?: number;
    /** Error message if failed */
    errorMessage?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for user steering messages
 */
export interface SteeringPayload {
    type: 'steering';
    /** The steering instruction text */
    instruction: string;
    /** ID of the stored steering step */
    steeringStepId?: string;
    /** Thread the steering message belongs to */
    threadId: string;
    /** Additional context (mentioned files, agents, etc.) */
    context?: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Payload for custom events
 */
export interface CustomEventPayload {
    type: 'custom';
    /** Name/identifier for the custom event */
    eventName: string;
    /** Arbitrary data for the custom event */
    data: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Union type for all event payloads
 */
export type AgentEventPayload =
    | AgentMessagePayload
    | CalendarUpdatePayload
    | SystemNotificationPayload
    | TaskUpdatePayload
    | SteeringPayload
    | CustomEventPayload;

// ============================================================================
// Core Event Message Interface
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Core event message structure
 */
export interface AgentEventMessage {
    /** Unique event identifier (UUID) */
    eventId: string;
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID (optional) */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID (optional) */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Source agent ID (for inter-agent messages) */
    sourceAgentId?: string;
    /** Source thread ID */
    sourceThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */
    priority: AgentEventPriority;
    /** Event payload (discriminated by type) */
    payload: AgentEventPayload;
    /** Event creation timestamp (ISO string) */
    createdAt: string;
    /** When the event was delivered via WebSocket */
    deliveredAt?: string;
    /** When acknowledgement was received */
    acknowledgedAt?: string;
    /** Optional expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Current status of the event */
    status: AgentEventStatus;
    /** Number of delivery retry attempts */
    retryCount: number;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

// ============================================================================
// Acknowledgement Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Acknowledgement message from agent
 */
export interface AgentEventAck {
    /** ID of the event being acknowledged */
    eventId: string;
    /** ID of the acknowledging agent */
    agentId: string;
    /** Instance ID of the acknowledging agent */
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Thread ID */
    threadId?: string;
    /** When the acknowledgement was sent */
    acknowledgedAt: string;
    /** Whether the event was processed successfully */
    success: boolean;
    /** Error message if processing failed */
    errorMessage?: string;
}

// ============================================================================
// Request/Input Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Input for adding an event to an agent's queue
 */
export interface AddEventInput {
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */
    priority?: AgentEventPriority;
    /** Event payload */
    payload: AgentEventPayload;
    /** Optional expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Input for getting pending events
 */
export interface GetPendingEventsInput {
    /** Agent ID to get events for */
    agentId?: string;
    /** Agent instance ID */
    agentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Thread ID */

    PENDING = 'pending',

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Internal Functions
 * Convenience functions for internal application components to send events to agents.
 * Use these functions from calendar service, task service, notification systems, etc.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventType,
    AgentEventPriority,
    AgentEventStatus,
    CalendarUpdatePayload,
    SystemNotificationPayload,
    TaskUpdatePayload,
    SteeringPayload,
    CustomEventPayload,
    AgentEventQueueResponse,
    AddEventResponseData
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// Internal Functions for Application Components
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Send a calendar update notification to an agent
 * Use this when calendar events are created, updated, or have reminders
 */
export async function sendCalendarUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    calendarEventId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder' | 'rescheduled',
    details?: {
        eventTitle?: string;
        startTime?: string;
        endTime?: string;
        location?: string;
        description?: string;
        reminderMinutes?: number;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'calendarUpdate',
        calendarEventId,
        action: action as any,
        eventTitle: details?.eventTitle,
        startTime: details?.startTime,
        endTime: details?.endTime,
        location: details?.location,
        description: details?.description,
        reminderMinutes: details?.reminderMinutes
    } as CalendarUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'reminder') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CALENDAR_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a system notification to an agent
 * Use for alerts, warnings, important system messages
 */
export async function sendSystemNotification(
    targetAgentId: string,
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'alert',
    title: string,
    message: string,
    options?: {
        actionRequired?: boolean;
        actionUrl?: string;
        actionLabel?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'systemNotification',
        notificationType: notificationType as any,
        title,
        message,
        actionRequired: options?.actionRequired,
        actionUrl: options?.actionUrl,
        actionLabel: options?.actionLabel
    } as SystemNotificationPayload;

    // Determine priority based on notification type
    let priority = options?.priority;
    if (!priority) {
        switch (notificationType) {
            case 'error':
            case 'alert':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
                break;
            case 'warning':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
                break;
            default:
                priority = AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
        }
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION,
        priority,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a task update notification to an agent
 * Use when tasks are created, updated, completed, or have status changes
 */
export async function sendTaskUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    taskId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'statusChanged' | 'dueSoon' | 'overdue',
    details?: {
        taskTitle?: string;
        status?: string;
        previousStatus?: string;
        assignee?: string;
        dueDate?: string;
        description?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'taskUpdate',
        taskId,
        action: action as any,
        taskTitle: details?.taskTitle,
        status: details?.status,
        previousStatus: details?.previousStatus,
        assignee: details?.assignee,
        dueDate: details?.dueDate,
        description: details?.description
    } as TaskUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'overdue') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
    } else if (action === 'dueSoon' || action === 'assigned') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.TASK_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a custom event to an agent
 * Use for application-specific events that don't fit other categories
 */
export async function sendCustomEvent(
    targetAgentId: string,
    eventName: string,
    data: Record<string, any>,
    options?: {
        targetThreadId?: string;
        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;

/**

export async function sendSteeringMessage(

export async function broadcastToAgents(
    targetAgentIds: string[],

    payload: any,
    options?: {
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<{
    success: boolean;
    results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;

}> {
    const results: Array<{
        agentId: string;
        success: boolean;
        eventId?: string;
        error?: string;
    }> = [];

    for (const targetAgentId of targetAgentIds) {

            results.push({

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Internal Functions
 * Convenience functions for internal application components to send events to agents.
 * Use these functions from calendar service, task service, notification systems, etc.
 */

import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,

} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

// ============================================================================
// Internal Functions for Application Components
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Send a calendar update notification to an agent
 * Use this when calendar events are created, updated, or have reminders
 */
export async function sendCalendarUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    calendarEventId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder' | 'rescheduled',
    details?: {
        eventTitle?: string;
        startTime?: string;
        endTime?: string;
        location?: string;
        description?: string;
        reminderMinutes?: number;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'calendarUpdate',
        calendarEventId,
        action: action as any,
        eventTitle: details?.eventTitle,
        startTime: details?.startTime,
        endTime: details?.endTime,
        location: details?.location,
        description: details?.description,
        reminderMinutes: details?.reminderMinutes
    } as CalendarUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'reminder') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.CALENDAR_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a system notification to an agent
 * Use for alerts, warnings, important system messages
 */
export async function sendSystemNotification(
    targetAgentId: string,
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'alert',
    title: string,
    message: string,
    options?: {
        actionRequired?: boolean;
        actionUrl?: string;
        actionLabel?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        expiresAt?: string;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'systemNotification',
        notificationType: notificationType as any,
        title,
        message,
        actionRequired: options?.actionRequired,
        actionUrl: options?.actionUrl,
        actionLabel: options?.actionLabel
    } as SystemNotificationPayload;

    // Determine priority based on notification type
    let priority = options?.priority;
    if (!priority) {
        switch (notificationType) {
            case 'error':
            case 'alert':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
                break;
            case 'warning':
                priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
                break;
            default:
                priority = AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
        }
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: options?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION,
        priority,
        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

/**
 * Send a task update notification to an agent
 * Use when tasks are created, updated, completed, or have status changes
 */
export async function sendTaskUpdate(
    targetAgentId: string,
    taskId: string,
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'statusChanged' | 'dueSoon' | 'overdue',
    details?: {
        taskTitle?: string;
        status?: string;
        previousStatus?: string;
        assignee?: string;
        dueDate?: string;
        description?: string;
        targetThreadId?: string;
        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
    }
): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<AddEventResponseData>> {
    const payload = {
        type: 'taskUpdate',
        taskId,
        action: action as any,
        taskTitle: details?.taskTitle,
        status: details?.status,
        previousStatus: details?.previousStatus,
        assignee: details?.assignee,
        dueDate: details?.dueDate,
        description: details?.description
    } as TaskUpdatePayload;

    // Determine priority based on action
    let priority = details?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
    if (action === 'overdue') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.URGENT;
    } else if (action === 'dueSoon' || action === 'assigned') {
        priority = AgentEventPriority.HIGH;
    }

    return agentEventQueueCliService.addEventForAgent({
        targetAgentId,
        targetThreadId: details?.targetThreadId,
        eventType: AgentEventType.TASK_UPDATE,
        priority,
        payload,
        metadata: details?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;

    const payload: CustomEventPayload = {

        payload,
        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
        metadata: options?.metadata
    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
}

    for (const targetAgentId of targetAgentIds) {
        try {

    const allSuccess = results.every(r => r.success);

export async function sendAgentToAgentMessage(

/**
 * EventQueue Add Event Tool
 * Wraps the SDK's agentEventQueue.addEvent() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import agentEventQueue from '../../modules/agentEventQueue';
import { AgentEventType, AgentEventPriority } from '../../types/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Parameters for the EventQueue Add Event tool
 */
export interface EventQueueAddEventParams {
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Target agent instance ID (optional) */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID (optional) */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Event type */
    eventType?: 'agentMessage' | 'calendarUpdate' | 'systemNotification' | 'taskUpdate' | 'custom';
    /** Event priority */
    priority?: 'low' | 'normal' | 'high' | 'urgent';
    /** Event payload - structure depends on eventType */
    payload: Record<string, any>;
    /** Expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

class EventQueueAddEventInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    EventQueueAddEventParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: EventQueueAddEventParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const response = await agentEventQueue.addEvent({
                targetAgentId: this.params.targetAgentId,
                targetAgentInstanceId: this.params.targetAgentInstanceId,
                targetThreadId: this.params.targetThreadId,
                eventType: this.params.eventType as AgentEventType || AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
                priority: this.params.priority as AgentEventPriority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
                payload: this.params.payload as any,
                expiresAt: this.params.expiresAt,
                metadata: this.params.metadata
            });

            if (!response.success) {
                return {
                    llmContent: `Failed to add event: ${response.message}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${response.message}`,
                    error: {
                        message: response.message,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            let llmContent = `Event added successfully.\n\n`;
            llmContent += `Event ID: ${response.data?.event?.eventId}\n`;
            llmContent += `Target Agent: ${this.params.targetAgentId}\n`;
            llmContent += `Status: ${response.data?.event?.status}`;

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: `Added event ${response.data?.event?.eventId}`,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error adding event: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

/**

 */
export class EventQueueAddEventTool extends BaseDeclarativeTool<

> {

            {
                type: 'object',
                properties: {

                        type: 'string',

                    },
                    eventType: {
                        type: 'string',
                        enum: ['agentMessage', 'calendarUpdate', 'systemNotification', 'taskUpdate', 'custom'],
                        description: 'Type of event (default: custom)'
                    },
                    priority: {
                        type: 'string',
                        enum: ['low', 'normal', 'high', 'urgent'],

    }

        return new EventQueueAddEventInvocation(params);
    }
}

<message role="assistant" ordinal="881" timestamp="2026-07-07T13:53:49.597Z">
Yes, your objection is correct. `addEvent` and `sendAgentMessage` should not be public agent-facing APIs.

Right now `addEvent` is exposed from [agentEventQueue.ts](D:\codeboltapps\Codebolt\sdks\codeboltjs\src\modules\agentEventQueue.ts:175), then exposed again as pseudo CLI/tools like `eventqueue_add_event`. That lets an agent fabricate arbitrary queue events. `sendAgentMessage` is just a convenience wrapper around the same mechanism: server-side it creates an `agentMessage` event via `addEventForAgent` in [agentEventQueueService.cli.ts](D:\codeboltapps\Codebolt\packages\server\src\cliLib\agentEventQueueService.cli.ts:348).

So the clean model is: agents consume queue events; runtime/server/app actions produce queue events. If agent-to-agent messaging is needed later, it should be a separate high-level API, not a generic queue producer.

&lt;proposed_plan&gt;
## Read-Only Agent Event Queue

### Summary
- Make the backend queue the single source of truth.
- Make `agentEventQueue` public API read-only from the agent perspective.
- Remove backward compatibility for old raw queue, ack, delivered, local-cache, add-event, and send-message APIs.
- Keep event creation inside server/runtime-owned services only.

### Key Changes
- Public `codebolt.agentEventQueue` exposes only:
  - `getPendingEvents(options?)`: consume pending normalized events from backend.
  - `waitForNextEvent(options?)`: first consume pending events; if none, wait for backend availability notification, then consume.
- Remove public agent-facing APIs/tools:
  - `addEvent`
  - `sendAgentMessage`
  - `acknowledgeEvent`
  - `getPendingQueueEvents`
  - `waitForNextQueueEvent`
  - `getPendingExternalEvents`
  - local cache inspection/clear helpers
  - pseudo CLI/tools `eventqueue_add_event`, `eventqueue_send_message`, old ack/raw wait/get tools.
- Keep server/internal event creation through an internal-only enqueue function used by runtime producers:
  - command completion
  - thread completion
  - steering messages
  - force-stop cleanup summaries
  - system/task notifications if still needed.
- Do not expose generic event creation to agents. If inter-agent messaging is required later, add a dedicated domain API such as `thread.sendMessage(...)`, and have the server translate it into a scoped event internally.

### Event Model
- Normalized event shape:
  - `eventId`
  - `type`
  - `scope: &#39;agent_instance&#39; | &#39;thread&#39;`
  - `target`
  - `data`
  - `metadata`
- Scope rules:
  - `agent_instance`: delivered only to the current running agent instance; dropped when that instance exits.
  - `thread`: durable for the thread; consumed by the next agent run in that thread.
- Default scopes:
  - `steering`: `agent_instance`
  - `backgroundCommandCompletion`: `thread`
  - `threadCompletion`: `thread`
  - `forceStopCleanup`: `thread`
  - `taskUpdate` / `systemNotification`: explicit internal producer choice.

### Backend And SDK Flow
- Backend stores normalized pending events only.
- No delivered/acknowledged/pulled state in the agent-facing path.
- `getPendingEvents` consumes events atomically.
- WebSocket sends only an availability notification, not the full event body.
- `waitForNextEvent` behavior:
  - call `getPendingEvents` first
  - return immediately if anything is pending
  - otherwise wait for `agentEventAvailable`
  - then call `getPendingEvents` again and return normalized events.
- `sdks/agent` and `act-updated` use only normalized events and inject them into the agent prompt/context.

### Tests
- Thread-scoped command completion survives agent restart and is consumed once.
- Agent-instance steering reaches only the active instance and is dropped after stop.
- User force-stop kills scoped async tasks and writes a thread-scoped cleanup event.
- Detached/background tasks remain running and produce thread-scoped completion events.
- Old public APIs/tools are removed and no code references remain.
- `act-updated`, `sdks/codeboltjs`, `sdks/agent`, and server builds are checked after cleanup.

### Assumptions
- No backward compatibility.
- Backend queue is the only durable source of truth.
- Agents are consumers of events, not generic event producers.
- Inter-agent messaging is out of scope for this queue cleanup unless implemented later as a separate domain API.
&lt;/proposed_plan&gt;
</message>

import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
import {
    AgentEventMessage,
    AgentEventStatus,
    AgentEventQueue,
    AgentEventAck,
    AgentEventPriority,
    PRIORITY_ORDER,
    AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG
} from '../types/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Agent Event Queue Store
 * In-memory store for managing agent event queues with EventEmitter for notifications.
 * Handles per-agent queues with pending and delivered states.
 */
class AgentEventQueueStore extends EventEmitter {
    private static instance: AgentEventQueueStore;

    /** Per-agent queues: Map<agentId, AgentEventQueue> */
    private agentQueues: Map<string, AgentEventQueue> = new Map();

    /** Quick lookup by eventId: Map<eventId, { agentId, eventId }> */
    private eventIndex: Map<string, { agentId: string; eventId: string }> = new Map();

    private constructor() {
        super();
        // Increase max listeners to handle multiple subscriptions
        this.setMaxListeners(50);
    }

    /**
     * Get singleton instance
     */
    static getInstance(): AgentEventQueueStore {
        if (!AgentEventQueueStore.instance) {
            AgentEventQueueStore.instance = new AgentEventQueueStore();
        }
        return AgentEventQueueStore.instance;
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Queue Management
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Ensure a queue exists for an agent, create if not
     */
    ensureQueue(agentId: string, agentInstanceId?: string): AgentEventQueue {
        let queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            queue = {
                agentId,
                agentInstanceId,
                pendingEvents: new Map(),
                deliveredEvents: new Map()
            };
            this.agentQueues.set(agentId, queue);
            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Created queue for agent: ${agentId}`);
        }
        return queue;
    }

    /**
     * Get queue for an agent (returns undefined if not exists)
     */
    getQueue(agentId: string): AgentEventQueue | undefined {
        return this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
    }

    /**
     * Check if agent has a queue
     */
    hasQueue(agentId: string): boolean {
        return this.agentQueues.has(agentId);
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Event Operations
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Add event to agent's pending queue
     */
    addEvent(event: AgentEventMessage): void {
        const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

        // Check queue size limit
        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Queue full for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, removing oldest event`);
            // Remove oldest low-priority event
            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);
        }

        // Add to pending queue
        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);

        // Add to index for quick lookup
        this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            eventId: event.eventId
        });

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            event
        });

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Added event ${event.eventId} for agent ${event.targetAgentId} (type: ${event.eventType}, priority: ${event.priority})`);
    }

    /**
     * Mark event as delivered (moved from pending to delivered queue)
     */
    markDelivered(eventId: string): boolean {
        const indexEntry = this.eventIndex.get(eventId);
        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        const event = queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId);
        if (!event) {

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED;
        event.deliveredAt = new Date().toISOString();

        // Move from pending to delivered
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.set(eventId, event);

        this.emit('agentEventQueue:delivered', {

    handleAck(ack: AgentEventAck): boolean {

            return false;
        }

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: queue not found for agent ${indexEntry.agentId}`);
            return false;
        }

        // Find event in either pending or delivered queue
        let event = queue.deliveredEvents.get(ack.eventId) || queue.pendingEvents.get(ack.eventId);
        if (!event) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot handle ACK: event ${ack.eventId} not in any queue`);
            return false;

        // Update event status
        event.status = AgentEventStatus.ACKNOWLEDGED;
        event.acknowledgedAt = ack.acknowledgedAt;

        // Remove from both queues
        queue.pendingEvents.delete(ack.eventId);
        queue.deliveredEvents.delete(ack.eventId);

        // Remove from index
        this.eventIndex.delete(ack.eventId);

        this.emit('agentEventQueue:acknowledged', {

        });

    getPendingEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {
        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);
        if (!queue) {

        }

        // Get events from both pending and delivered queues

        const pendingEvents = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())

        const deliveredEvents = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED);

        const allEvents = [...pendingEvents, ...deliveredEvents]
            .sort((a, b) => {
                // Sort by priority (lower PRIORITY_ORDER value = higher priority)
                const priorityDiff = PRIORITY_ORDER[a.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[b.priority];
                if (priorityDiff !== 0) {
                    return priorityDiff;
                }
                // Then by creation time (oldest first)
                return new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(b.createdAt).getTime();

    pullEvents(agentId: string, limit?: number): AgentEventMessage[] {

    getPendingCount(agentId: string): number {

            return 0;
        }
        const pendingCount = Array.from(queue.pendingEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING)
            .length;
        const deliveredCount = Array.from(queue.deliveredEvents.values())
            .filter(event => event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED)
            .length;
        return pendingCount + deliveredCount;
    }

    /**
     * Get count of delivered (awaiting ACK) events for an agent

    getDeliveredCount(agentId: string): number {

    getAllPendingForDelivery(): AgentEventMessage[] {

    getStats(): {

    clearAll(): void {

     */
    ensureQueue(agentId: string, agentInstanceId?: string): AgentEventQueue {
        let queue = this.agentQueues.get(agentId);

            queue = {
                agentId,
                agentInstanceId,
                pendingEvents: new Map(),
                deliveredEvents: new Map()

            this.agentQueues.set(agentId, queue);

        }

        // Check queue size limit
        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_AGENT) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Queue full for agent ${event.targetAgentId}, removing oldest event`);
            // Remove oldest low-priority event
            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);

        // Add to pending queue
        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);

        // Add to index for quick lookup
        this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            eventId: event.eventId
        });

        // Emit event
        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
            agentId: event.targetAgentId,
            event
        });

    }

    markDelivered(eventId: string): boolean {

        if (!indexEntry) {
            logger.warn(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cannot mark delivered: event ${eventId} not found in index`);
            return false;

        const queue = this.agentQueues.get(indexEntry.agentId);
        if (!queue) {

            return false;

        const event = queue.pendingEvents.get(eventId);

     */
    getStats(): {
        totalQueues: number;
        totalPendingEvents: number;
        totalDeliveredEvents: number;
        queueStats: Array<{
            agentId: string;
            pendingCount: number;
            deliveredCount: number;
        }>;
    } {
        let totalPending = 0;
        let totalDelivered = 0;
        const queueStats: Array<{
            agentId: string;
            pendingCount: number;
            deliveredCount: number;
        }> = [];

        for (const [agentId, queue] of this.agentQueues) {
            const pendingCount = queue.pendingEvents.size;
            const deliveredCount = queue.deliveredEvents.size;
            totalPending += pendingCount;
            totalDelivered += deliveredCount;
            queueStats.push({ agentId, pendingCount, deliveredCount });
        }

        return {
            totalQueues: this.agentQueues.size,
            totalPendingEvents: totalPending,
            totalDeliveredEvents: totalDelivered,
            queueStats
        };
    }

    /**
     * Get all agent IDs that have queues
     */
    getAgentIds(): string[] {
        return Array.from(this.agentQueues.keys());
    }

    // ========================================================================
    // Lifecycle
    // ========================================================================

    /**
     * Clear all queues (used for testing or shutdown)
     */
    clearAll(): void {
        for (const agentId of this.agentQueues.keys()) {
            this.clearQueue(agentId);
        }
        this.agentQueues.clear();
        this.eventIndex.clear();
        logger.info('[AgentEventQueueStore] Cleared all queues');
    }

    /**
     * Initialize store with events loaded from persistence
     */
    loadEvents(events: AgentEventMessage[]): void {
        for (const event of events) {
            // Only load pending or delivered events
            if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING ||
                event.status === AgentEventStatus.DELIVERED) {
                const queue = this.ensureQueue(event.targetAgentId, event.targetAgentInstanceId);

                if (event.status === AgentEventStatus.PENDING) {
                    queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
                } else {
                    queue.deliveredEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
                }

                this.eventIndex.set(event.eventId, {
                    agentId: event.targetAgentId,
                    eventId: event.eventId
                });
            }
        }

        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Loaded ${events.length} events from persistence`);
    }
}

export const agentEventQueueStore = AgentEventQueueStore.getInstance();
export default agentEventQueueStore;
