/**
 * Agent Event Queue Types
 * Type definitions for the Agent Event Queue system in codeboltjs SDK
 */

// ============================================================================
// Event Type Enums
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Types of events that can be sent to agents
 */
export enum AgentEventType {
    /** Inter-agent communication */
    AGENT_MESSAGE = 'agentMessage',
    /** Calendar event notifications (reminders, updates) */
    CALENDAR_UPDATE = 'calendarUpdate',
    /** System-level notifications */
    SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION = 'systemNotification',
    /** Task status change notifications */
    TASK_UPDATE = 'taskUpdate',
    /** User-defined custom events */
    CUSTOM = 'custom'
}

/**
 * Status of an event in the queue
 */
export enum AgentEventStatus {
    /** In queue, awaiting delivery */
    PENDING = 'pending',
    /** Sent via WebSocket, awaiting acknowledgement */
    DELIVERED = 'delivered',
    /** Acknowledgement received, can be archived */
    ACKNOWLEDGED = 'acked',
    /** Retrieved via pull mode (auto-removed) */
    PULLED = 'pulled',
    /** Delivery failed */
    FAILED = 'failed',
    /** Event expired before delivery */
    EXPIRED = 'expired'
}

/**
 * Priority levels for events
 */
export enum AgentEventPriority {
    LOW = 'low',
    NORMAL = 'normal',
    HIGH = 'high',
    URGENT = 'urgent'
}

// ============================================================================
// Payload Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Payload for inter-agent messages
 */
export interface AgentMessagePayload {
    type: 'agentMessage';
    /** Message content */
    content: string;
    /** Type of message content */
    messageType?: 'text' | 'json' | 'command';
    /** Reference to a previous eventId for replies */
    replyTo?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for calendar update notifications
 */
export interface CalendarUpdatePayload {
    type: 'calendarUpdate';
    /** ID of the calendar event */
    calendarEventId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder';
    /** Title of the calendar event */
    eventTitle?: string;
    /** Event start time (ISO string) */
    startTime?: string;
    /** Event end time (ISO string) */
    endTime?: string;
    /** Additional event details */
    description?: string;
    /** Location of the event */
    location?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for system notifications
 */
export interface SystemNotificationPayload {
    type: 'systemNotification';
    /** Type of notification */
    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success';
    /** Notification title */
    title: string;
    /** Notification message */
    message: string;
    /** Whether the agent needs to take action */
    actionRequired?: boolean;
    /** Action to take if actionRequired is true */
    actionType?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for task update notifications
 */
export interface TaskUpdatePayload {
    type: 'taskUpdate';
    /** ID of the task */
    taskId: string;
    /** Action that occurred */
    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'failed' | 'cancelled';
    /** Title of the task */
    taskTitle?: string;
    /** Current status of the task */
    status?: string;
    /** Progress percentage (0-100) */
    progress?: number;
    /** Error message if failed */
    errorMessage?: string;
}

/**
 * Payload for custom events
 */
export interface CustomEventPayload {
    type: 'custom';
    /** Name/identifier for the custom event */
    eventName: string;
    /** Arbitrary data for the custom event */
    data: Record<string, any>;
}

/**
 * Union type for all event payloads
 */
export type AgentEventPayload =
    | AgentMessagePayload
    | CalendarUpdatePayload
    | SystemNotificationPayload
    | TaskUpdatePayload
    | CustomEventPayload;

// ============================================================================
// Core Event Message Interface
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Core event message structure
 */
export interface AgentEventMessage {
    /** Unique event identifier (UUID) */
    eventId: string;
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID (optional) */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID (optional) */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Source agent ID (for inter-agent messages) */
    sourceAgentId?: string;
    /** Source thread ID */
    sourceThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */
    priority: AgentEventPriority;
    /** Event payload (discriminated by type) */
    payload: AgentEventPayload;
    /** Event creation timestamp (ISO string) */
    createdAt: string;
    /** When the event was delivered via WebSocket */
    deliveredAt?: string;
    /** When acknowledgement was received */
    acknowledgedAt?: string;
    /** Optional expiration time (ISO string) */
    expiresAt?: string;
    /** Current status of the event */
    status: AgentEventStatus;
    /** Number of delivery retry attempts */
    retryCount: number;
    /** Additional metadata */
    metadata?: Record<string, any>;
}

// ============================================================================
// Request/Input Types
// ============================================================================

/**
 * Input for adding an event to an agent's queue
 */
export interface AddEventInput {
    /** Target agent ID */
    targetAgentId: string;
    /** Specific target agent instance ID */
    targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
    /** Target thread ID */
    targetThreadId?: string;
    /** Type of event */
    eventType?: AgentEventType;
    /** Event priority */

+class AgentEventQueueStore extends EventEmitter {
+    private static instance: AgentEventQueueStore;
+
+    private eventQueues: Map<string, AgentEventQueue> = new Map();
+    private eventIdToQueueKey: Map<string, string> = new Map();
+
+    private constructor() {
+        super();
+        this.setMaxListeners(50);
+    }
+
+    static getInstance(): AgentEventQueueStore {
+        if (!AgentEventQueueStore.instance) {
+            AgentEventQueueStore.instance = new AgentEventQueueStore();
+        }
+        return AgentEventQueueStore.instance;
+    }
+
+    ensureQueue(queueKey: string): AgentEventQueue {
+        let queue = this.eventQueues.get(queueKey);
+        if (!queue) {
+            queue = {
+                queueKey,
+                pendingEvents: new Map()
+            };
+            this.eventQueues.set(queueKey, queue);
+            logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Created queue: ${queueKey}`);
+        }
+        return queue;
+    }
+
+    addEvent(event: AgentEventMessage): void {
+        const queueKey = getAgentEventQueueKey(event);
+        const queue = this.ensureQueue(queueKey);
+
+        if (queue.pendingEvents.size >= AGENT_EVENT_QUEUE_CONFIG.MAX_PENDING_PER_QUEUE) {
+            this.removeOldestLowPriorityEvent(queue);
+        }
+
+        queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
+        this.eventIdToQueueKey.set(event.eventId, queueKey);
+
+        this.emit('agentEventQueue:added', {
+            queueKey,
+            event
+        });
+
+        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Added event ${event.eventId} to ${queueKey} (${event.type})`);
+    }
+
+    getPendingEventsForQuery(query: {
+        agentId?: string;
+        agentInstanceId?: string;
+        threadId?: string;
+        eventTypes?: string[];
+        minPriority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        limit?: number;
+    }): AgentEventMessage[] {
+        const candidateQueueKeys = this.resolveQueueKeysForQuery(query);
+        const allEvents: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
+
+        for (const queueKey of candidateQueueKeys) {
+            const queue = this.eventQueues.get(queueKey);
+            if (!queue) {
+                continue;
+            }
+            allEvents.push(...queue.pendingEvents.values());
+        }
+
+        const minimumPriorityOrder = query.minPriority === undefined
+            ? undefined
+            : PRIORITY_ORDER[query.minPriority];
+
+        const matchingEvents = allEvents
+            .filter((event) => {
+                if (query.eventTypes?.length && !query.eventTypes.includes(event.type)) {
+                    return false;
+                }
+                if (minimumPriorityOrder !== undefined) {
+                    return PRIORITY_ORDER[event.metadata.priority] <= minimumPriorityOrder;
+                }
+                return true;
+            })
+            .sort((firstEvent, secondEvent) => {
+                const priorityDifference = PRIORITY_ORDER[firstEvent.metadata.priority] - PRIORITY_ORDER[secondEvent.metadata.priority];
+                if (priorityDifference !== 0) {
+                    return priorityDifference;
+                }
+                return new Date(firstEvent.metadata.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(secondEvent.metadata.createdAt).getTime();
+            });
+
+        return query.limit ? matchingEvents.slice(0, query.limit) : matchingEvents;
+    }
+
+    consumePendingEventsForQuery(query: {
+        agentId?: string;
+        agentInstanceId?: string;
+        threadId?: string;
+        eventTypes?: string[];
+        minPriority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        limit?: number;
+    }): AgentEventMessage[] {
+        const events = this.getPendingEventsForQuery(query);
+        const consumedByQueueKey = new Map<string, number>();
+
+        for (const event of events) {
+            const queueKey = this.eventIdToQueueKey.get(event.eventId);
+            if (!queueKey) {
+                continue;
+            }
+
+            const queue = this.eventQueues.get(queueKey);
+            queue?.pendingEvents.delete(event.eventId);
+            this.eventIdToQueueKey.delete(event.eventId);
+            consumedByQueueKey.set(queueKey, (consumedByQueueKey.get(queueKey) || 0) + 1);
+        }
+
+        for (const [queueKey, count] of consumedByQueueKey) {
+            this.emit('agentEventQueue:consumed', {
+                queueKey,
+                count
+            });
+        }
+
+        if (events.length > 0) {
+            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Consumed ${events.length} event(s)`);
+        }
+
+        return events;
+    }
+
+    getPendingCountForQuery(query: {
+        agentId?: string;
+        agentInstanceId?: string;
+        threadId?: string;
+    }): number {
+        return this.getPendingEventsForQuery(query).length;
+    }
+
+    getPendingCountForQueue(queueKey: string): number {
+        return this.eventQueues.get(queueKey)?.pendingEvents.size || 0;
+    }
+
+    clearQueue(queueKey: string): void {
+        const queue = this.eventQueues.get(queueKey);
+        if (!queue) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        for (const eventId of queue.pendingEvents.keys()) {
+            this.eventIdToQueueKey.delete(eventId);
+        }
+
+        queue.pendingEvents.clear();
+        this.emit('agentEventQueue:queueCleared', { queueKey });
+        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Cleared queue ${queueKey}`);
+    }
+
+    clearAgentInstanceEvents(agentInstanceId: string): number {
+        const queueKey = `agent_instance:${agentInstanceId}`;
+        const count = this.getPendingCountForQueue(queueKey);
+        this.clearQueue(queueKey);
+        return count;
+    }
+
+    removeExpiredEvents(): AgentEventMessage[] {
+        const removedEvents: AgentEventMessage[] = [];
+        const now = new Date();
+
+        for (const [queueKey, queue] of this.eventQueues) {
+            for (const [eventId, event] of queue.pendingEvents) {
+                if (event.expiresAt && new Date(event.expiresAt) < now) {
+                    queue.pendingEvents.delete(eventId);
+                    this.eventIdToQueueKey.delete(eventId);
+                    removedEvents.push(event);
+                    this.emit('agentEventQueue:expired', {
+                        eventId,
+                        queueKey
+                    });
+                }
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (removedEvents.length > 0) {
+            logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Removed ${removedEvents.length} expired event(s)`);
+        }
+
+        return removedEvents;
+    }
+
+    getStats(): {
+        totalQueues: number;
+        totalPendingEvents: number;
+        queueStats: Array<{
+            queueKey: string;
+            pendingCount: number;
+        }>;
+    } {
+        let totalPendingEvents = 0;
+        const queueStats: Array<{
+            queueKey: string;
+            pendingCount: number;
+        }> = [];
+
+        for (const [queueKey, queue] of this.eventQueues) {
+            const pendingCount = queue.pendingEvents.size;
+            totalPendingEvents += pendingCount;
+            queueStats.push({ queueKey, pendingCount });
+        }
+
+        return {
+            totalQueues: this.eventQueues.size,
+            totalPendingEvents,
+            queueStats
+        };
+    }
+
+    getQueueKeys(): string[] {
+        return Array.from(this.eventQueues.keys());
+    }
+
+    clearAll(): void {
+        for (const queueKey of this.eventQueues.keys()) {
+            this.clearQueue(queueKey);
+        }
+        this.eventQueues.clear();
+        this.eventIdToQueueKey.clear();
+        logger.info('[AgentEventQueueStore] Cleared all queues');
+    }
+
+    loadEvents(events: AgentEventMessage[]): void {
+        for (const event of events) {
+            const queueKey = getAgentEventQueueKey(event);
+            const queue = this.ensureQueue(queueKey);
+            queue.pendingEvents.set(event.eventId, event);
+            this.eventIdToQueueKey.set(event.eventId, queueKey);
+        }
+
+        logger.info(`[AgentEventQueueStore] Loaded ${events.length} pending event(s) from persistence`);
+    }
+
+    private resolveQueueKeysForQuery(query: {
+        agentId?: string;
+        agentInstanceId?: string;
+        threadId?: string;
+    }): string[] {
+        const queueKeys: string[] = [];
+
+        if (query.agentInstanceId) {
+            queueKeys.push(`agent_instance:${query.agentInstanceId}`);
+        }
+
+        if (query.threadId) {
+            queueKeys.push(`thread:${query.threadId}`);
+        }
+
+        if (queueKeys.length > 0) {

+        }
+
+        if (query.agentId) {
+            return this.getQueueKeys().filter((queueKey) => {

+            if (eventIsLowerPriority || eventIsOlderSamePriority) {

+class AgentEventQueueDataService {

+                data: { event },
+                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+            };
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error enqueueing event: ${error.message}`);
+            return {
+                success: false,
+                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
+                message: 'Failed to enqueue event',
+                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
+            };
+        }
+    },
+
+    async getPendingEvents(
+        params: GetPendingEventsInput = {},
+        finalMessage?: any
+    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>> {
+        try {
+            await this.initialize();
+
+            const query = {
+                agentId: params.agentId || finalMessage?.agentId,
+                agentInstanceId: params.agentInstanceId || finalMessage?.agentInstanceId || finalMessage?.uniqueConnectionId,
+                threadId: params.threadId || finalMessage?.threadId,
+                limit: params.limit,
+                eventTypes: params.eventTypes,
+                minPriority: params.minPriority
+            };
+
+            const events = agentEventQueueStore.consumePendingEventsForQuery(query);
+            await agentEventQueueDataService.removeManyFromIndex(events.map((event) => event.eventId));
+            const pendingCount = agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCountForQuery(query);
+
+            return {
+                success: true,
+                code: 'OK',
+                message: 'Pending events consumed',
+                data: {
+                    events,
+                    count: events.length,
+                    pendingCount
+                },
+                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+            };
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting pending events: ${error.message}`);
+            return {
+                success: false,
+                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
+                message: 'Failed to get pending events',
+                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
+            };
+        }
+    },
+
+    async getQueueStats(): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<QueueStatsResponseData>> {
+        try {
+            await this.initialize();
+
+            const stats = agentEventQueueStore.getStats();
+            const storage = await agentEventQueueDataService.getStorageStats();
+
+            return {
+                success: true,
+                code: 'OK',
+                message: 'Queue statistics retrieved',
+                data: {
+                    ...stats,
+                    storage
+                },
+                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+            };
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error getting stats: ${error.message}`);
+            return {
+                success: false,
+                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
+                message: 'Failed to get statistics',
+                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
+            };
+        }
+    },
+
+    clearAgentInstanceEvents(agentInstanceId: string): number {
+        return agentEventQueueStore.clearAgentInstanceEvents(agentInstanceId);
+    },
+
+    async handleAgentEventQueueOperation(
+        action: string,
+        params: any,
+        finalMessage: any
+    ): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse> {
+        const requestId = finalMessage?.requestId;
+
+        try {
+            let response: AgentEventQueueResponse;
+
+            switch (action) {
+                case 'getPendingEvents':
+                    response = await this.getPendingEvents(params, finalMessage);
+                    break;
+                case 'getQueueStats':
+                    response = await this.getQueueStats();
+                    break;
+                default:
+                    response = {
+                        success: false,
+                        code: 'UNKNOWN_ACTION',
+                        message: `Unknown or unsupported agent event queue action: ${action}`
+                    };
+            }
+
+            const responseType = action === 'getQueueStats'
+                ? 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse'
+                : 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse';
+            return { ...response, requestId, type: responseType };
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error handling operation ${action}: ${error.message}`);
+            return {
+                success: false,
+                requestId,
+                type: 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse',
+                code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR',
+                message: 'Internal error',
+                error: { code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: error.message }
+            };
+        }
+    },
+
+    validateEnqueueInput(params: EnqueueAgentEventInput): string | null {
+        if (!params.type) {
+            return 'type is required';
+        }
+        if (!params.scope) {
+            return 'scope is required';
+        }
+        if (!params.target) {
+            return 'target is required';
+        }
+        if (params.scope === AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE && !params.target.agentInstanceId && !params.target.agentId) {
+            return 'target.agentInstanceId or target.agentId is required for agent_instance events';
+        }
+        if (params.scope === AgentEventScope.THREAD && !params.target.threadId) {
+            return 'target.threadId is required for thread events';
+        }
+        if (!params.data) {
+            return 'data is required';
+        }
+        return null;
+    },
+
+    async notifyEventAvailable(event: AgentEventMessage): Promise<boolean> {
+        try {
+            const socket = this.resolveTargetSocket(event);
+            if (!socket || socket.readyState !== 1) {
+                logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] No active socket for ${getAgentEventQueueKey(event)}`);
+                return false;
+            }
+
+            const availabilityMessage: AgentEventAvailabilityMessage = {
+                type: 'agentEventAvailable',
+                scope: event.scope,
+                threadId: event.target.threadId,
+                agentInstanceId: event.target.agentInstanceId,
+                agentId: event.target.agentId
+            };
+            socket.send(JSON.stringify(availabilityMessage));
+            return true;
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueCliService] Error notifying event availability: ${error.message}`);
+            return false;
+        }
+    },
+
+    resolveTargetSocket(event: AgentEventMessage): any {
+        if (event.target.agentInstanceId) {
+            const socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketById?.(event.target.agentInstanceId);
+            if (socket) {
+                return socket;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (event.target.agentId) {
+            const socket = wsconnectionManager.getSocketByAgentId(event.target.agentId);
+            if (socket) {
+                return socket;
+            }
+        }
+
+        if (event.target.threadId) {
+            return wsconnectionManager.getSocketByThreadId(event.target.threadId);
+        }
+
+        return null;
+    }
+};

import { IncomingMessage } from '../types';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../utils/socket-constants';
import { terminatePtyProcessById } from '../aiTerminal';
import { sendMessageToCodebotCli } from '../../cliLib/wsconnections';
import { threadServiceCLI } from '../../cliLib/thread/thread-service.cli';
import agentProcessManager from '../../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import sideExecutionManager from '../../managers/SideExecutionManager';
import { processAgentMessage } from '../../services/agentMessageService';
import { llmService } from '../../services/llmService';
import { getEnvironmentById, sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage, sendProviderAgentStartToEnvironment } from '../../services/environmentsServices';
import { sendMessageToUI, sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi } from '../../utils/messages';
import { isActiveThreadStatus, isTerminalThreadStatus, threadFileStore } from '../../stores/threadFileStore';
import { sendSteeringMessage } from '../../services/agentEventQueueInternal';
import logger from '../../utils/appLogger';

export abstract class BaseMessageHandler {
  constructor(protected threadId: string) { }

  abstract canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean;
  abstract handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void>;

  protected async executeWithLogging(
    operation: string,
    fn: () => Promise<void>
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`[${operation}] Error: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  protected sendMessageToUI(event: string, data: any): void {
    sendMessageToUI(event, data);
  }

  protected validateMessage(message: IncomingMessage, requiredFields: string[]): boolean {
    return requiredFields.every(field => {
      const value = field.split('.').reduce((obj, key) => obj?.[key], message);
      return value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '';
    });
  }
}

export class RemoteEnvironmentProviderMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return Boolean(message?.message?.remoteEnv && message?.message?.environmentProvider);
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('RemoteEnvironmentProvider', async () => {
      const payload = message.message as any;

      const selectedAgent = payload.selectedAgent;
      const agentId = payload.agentId || selectedAgent?.agentId || selectedAgent?.id || selectedAgent?.value;
      const userMessage = payload.userMessage || payload.text || message.data?.text || '';
      const targetThreadId = payload.threadId || this.threadId;
      const parentRuntimeId = String(payload.parentRuntimeId || '').trim();
      const currentRuntimeId = String(process.env.CODEBOLT_RUNTIME_ID || process.env.RUNTIME_ID || '').trim();

      logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] received remote env message: thread=${targetThreadId} messageId=${payload.messageId || message.messageId || ''} parentRuntimeId=${parentRuntimeId || ''} currentRuntimeId=${currentRuntimeId || ''} provider=${JSON.stringify({
        name: payload.environmentProvider?.name,
        unique_id: payload.environmentProvider?.unique_id,
        providerId: payload.environmentProvider?.providerId,
        isLocal: payload.environmentProvider?.isLocal,
      })} environmentName=${payload.environmentName || ''} syncMode=${payload.syncMode || ''} mergeStrategy=${payload.mergeStrategy || ''} textPreview=${String(userMessage || '').slice(0, 120)}`);

      if (parentRuntimeId && (!currentRuntimeId || parentRuntimeId !== currentRuntimeId)) {
        logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] forwarding message to cloud runtime: runtime=${parentRuntimeId} thread=${targetThreadId} parentEnvironmentId=${payload.parentEnvironmentId || ''}`);
        await sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage({
          parentRuntimeId,
          parentEnvironmentId: payload.parentEnvironmentId,
          parentProjectPath: payload.parentProjectPath,
          threadId: targetThreadId,
          agentId,
          userMessage: {
            ...payload,
            type: 'userMessage',
            text: userMessage,
            userMessage,
            threadId: targetThreadId,
            messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
            agentId,
            selectedAgent,
            remoteEnv: true,
            source: payload.source || 'local',
            isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal ?? false,
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] creating local remote environment thread: thread=${targetThreadId} provider=${payload.environmentProvider?.providerId || payload.environmentProvider?.unique_id || payload.environmentProvider?.name || ''}`);
      await threadServiceCLI.handleCreateAndStartThread({
        threadId: targetThreadId,
        reuseThreadId: true,
        title: userMessage ? String(userMessage).slice(0, 50) : 'Workspace environment task',
        userMessage,
        selectedAgent,
        agentId,
        messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
        remoteEnv: true,
        environmentProvider: payload.environmentProvider,
        environmentName: payload.environmentName || `env-${targetThreadId.substring(0, 8)}`,
        mentionedAgents: payload.mentionedAgents || [],
        mentionedMCPs: payload.mentionedMCPs || [],
        mentionedFlags: payload.mentionedFlags || [],
        flags: payload.flags,
        source: payload.source,
        isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal,
        selection: payload.selection,
        environmentSource: payload.environmentSource,
        environmentPath: payload.environmentPath,
        requestedPath: payload.requestedPath,
        resolvedPath: payload.resolvedPath,
        pathSource: payload.pathSource,
        syncMode: payload.syncMode,
        mergeStrategy: payload.mergeStrategy,
        supportedSyncModes: payload.supportedSyncModes,
        supportedMergeStrategies: payload.supportedMergeStrategies,
        parentRuntimeId: payload.parentRuntimeId,
        parentEnvironmentId: payload.parentEnvironmentId,
        parentProjectPath: payload.parentProjectPath,
        projectPath: payload.projectPath,
        providerConfig: payload.providerConfig,
        gitUrl: payload.gitUrl,
        gitBranch: payload.gitBranch,
        gitToken: payload.gitToken,
      } as any, undefined);
    });
  }
}

export class EnvironmentMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return !!message?.message?.environment;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('Environment', async () => {
      const environmentRef = message.message.environment;
      const environmentId = this.getEnvironmentId(environmentRef);
      const inlineExecutionMode = this.getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environmentRef);

      if (!environmentId) {
        if (inlineExecutionMode === 'local_thread_pool') {
          await this.processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message);
          return;
        }

        logger.warn('[Environment] Missing environment id on message');
        return;
      }

      const environment = await getEnvironmentById(environmentId);
      const executionMode = this.getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environment) || inlineExecutionMode;

      if (executionMode === 'local_thread_pool') {
        await this.processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message);
        return;
      }

      const targetRuntimeId = this.getCloudRuntimeId(environment) || this.getCloudRuntimeId(environmentRef);
      if (targetRuntimeId && this.isCloudRuntimeEnvironment(environment, environmentRef)) {
        const payload = message.message as any;
        const selectedAgent = payload.selectedAgent;
        const agentId = payload.agentId || selectedAgent?.agentId || selectedAgent?.id || selectedAgent?.value;
        const userMessage = payload.userMessage || payload.text || message.data?.text || '';
        const targetThreadId = payload.threadId || this.threadId;
        const parentProjectPath = this.getCloudEnvironmentPath(environment) || this.getCloudEnvironmentPath(environmentRef);

        logger.info(`[Environment] forwarding existing cloud environment message: environment=${environmentId} runtime=${targetRuntimeId} thread=${targetThreadId} messageId=${payload.messageId || message.messageId || ''} agentId=${agentId || ''} textPreview=${String(userMessage || '').slice(0, 120)}`);
        await sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage({
          parentRuntimeId: targetRuntimeId,
          parentEnvironmentId: environment?.id || environmentId,
          parentProjectPath,
          threadId: targetThreadId,
          agentId,
          userMessage: {
            ...payload,
            type: 'userMessage',
            text: userMessage,
            userMessage,
            threadId: targetThreadId,
            messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
            agentId,
            selectedAgent,
            source: payload.source || 'local',
            isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal ?? false,
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      const success = await sendProviderAgentStartToEnvironment(environmentId, message, this.threadId);

      if (!success) {
        logger.warn(`[Environment] Failed to send to environment: ${environmentId}`);
      }
    });
  }

  private getEnvironmentId(environment: any): string | undefined {
    if (typeof environment === 'string') return environment;
    return environment?.id || environment?.environmentId || environment?.environment_id;
  }

  private getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environment: any): string | undefined {
    return environment?.config?.executionMode || environment?.executionMode || environment?.type;
  }

  private getCloudRuntimeId(environment: any): string | undefined {
    const runtime = environment?.config?.runtime && typeof environment.config.runtime === 'object'
      ? environment.config.runtime
      : {};
    const runtimeId = String(
      environment?.config?.runtimeId ||
      environment?.config?.cloudRuntimeId ||
      runtime.runtimeId ||
      runtime.runtime_id ||
      runtime.cloudRuntimeId ||
      runtime.cloud_runtime_id ||
      runtime.serverId ||
      '',
    ).trim();
    return runtimeId || undefined;
  }

  private isCloudRuntimeEnvironment(environment: any, fallbackEnvironment?: any): boolean {
    const candidate = environment || fallbackEnvironment || {};
    const provider = candidate.provider || {};
    const providerId = String(
      provider.unique_id ||
      provider.providerId ||
      provider.name ||
      candidate.config?.providerId ||
      '',
    ).toLowerCase();
    return String(candidate.id || '').startsWith('cloud:') ||
      providerId.includes('cloudprovider') ||
      Boolean(this.getCloudRuntimeId(candidate));
  }

  private getCloudEnvironmentPath(environment: any): string | undefined {
    const runtime = environment?.config?.runtime && typeof environment.config.runtime === 'object'
      ? environment.config.runtime
      : {};
    const environmentPath = String(
      runtime.parentProjectPath ||
      runtime.parent_project_path ||
      environment?.config?.parentProjectPath ||
      runtime.projectPath ||
      runtime.project_path ||
      runtime.environmentPath ||
      runtime.environment_path ||
      environment?.config?.projectPath ||
      environment?.config?.environmentPath ||
      environment?.config?.resolvedPath ||
      environment?.config?.workspacePath ||
      '',
    ).trim();
    return environmentPath || undefined;
  }

  private async processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    if (message.message) {
      message.message.isRemoteTask = false;
    }

    await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
  }
}

class SimpleMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string, private messageType: string | string[]) {
    super(threadId);
  }

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    if (Array.isArray(this.messageType)) {
      return this.messageType.includes(message.type);
    }
    return message.type === this.messageType;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    sendMessageToCodebotCli(message);
  }
}

export class EditorMessageHandler extends SimpleMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string) {
    super(threadId, "EditorMessage");
  }

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return super.canHandle(message) && message?.message?.selection?.selectedText !== "";
  }
}

export class ResponseMessageHandler extends SimpleMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string) {
    super(threadId, [MESSAGE_TYPES.FEEDBACK_RESPONSE, MESSAGE_TYPES.CONFIRMATION_RESPONSE]);
  }
}

export class TerminalProcessHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_TERMINAL_PROCESS;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('TerminalProcess', async () => {
      if (!this.validateMessage(message, ['message.processId'])) {
        throw new Error('Missing or invalid processId');
      }

      const processId = parseInt(message.message.processId, 10);
      if (isNaN(processId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid processId: ${message.message.processId}`);
      }

      await terminatePtyProcessById(processId);
    });
  }
}

export class ProcessStopHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.PROCESS_STOPPED ||
      message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_PROCESS_CLICKED;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('ProcessStop', async () => {
      const threadIdToStop = message?.message?.threadId || this.threadId;
      const processesToStop = agentProcessManager.getProcessesByThreadTree(threadIdToStop);
      const parentAgentInstanceIds = processesToStop.map(processMetadata => processMetadata.instanceId);
      const threadIdsToCancel = new Set<string>([threadIdToStop]);
      for (const processMetadata of processesToStop) {
        if (processMetadata.threadId) {
          threadIdsToCancel.add(processMetadata.threadId);
        }
      }
      let stoppedLLMRequests = 0;
      for (const threadId of threadIdsToCancel) {
        stoppedLLMRequests += llmService.cancelActiveRequestsForThread(threadId, 'thread_stop_clicked');
      }
      const stoppedSideExecutions = await sideExecutionManager.stopAllForThreadOrParents(
        threadIdToStop,
        parentAgentInstanceIds
      );
      let stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessTreeByThreadId(threadIdToStop, true);

      if (stoppedCount > 0 || stoppedSideExecutions > 0 || stoppedLLMRequests > 0) {
        this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
          threadId: threadIdToStop,
          stoppedProcesses: stoppedCount,
          stoppedSideExecutions,
          stoppedLLMRequests,
          message: `Successfully stopped ${stoppedCount} process(es), ${stoppedSideExecutions} side execution(s), and ${stoppedLLMRequests} LLM request(s)`
        });
      } else {
        stoppedCount = await this.handleFallbackStop(threadIdToStop);
      }

      await this.setThreadStopped(threadIdToStop, stoppedCount + stoppedSideExecutions);
    });
  }

  private async handleFallbackStop(threadId: string): Promise<number> {
    const allProcesses = agentProcessManager.getAllProcesses();
    if (allProcesses.length > 0) {
      await agentProcessManager.stopAllProcesses(true);
      this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
        threadId,
        stoppedProcesses: allProcesses.length,
        message: `Stopped all processes (fallback)`
      });
      return allProcesses.length;
    } else {
      this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
        threadId,
        stoppedProcesses: 0,
        message: `No active processes found`
      });
      return 0;
    }
  }

  private async setThreadStopped(threadId: string, stoppedCount: number): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const thread = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);
      const currentStatus = thread?.status;

      if (isTerminalThreadStatus(currentStatus) || currentStatus === 'waiting') {
        logger.info(`Preserving thread ${threadId} status '${currentStatus}' after stop request`);
        return;
      }

      if (stoppedCount > 0 || isActiveThreadStatus(currentStatus)) {
        const updated = await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
        if (updated) {
          sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi(threadId, 'stopped', `Thread ${threadId} was stopped`);
        }
        return;
      }

      logger.info(`Leaving thread ${threadId} status unchanged after stop request (current: ${currentStatus || 'unknown'})`);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`Failed to mark thread as stopped ${threadId}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

export abstract class ThreadStepHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  // threadFileStore is already initialized, no setup needed
}

export class TaskStepsHandler extends ThreadStepHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.UPDATE_TASK_STEPS;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('TaskSteps', async () => {
      if (!this.validateMessage(message, ['message.threadId'])) {
        throw new Error('Missing threadId');
      }
    });
  }
}

export class StepActivationHandler extends ThreadStepHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.ACTIVATE_STEP;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('StepActivation', async () => {
      const { threadId, stepId } = message.message;

      if (!threadId || !stepId) {
        throw new Error('Missing threadId or stepId');
      }

      const success = await threadFileStore.activateStep(threadId, stepId);

      this.sendMessageToUI("stepActivated", {
        threadId,
        stepId,
        success,
        message: success ? `Step ${stepId} activated` : `Failed to activate step ${stepId}`
      });
    });
  }
}

export class SteeringMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    const isSteering = !!(message?.message as any)?.isSteeringMessage;
    logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] canHandle check: isSteeringMessage=${isSteering}, type=${message?.type}`);
    return isSteering;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('SteeringMessage', async () => {
      const threadId = message?.message?.threadId || this.threadId;
      const msg = message?.message as any;
      const instruction = msg?.steeringInstruction || msg?.userMessage || '';
      const steeringStepId = msg?.steeringStepId;

      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Handling steering message for thread ${threadId}`);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Instruction: "${instruction.substring(0, 200)}"`);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] SteeringStepId: ${steeringStepId}`);

      if (!instruction.trim()) {
        logger.warn(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Empty steering instruction for thread ${threadId}`);
        return;
      }

      // Find the running agent for this thread
      const processes = agentProcessManager.getProcessesByThreadId(threadId);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Found ${processes.length} running process(es) for thread ${threadId}`);

      if (processes.length === 0) {
        logger.warn(`[SteeringMessageHandler] No running agent found for thread ${threadId}. Steering messages require a running agent — ignoring.`);
        this.sendMessageToUI("steeringError", {
          threadId,
          message: "No running agent found to steer. Please start an agent first.",
          instruction: instruction.substring(0, 200)
        });
        return;
      }

      const targetProcess = processes[0];
      const targetAgentId = targetProcess.agentId;
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Target agent: ${targetAgentId}, instanceId: ${targetProcess.instanceId}`);

      // Build context from the message payload
      const context: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (msg) {
	        if (msg.mentionedFiles?.length) context.mentionedFiles = msg.mentionedFiles;
	        if (msg.mentionedAgents?.length) context.mentionedAgents = msg.mentionedAgents;
	        if (msg.mentionedEnvironments?.length) context.mentionedEnvironments = msg.mentionedEnvironments;
	        if (msg.mentionedFolders?.length) context.mentionedFolders = msg.mentionedFolders;
        if (msg.mentionedMCPs?.length) context.mentionedMCPs = msg.mentionedMCPs;
        if (msg.uploadedImages?.length) context.uploadedImages = msg.uploadedImages;
        if (msg.links?.length) context.links = msg.links;
        if (msg.controlFiles?.length) context.controlFiles = msg.controlFiles;
      }

      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Sending steering event to agent event queue...`);

      const result = await sendSteeringMessage(
        targetAgentId,
        instruction,
        threadId,
        {
          steeringStepId,
          targetAgentInstanceId: targetProcess.instanceId,
          context: Object.keys(context).length > 0 ? context : undefined,
          metadata: {
            source: 'user',
            messageId: message?.messageId || message?.message?.messageId
          }
        }
      );

      if (result.success) {
        logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Steering event queued successfully: eventId=${result.data?.event?.eventId}, targetAgent=${targetAgentId}`);
      } else {
        logger.error(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Failed to queue steering event: ${result.message}, code=${result.code}`);
        this.sendMessageToUI("steeringError", {
          threadId,
          message: `Failed to deliver steering message to agent: ${result.message}`,
          instruction: instruction.substring(0, 200)
        });
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AgentMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  private readonly excludedTypes = Object.values([
    MESSAGE_TYPES.NO_CLOSE,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.RUN_IN_BACKGROUND,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.COMMAND_FAILED,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.CONFIRMATION_RESPONSE,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.FEEDBACK_RESPONSE,
    'reviewModeResponse',
    'reviewModeBulkResponse',
    'reviewModeHunkAction'
  ]);

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return !this.excludedTypes.includes(message.type as any);
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('AgentMessage', async () => {
      try {
        // Create a step from the incoming message before processing
        this.createStepFromMessage(message);

        // Process the agent message as usual
        await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageHandler] Error processing message: ${error.message}`);
        // Continue with message processing even if step creation fails
        await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
      }
    });
  }

  private async createStepFromMessage(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Only create steps for messages that have actual content
      const messageContent = message?.message?.userMessage

      if (!messageContent || messageContent.trim() === '') {
        logger.debug(`[AgentMessageHandler] Skipping step creation for empty message`);
        return;
      }

      // Don't create steps for system messages that shouldn't be tracked
      if (this.excludedTypes.includes(message.type as any)) {
        logger.debug(`[AgentMessageHandler] Skipping step creation for excluded message type: ${message.type}`);
        return;
      }

      // Create the step with message type information
      const messageType = `agent_${message.type}` || 'agent_message';
      const step = await threadFileStore.createStepFromMessage(this.threadId, message, messageType, true);

      logger.info(`[AgentMessageHandler] Created step ${step.stepId} for message type ${messageType} in thread ${this.threadId}`);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`[AgentMessageHandler] Failed to create step from message: ${error.message}`);
      // Don't throw the error, just log it, so message processing can continue
    }
  }
}

import { IncomingMessage } from '../types';
import { MESSAGE_TYPES } from '../utils/socket-constants';
import { terminatePtyProcessById } from '../aiTerminal';
import { sendMessageToCodebotCli } from '../../cliLib/wsconnections';
import { threadServiceCLI } from '../../cliLib/thread/thread-service.cli';
import agentProcessManager from '../../managers/AgentProcessManager';
import sideExecutionManager from '../../managers/SideExecutionManager';
import { processAgentMessage } from '../../services/agentMessageService';
import { llmService } from '../../services/llmService';
import { getEnvironmentById, sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage, sendProviderAgentStartToEnvironment } from '../../services/environmentsServices';
import { sendMessageToUI, sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi } from '../../utils/messages';
import { isActiveThreadStatus, isTerminalThreadStatus, threadFileStore } from '../../stores/threadFileStore';
import { sendSteeringMessage } from '../../services/agentEventQueueInternal';
import logger from '../../utils/appLogger';

export abstract class BaseMessageHandler {
  constructor(protected threadId: string) { }

  abstract canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean;
  abstract handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void>;

  protected async executeWithLogging(
    operation: string,
    fn: () => Promise<void>
  ): Promise<void> {
    try {
      await fn();
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`[${operation}] Error: ${error.message}`);
      throw error;
    }
  }

  protected sendMessageToUI(event: string, data: any): void {
    sendMessageToUI(event, data);
  }

  protected validateMessage(message: IncomingMessage, requiredFields: string[]): boolean {
    return requiredFields.every(field => {
      const value = field.split('.').reduce((obj, key) => obj?.[key], message);
      return value !== undefined && value !== null && value !== '';
    });
  }
}

export class RemoteEnvironmentProviderMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return Boolean(message?.message?.remoteEnv && message?.message?.environmentProvider);
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('RemoteEnvironmentProvider', async () => {
      const payload = message.message as any;

      const selectedAgent = payload.selectedAgent;
      const agentId = payload.agentId || selectedAgent?.agentId || selectedAgent?.id || selectedAgent?.value;
      const userMessage = payload.userMessage || payload.text || message.data?.text || '';
      const targetThreadId = payload.threadId || this.threadId;
      const parentRuntimeId = String(payload.parentRuntimeId || '').trim();
      const currentRuntimeId = String(process.env.CODEBOLT_RUNTIME_ID || process.env.RUNTIME_ID || '').trim();

      logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] received remote env message: thread=${targetThreadId} messageId=${payload.messageId || message.messageId || ''} parentRuntimeId=${parentRuntimeId || ''} currentRuntimeId=${currentRuntimeId || ''} provider=${JSON.stringify({
        name: payload.environmentProvider?.name,
        unique_id: payload.environmentProvider?.unique_id,
        providerId: payload.environmentProvider?.providerId,
        isLocal: payload.environmentProvider?.isLocal,
      })} environmentName=${payload.environmentName || ''} syncMode=${payload.syncMode || ''} mergeStrategy=${payload.mergeStrategy || ''} textPreview=${String(userMessage || '').slice(0, 120)}`);

      if (parentRuntimeId && (!currentRuntimeId || parentRuntimeId !== currentRuntimeId)) {
        logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] forwarding message to cloud runtime: runtime=${parentRuntimeId} thread=${targetThreadId} parentEnvironmentId=${payload.parentEnvironmentId || ''}`);
        await sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage({
          parentRuntimeId,
          parentEnvironmentId: payload.parentEnvironmentId,
          parentProjectPath: payload.parentProjectPath,
          threadId: targetThreadId,
          agentId,
          userMessage: {
            ...payload,
            type: 'userMessage',
            text: userMessage,
            userMessage,
            threadId: targetThreadId,
            messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
            agentId,
            selectedAgent,
            remoteEnv: true,
            source: payload.source || 'local',
            isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal ?? false,
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      logger.info(`[RemoteEnvironmentProvider] creating local remote environment thread: thread=${targetThreadId} provider=${payload.environmentProvider?.providerId || payload.environmentProvider?.unique_id || payload.environmentProvider?.name || ''}`);
      await threadServiceCLI.handleCreateAndStartThread({
        threadId: targetThreadId,
        reuseThreadId: true,
        title: userMessage ? String(userMessage).slice(0, 50) : 'Workspace environment task',
        userMessage,
        selectedAgent,
        agentId,
        messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
        remoteEnv: true,
        environmentProvider: payload.environmentProvider,
        environmentName: payload.environmentName || `env-${targetThreadId.substring(0, 8)}`,
        mentionedAgents: payload.mentionedAgents || [],
        mentionedMCPs: payload.mentionedMCPs || [],
        mentionedFlags: payload.mentionedFlags || [],
        flags: payload.flags,
        source: payload.source,
        isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal,
        selection: payload.selection,
        environmentSource: payload.environmentSource,
        environmentPath: payload.environmentPath,
        requestedPath: payload.requestedPath,
        resolvedPath: payload.resolvedPath,
        pathSource: payload.pathSource,
        syncMode: payload.syncMode,
        mergeStrategy: payload.mergeStrategy,
        supportedSyncModes: payload.supportedSyncModes,
        supportedMergeStrategies: payload.supportedMergeStrategies,
        parentRuntimeId: payload.parentRuntimeId,
        parentEnvironmentId: payload.parentEnvironmentId,
        parentProjectPath: payload.parentProjectPath,
        projectPath: payload.projectPath,
        providerConfig: payload.providerConfig,
        gitUrl: payload.gitUrl,
        gitBranch: payload.gitBranch,
        gitToken: payload.gitToken,
      } as any, undefined);
    });
  }
}

export class EnvironmentMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return !!message?.message?.environment;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('Environment', async () => {
      const environmentRef = message.message.environment;
      const environmentId = this.getEnvironmentId(environmentRef);
      const inlineExecutionMode = this.getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environmentRef);

      if (!environmentId) {
        if (inlineExecutionMode === 'local_thread_pool') {
          await this.processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message);
          return;
        }

        logger.warn('[Environment] Missing environment id on message');
        return;
      }

      const environment = await getEnvironmentById(environmentId);
      const executionMode = this.getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environment) || inlineExecutionMode;

      if (executionMode === 'local_thread_pool') {
        await this.processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message);
        return;
      }

      const targetRuntimeId = this.getCloudRuntimeId(environment) || this.getCloudRuntimeId(environmentRef);
      if (targetRuntimeId && this.isCloudRuntimeEnvironment(environment, environmentRef)) {
        const payload = message.message as any;
        const selectedAgent = payload.selectedAgent;
        const agentId = payload.agentId || selectedAgent?.agentId || selectedAgent?.id || selectedAgent?.value;
        const userMessage = payload.userMessage || payload.text || message.data?.text || '';
        const targetThreadId = payload.threadId || this.threadId;
        const parentProjectPath = this.getCloudEnvironmentPath(environment) || this.getCloudEnvironmentPath(environmentRef);

        logger.info(`[Environment] forwarding existing cloud environment message: environment=${environmentId} runtime=${targetRuntimeId} thread=${targetThreadId} messageId=${payload.messageId || message.messageId || ''} agentId=${agentId || ''} textPreview=${String(userMessage || '').slice(0, 120)}`);
        await sendCloudRuntimeUserMessage({
          parentRuntimeId: targetRuntimeId,
          parentEnvironmentId: environment?.id || environmentId,
          parentProjectPath,
          threadId: targetThreadId,
          agentId,
          userMessage: {
            ...payload,
            type: 'userMessage',
            text: userMessage,
            userMessage,
            threadId: targetThreadId,
            messageId: payload.messageId || message.messageId,
            agentId,
            selectedAgent,
            source: payload.source || 'local',
            isFromPortal: payload.isFromPortal ?? false,
          },
        });
        return;
      }

      const success = await sendProviderAgentStartToEnvironment(environmentId, message, this.threadId);

      if (!success) {
        logger.warn(`[Environment] Failed to send to environment: ${environmentId}`);
      }
    });
  }

  private getEnvironmentId(environment: any): string | undefined {
    if (typeof environment === 'string') return environment;
    return environment?.id || environment?.environmentId || environment?.environment_id;
  }

  private getEnvironmentExecutionMode(environment: any): string | undefined {
    return environment?.config?.executionMode || environment?.executionMode || environment?.type;
  }

  private getCloudRuntimeId(environment: any): string | undefined {
    const runtime = environment?.config?.runtime && typeof environment.config.runtime === 'object'
      ? environment.config.runtime
      : {};
    const runtimeId = String(
      environment?.config?.runtimeId ||
      environment?.config?.cloudRuntimeId ||
      runtime.runtimeId ||
      runtime.runtime_id ||
      runtime.cloudRuntimeId ||
      runtime.cloud_runtime_id ||
      runtime.serverId ||
      '',
    ).trim();
    return runtimeId || undefined;
  }

  private isCloudRuntimeEnvironment(environment: any, fallbackEnvironment?: any): boolean {
    const candidate = environment || fallbackEnvironment || {};
    const provider = candidate.provider || {};
    const providerId = String(
      provider.unique_id ||
      provider.providerId ||
      provider.name ||
      candidate.config?.providerId ||
      '',
    ).toLowerCase();
    return String(candidate.id || '').startsWith('cloud:') ||
      providerId.includes('cloudprovider') ||
      Boolean(this.getCloudRuntimeId(candidate));
  }

  private getCloudEnvironmentPath(environment: any): string | undefined {
    const runtime = environment?.config?.runtime && typeof environment.config.runtime === 'object'
      ? environment.config.runtime
      : {};
    const environmentPath = String(
      runtime.parentProjectPath ||
      runtime.parent_project_path ||
      environment?.config?.parentProjectPath ||
      runtime.projectPath ||
      runtime.project_path ||
      runtime.environmentPath ||
      runtime.environment_path ||
      environment?.config?.projectPath ||
      environment?.config?.environmentPath ||
      environment?.config?.resolvedPath ||
      environment?.config?.workspacePath ||
      '',
    ).trim();
    return environmentPath || undefined;
  }

  private async processLocalThreadPoolMessage(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    if (message.message) {
      message.message.isRemoteTask = false;
    }

    await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
  }
}

class SimpleMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string, private messageType: string | string[]) {
    super(threadId);
  }

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    if (Array.isArray(this.messageType)) {
      return this.messageType.includes(message.type);
    }
    return message.type === this.messageType;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    sendMessageToCodebotCli(message);
  }
}

export class EditorMessageHandler extends SimpleMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string) {
    super(threadId, "EditorMessage");
  }

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return super.canHandle(message) && message?.message?.selection?.selectedText !== "";
  }
}

export class ResponseMessageHandler extends SimpleMessageHandler {
  constructor(threadId: string) {
    super(threadId, [MESSAGE_TYPES.FEEDBACK_RESPONSE, MESSAGE_TYPES.CONFIRMATION_RESPONSE]);
  }
}

export class TerminalProcessHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_TERMINAL_PROCESS;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('TerminalProcess', async () => {
      if (!this.validateMessage(message, ['message.processId'])) {
        throw new Error('Missing or invalid processId');
      }

      const processId = parseInt(message.message.processId, 10);
      if (isNaN(processId)) {
        throw new Error(`Invalid processId: ${message.message.processId}`);
      }

      await terminatePtyProcessById(processId);
    });
  }
}

export class ProcessStopHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.PROCESS_STOPPED ||
      message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.STOP_PROCESS_CLICKED;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('ProcessStop', async () => {
      const threadIdToStop = message?.message?.threadId || this.threadId;
      const processesToStop = agentProcessManager.getProcessesByThreadTree(threadIdToStop);
      const parentAgentInstanceIds = processesToStop.map(processMetadata => processMetadata.instanceId);
      const threadIdsToCancel = new Set<string>([threadIdToStop]);
      for (const processMetadata of processesToStop) {
        if (processMetadata.threadId) {
          threadIdsToCancel.add(processMetadata.threadId);
        }
      }
      let stoppedLLMRequests = 0;
      for (const threadId of threadIdsToCancel) {
        stoppedLLMRequests += llmService.cancelActiveRequestsForThread(threadId, 'thread_stop_clicked');
      }
      const stoppedSideExecutions = await sideExecutionManager.stopAllForThreadOrParents(
        threadIdToStop,
        parentAgentInstanceIds
      );
      let stoppedCount = await agentProcessManager.stopProcessTreeByThreadId(threadIdToStop, true);

      if (stoppedCount > 0 || stoppedSideExecutions > 0 || stoppedLLMRequests > 0) {
        this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
          threadId: threadIdToStop,
          stoppedProcesses: stoppedCount,
          stoppedSideExecutions,
          stoppedLLMRequests,
          message: `Successfully stopped ${stoppedCount} process(es), ${stoppedSideExecutions} side execution(s), and ${stoppedLLMRequests} LLM request(s)`
        });
      } else {
        stoppedCount = await this.handleFallbackStop(threadIdToStop);
      }

      await this.setThreadStopped(threadIdToStop, stoppedCount + stoppedSideExecutions);
    });
  }

  private async handleFallbackStop(threadId: string): Promise<number> {
    const allProcesses = agentProcessManager.getAllProcesses();
    if (allProcesses.length > 0) {
      await agentProcessManager.stopAllProcesses(true);
      this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
        threadId,
        stoppedProcesses: allProcesses.length,
        message: `Stopped all processes (fallback)`
      });
      return allProcesses.length;
    } else {
      this.sendMessageToUI("processStoppedConfirmation", {
        threadId,
        stoppedProcesses: 0,
        message: `No active processes found`
      });
      return 0;
    }
  }

  private async setThreadStopped(threadId: string, stoppedCount: number): Promise<void> {
    try {
      const thread = await threadFileStore.getThreadByThreadId(threadId);
      const currentStatus = thread?.status;

      if (isTerminalThreadStatus(currentStatus) || currentStatus === 'waiting') {
        logger.info(`Preserving thread ${threadId} status '${currentStatus}' after stop request`);
        return;
      }

      if (stoppedCount > 0 || isActiveThreadStatus(currentStatus)) {
        const updated = await threadFileStore.updateThreadStatusSimple(threadId, 'stopped');
        if (updated) {
          sendThreadStatusUpdateToUi(threadId, 'stopped', `Thread ${threadId} was stopped`);
        }
        return;
      }

      logger.info(`Leaving thread ${threadId} status unchanged after stop request (current: ${currentStatus || 'unknown'})`);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`Failed to mark thread as stopped ${threadId}: ${error.message}`);
    }
  }
}

export abstract class ThreadStepHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  // threadFileStore is already initialized, no setup needed
}

export class TaskStepsHandler extends ThreadStepHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.UPDATE_TASK_STEPS;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('TaskSteps', async () => {
      if (!this.validateMessage(message, ['message.threadId'])) {
        throw new Error('Missing threadId');
      }
    });
  }
}

export class StepActivationHandler extends ThreadStepHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return message.type === MESSAGE_TYPES.ACTIVATE_STEP;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('StepActivation', async () => {
      const { threadId, stepId } = message.message;

      if (!threadId || !stepId) {
        throw new Error('Missing threadId or stepId');
      }

      const success = await threadFileStore.activateStep(threadId, stepId);

      this.sendMessageToUI("stepActivated", {
        threadId,
        stepId,
        success,
        message: success ? `Step ${stepId} activated` : `Failed to activate step ${stepId}`
      });
    });
  }
}

export class SteeringMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    const isSteering = !!(message?.message as any)?.isSteeringMessage;
    logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] canHandle check: isSteeringMessage=${isSteering}, type=${message?.type}`);
    return isSteering;
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('SteeringMessage', async () => {
      const threadId = message?.message?.threadId || this.threadId;
      const msg = message?.message as any;
      const instruction = msg?.steeringInstruction || msg?.userMessage || '';
      const steeringStepId = msg?.steeringStepId;

      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Handling steering message for thread ${threadId}`);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Instruction: "${instruction.substring(0, 200)}"`);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] SteeringStepId: ${steeringStepId}`);

      if (!instruction.trim()) {
        logger.warn(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Empty steering instruction for thread ${threadId}`);
        return;
      }

      // Find the running agent for this thread
      const processes = agentProcessManager.getProcessesByThreadId(threadId);
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Found ${processes.length} running process(es) for thread ${threadId}`);

      if (processes.length === 0) {
        logger.warn(`[SteeringMessageHandler] No running agent found for thread ${threadId}. Steering messages require a running agent — ignoring.`);
        this.sendMessageToUI("steeringError", {
          threadId,
          message: "No running agent found to steer. Please start an agent first.",
          instruction: instruction.substring(0, 200)
        });
        return;
      }

      const targetProcess = processes[0];
      const targetAgentId = targetProcess.agentId;
      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Target agent: ${targetAgentId}, instanceId: ${targetProcess.instanceId}`);

      // Build context from the message payload
      const context: Record<string, any> = {};
      if (msg) {
	        if (msg.mentionedFiles?.length) context.mentionedFiles = msg.mentionedFiles;
	        if (msg.mentionedAgents?.length) context.mentionedAgents = msg.mentionedAgents;
	        if (msg.mentionedEnvironments?.length) context.mentionedEnvironments = msg.mentionedEnvironments;
	        if (msg.mentionedFolders?.length) context.mentionedFolders = msg.mentionedFolders;
        if (msg.mentionedMCPs?.length) context.mentionedMCPs = msg.mentionedMCPs;
        if (msg.uploadedImages?.length) context.uploadedImages = msg.uploadedImages;
        if (msg.links?.length) context.links = msg.links;
        if (msg.controlFiles?.length) context.controlFiles = msg.controlFiles;
      }

      logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Sending steering event to agent event queue...`);

      const result = await sendSteeringMessage(
        targetAgentId,
        instruction,
        threadId,
        {
          steeringStepId,
          targetAgentInstanceId: targetProcess.instanceId,
          context: Object.keys(context).length > 0 ? context : undefined,
          metadata: {
            source: 'user',
            messageId: message?.messageId || message?.message?.messageId
          }
        }
      );

      if (result.success) {
        logger.info(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Steering event queued successfully: eventId=${result.data?.event?.eventId}, targetAgent=${targetAgentId}`);
      } else {
        logger.error(`[SteeringMessageHandler] Failed to queue steering event: ${result.message}, code=${result.code}`);
        this.sendMessageToUI("steeringError", {
          threadId,
          message: `Failed to deliver steering message to agent: ${result.message}`,
          instruction: instruction.substring(0, 200)
        });
      }
    });
  }
}

export class AgentMessageHandler extends BaseMessageHandler {
  private readonly excludedTypes = Object.values([
    MESSAGE_TYPES.NO_CLOSE,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.RUN_IN_BACKGROUND,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.COMMAND_FAILED,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.CONFIRMATION_RESPONSE,
    MESSAGE_TYPES.FEEDBACK_RESPONSE,
    'reviewModeResponse',
    'reviewModeBulkResponse',
    'reviewModeHunkAction'
  ]);

  canHandle(message: IncomingMessage): boolean {
    return !this.excludedTypes.includes(message.type as any);
  }

  async handle(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    await this.executeWithLogging('AgentMessage', async () => {
      try {
        // Create a step from the incoming message before processing
        this.createStepFromMessage(message);

        // Process the agent message as usual
        await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
      } catch (error) {
        logger.error(`[AgentMessageHandler] Error processing message: ${error.message}`);
        // Continue with message processing even if step creation fails
        await processAgentMessage(message as any, this.threadId);
      }
    });
  }

  private async createStepFromMessage(message: IncomingMessage): Promise<void> {
    try {
      // Only create steps for messages that have actual content
      const messageContent = message?.message?.userMessage

      if (!messageContent || messageContent.trim() === '') {
        logger.debug(`[AgentMessageHandler] Skipping step creation for empty message`);
        return;
      }

      // Don't create steps for system messages that shouldn't be tracked
      if (this.excludedTypes.includes(message.type as any)) {
        logger.debug(`[AgentMessageHandler] Skipping step creation for excluded message type: ${message.type}`);
        return;
      }

      // Create the step with message type information
      const messageType = `agent_${message.type}` || 'agent_message';
      const step = await threadFileStore.createStepFromMessage(this.threadId, message, messageType, true);

      logger.info(`[AgentMessageHandler] Created step ${step.stepId} for message type ${messageType} in thread ${this.threadId}`);
    } catch (error) {
      logger.error(`[AgentMessageHandler] Failed to create step from message: ${error.message}`);
      // Don't throw the error, just log it, so message processing can continue
    }
  }
}
