+import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
+import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
+import {
+    AgentEventPriority,
+    AgentEventQueueResponse,
+    AgentEventScope,
+    AgentEventType,
+    EnqueueAgentEventResponseData
+} from '../types/agentEventQueue';
+
+export async function sendCalendarUpdate(
+    targetAgentId: string,
+    calendarEventId: string,
+    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'deleted' | 'reminder' | 'rescheduled',
+    details?: {
+        eventTitle?: string;
+        startTime?: string;
+        endTime?: string;
+        location?: string;
+        description?: string;
+        reminderMinutes?: number;
+        targetThreadId?: string;
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<EnqueueAgentEventResponseData>> {
+    return agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+        type: AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
+        scope: details?.targetThreadId ? AgentEventScope.THREAD : AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+        target: {
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            threadId: details?.targetThreadId
+        },
+        priority: details?.priority || (action === 'reminder' ? AgentEventPriority.HIGH : AgentEventPriority.NORMAL),
+        data: {
+            eventName: 'calendarUpdate',
+            calendarEventId,
+            action,
+            eventTitle: details?.eventTitle,
+            startTime: details?.startTime,
+            endTime: details?.endTime,
+            location: details?.location,
+            description: details?.description,
+            reminderMinutes: details?.reminderMinutes
+        },
+        metadata: details?.metadata
+    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: details?.targetThreadId || 'internal' });
+}
+
+export async function sendSystemNotification(
+    targetAgentId: string,
+    notificationType: 'info' | 'warning' | 'error' | 'success' | 'alert',
+    title: string,
+    message: string,
+    options?: {
+        actionRequired?: boolean;
+        actionUrl?: string;
+        actionLabel?: string;
+        targetThreadId?: string;
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        expiresAt?: string;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<EnqueueAgentEventResponseData>> {
+    const defaultPriority = notificationType === 'error' || notificationType === 'alert'
+        ? AgentEventPriority.URGENT
+        : notificationType === 'warning'
+            ? AgentEventPriority.HIGH
+            : AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
+
+    return agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+        type: AgentEventType.SYSTEM_NOTIFICATION,
+        scope: options?.targetThreadId ? AgentEventScope.THREAD : AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+        target: {
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            threadId: options?.targetThreadId
+        },
+        priority: options?.priority || defaultPriority,
+        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
+        data: {
+            notificationType,
+            title,
+            message,
+            actionRequired: options?.actionRequired,
+            actionUrl: options?.actionUrl,
+            actionLabel: options?.actionLabel
+        },
+        metadata: options?.metadata
+    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: options?.targetThreadId || 'internal' });
+}
+
+export async function sendTaskUpdate(
+    targetAgentId: string,
+    taskId: string,
+    action: 'created' | 'updated' | 'completed' | 'assigned' | 'unassigned' | 'statusChanged' | 'dueSoon' | 'overdue',
+    details?: {
+        taskTitle?: string;
+        status?: string;
+        previousStatus?: string;
+        assignee?: string;
+        dueDate?: string;
+        description?: string;
+        targetThreadId?: string;
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<EnqueueAgentEventResponseData>> {
+    const defaultPriority = action === 'overdue'
+        ? AgentEventPriority.URGENT
+        : action === 'dueSoon' || action === 'assigned'
+            ? AgentEventPriority.HIGH
+            : AgentEventPriority.NORMAL;
+
+    return agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+        type: AgentEventType.TASK_UPDATE,
+        scope: details?.targetThreadId ? AgentEventScope.THREAD : AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+        target: {
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            threadId: details?.targetThreadId
+        },
+        priority: details?.priority || defaultPriority,
+        data: {
+            taskId,
+            action,
+            taskTitle: details?.taskTitle,
+            status: details?.status,
+            previousStatus: details?.previousStatus,
+            assignee: details?.assignee,
+            dueDate: details?.dueDate,
+            description: details?.description
+        },
+        metadata: details?.metadata
+    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: details?.targetThreadId || 'internal' });
+}
+
+export async function sendCustomEvent(
+    targetAgentId: string,
+    eventName: string,
+    data: Record<string, any>,
+    options?: {
+        targetThreadId?: string;
+        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        expiresAt?: string;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<EnqueueAgentEventResponseData>> {
+    return agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+        type: AgentEventType.CUSTOM,
+        scope: options?.targetThreadId ? AgentEventScope.THREAD : AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+        target: {
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            agentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
+            threadId: options?.targetThreadId
+        },
+        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
+        expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
+        data: {
+            eventName,
+            ...data
+        },
+        metadata: options?.metadata
+    }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: options?.targetThreadId || 'internal' });
+}
+
+export async function sendSteeringMessage(
+    targetAgentId: string,
+    instruction: string,
+    threadId: string,
+    options?: {
+        steeringStepId?: string;
+        targetAgentInstanceId?: string;
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        context?: Record<string, any>;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<EnqueueAgentEventResponseData>> {
+    return agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+        type: AgentEventType.STEERING,
+        scope: AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+        target: {
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            agentInstanceId: options?.targetAgentInstanceId,
+            threadId
+        },
+        priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.HIGH,
+        data: {
+            instruction,
+            steeringStepId: options?.steeringStepId,
+            threadId,
+            context: options?.context
+        },
+        metadata: options?.metadata
+    }, { agentId: 'user', threadId });
+}
+
+export async function broadcastToAgents(
+    targetAgentIds: string[],
+    eventType: AgentEventType,
+    data: Record<string, any>,
+    options?: {
+        priority?: AgentEventPriority;
+        expiresAt?: string;
+        metadata?: Record<string, any>;
+    }
+): Promise<{
+    success: boolean;
+    results: Array<{
+        agentId: string;
+        success: boolean;
+        eventId?: string;
+        error?: string;
+    }>;
+}> {
+    const results = [];
+
+    for (const targetAgentId of targetAgentIds) {
+        const response = await agentEventQueueCliService.enqueueEvent({
+            type: eventType,
+            scope: AgentEventScope.AGENT_INSTANCE,
+            target: { agentId: targetAgentId },
+            priority: options?.priority || AgentEventPriority.NORMAL,
+            expiresAt: options?.expiresAt,
+            data,
+            metadata: options?.metadata
+        }, { agentId: 'system', threadId: 'internal' });
+
+        results.push({
+            agentId: targetAgentId,
+            success: response.success,
+            eventId: response.data?.event.eventId,
+            error: response.error?.message
+        });
+    }
+
+    return {
+        success: results.every((result) => result.success),
+        results
+    };
+}
+
+export function getPendingEventCountForThread(threadId: string): number {
+    return agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCountForQuery({ threadId });
+}
+
+export function getPendingEventCountForAgentInstance(agentInstanceId: string): number {
+    return agentEventQueueStore.getPendingCountForQuery({ agentInstanceId });
+}
+
+export function hasPendingEventsForThread(threadId: string): boolean {
+    return getPendingEventCountForThread(threadId) > 0;
+}
+
+export const agentEventQueueInternal = {
+    sendCalendarUpdate,
+    sendSystemNotification,
+    sendTaskUpdate,
+    sendCustomEvent,
+    sendSteeringMessage,
+    broadcastToAgents,
+    getPendingEventCountForThread,
+    getPendingEventCountForAgentInstance,
+    hasPendingEventsForThread
+};
+
+export default agentEventQueueInternal;
*** End Patch

*** Add File: packages/server/src/sockets/agentEventQueueSocket.ts
+import logger from '../utils/appLogger';
+import { agentEventQueueStore } from '../stores/agentEventQueueStore';
+import { agentEventQueueCliService } from '../cliLib/agentEventQueueService.cli';
+import { uiSocketConnection } from './socketManager';
+import {
+    AgentEventMessage,
+    AgentEventQueueUIUpdate
+} from '../types/agentEventQueue';
+
+export const agentEventQueueSocketHandler = {
+    initialized: false,
+
+    initialize(): void {
+        if (this.initialized) {
+            return;
+        }
+
+        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:added', ({ queueKey, event }) => {
+            this.notifyUI('eventAdded', { queueKey, event });
+        });
+
+        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:consumed', ({ queueKey, count }) => {
+            this.notifyUI('eventsConsumed', { queueKey, count });
+        });
+
+        agentEventQueueStore.on('agentEventQueue:expired', ({ eventId, queueKey }) => {
+            this.notifyUI('eventExpired', { eventId, queueKey });
+        });
+
+        this.initialized = true;
+        logger.info('[AgentEventQueueSocket] Initialized');
+    },
+
+    async handleMessage(ws: any, message: any): Promise<any> {
+        const { action, params } = message;
+
+        switch (action) {
+            case 'getPendingEvents':
+                return await agentEventQueueCliService.getPendingEvents(params, {
+                    agentId: ws.agentId,
+                    agentInstanceId: ws.uniqueConnectionId,
+                    threadId: ws.threadId
+                });
+
+            case 'getQueueStats':
+                return await agentEventQueueCliService.getQueueStats();
+
+            default:
+                return {
+                    success: false,
+                    code: 'UNKNOWN_ACTION',
+                    message: `Unknown or unsupported action: ${action}`
+                };
+        }
+    },
+
+    notifyUI(
+        eventType: 'eventAdded' | 'eventsConsumed' | 'eventExpired' | 'queueCleared',
+        data: {
+            eventId?: string;
+            queueKey: string;
+            event?: AgentEventMessage;
+            count?: number;
+        }
+    ): void {
+        try {
+            if (!uiSocketConnection || uiSocketConnection.readyState !== 1) {
+                return;
+            }
+
+            const update: AgentEventQueueUIUpdate = {
+                type: 'agentEventQueueUpdate',
+                eventType,
+                data,
+                timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
+            };
+            uiSocketConnection.send(JSON.stringify(update));
+        } catch (error: any) {
+            logger.error(`[AgentEventQueueSocket] Error sending UI notification: ${error.message}`);
+        }
+    },
+
+    async onAgentConnected(agentId: string, _socket: any): Promise<void> {
+        logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueSocket] Agent ${agentId} connected; events remain in backend queue until consumed`);
+    },
+
+    onAgentDisconnected(agentId: string): void {
+        logger.debug(`[AgentEventQueueSocket] Agent ${agentId} disconnected`);
+    },
+
+    getQueueStats(): {
+        totalQueues: number;
+        totalPendingEvents: number;
+    } {
+        const stats = agentEventQueueStore.getStats();
+        return {
+            totalQueues: stats.totalQueues,
+            totalPendingEvents: stats.totalPendingEvents
+        };
+    }
+};
+
+export default agentEventQueueSocketHandler;
*** End Patch

]]></arguments>
</tool_call>

+import { EventEmitter } from 'events';
+import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
+import cbws from '../core/websocket';
+import type {
+    AgentEventMessage,
+    AgentEventQueueResponse,
+    GetPendingEventsInput,
+    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
+    QueueEventHandler,
+    QueueStatsResponseData
+} from '@codebolt/types/lib';
+
+export type {
+    AgentEventMessage,
+    AgentEventQueueResponse,
+    GetPendingEventsInput,
+    GetPendingEventsResponseData,
+    QueueEventHandler,
+    QueueStatsResponseData
+} from '@codebolt/types/lib';
+
+export {
+    AgentEventPriority,
+    AgentEventScope,
+    AgentEventType
+} from '@codebolt/types/lib';
+
+const eventEmitter = new EventEmitter();
+const eventHandlers = new Set<QueueEventHandler>();
+
+const eventAvailabilitySubscription = cbws.messageManager.subscribe('agentEventAvailable');
+eventAvailabilitySubscription.on('message', (message: any) => {
+    eventEmitter.emit('agentEventAvailable', message);
+});
+
+async function fetchAndConsumePendingEvents(params: GetPendingEventsInput = {}): Promise<AgentEventMessage[]> {
+    const requestId = randomUUID();
+    const response = await cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse<AgentEventQueueResponse<GetPendingEventsResponseData>>(
+        {
+            type: 'agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents',
+            requestId,
+            params
+        },
+        'agentEventQueue.getPendingEventsResponse'
+    );
+
+    if (!response.success) {
+        throw new Error(response.message || 'Failed to get pending agent events');
+    }
+
+    const events = response.data?.events || [];
+    for (const event of events) {
+        for (const handler of eventHandlers) {
+            handler(event);
+        }
+    }
+
+    return events;
+}
+
+const agentEventQueue = {
+    getPendingEvents: fetchAndConsumePendingEvents,
+
+    waitForNextEvent: async (params: GetPendingEventsInput = {}): Promise<AgentEventMessage | AgentEventMessage[]> => {
+        const pendingEvents = await fetchAndConsumePendingEvents(params);
+        if (pendingEvents.length > 0) {
+            return params.limit === 1 ? pendingEvents[0] : pendingEvents;
+        }
+
+        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
+            const onEventAvailable = async () => {
+                eventEmitter.removeListener('agentEventAvailable', onEventAvailable);
+                try {
+                    const events = await fetchAndConsumePendingEvents(params);
+                    resolve(params.limit === 1 ? events[0] : events);
+                } catch (error) {
+                    reject(error);
+                }
+            };
+
+            eventEmitter.once('agentEventAvailable', onEventAvailable);
+        });
+    },
+
+    onEvent: (handler: QueueEventHandler): (() => void) => {
+        eventHandlers.add(handler);
+        return () => {
+            eventHandlers.delete(handler);
+        };
+    },
+
+    getQueueStats: (): Promise<AgentEventQueueResponse<QueueStatsResponseData>> => {
+        const requestId = randomUUID();
+        return cbws.messageManager.sendAndWaitForResponse(
+            {
+                type: 'agentEventQueue.getQueueStats',
+                requestId,
+                params: {}
+            },
+            'agentEventQueue.getQueueStatsResponse'
+        );
+    }
+};
+
+export default agentEventQueue;
*** End Patch

/**
 * EventQueue Get Stats Tool
 * Wraps the SDK's agentEventQueue.getQueueStats() method
 */

import type { ToolInvocation, ToolResult } from '../types';
import { ToolErrorType, Kind } from '../types';
import { BaseDeclarativeTool, BaseToolInvocation } from '../base-tool';
import agentEventQueue from '../../modules/agentEventQueue';

/**
 * Parameters for the EventQueue Get Stats tool
 */
export interface EventQueueGetStatsParams {
    // No parameters required
}

class EventQueueGetStatsInvocation extends BaseToolInvocation<
    EventQueueGetStatsParams,
    ToolResult
> {
    constructor(params: EventQueueGetStatsParams) {
        super(params);
    }

    async execute(): Promise<ToolResult> {
        try {
            const response = await agentEventQueue.getQueueStats();

            if (!response.success) {
                return {
                    llmContent: `Failed to get queue stats: ${response.message}`,
                    returnDisplay: `Error: ${response.message}`,
                    error: {
                        message: response.message,
                        type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                    },
                };
            }

            const stats = response.data;
            let llmContent = `Queue Statistics:\n\n`;
            llmContent += `Total Agents: ${stats?.totalAgents || 0}\n`;
            llmContent += `Total Pending: ${stats?.totalPending || 0}\n`;
            llmContent += `Total Delivered: ${stats?.totalDelivered || 0}\n`;

            if (stats?.storage) {
                llmContent += `\nStorage:\n`;
                llmContent += `  Total Events: ${stats.storage.totalEvents}\n`;
                llmContent += `  Index Size: ${stats.storage.indexSize}\n`;
            }

            if (stats?.agentStats && Object.keys(stats.agentStats).length > 0) {
                llmContent += `\nPer-Agent Stats:\n`;
                for (const [agentId, agentStat] of Object.entries(stats.agentStats)) {
                    llmContent += `  ${agentId}: pending=${(agentStat as any).pending}, delivered=${(agentStat as any).delivered}\n`;
                }
            }

            return {
                llmContent,
                returnDisplay: `Queue: ${stats?.totalPending || 0} pending, ${stats?.totalDelivered || 0} delivered`,
            };
        } catch (error) {
            const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error occurred';
            return {
                llmContent: `Error getting queue stats: ${errorMessage}`,
                returnDisplay: `Error: ${errorMessage}`,
                error: {
                    message: errorMessage,
                    type: ToolErrorType.EXECUTION_FAILED,
                },
            };
        }
    }
}

currently multiple types of events were there from calender update to task update to pull events etc. So all these will now be routed through this event queue
</message>
<message role="assistant" ordinal="980" timestamp="2026-07-07T14:10:01.756Z">
Yes, with one important distinction: **event types** like steering, command completion, thread completion, calendar update, task update, and system notification should all be produced into the same backend queue. **Pull events** is not an event type; it was an old retrieval/ack mechanism, and in this model it becomes `getPendingEvents()` consume-on-read.

I noticed I made calendar update a `custom` event in the internal helper while simplifying. That is less clear than your intent, so I’m making `calendarUpdate` first-class in the normalized event type list too.
</message>

<message role="assistant" ordinal="1005" timestamp="2026-07-07T14:13:26.66Z">
Implemented the backend-first, read-only agent event queue model.

Yes: **runtime/app-originated events now route through the backend event queue** when they are intended for the agent loop. That includes `steering`, `backgroundCommandCompletion`, `threadCompletion`, `calendarUpdate`, `taskUpdate`, `systemNotification`, `forceStopCleanup`, `agentMessage`, and `custom`.

The exception is **`pullEvents`**: that is not an event type anymore. It was an old retrieval mode. The replacement public API is:

- `codebolt.agentEventQueue.getPendingEvents(...)`
- `codebolt.agentEventQueue.waitForNextEvent(...)`

Both consume normalized backend events. I removed public agent-facing producer APIs like `addEvent`, `sendAgentMessage`, and `acknowledgeEvent`, plus the old eventqueue add/send/ack tools.

Main changes:
- Backend queue now stores normalized pending events only, with `agent_instance` and `thread` scopes.
- Server/runtime producers use internal `enqueueEvent(...)`.
- SDK event queue is read-only for agents.
- `act-updated` now consumes `getPendingEvents()` and handles normalized events.
- Agent guidance no longer tells agents to use `eventqueue_send_message`.

Verification:
- Passed `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/types`
- Passed `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/codeboltjs`
- Passed `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/server`
- Passed `npm run build --workspace=@codebolt/agent`
- `act-updated` standalone `tsc` still fails because its local package resolution for `@codebolt/*` and TS libs is broken, unrelated to this queue change.

Full server `typecheck` still has many existing unrelated errors across controllers/utilities, so I used the server’s configured build command for validation.
